title: Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath from London
description: Unless you hire a car, visiting Stonehenge, Bath, and Windsor Castle in one day is next to impossible. Designed specifically for travelers with limited time in London, this tour allows you to check off a range of southern England's historical attractions in just one day by eliminating the hassle of traveling between each one independently. Travel by comfortable coach and witness your guide bring each UNESCO World Heritage Site to life with commentary. Plus, all admission tickets are included in the tour price.

reviews.usertext: This was my first time in the UK and the second time for my girlfriend. She had already done this tour in her first trip a few years ago. The tour was fantastic. Every place was beautiful. My personal favorite was the Bath. The tickets into the Bath were not included but it was worth paying the extra 40 pounds (for both of us) to go in and explore. Our overall tour experience was amplified tenfold by our tour guide Peter and our driver Andres aka Pringle. Peter is probably the best tour guide we have ever had. My girlfriend ended up having a lot better experience this time around because of Peter & Andres. Peter is truly knowledgeable and he clearly loves what he does. His kept the excitement & energy level high throughout and that just goes to show his dedication towards this and how much he loves & appreciates his country. We thought Peter was a good person as he ensured at the end of the trip that every person in the bus knows how to get back to their hotels from the drop off location. He was very respectful as well. The weather was pretty bad as it rained all day but Andres drove the bus like a true professional. Not once did we felt his driving was rash or he was trying to make risky moves. Visibility was low but he made sure everyone in the bus was comfortable throughout. We highly recommend taking a rain jacket and/or an umbrella as it can rain anytime and it gets very muddy around Stonehenge.

Overall it was an awesome day! Loved seeing Windsor Castle and walking around inside, then seeing Stonehenge and finally seeing the Roman Baths. But it felt incredibly rushed only being able to send an hour and a half at each place.

Also with the Roman Bath, make sure that you have pre-booked your entry fee as entry is not guaranteed as they are only allowed a minimum amount of people there each day. We only found this out 20mins before entering the town of Bath. But we’re lucky enough that it was a rainy day and we could go in.

Also the tour guide, though at the beginning seemed very nice, he ignored my partner and I, only ever taking to the other passengers and not even smiling at us. This came as a shock as we were always early to each bus departure and were overall really excited for this trip and really felt we didn’t deserve this. And to add to this the tour guide was seen by multiple passengers vaping on the bus.

Overall it was a great experience besides those few things and would highly recommend it to anyone wanting to see these places in the span of a day!

First of all, know that this is a HIGHLIGHT tour. If you want to take your time and read every sign and listen to all the audio guides, then this tour isn't for you. It's fast with short stops at each location, but you get to see the highlights of each location in a day.

Our first stop was Windsor Castle, which was open on Monday (check the schedule because it's closed Tues-Wed). Tours don't get to skip the line, so you will end up waiting a bit to get in, which cuts into your allotted time. We had about 1.5 hours to walk around on our own and grab a sandwich before hopping back on the bus. You can't take pictures inside the castle, so that helps ensure that lines move, but as I said, you won't have time to wander slowly if you want to see it all. We walked through the cathedral and the state rooms pretty quickly, but at least we saw it.

The next stop is Stonehenge. Luckily, our tour guide (Richard) bypassed the main line and got us on a shuttle bus to the site pretty quickly. We had about an hour to walk around, which was plenty since we were able to skip the line here.

Final stop was Bath. Again, we had 1.5 hours to walk around. We waited as a group to enter but it didn't take very long, then you can wander at your own pace, but you still don't have time to study everything. There was enough time to see the Roman baths, peek inside the abbey, and we even grabbed a snack and a beer before we left.

There are short stops, but you need to be on time!!! We left one couple behind at Windsor that were late, and we also picked up others who got left by their tour buses. It's a tight schedule and they are not messing around when they say that they will leave. At first I found that a bit rude that the guide kept harping on that, but now I see why. If you don't stick to the schedule, you end up waiting in long lines at each site which delays the whole tour.

It was a long day roughly 13 hours from pickup to drop off but it was so worth it. I wish we had a little more time at Windsor palace but understood we had a schedule to adhere to, but at least I got to see the final resting place of Queen Elizabeth. Stonehenge and Bath were great as well. If anyone is on the fence about doing this tour, just do it!! Now let’s talk about our tour guide for the day Richard, he was awesome! He’s full of so much knowledge, very professional and you can tell he is very passionate about his job. Our driver for the day was Barrington and he took us there safely and back, very smooth ride. Overall it was an awesome day, money well spent. Also when booking there are options to include the entry fees to Bath and Windsor Palace….just do it, get the package with everything included because when we got to Windsor palace some people on our bus did not get to come inside beside tickets were sold out for the day. Also check which days they allow people inside Windsor Palace because not everyday the public is allowed and choose you dates around that info if possible. Happy booking! I hope you are able to get Richard as your guide because he’s awesome.

Tour Guide Rowan was fantastic with right amount of information and humor to make the tour enjoyable even with proper British weather (cold, rainy, and windy).
Marion (sp?) the driver made the ride comfortable and smooth and took some detours from all the London construction to save us 15-30 minutes getting home.
Downside was unavoidable as there are more tourists heading to Windsor to see where Queen Elizabeth was buried so we didn’t get to enjoy the sites as the queue to get into Windsor and the shuttle bus at Stonehenge was super long.
We loved each stop and it is a wonderful tour to see Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath all in one day.
Just wished there was more time at each of the stops.

We had a great trip! The bus was easy to find and the directions were perfect. We stayed at the Double Tree behind Victoria Station so the Victoria Coach Station was a quick 7-8 minute walk.

Our guide, Rowan, and our driver were terrific. Rowan was very knowledgeable and her sense of humor made the narrative entertaining and engaging. We weren’t able to see Stonehenge up close because the site closed early without informing the travel company…but the driver drove very slowly so we could get pictures…and Evan Evans went out of their way to make it right. We received an email before we were even back in London stating we would be reimbursed for the trip since we didn’t get to see Stonehenge.

In Bath, we headed straight for the Jane Austin Centre…it’s not much but if you’re an Austin fan it is great! We headed straight there off the bus, did the tour, and made it back to the bus with no time to spare…but it was worth it!

I would recommend picking up a picnic lunch and snacks before you leave London because the stops are quick and if you want to sightsee you won’t have time for food.

We’d definitely take another Evan Evans Tour!

Robert (guide) and Idris (driver) were incredible! They got us everywhere quickly and made sure everything ran smoothly. Robert is so enthusiastic and knowledgeable about each site, especially Windsor Castle, where the queue flew by as he told us stories about Henry VIII and other monarchs that were a terrific lead-up to the visit. I am shocked by the reviews saying that tour felt rushed, because my boyfriend and I felt like it was the perfect amount of time in each location to see the highlights, grab a bite, or wander around. Robert and Idris also timed our stops to avoid the rain, which was very appreciated. HIGHLY recommend this tour!

Far too little time at Windsor Castle; longer than necessary at Stonehenge; and it was not made clear that the trip to Bath did not include the Baths! For the overwhelming majority of riders on our bus, no guidance was given on what to see while we waited over 2.5 hours for the guide to take a handful through the Roman Baths. If we had known about the Royal Crescent, the Art Gallery, or the Circus, we could have walked. Beyond that our guide expected a $40 tip per couple. If Evan Evans Tours wants to charge this much for this tour, then, provide better guidance and more appropriate timing.

We took a delightfully entertaining and comfortable bus tour from London to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath that we highly recommend to anyone. Our guide for the tour, Robert, shared his remarkable knowledge of the history of all three places, but with the delivery of a great storyteller. The journey was well organized, very comfortable, and our driver, Idris, made our long day’s journey through some pretty soggy weather and London traffic truly pleasant. An excellent choice among many, at good value.

We had a great time seeing Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath today. Our tour guide, Rhys, was so knowledgeable and I was really impressed with how much he knew. He even talked about points in London as we were exiting and re-entering the city.

The tour is exactly as advertised, so if you want more than an hour or so at each location, this tour is not for you. Rhys explained it well as he said it’s like ordering tapas at a restaurant instead of a main meal. You get a little taste of everything, but not the full experience of one particular place. It is a lot of time on a bus, but again, that is advertised. And yes, they will leave you (no one was left in our group bc everyone was punctual at each location) as they have certain driving time guidelines they must follow according to the law. It was enough time at each place to get the general gist, but not explore anything more than why you’re there.

Overall the locations were great, Rhys and our driver, Luan were incredible, and I highly recommend for anyone looking to see multiple sites in a short amount of time. Also, bring snacks! Not much time to eat during the day. We brought some fruit and chips and then waited until Bath to eat at a tapas restaurant in about 20 minutes.

This was a great tour that packed a lot into one day! Our tour guide, Bruce, was an amazing resource. His tips were spot on and by following his advice we are able to maximize the time at each site. For example, he recommended we get in line immediately at Windsor castle to pay our respects to the queen and as a result we were able to do that first and then go through the state apartments all before we needed to leave for the next site.

A bus tour is perfect for anyone who doesn't want to deal with the hassle of finding transportation to each site in an unfamiliar country. I was very impressed with the tour guide's knowledge of the places we visited and that he kept us on time so we made it to every place at our designated entry time. I would definitely recommend this tour!! Kudos to Armando our bus driver who got us to all destinations safely!

Eugene was a wonderful tour director! He made sure the temperate on the bus was perfect for everyone, he was very clear about what to expect with each stop, and he told informational and funny stories along the way.

Raad , our driver, was also very helpful! He made sure we had the best routes and avoided traffic jams, like at Stonehenge, and got us everywhere safely and soundly each time.

Overall, my 12 year old son and I had a wonderful time and thoroughly enjoyed this day-long adventure! Worth the money and great for all ages!

The female tour guide (forget her name) was very pleasant and knowledgeable, unfortunately, this was a very rushed experience. All three sites in one day is way too much, especially on a large bus tour, unless you just want brief highlights. Windsor Castle is extremely interesting and beautiful and is a "must see" but, due to the long cue, was very rushed inside and we had to literally run through St. George's Chapel at the end. The chapel itself is not an easy in and easy out. You must follow a designated path and it was very crowded. Got lost on the way back to the bus and was a few minutes late. A small map would have helped. Stonehenge was ok but was again very rushed and several people (we think 5) actually got left behind!!! Lastly, Bath was lovely but to see it, you really had no time to stop and eat lunch. We had ice cream cones. After the incident at Stonehenge, we were careful to get back to the bus early!!!

Having the sites organized and being escorted to them was very good. The tour guide and driver were great. It was a lot to fit into one day and the pace at the events was frantic, with lots of queuing up at each event. That queuing was a bit frustrating, but not a function of the tour guide so much as one of traffic and heavy demand at the sites. At times the ‘hurry off the bus’ / ‘hurry back to the bus’ left a slightly sour taste for us. If I had to do it again I would by tickets via the tour company for some of the sites at the site, because then you can walk right up to the cashier without the long group queue, or I would only choose 2 of the 3 events.

This was a good way to see a lot of sights in one day, but it is a packed itinerary. Our guide was knowledgeable and engaging, without being "over the top" or repetitive.

The only downside on this trip was that we really did not have quite enough time at each site. It felt very rushed, e.g. you could do a quick walkthrough, but not time to explore. For example, at Stonehenge, given the amount of time allotted for the stop and the lines to wait for the shuttle, we literally arrived at the site, walked a quick loop, and had to return to the bus - no time to even listen to the audio guide or stop in the little gift shop.

Also, given the length of the day, I would recommend travelers bring along a water bottle and snacks. Given how the day went at Stonehenge (which was our second stop around lunch time) we had no time to grab any lunch so we ended up eating lunch in Bath at like 3pm. The other advice I would give is to consider the impact of London traffic as you plan your day. No fault at all of the tour company, but this trip ended up being almost a 13 hour day for us due to a traffic jam, putting us back in London at almost 9pm!

If we were to do it again, I think we would book a trip with less stops but a little more time built in at each location to explore.

I went as a couple but because we booked separately as my partner had prior working arrangements which was cancelled last minute, we were assigned to separate tour buses. I was not made aware that there were 3 busses provided by the tour company departing at the same time. As a result, my partner had to be on a different bus which was travelling in a different direction!

Fortunately, my tour guide, Richard and my coach captain Rad (not sure if I got his name correct) had put in extra effort to reassign my partner to my coach. Richard graciously gave up his comfortable seat and had to sit on a foldable seat (sacrificing his poor back) for us! For that, we are super grateful to both of them!

The tour was good as well with the Vox system which allowed us to hear Richard throughout the tour clearly. Richard has lots of stories to tell us along the way and he is very fluent in many languages. He had put in extra effort to ensure we arrive at the destination slightly earlier and also provided ample time to explore the locations.

Rad is also a careful driver and always made sure we reached the destinations safely and promptly.

Thank you both for the wonderful day tour!

This was an amazing tour! My husband and I were only in London for 3 days, so we would not have seen all three of these places without this tour. Our guide, Kevin, did a fantastic job of keeping us on schedule all day. At each stop, he took us to the attraction entrance and repeatedly gave clear instructions on when to meet back at the bus. Entrance into each attraction was seamless. We felt that we had plenty of time to explore each location but not so much that we got bored. The walk to and from the bus at each location was quite short and easy to remember when it was time to head to the next stop.

My husband and I booked this tour mainly to see Windsor Castle and Stonehenge, both of which exceeded expectations. Surprisingly, Bath exceeded our expectations as well. When you book your tour, be sure to select the Roman bath entrance add-on as they were sold out for the day when we arrived and could not add on additional guests. The pictures don't do it justice and it's actually quite extensive once you get inside. It's well worth the extra cost. Our guide also recommended a local ice cream shop (La Cremeria Ice Cream Parlor) that was just across the square from the baths. It was a nice treat before heading back to London.

It is a long day, so be sure to pack some snacks. We were glad we had food to eat while on the bus so we didn't have to waste valuable time buying food at the various stops.

This is one of the best day trips I've been on in Europe. I would highly recommend to anyone!

Booked through Evan’s Evan Tours using aviator website. The tour took place starting at the Victorian coach station and we were greeted by our awesome tour guide Kevin and his the bus driver Luan. Kevin was super entertaining and gave us lots of information about the history of our destinations. The bus was super roomy and comfy with wifi, AC, and charger.

Our first stop was Windsor Castle and absolutely gorgeous castle where the Queen spends most her time. We got to go to the state apartments where heads of state are and also got pictures with royal queens guards Amin the courtyard. So much history in one place and such intricate artwork and craftsmanship from centuries of royalty.

Next stop was Stonehenge and it was very mystical seeing this huge rocks that were moved there before civilizations and recorded history. It’s really something else to see in person versus in pictures and the magnitude really hits you.

Last stop was Bath where Romans built ancient bathhouses during their conquest and occupation. The beautiful Roman architecture and statues were amazing to see in person and stepping into a place where people relaxed 2000 years ago was inspiring.

Make sure to pack food because hitting 3 sites in a day, you barely have enough time to explore the city or buy food at the shops and you are on a very tight schedule. Pay attention to Kevin in regards to time to make sure you know where and when to meet and you shouldn’t have much trouble and have an enjoyable experience!

Pros- Driver Alex and guide Lesley were great. Alex got us everywhere we needed to go on time and was a great driver.
Lesley, her voice is lovely. She’s very knowledgeable on this tour as she’s been doing it for almost 25 years. She explains everything you need to know to have the best time with the given amount of time available.
The three destinations were great. 1 hour on average at each spot. You definitely wish you had more time but the way the tour is structured you get enough time to enjoy each destination.
The buses were comfortable.
The CONS: they don’t offer any water or snacks on the 12 hour trip. Make sure to pack food/water ( which we did) as you won’t have time to see destination and get food.
I’m from the states so you have to test negative still to fly home. No one on the bus wears masks, and many were coughing nonstop and or sneezing, etc. (there’s 50 plus people) windows were up, so the 5 hour bus ride if your worried about covid etc can be a challenge.

Other then that- I’m happy I did this trip.

Be aware that this is a taste of each place with not much time at all at each place. You might have about an hour at each attraction. We found it very stressful and extremely rushed. By the time we got into Windsor Castle we had about 50 minutes before we had to be leaving in order to get to the bathroom and back on the bus. Stonehenge and Bath were the same. Most of the day was spent driving, which is fair since they are each quite far apart. I now wish that I had made my own way to Windsor Castle and Bath as they are worth a full day each, eventhough from London that would make it 2 long days.
So as long as you are aware that there is no time for looking around, just do the attention and get back on the bus, you will be good to go.
The tour guide Saul and our driver David were excellent.
Hints to make your day more enjoyable
1. Take a packed lunch, you don't have time for food!
2. Be there really early and try to find out where they will check you in (they will not check you in until 7:30 sharpe) but if you want a good seat on the bus you have to be there early. Seats are the same all day. (We were there at about 7:05 am and fortunately were the 1st ones on the bus so we chose right behind the driver).
3. When they say be back at a certain time, you better be back, or they leave you and arrange for another bus to bring you to the next site...seriously that happened on our tour!
4. You don't return till some time between 7 and 8 pm, just depends on traffic.
You see a lot but I will have to look at my pictures to remember what I saw because we went so fast I didn't feel in the moment.
Enjoy

Positives: Our tour guide, Manon, was absolutely wonderful and I’d rate her a 5/5 for her enthusiasm, entertaining personality, knowledge, and charisma. I appreciated the information she had to share about the sites we visited as well as those we passed while driving on the coach bus. Also, Greg, the coach driver, did a fantastic job getting us to our destinations safely and quickly.

Areas for Improvement: I wish the advertisement for the trip was more forthcoming regarding a) how little time you get to spend at each location and b) how little time there is to get any food and therefore a recommendation to bring food would have been appreciated. This truly is a “tapas” style trip. There was so little time at each destination that we had to rush through and did not have time to thoroughly enjoy the sites, explore, or see more than one small part of the site. If you want to get something quick to eat, you have to sacrifice another component of the site visit. Not including the time spent in line, I think we had approximately 45-60 minutes at each location, which simply wasn’t enough.

Although the time on site was so short, it did give us a glimpse into which sites we would like to visit again for a more thorough experience in the future.

While the staff (Driver and tour guide) and the places themselves were great, the duration for the amount of cash we paid was absolutely ridiculous. We spent about 10-15 minutes at each place, not even 30 full minutes, to truly enjoy and take in the views and history. Sure, it was supposed to be a tour for people with limited time, but not to the point that you finish off the tour so quickly!

This was a great way to see everything in a quick day. First stop at Windsor Castle which was definitely worth the wait. Long queue to start, but it moved fairly quick. We had a total of 1.5hrs at this stop. It was just enough time to see everything we wanted to, but we did have to rush through and don’t have time to read every info spot or listen to the audio guides.

Second stop is Stonehenge. I was apprehensive about this stop because of some reviewers stating “it is just a bunch of rocks”. I would have to disagree and say that Stonehenge is quite fascinating and beautiful. We had a total of 1hour at Stonehenge which was just enough time to shuttle to and from, walk the perimeter, get some awesome photos, and roam through the gift shop.

Third and final stop was Bath. I was mostly anticipating this stop but turns out that The Roman baths themselves were a little underwhelming. The city of Bath is beautiful and has an amazing charm and vibe. We will plan to spend much more time in Bath on our next trip. We had a total of 1.5 hrs in bath which allowed us time to tour the baths, tour bath Abby, and walk the shopping streets and allys.

Peter was our guide and did a great job answering questions , guiding us to and from each stop, and tossing in funny banter and lots of personality.

My only downsides to this tour are:
1, they do not allow hot drinks on the coach. Many of us had arrived 15-30 minutes early and spent that time buying coffee at the coach station. Right before we boarded, the tour guides announced that hot coffee was not allowed and we all had to throw out the fresh coffee that we had just purchased minutes earlier. A note of this policy would be good due to the early hour of the tour.
2, the stops were great and just enough time to see each place. There really wasn’t any extra time anywhere to grab a proper lunch. There were long lines at all of the food vendors and more coffee shop style places than grab and go lunch options. I would recommend to extend the time spent at Windsor to allow more time to grab lunch. Or, recommend to all patrons to bring their own sack lunch onboard.
3, none of the stops are very conducive to persons with limited mobility. It is a lot of walking, standing in queue, and very limited stop to test areas. There was an elderly gentleman in our group who utilized a cane and I’m not sure that he was able to see everything he wanted.

First, i like the fact that we had enough time on each stop. Just enough to explore the castle, stonehenge, and roman bath. Tours are very strict with times so we appreciate everybody in the tour respecting that.

Second, company has constantly communicated via email or text to make sure we got the tickets and we were aware of where and when to meet at the start of the tour. Easy booking and cancellation.

Third, tour coach was clean, comfortable, and driver Joe kept us safe. It is a big deal because we spent a lot of time travelling. Almost the whole day.

Lastly, our tour guide Mel was great. Shared a lot of history and facts about the places. Included history which some of the tourist were curious about. He clearly gave out reminders and instructions which is important for a big group like ours and especially when keeping with the time was essential. He also made sure we are okay when we get back to London. I liked that he knows the clean toilets to use because i personally cant stand dirty and stinky public toilets.

My wife and I took Tour 21 out of the Victoria Coach Station at 8am. The bus departed promptly at 8:01 so would recommend getting there a bit early, especially if you’ve never been to that station before (we hadn’t and ended up in the back of the line/bus). The coach is roomy enough with comfortable seats but doesn’t allow hot drinks or food on board so make sure to get your fix before you go (we packed some cold sandwiches).
Our tour guide was Saul Z. and our driver was Jo. They are both amazing at what they do (I wouldn’t want to navigate that huge bus through the tiny crowded streets of London)! Saul was extremely friendly and knowledgeable and kept us informed of the strict itinerary the entire way. He is also multilingual and would translate for other groups as we went along. Definitely pay attention to the timeline he provides as the bus will have to leave you behind if you don’t return within the window given.
Windsor Castle was overwhelmingly grand and we wished we had a whole day to explore it, along with the town. There’s cafes there too if you need to get any food or beverage before heading off.
Stonehenge is as special a place as they come. Even with all the other tourists present there still exists a reverence over the entire place. Again, could’ve spent more time here if given the chance.
The last stop was Bath. This city is rich with history and the Roman Bath House is deceptively huge. It’s very interactive and informative and sits in the shadow of the very old Abbey Church of Saint Peter and Saint Paul, which you can tour as well if you have time. There’s also places here to grab a coffee or bite if you’d like (I found a pub and my wife found a chocolate shop).
The drive back to London is just under 3 hours and is a good time to chat about your favorite parts, look through photos, or even take a nap. You’ll wake up back in London around 7:45pm refreshed and ready for dinner!
Overall we would highly recommend this tour. Even though we would’ve loved to stay at each place longer, to have a guide and a ride was so helpful and convenient. You can’t beat this experience!

took a tour with kevin and corey for stonehenge, bath and windsor castle. corey got us to and from each location safely and as quickly as he could and kevin shared his knowledge on english culture throughout the ages in a witty and funny manner. 10/10 recommend. they give you enough time to explore on your own, but be sure to be back at the meeting point to ensure a timely departure.

We had a wonderful time touring Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. It was a long day but it went by quickly and on top of it all it was an unexpectedly sunny day despite the rainy forecast. Our tour guide, Richard Morrell, was extremely knowledgeable and shared a lot of interesting stories about British history and culture along the way. He kept everything running smoothly, accommodating some special needs in our sizable group. And our driver, Rafael, did an excellent job navigating the ins and out of the road, including heavy traffic on our return. If you have a chance to book a tour with Richard I highly recommend it!

Wow, what a fantastic trip! wether you have some time in London or maybe even just a little time, this is the trip to take! Earl is by far one of the best coach drivers I have ever experienced. His fun and playful humor made the day and drives from spot to spot even more enjoyable. Richard is by far one of the best guides I have every had for a tour. He is so knowledgeable, quick witted, and kind.

It was a perfect day to see the three(4) sites. The headsets for the tour were clutch too! Not having Richard shout like all the other guided tours around us, you were able to hear him clear without him raising his voice.

They switched up the order of the tour so that we could go to each places without the mass of other tours being there as well…pure genius.

Richard also noticed that i was traveling solo and made sure that I felt ok and paired me up on the bus with another solo gal, that we ended up becoming friends and enjoyed the day together!

I can’t say it enough, but if your going to book anyone you need to book them! I wanted to bring both with me to Scotland To have the beat tours there too!

Went on a tour with Peter today to Windsor, Stonehenge, and Bath and had a fantastic time. We got so lucky with beautiful weather and a smooth coach ride. Peter was very well informed and relaxed and helped make the process stress free. Like he said, this was more of a teaser tour to introduce other parts of England so that you know where you would like to come back and visit.

Windsor is absolutely stunning (the queen was in the day we went!) and the state room tour was beautiful. I would love to come back to spend more time exploring the castle. Stonehenge was as amazing as you would expect - we got some handy maps and audio guides and had plenty of time to listen to look at the rocks. Again, would be lovely to spend some more time exploring the surrounding country side. And finally Bath, my personal favorite. I didn’t even have the ticket for the Roman baths but fell in love with the city anyways. It’s the most beautiful city and is what I pictured when I thought of England. Like our tour guide said, take out the cell phones and cars and it’s like you’re back in 1800 England. I loved seeing the parade, exploring the little shops, getting ice cream and seeing the canal and garden. I would absolutely stay here on my next visit to the UK.

I highly recommend this tour if these locations are of interest to you. For the convenience, security, and experience, you can’t beat the price. It’s a great way to spend the day and see some historic sights outside of London. One tip: I would buy lunch before hand so you don’t need to spend time at any of the sights to get some. I bought a sandwich at the Pret in the train station and it was an excellent decision.

Great tour by Evan Evans! Our tour guide Chrissy made it a great experience with her knowledge of the destinations and her passion for what she does. Rod was a great driver. He made the 12 hour day trip feel like it was nothing. Majority of our time was spent on the bus during the trip so we appreciated his focus and careful driving.

As our lovely tour guide said, this was definitely a "tapas" tour of each location. I knew going into the tour that it wouldn't be enough time but it did do a great intro into each location. Overall a great way to see each site if you have limited time! If you have more time, I would recommend visiting these places on your own to spend more time there.

I would have liked more tour like narration on the bus ride (since that is easily the majority of the day). I also wish masking was more encouraged since we were all on a crowded bus. I 100% caught covid from my trip, so I just recommend that everyone be prepared for that possibility.

I also could have done without Stonehenge. I wish this tour group also offered a tour of just Windsor and Bath to allow more time at both.

Simply fabulous tour. Our tour guide Mel Adams had an amazing wealth of historical knowledge that was shared in an insightful yet entertaining manner. This is the perfect way to see several must see sites while learning about the culture and history.

The coach was very comfortable and our driver Luan did a very good job in heavy traffic and a bit of weather. I felt very safe.

If you are visiting London and wish to explore this should be on top of your list.

I took the Windsor, Stonehenge, Bath tour today. The tour was very interesting and informative. Our tour guide, Bruce was both knowledgeable and amusing as he guided us for the nearly 12 hour tour. His insistence on being on time was instrumental in assuring our prompt arrival at each location ahead of most of the other tourist coaches. This put us near the front of the queue at each location. Our driver, Armando, also did an excellent job of driving us smoothly and safely from the start through the end of the journey. The efficiency and experience of these two gentlemen was instrumental in making this a fantastic trip. Each venue that we visited was well organized and relatively easy to traverse for most everyone. However, be prepared for several staircases and a fair amount of walking. There's not much time to stop and revel at the sights, yet there is enough to enjoy an overview of each of these historic sites. Plan to bring food and refreshments if you care to eat because there isn't much time to stop and dine. Also, comfortable walking shoes and a charging cable for your phone would be helpful. I strongly recommend this tour and plan to do it again once my wife visits.

Our tour was perfect for someone who has limited time in the UK and wants to cover as much as possible. Our guide Eugene was very informative, passionate about his work and overall real nice guy. Our driver Merick was also always on time, very gentle and experienced. Both are the best in the business! Would 100% recommend for anyone passing thru thru UK and want to explore outside London!

Our tour guide Godfrey was great, very friendly and entertaining which was helpful since there's a bit of bus riding involved, naturally, to get to and fro. He was very knowledgeable and used the time before each stop to inform on do's and don'ts and provide useful information and tips for each stop. Each stop was interesting in its own right. Be prepared to move quickly since you're doing a lot in one day! All in all a great day trip, highly recommended.

Rowan was the best tour guide ever! She was very funny and personable and gave us a lot of great tidbits. We felt like she took a personal interest in making sure everyone had a wonderful experience and she gave us numerous tips to get the most out of each location. Her commentary was very interesting and showed how thoroughly she prepares for her tours. We were able to see 3 great locations that we may not have reached otherwise. While we wish we had more time in Bath as we only got to see the Roman Baths there, this we completely understand this was due to the length of the day and no fault of the tour company. In fact, some folks on the tour took the option to stay in Bath and make their own way back to London via train. Gregory was also the most skilled bus driver we had of the three tours we went on with various companies. We appreciated the smooth ride and felt very comfy on the bus the whole time!

The entire experience as a whole was amazing. Our guide, Saul Zamora, contributed a lot to our enjoyment of these different historic landmarks. He was very knowledgeable about the history and purposes of the different locations and was able to keep the mood upbeat while still being professional. Saul and the driver, Raad, went out of their way to ensure that everyone felt comfortable and accommodated, giving us realistic expectations of what one was able to do with the time allotted. In short, this was rather comfortable and enlightening.

Took this tour on the second Saturday of October. We had beautiful weather and a smooth drive. Although each stop is not incredibly long, the only spot we really felt was too tight was Windsor. It felt like our tour guide (who was very nice) just spent too much time speaking to us about the history while standing on the pavement in the town, when she should have immediately led us to the castle's entry line and spoken to us about it all as we waited there. Instead, since we took so long standing there outside, when we did walk to the entry line, it was extremely long and we spent way too much time waiting to enter and pass security. That left us about half hour to "run" through Windsor Castle.

We felt we had a decent amount of time at Stonehenge, and at Bath. Although by the time we got to Bath, we were in need of a good pint and some sustenance so after walking through town for a brief 15 minutes or so, my mom and I sat at a local pub instead of doing any real touring. We didn't feel like we missed much, although we would love to go back to Bath and spend a whole day there some time in the future.

Our bus seemed brand new--extremely clean, and comfortable. Only thing is the seat can get a bit tight when the person in front of you reclines. I know the option to recline is there, but it really makes things uncomfortable for those sitting behind you. And if you must recline, let the person behind you know before you do, because if they have anything on their table, it will go flying when you do! Just a suggestion :)

We had the most amazing tour with Monica as our guide and Rafael as our driver! This is a whirlwind tour covering a good chunk of the South in a 12 hour span. It will give you an opportunity to see Windsor castle (pay for the castle tour it’s worth it), Stone Henge (dress warm) , and Bath ( Tour of Roman baths extra). We loved Bath and now having seen it we will come back to spend more time in the town itself. Next trip we will come when it’s a bit warmer to do the sunrise trip to Stone Henge so we can actually walk within the stones. Not having traveled to the south before it was an exceptional introduction. Highly recommend this tour

The bus is (going home for the conclusion of the tour now) a germ pool and a COVID nightmare. 98% filled, only one or two seats are open and we’re caught between a bus driver who should have called out sick today and has coughed profusely the entire trip while wearing his mask as a chin guard and another passenger who is clearly very ill with a very crackly cough. She shouldn’t have been allowed on the tour but nobody has said a word to either. Only glaring looks of freight and disappointment.

The tour itself was lovely but it’s disheartening that Evan Evans tours has filled everything to capacity with no proper ventilation. Bad on me for staying on the bus in the morning when I saw how jam packed we were but had the symphony of coughing and crackling started before we left I would have definitely gotten off. Hope none of us get COVID from this as I’m sure we all have tests to take before we fly home. Incredibly uncomfortable and disappointing.

Well worth the day. Great addition to our vacation. The tour guide Robert was very knowledgeable and pleasant. Pay extra to be able to see the Roman bath at Bath cus it’s not included in the price and if there’s a large crowd you may not have enough time.

Seeing three far flung places in one day is challenging, but this was a top-flight operation. I used two other tour companies on this trip to London, and there’s no comparison. Our guide Richard was exceptionally knowledgeable, and did a wonderful job shepherding us through the tour. I would recommend, however, going on a tour with just two stops so you’re not rushed. I would absolutely use Evan Evan’s again.

We took this tour on our way to a cruise in Southampton. The company could not have been more helpful! Our guide was Leslie (I know that is not the correct spelling - please accept my apologies!). We got to Windsor in plenty of time to be able to tour and see the chapel where the Queen was recently put to rest - amazing, solemn and wonderful. We continued on to Stonehenge and toured the area and left the group at that point to make our own way on to Southampton. The driver was great in loading and unloading our luggage - and the tour guide was just awesome. I'm sure the continuation on to Bath was grand as well.

This tour is a great way to get a taste of each of these locations. One could easily spend an entire day in Windsor or Bath but this tour will expose you to enough that you’ll get a great introduction in just a day. The guide gives you a lot of information and history while on the bus and then you’re given an audio guide at each location to go through at your own pace.

With the Queen now living full time in Windsor, we were only able to tour the state apartments. We also visited on a Sunday so St. George’s Chapel was not open to the public, but there was still plenty to see and the audio guide contains a lot of information. If you get through it quickly definitely spend some time walking around Windsor.

You can get through the Stonehenge audio guide pretty quickly so if I had to change anything about the tour it would be to spent slightly less time here to have more time in Windsor or Bath.

The Roman Baths are very interesting and well preserved. The audio guide was informative. Walking around Bath was also very nice and I wish we could have spent a little more time here, but it was a great introduction.

Our tour guide Richard was fantastic. He has such a wealth of knowledge about all of the places we visited and beyond, and was so helpful with giving his expert tips and recommendations for each of the places we visited in addition to places we were visiting after London.

Arrive at the bus station early to give yourself enough time to find the right gate. The bus itself was comfortable with a bathroom on board (no coffee allowed on the bus so make sure you finish it beforehand). There’s no designated lunch break and grabbing something at one of the locations takes away from the limited time you have to enjoy them, so I would recommend packing lunch/snacks so you can eat on the bus.

I would absolutely recommend taking this tour.

This was the perfect way to see the three sites. Our driver Earl was upbeat with a great sense of humor. Our tour guide was Richard. He had a wealth of information about each site, as well as London in general. He was very attentive to everyone’s needs, including speak Spanish to one lady in our party.

Our coach was new and comfortable. As the day we went was the eve of Queen Elizabeth’s funeral, the roads upon our return were clogged. Rather than spend interminal hours trying to get to Victoria Station, they dropped us at Sloan square so we were able to take the subway to our hotel. I recommend this tour, Richard and Earl!

This tour was awesome! Each place had a different aesthetical and historical feeling that I really enjoyed. The ride through the Cotswolds was also really enjoyable. Katia, our guide, could not have asked for anyone better. She was very funny, knowledgeable and delivered the information in a way that everyone could understand it. She was very engaging and patient with everyone on a personal level. Also, John the driver was the real hero of our journey! An overall awesome experience! Thank you Katia and John truly.

My husband and I celebrated our 30th wedding anniversary in London and took a day tour to Stonehenge, Windsor and Bath. It was a rainy day but I assure you this trip is a must do…rain or shine. Stonehenge was a beautiful site to see at every angle, Windsor was spectacular and grand. Luckily we got to pay our respects to Queen Elizabeth, visited the state rooms and walked the grounds. Bath had the Roman baths and reminded of a fortified town in the Tuscan regions. There were many places to eat and shop. Pretty cool place to see!
I hope you would be so lucky as to get Robert (Evans & Evans tour) as your guide. He made sure we were all safe and he was very attentive and informative with his historical narrative of each site. As well he even included some witty humor. This is a plus! This made the tour all the more relaxing. Also let’s not forget our driver Idris. I must include him in this review bc if it wasn’t for him this tour could have been a bumpy ride through some of the terrain, plus his gracious smile put us at ease. Robert made sure everyone had their seatbelts on bc he informed us that it might be a bumpy ride to Stonehenge. I was so relaxed with Idris at the helm and having command of his bus that I didn’t feel a thing. It actually put me to sleep. Overall this tour gets 10 stars from me and my husband, plus another 10 stars to Robert and Idris the….Evans & Evans dynamic duo!!!!

We went with EvansEvansTours for this daytrip to Windsor Castle, Stonehedge and Bath. The tour was great, we booked entries to all sights. we had enough time to get an impression of all sights. Only windsor Castle would have been good to extend the stop by 30 min. We recommend to take the early tour so you manage to see the guard change at windsor Castle, which takes place at 11:00 am. Our tour guide Peter has given us great insights all the Journey and driver John was driving carefully, they both were fantastic. This tour, the Guide and Company are highly recommended.

We had a wonderful trip to the cities of Windsor and Bath, and ofcourse stonehedge! Our tour was unfortunately very wet and rainy but Bath and Windsor were mainly inside for what time we had there. Godfey was a very informed tour guide who kept the tour light and interesting. Biggest recommendation we have for anyone planning to go is to bring food with you as there's very little time to get anything to eat! You'll be so busy running around you won't have time to wait for food too. Totally worth it to go.

We missed the tour bus at the Stonehenge because the line of the shuttle bus that took us back to the tour bus parking place was very long, and it took us more than 15 minutes to get on the shuttle bus. After 30 minutes of panicking and looking for alternatives, fortunately, another tour bus has a few extra seats and kindly took us; otherwise, our trip would be totally ruined. I wish the tour guide would gave us a warning about the timing getting on the shuttle bus.

I can throughly recommend this tour especially through Evan and Evans. Other tour services have vary degrees of professionalism. For instance other services can't guarantee you get all the features their best buses offer as they use a variety of buses. Evan Evans though have standardized their coaches meaning that you always get the best quality bus they have will all the features you were promised. This sense of professionalism translates accross the board as my guide, Richard, and bus driver, Michelangelo, were some of the most fantastic tour guides I have ever had. Richard constantly kept the tours lively while not being over bearing. This was easy for him as Evan Evans uses devices to allow the tour guide to talk to you wherever you are at the sight. Meaning you can look at what you want while they give you the information. His enthusiasm and passion for traveling was infectious and truly made the experience something else. Michelangelo as well drove perfectly safe and was willing to help unlike most bus drivers that simply want to drive and be left alone. Couldn't recommend Evan Evans enough they have been doing tours more than any other company out of London which has clearly helped them become as professional as they are.

Amazing experience! Our tour guide Eugene went above and beyond with added commentary, great stories, knowledge, and humour. My husband and I throughly enjoyed all three sites and thanks to an amazing driver Dave we were often ahead of the other tour groups meaning .. we got closer to the front of the line for activities ♥️

Seeing the history in person. We'd read about and seen sights in movies, now we got to see them in person. Simon our guide and Idris the driver were fantastic, and Simon's humor was quite enjoyable throughout the day (especially when sharing the origin of phrases).

We got out from Windsor Castle on time as suggested from tour guide but was lost because we were directed to wrong train station where the coach was. When we contact the tour operator, to either connect us with tour guide so we can find the right location. She refused to connect us and simply said we need to make to the coach on time or they will leave without us. We were warned by tour guide in the beginning they do leave without waiting but we were out on there on time as suggested. Not only the operator refused to connect the tour guide to help find the location, she was simply rude! We make ourselves to next destination was given inaccurate information again by tour operator. We called tour operator and was treated very rude again by the lady and not willing to help. While we owned the part we should have remembered our way to the coach, but we got no help from the tour operator and she was rude. I just don’t understand why she couldn’t connect us with the tour guide to help! Missing the rest of the tour was one thing, but refusing to help with bad attitude is another. The first part of tour to Windsor Castle was great by the tour guide. The tour operator made it the worst experience!

Great experience for the whole family (2 adults and an 18 and 14 year old)! Robert, our guide was exceptional (and I’ve been on many.) He was super knowledgeable and had great historical insight served up in a very entertaining manner. Our kids listened the whole time! Idris, our driver was amazing - no idea how he was able to maneuver the bus, but he did do magically.

The overall experience was fantastic. We were disappointed that entry into Windsor Castle was prohibited but it's out of the control of the tour company. They in fact refunded us for that portion which was very nice.

Our tour guide, Saul, was an amazing tour guide. The group had both English and Spanish speakers and he was excellent in giving a bilingual tour! I'd give him 5 stars alone.

In summary, this experience was worth it.

So many tours operators to choose from, however I spent several days researching the trips that I was planning for my family of 4 with two tweens (11 and 13). All reviews pointed to Evan Evans tours. We were not disappointed. Our tour guy, Mr. Richard M. and our driver Mr. Joe. were fantastic. Richard was very knowledgeable and very enthusiastic and he love being our director.
The tour bus (Coach) left the Victoria Coach Station on time. Our first stop was at Windsor Castle, we were able to see the State Apartments only since our tour was on Sunday so we were not able to see the Chapel. We only had 55 minutes to tour the Castle. I would recommend to spent there at least 4 hours because there is so much to see.
Our next stop was at Stonehenge, there is not much I can say. The place is unbelievable and it’s hard to believe it’s so ancient.
Our last stop was at Bath to see the Roman Baths which are the oldest (best preserved in Europe). We had 1.5 hrs there. It was perfect time to see the Roman Baths.
The tour gave us a quick glimpse on what we wanted to see. We are planning on separate trip to Windsor Castle to see more and spend more time there.
I would highly recommend this tour for anyone including families with kids (+7yo).

It was a worthwhile experience . The driver Marius was OK and the tour guide, Ana was absolutely amazing where she was very helpful , eloquent and connects with every individual on the tour. Moreover, she was very helpful of any information and transportation for newcomers in London. If I ever cover a country like Spain, i would wish Ana was my guide.

Awesome tour. We booked our tour through Contiki. Had Nicholas and Kevin as our tour guide and bus driver. Nice bus with a USB port which meant we never had to worry about low phone battery. So we could take as many photos and videos as we wanted. Nicholas did an awesome job explaining the historical aspects of the places we visited and also went above and beyond as a tour guide assisting everyone in all the locations we visited. Also made sure we were first to arrive at the castle in order to explore as much as we could in a limited time frame. Kevin was an awesome bus driver who manoeuvred smoothly through the English country side and urban city. Would definitely recommend this tour if you just wanna quickly visit these places without worrying about organising anything.

This tour was well organized (once we departed) and well worth the money.
The visits to the sites were organized and enjoyable.
We arrived at Windsor Castle a bit early but it helped with the crowds.
The visit to Bath went off without a hitch.
There was a medical emergency at Stonehenge that affected our tour but we worked around it and had a good time.

The guide (Eileen) worked very well with the participants and the driver.
She kept us informed and handled the details at each of he stops very well.
She handled some “uncooperative” participants with tact.

What a memorable day! Simply Amazing!! Leslie, tour guide, gave us helpful narratives and tips for each visit which allowed us to do and see the “best bits”. Rad, the driver, was excellent and got us to and fro safely. I would recommend this trip to anyone, especially if Leslie is the guide!

My husband and I visited London in February for a few days and wanted to explore the "countryside." After reading the reviews from previous guests, we decided to book with Evan Evans Tours. Monica and Mark were the best tour guide and driver. We chose to participate in the three-attraction tour. We started out at Windsor...we were there early, so we were able to be in the front of the entrance. Tip: Leave your cameras on the bus....you are not allowed to take pictures in any of the buildings which was disappointing. We headed over to Stonehenge next which was about an hour away. It was a dreary, misty and cold day, so we took the shuttle bus up to the site, but the mile-long walk looked nice for a more sunny and warm day. The rock formations were interesting and the grounds are beautiful. Heading to Bath took about an hour and a half. It was really amazing seeing the bath still actively flowing with hot springs. Windsor and Bath are both enchanting towns with plenty of shopping and food options. Pack some snacks and water for the bus ride since you will on the road the entire day. Hot food and hot drinks are not permitted on the bus, and there is not restroom. Bring some extra cash to tip...we had no cash on us and felt sorry we didn't have anything to leave since Monica and Mark really went out of their way to accommodate us and ensure we made the most of the experience.

Choosing this tour was a smart decision as we had an awesome experience from start to finish. Richard (our guide) was super professional, experienced, courteous with the right amount of humour through the day (ask for his Michael Caine impressions). James (our skipper) was great too and together they make a great team and ensure you have a great experience. Highly recommend them.

Having Mel as our tour guide and Bosco as driver led to a great experience! Mel is funny and memorable. He was also very knowledgeable and had multiple interpretations/perspectives of history. This was one of our best experiences on our trip. We chose to have entry to Stonehenge (not in season for inner circle tour yet), Windsor Castle and didn’t go into the Roman Baths. Instead, we got to explore the city of Bath, visiting Bath’s Abbey and seeing where the first King of England was crowned, along with memorials dating back to the late 1600’s. This was also the best opportunity to eat compared to all the locations visited. Only opportunity we found were loads of gum stuck to the food tray on the bus (seat 33 or 34), which was likely an inconsiderate prior tourist.

This was an excellent tour! Eugene was an amazing tour guide; he was funny, approachable, and very knowledgeable about the sites we visited and the UK in general. Cory was an excellent driver as well! I do think the sign in process was hectic at Victoria Coach Station; we almost missed our bus because the staff member pointed us to the wrong line. I recommend getting there at least fifteen minutes early just so you can find them. Also, I think we could have spent thirty minutes more at each location, especially Windsor Castle. Bath is an amazing city to visit; my family and I wished we could go back. Try the ice cream, it is the best!

Highly recommended to you if you have not much time travel by yourself to the three landmark of England.Our guide Danxia is very nice.On the coach, she talked a lot of interesting things about three Landmarks.And she said everything very clearly,such as the meeting point and when to leave etc. She also gave us suggestions of where to go in London and help us.manage the routes. Also, the driver is skillful on climbing the twisting mountain roads to show us the good viee of Bath villages. Thanks for the hard work to drive a day long.It is such a full schedule day.

I went on this tour with my husband and mother-in-law, and we had a marvelous time! Barry (the driver) and Godfrey (our tour guide) took very good care of us and ensured we had as much fun as possible. Be advised that this tour may feel very fast, as you get to see three major tourist spots all in the span of one day; if you want loads of time in one or all of these spots, I’d recommend a tour with fewer stops. But for us, it was just what we wanted. It was a chance to explore as much as possible over the span of one day. Godfrey was well informed and kept us laughing while Barry made us feel safe on the road. It was a long day, and it was a lot of driving, but for us, it was worth it. We would definitely visit with this company again and would be happy to tour with Godfrey and Barry again. Thank you!

Definitely well worth the money, this tour takes you to 3 destinations that would otherwise require at least two days. Our tour guide Robert was delightful and charismatic, and the tour itself was great. Only suggestion would be more time spent at Stonehenge, but otherwise it was a smooth day. Our driver Raphael was awesome as well!

Manon was the best tour guide we have had on our 6 weeks in Britain.,Not only did she tell us about what we booked to see but she pointed out some amazing sights along the way. She made sure everyone was back to the bus on time which made everyone’s tour enjoyable which some guides don’t. By far the best tour in Britain. Sam our driver was a legend too.

We took this tour when Windsor castle was closed due to the queens death, but it was still a great experience. Our guide, Saul Zamora was phenomenal - he knew how to manage the group professionally on a tight schedule and gave us a lot of great info along the way. Our driver Barrington also made it a pleasant journey. Bus was in excellent shape and very comfortable. Don’t miss getting fish and chips at the place where the bus drops off in Bath - best I’ve had anywhere!

We attended to a lovely all day tour with the guidance of Nicholas, who is the Hitchhiker's Guide to Great Britain. The whole day was sharp and perfectly organised, everything was clear and well understandable. Our driver, Michael Angelo was a real artist with the steering wheel, the very composer of the safe driving.
We are satisfied, all the tours here are highly recommended!

We had Robert and Luan as our guide and driver. Robert was very knowledgeable and the drive between places seemed to fly by as he gave so much information and told many stories. Luan drove us safely from place to place. This is a great day trip if you are short on time in London and are looking to accomplish a lot in a day. It’s a great way to get a taste of the sights! I highly recommend bringing your own lunch and snacks so you don’t have to bother with that at the sights.

We had a very nice trip and enjoyable tour by Pepe in Premium tours today with Andrew the coach driver . The trip itself is memorable with Pepe he made it more like you lived those days as he narrated the historical with his own way of enthusiasm .
Will 101 percent recommend Premium tours with Pepe as our tour guide .

Simon was our guide. He was fantastic! Personable and knowledgeable. Alex was our driver and did a wonderful job. The coach was very comfortable with USB charging ports. Each stop you just get “a taste” of the area. If you’re looking to spend leisurely time at any of the places, this is not the tour for you. We had a short amount of time in the area, so this was perfect for us to be able to see all of these sights. Would recommend to anyone with the same circumstances.

Fantastic trip and fantastic tour guide! Guided tours are so much more informative then just walking about town (which we did a lot). I wish we had gone on this tour early in our trip to England to capture so much of the history, and then done our follow up walks.
The coach (bus) was clean and comfortable and the guide took the personal attention to make sure each person was as engaged as they wanted to be and got the most out of the trip. Thanks to Mel (guide) and to Barry (driver) for such a great time!

We had a great time on this tour. It does take some time to get into Windsor Castle and there is more to see outside of the castle as well. I recommend going there when you have extra time another day. Our tour guide Rowan was amazing and made our trip very enjoyable. She was knowledge and helpful! I would recommend this tour because it does get you to major spots, there just isn’t enough time in the day to fit every single part of each spot. We expected that since it is far from London.

Godfrey our tour guide and Michelangelo our driver were both terrific .This was a well planned tour- Godfrey gave us the history of each place we saw and gave clear instructions on what to see and where to meet- as well as helped us plan out when to get water, coffee and food.He took very good care of us and the pace was well thought out as well-just enough time at each stop.We highly recommend this tour for anyone who is interested in seeing these sights.

The locations themselves were great, but there were a few different challenges. There was one person on the tour that was late a couple different times and made it so we were all sitting on the bus waiting. We had first booked a tour for Bath and Stonehenge, but then were told it was cancelled and we needed to rebook for the tour including Windsor. So, we cancelled and rebooked, and then as we were boarding the bus, they told us that Windsor castle was actually closed. So, in Windsor, we ended up mostly just walking around the town on our own. Then in Bath, the guide told us the Roman Baths were closed, and we only had limited time, but then when we walked around there, we discovered the baths were actually open, so at least 50% of our tour stood in line, bought tickets, and hustled through the baths on their own. Which was pretty awesome, but would have been better with clearer scheduling. Stonehenge was amazing. We had great weather and just soaked in the history of it. The bus itself was nice and USB ports in each seat, and the guide did a good job teaching us about London while we were in route.

We had taken the day trip out of London and it was very well organised. Richard was really good in explaining the historical aspects and made the tour fun. The driver (name forgotten) was warm and welcoming and was exceptional in maintaining the tour schedule in spite of a delay due to crash on the highway. If you are planning for this trip I would suggest you to choose Richard as your guide.

Great bus tour for those with limited time in england! Seeing Stonehenge was on our bucket list so that is why we booked it It was a plus to also get to see Windsor and Bath. If you have the time, Windsor and Bath could be a full day by themselves wuth all that you could see,, and to shop.
Our tour guide Rowan kept us on schedule and entertained with stories while on bus. Be prepared: It is a long day sitting on a bus so dress comfortably, bring snacks/lunch and understand that you are on a strict timetable so will need to walk quickly from bus to sites. It involves standing in line at each site to enter.

Guide Godfrey
Deiver Corey.
Covered all 3 in one day.
Beautiful weather. 80 degrees. No rain.
Godfrey kept us on schedule and imparted enough knowledge (in addition to our pre-search) to place each location in some historical context.

We were able to spend some time at each place, not enough to see everything at Windsor in detail, but that’s the tradeoff for booking such an ambitious tour. The line at Windsor is the line at Windsor; no way to avoid that. Spending time reading and looking for the crests of prominent Knights of the Garter dating back to the 14th century was fascinating.

At Bath, one of the colleges had graduation so there were a lot of grads and family members around the Roman baths. Roman baths are fascinating feats of engineering, but the green murky pool is kind of nasty. The pictures on the Internet don’t lie. They need a good pool guy.

Highlight for me was Stonehenge. Words can’t really describe hanging out with one of the oldest man made structures on Earth. (Did not feel any auras, but it was still very cool). Beautiful setting in the English countryside adds to the experience greatly.

Terrible customer service!!! Our tour guide left 6 people behind at start and when we needed bathroom, were 10 min late for bus leaving Windsor for Stonehenge but BUS LEFt!!!! No call. No message. They had our number. How could they go this? And asked for refund - they said they’d investigate!!! Are you kidding? $320 blown because they couldn’t wait for sick senior citizen! Shame on them.

The tour was very well organised and very well facilitated. Our guide Manon was extremely friendly, approachable and knowledgeable. After getting held up at the Stonehenge return shuttle buses with long lines I had to change tours. Manon very kindly organised another seat on another bus and I finished the day going to Oxford and enjoying listening to the new tour guide Richard who was equally knowledgeable and engaging. I highly recommend Evans Evans Tours.

One recommendation is ensure you organise a packed lunch and have water etc. There are cafes etc but the tours are quite busy and scheduled.

Guide (Robert) was fantastic… informative, friendly, funny, and took great care of his people! The driver (Idris) was masterful navigating the narrow lanes and busy streets. We weren’t sure what to expect when we booked the tour— SO glad we did!! Great way to see three wonderful unique English sights. Thank you Robert and Idris for the excellent day!!!

Our tour guide Catia was an amazing vat of knowledge of history! I can’t say enough about that! My issue was the tour group was too large (42 people). Some in our group spent time complaining to our guide about issues regarding their tickets which she clearly had no control over, but we were having to listen to the poor gal deal with the issue over our Vox box listening equipment. Since the group was large, some people were a bit pushy to get to a spot near the guide or a view of what we were looking at, so it was difficult to see things. We also did not have a sufficient amount of time to tour Baths or really enjoy a meal anywhere we went.

This was my first trip to London and so I picked this tour since it covers multiple locations. Both the departure and arrival experiences were convenient and efficient and the quality of the tour was excellent. He provided very clear instructions so we knew where to meet and when, which was helpful for those of us new to the areas.

Our tour guide, Saul, did a wonderful job of keeping the tour on schedule (along with our driver James), which was critical to ensuring that we had adequate time at each stop. The pace was somewhat brisk, but not rushed—perfect given this three-site visit.

Saul was very knowledgeable and provided excellent background information and commentary about each of the sites. He was courteous, orderly, and calm throughout the tour, which made this fun (albeit long) day very pleasant.

He also provided recommendations about other things to do in London and checked with each tour guest to help ensure that they knew how to reach their hotels at the conclusion of the tour.

Each location was beautiful and a “must-see”and I highly recommend Saul (Evan Evans Tours).

Very relaxing trip. We enjoyed the Bus and the guide very very much. The ride on the bus was comfortable and the guide was impeccable and very informative about everything he saw. The driver was very well behaved and wonderful driving skills.I diffidently recommend this trip to my friends and family.

I highly recommend this tour. It was a great way to see a lot of sites in a short amount of time. Jennifer our guide was a star with her stories and how she constantly was making sure everyone was ok. She was so knowledgeable not just about the sites but about the history of the country. I really enjoyed listening to her talk! Our driver Aston was also a blast and very funny. Overall great experience. I highly recommend.

Great tour! Manon the tour guide did a great job explaining and setting the expectation that this was a tasting tour. She also anticipated some inclement weather and phoned ahead to change the order of the tour so we could enjoy Stonehenge relatively dry. Much kudos to Barrington the driver as well

It was a good introduction to these places, but you could really spend an entire day at each town, especially Bath. We ran out of time to do much besides see the stones at Stonehenge because of the crowds and due to the mourning period, we didn’t see much at Windsor, but neither is the tour guide’s fault. Eugene and our driver Kadar were great! They made the best of things for us.

This tour was a great way to see a lot of London without a lot of hassle. Richard (Morrell) was our guide and he was fantastic. He was friendly, knowledgeable, personable and caring. He made sure everyone was enjoying themselves but kept us on a tight schedule which was necessary as it was crowded. Earl was our driver, also very friendly, a great driver, we felt very safe. The coach was clean and comfortable. We were lucky enough to be at Windsor Castle on the first day they were open to the public after the Queen’s passing, very special. We were able to see her final resting place in the chapel and the highlights of the castle. The audio guide for Stonehenge provided by the tour company was very good. The Baths were very interesting and the town very quaint. We would definitely recommend Evan Evans tour company and would use them again.

My wife and I had a marvellous Thursday tour with Kevin coordinating and Rad driving. Kevin was a fount of knowledge, and handled the pressure of getting everyone to three locations in a day professionally and in an entertaining manner. A wonderful team and trip. It always felt safe and delivered in spades. Thank you.

Booked based on the idea that we could see a number of things in a day trip. I had been wanting to go to Windsor Castle forever and my husband wanted to see Stonehenge.

Departure was smooth although our trip had been reschedule due to low numbers on our preferred day. Guide and driver were fine. Given lots of instructions about what we could eat/drink on the bus and the advise to use loos wherever we found them as the bus does not make those kind of stops (more on that later).

So, it was very disappointing to arrive at Windsor Castle and be admonished to be back at a certain time and oh yes, don't get locked in as there would be a changing of the guard. We essentially had less than 30 minutes in the Castle where we were given a 120 minute audio guide which we couldn't come close to finishing. We will be going back via rail on our next visit.

Stonehenge was just fine,give an audio to which we could listen. Might have wanted a bit more time to do some real walking.

In Bath we evidently did not have tix for entry to the baths which was just fine. No city tour offered, not even a map, just some vague suggestion and an admonishment to be back on time. . We wandered around and then settled into a pub.

On the way back, which was a very long ride, I needed to use a loo quite badly. I asked the guide and driver to please make a stop which I was told was not in the schedule. I said I didn't care and could use the back of the coach if need be. Well, not only was a stop made, but over 2/3 of the people got off to use the loo!

Highly suggest that a rest stop be included on future tours.

In sum, I can see where this tour would appeal to may who just want to "tick" things off, but for us it was a disappointment to have so little time in Windsor and Bath.

What can be said about this spectacular construction. All the theories about this place are various, everyone talks about many theories and nobody is right. What I can say is that it is a very beautiful experience, it is a magical place, it is a mystical place, you feel the energy of the large number of people who come to see this place.
It was well worth having made a special trip from London to visit this attraction.
In rainy weather I recommend going with waterproof boots

This tour was AMAZING from the second I got on the bus to the very last stop. This is because my tour guide- Mel- was extremely lively, personable, and knowledgeable. He provided some history about London and the sites we were visiting on the tour, he had a great sense of humor, and was extremely engaging. Our bus driver- Merrick (sorry if misspelled) got us to and from each location quickly and safely. While this tour is a "taster tour", Mel provided great tips to maximize our time at each location. I would take this tour every single time if it was guaranteed I'd be with Mel and Merrick. Dynamic Duo for sure. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to explore outside of London. Even if you're looking to explore London as well, Mel was full of great suggestions and was more than happy to point us in the right direction. Thank you!!!

Our tour guide was Carina, and our driver was Jodi…. They were amazing!! Catia is VERY knowledgeable, fun, and super nice. Jodi did great driving - couldn’t believe the spaces he could get through without a scratch. Sites were also very good - so much to see … front row parking. Travel outside of busy London to countryside. Highly recommend!!!!

We only had a short time to visit England and so we decided to take this marathon of a tour. Eventhough I only had a birdseye view of the 3 locations, I had an amazing time on this 12 hour trip. Our topnotch tour guide, Mel Adams, was not only knowledgeable and professional but also highly engaging and fun. This trip and Mel are both highly recommended.

Helpful tip: The changing of the guards take approximately over 40.minutes. Although it is quite nice to watch, it shortens one time in Windsor Palace. I suggest just taking 10 minutes of video and move on to see the St. George's Chapel so that you will have more time to see the Palace.

Godfrey was a fantastic tour guide, keeping us well entertained and informed throughout the tour. Him and the driver, Barry, proved to be great duo, constantly checking maps to find the quickest routes to each of our location.

Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath were all interesting destinations. Bath in particular was beautiful in December. If you visit Bath around the holidays, make sure you walk through the charming Christmas market.

A special thanks to Godfrey and Barry for the extra work required to keep the tour safe in the midst of recently increased COVID precautions.

It was a very straightforward way to visit three interesting places. The guide was informative and friendly, the driver was also friendly. The itinerary gave a reasonable amount of time in each place. I think when you do this type of tour, you have to accept that you can’t see absolutely everything at each stop. We originally booked to do the Spanish tour but a few days before they let us know that only the English tour was running. If we had known this from the start, we would have booked all three entrance fees, to allow us to visit the Roman baths museum, too. For some reason this option wasn’t available with the Spanish option. It was, nevertheless, a very nice day out. Thank you!

We enjoyed our day and all that we saw but we felt rushed and wished for more time at each stop. Our bus driver, Aiden was great. Robert, our guide, was very knowledgeable. The teen in our group was overwhelmed with information but I enjoyed the commentary. All instructions were clear and informative. We enjoyed each stop but would have liked more time to explore Windsor and Bath. We had to rush through the Roman Baths to carve out time to eat. There is no built in meal time. We were lucky that Stonehenge wasn’t too crowded when we went but we still had just enough time to walk around the circle, buy a souvenir, use the toilet, get a water and get back to the bus. The bus was nice and relatively comfortable but at one point everyone complained about the air conditioning (it was 31C/90F) and they hadn’t turned it on. We are glad that we took the tour. It was a good way to see a lot in one day.
