Tour guide was really good and informative
The places we visited were worth it.
Comfortable bus.
The only drawbacks:
Windsor Castle: more than half of the allotted time was spent on the queue (oct22,2019 tour)
Stonehenge: much better than windsor but still rushed, lots of tourist long queue for the stonehenge bus.
City of Bath/Roman Bath: the only place we feel we had ample time to explore, did not wait very long to enter the roman bath.

Our guide Mel was very knowledgeable and did an excellent job giving us history on the 3 locations we visited. He kept us on time and provided the best things to do at each stop to maximize our time. Mel is a funny guy and I highly recommend him as a guide!
The tour was rushed due to the increased crowds and I would suggest to the tour company to reduce to 2 stops to allow more time at each stop.

This past Saturday, March 14th, I woke up way earlier than I wanted to, I arrived in London the evening before and was to be frank, I was tired. When we arrived at the station to be picked up, I asked how long the tour would last and was told that we would be arriving approx. 12 hours later. I thought, great...I'm tired and now have this long day ahead.

When it was time to board the bus, we were greeted by Eugene, someone with the power to shift my tired mindset around. His joyfulness was infectious, only to get on the bus and be greeted with a smile from Dave. Once everyone was situated, we were educated and entertained and when there was downtime for us to close our eyes for a bit, we were awaked by a friendly and song-like, "wakey wakey." It will now be stuck in my head like Kylie Jenner's, "rise and shine."

The day went by fast, but never felt rushed, I have a wealth of knowledge that I didn't have before the tour and have made it back home and have been online learning even more. It was my first time in London and it was such a great introduction. I will definitely recommend this tour to anyone looking to travel to London. I would also recommend taking the tour with the dynamic duo, Dave and Eugene!!

I did Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Oxford. Robert was an excellent guide, and spoke over radios to us, giving interesting and amusing commentary on the bus, in the queue for Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and for a walking tour of Oxford. The sights themselves were well worth seeing, but the tour suffers slightly by having somewhat tight time limits. If you really want to see Windsor Castle especially, you may need a more focussed tour. This is a taster tour, but well worth doing if you're short on time. Shoutout to Barrington the driver, who got us across great distances in good time.

We loved the whole experience, we did not do the visitors centre, did the walk on our own at Stonhenge.
We loved Bath, beautiful medieval city we were just disappointed that you had to pay to go into the sunken garden. Windsor was lovely, just did the walkabout still worth it, even if you don't get to see inside.
Overall impression , we found the parking a problem everywhere we went , expensive, very expensive.
Had a great holiday overall

Wow, what can I say. My husband and I have been on dozens of tours in different countries over the years and the Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath tour was one of the best we have EVER had. Full credit goes to our fantastic guide Phil, he was the most knowledgeable and helpful tour leader and full to the brim of interesting facts. Thanks to Phil and our driver Valentine we kept to schedule on an extremely busy day during peak Christmas season. Phil goes above and beyond in every way and his professionalism and passion makes the tour well worth the price! Would highly recommend!

My best friend and I decided to spend at week in London and also go to Stonehenge for a day. I was scheduled to just do the early tour of Stonehenge in the inner circle, but do to low numbers it was cancelled. Fortunately, there was a later tour that went to Windsor and Bath. So all around it was a nice replacement. Our guide, Mel Adams, and our driver Paul were AMAZING! Not even 15 minutes on the road to Stonehenge and everyone was laughing. Mel has this wonderful way to make you feel like you’ve been friends for a long time. At each location, Mel gave a wonderful background of information. He is very knowledgeable and keep you on edge the whole time with these little nuggets of trivia and jokes. The bus itself was clean and make the drive very enjoyable. Pack snacks and drinks but you do have opportunities to purchase meals at the sites. It was a long day but I’m so very blessed to explore with my bestie and Mel leading the way. I’d definitely recommend Evan Evans Tours and would request Mel again! I appreciated his kindness. Oh yep we were there for the Covid-19 crisis and even with the worrisome paranoid thoughts about germs, Mel and Paul took extra precautions to keto us safe, informed and entertained. THANK YOU MATES! Book Evan Evans and request Mel if you can :)

Robert and mason were great. Robert knew a lot of great stories and facts and told them in an interesting way that you didn’t realize you were waiting in line. You didn’t have a ton of time at any stop but it was a great way to hit them all in one day. Would definitely recommend.

This was a wonderful experience! We went on the group tour with entrance fees to each place. Sasha was our tour guide and Yannis was our driver. Yannis was an excellent driver! Sasha had so much energy and so much knowledge! She was entertaining and engaging. The trip is an all day trip so expect a good bit of walking and bus riding. Hot foods and beverages are not allowed on board so finish it before the bus! That only drawback is the amount of time you have at each stop. But as our tour guide said it’s just a taste of each place you get when you go on this tour. Bath was a really cute town and the Roman Baths were nice to see. The Windsor castle was amazing. I definitely wish we had more time here! Sasha saved the best for last — Stonehenge was an amazing site to see! It did rain by the time we got there but it didn’t ruin the experience! I would definitely recommend this tour! And if you get Sasha as your guide expect to learn so much about London!

Godfrey and Sam were remarkably. Godfrey is very friendly and knowledgeable. He translated in Spanish and English amazingly. This tour has a lot of driving and I recommend taking motion sickness medicine for those who get car sick. This not a leisure tour, it’s very fast pace and time restricted. Despite the bad weather the tour was nice.

We enjoyed a day trip with this tour. Our guide Chris was so informative and we had a smooth day of travel seeing these three areas. First was Windsor Castle, then Stonehenge followed by Bath. It’s a full day which starts at 7:30 to meet at Victoria Carriage station and return there close to 7:40. The bus was driven by George and was very comfortable for the trip.

This was such a cool experience. Highly recommend seeing all three sites - Stonehenge, Bath, & the castle. You get about an hour or a little longer to explore each place which is enough if you’re looking to gain some insight and see the location.

Pack a lunch to get the most out of your day. Most of the stops were very busy, the time it would take to stop and get food will take away from your experience of the day.

Tour guide Robert - very knowledgeable about London on the way to the sites and shared fun facts along our coach ride. He was diligent with our time and helped the tour move right along. We had a great time exploring and learning with/from him.

Robert (Irish) the tour guide and Raphael the driver were excellent on our day trip from London to Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge. We went August 8, 2022, at 8am, and Robert made sure that we stayed together, knew where we were going, how to get back, knew the schedule, and kept us informed with running commentaries throughout the day on the different locales. My only downer is that we could not stay longer in Bath - an impossibility given that we were going on to Stonehenge as well.

We jumped on this tour to visit Stonehenge, but all three locations were amazing. The weather, was amazing! My wife and I are from Australia and hate the heat. We traded 40 deg for 8 deg, and couldn’t be happier. All that was made even better with Debbie’s wit, stories, enthusiasm, one on one little jokes, and making every ‘Darling’ feel special and welcome. We have 14 more days of our trip, and I am now worried we won’t get a guide as knowledgeable and passionate. Thank you Debbie for a fantastic day.

Adam and Jacqueline from Australia

The tour is very well designed to be completed in a day. Andy Jackson is an impeccable host, with his history well in place, he humours with invaluable snippets, that would only be known to a local.
A big shout out to our driver Earl, who added to the fun.
Highly recommend it !

Our tour guide Mel and driver Mark were fantastic. Mel was so friendly, engaging, and passionate about history. He really made everything so interesting and fun, and gave great advice about where to go at each stop when we had free time. Mark got us everywhere on time, and every drive to each stop was pleasant. Would absolutely recommend this tour, tour guide, and driver! Thank you for a memorable experience.

The sites were extremely beautiful, and we learned so much about all 3 places. Our tour guide Eugene was incredibly knowledgeable, and as a history buff, it was a lot of fun to take time on the side to discuss the things he was sharing with us. Our bus driver, Jamea, was a champ on the streets. The drive was smooth and enjoyable. I would highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to learn more about England. Also, bring an umbrella to Stonehenge. we got soaked the moment we were right in front of the monument. Not the smartest move that I have made but the bus was warm when we got back on. More props to James.

Absolutely loved this trip! What a fun day, our guide, Bruce and our driver Elvio were EXCELLENT- Bruce’s witty, entertaining and knowledgeable presence really made the trip special. I don’t know that I’d recommend it otherwise. The two of them made all the difference.
A day I will never forget.

Schedule: Windsor Castle (~2hrs), Bath(~2hrs), then Stonehenge(~1.5hrs). Bus left soon after 7:30AM from Grosvenor Square - get there early, we got there at 7:30 and were among the last to board. Got to Windsor 1 hr before opening but we were first in line. Had lunch in Bath, nice little town to shop and eat - we skipped the Roman Baths. Stonehenge was beautiful, there’s a visitor center with some exhibits which were interesting.

The tour has a strict schedule and you have to watch the time in order to make it back to the bus on time. I like the order of the schedule since we were able to bypass the crowds by getting to Windsor early and also going to Stonehenge in the late afternoon. Our guide Bruce was entertaining, friendly, and helpful! I liked his personal anecdotes and jokes, a very personable guy. Mario our driver was great - we got to all our places on time, no complaints.

Be prepared for a lot of walking and being outside. We got lucky with warm, sunny weather. Our tour bus didn’t have air conditioning in the back which made the 2 hour return uncomfortable. Overall, would recommend this tour because you get to see a lot in a day!

Awesome experience! Our tour guide Chrissy was amazing and all the places we visited were 10/10. The service was perfect and we had no issues. One thing that caused us an issue is our ticket said admission to Windsor & Roman Baths were included but found out on the day that it wasn’t and so we had to pay on the day. We did click the first option of Stonehenge entry only and so maybe I overlooked it but in the description and even on our ticket it said all admission was included. Something to keep in mind but I guess it was our fault but it definitely wasn’t clear enough.

First our tour guide Robert was FANTASTIC. Knowledgeable and entertaining. The tour company stated that our coach bus for the 12 hour day would have wifi and USB charging ports which it did not which was really inconvenient for such a long day. We had 3 historical places to visit Windsor, Bath & Stonehenge. There was really not enough time to fully enjoy Windsor & Bath. You have to RUSH through these places. There was also no time to enjoy the local cafes or shops which was really disappointing. If you are a history buff you are better off spending a full day each at Windsor & Bath. If you are short on time then this tour will get the job done.

Evan Evans puts on a fantastic tour - everything as advertised. Our driver Key was excellent and very safe even in rainy conditions. Guide Godfrey was engaging and very helpful. Interesting item is that at all stops, the Guide cannot take you into the venue... you are reliant on the audio guides provided at the place. Not a bad thing in my mind as I prefer going thru at my own pace. Very comfortable bus and timely in all departures. Plenty of food and restroom options at every stop. Highly recommend.

This tour was perfect for our quick family trip to the UK. We had limited time to see a lot, and this tour helped us accomplish a lot in one day. First of all, our tour guide Debra, was 150% awesome. She was extremely knowledgeable of the history of the sites we visited, shared a lot of kind of side stories about the UK (e.g., regarding football teams, pubs, etc.), had a fantastic sense of humor, and was just generally a joy to have leading us.
The day we went on our tour, the weather was horrible (i.e., typhoon Dennis), however the bus was very comfortable and we were able to warm up and dry off in between stops. Our first stop was Windsor Castle. Debra gave us a full briefing on the history, etc. prior to our arrival. Once there, she escorted us through the village of Windsor, the security and ticket lines, and then let us loose for an hour or two. The castle is a must see when in the London area. There is good shopping, food, coffee/tea close by as well. Our second stop was Stonehenge. We got the appropriate 'experience' as it was very rainy/sleety, windy, and cold....All good. It added to the experience. Again, we got the rundown on the history from Debra prior to the stop. There is a nice cafe/gift shop in the welcome center. The sight itself speaks for itself. Another must see for sure. Our last stop was Bath. It's not one of my favorite sites in the UK, but it was good to see and rounded out our day. Like Windsor, Bath is a nice little town with plenty of history, shopping and food.
I read some reviews prior to us going which said there is not enough time in each place. For us, it was perfect. We knocked off 3 key sites in one day, with the help of a great bus driver (James?), comfortable bus seats, and wonderful tour guide. Highly recommended.
I highly recommend this company. Very well done.

My fiance and I did this tour and it was great! For our first time doing this type of tour, Godfrey really made the experience enjoyable. He was very funny and gave plenty of insight into the site we were seeing and many other buildings along the way. Barry was great with providing us with directions and made the experience that much more worth while. I would highly recommend this tour and these two people as they are very personable and friendly to be around!if I visit London again, I am definitely going to take another tour with this company.

Richard was amazing. He’s extremely knowledgeable in all things and really wants you to enjoy your trip. There is not a lot of time at each place but he tries to make sure you have time to do what is intended. It’s a great highlight tour and now I know where I need to come back and see more of. Learned so much and would love to have Richard again anytime. Before booking make sure to check what days the changing of the guard is and what things are open as not all things are open all week.

My son and I were very disappointed when our tour to Warwick Castle, Oxford, Stratford upon Avon and Cotswold was cancelled and we were given a few options from which to choose. We decided to take the day trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath as replacements. But as soon as our tour guide Mel Adams started sharing valuable historical facts about the places we were to visit. Must admit, Mel has profound knowledge in History. Bath being the city where he was born and raised, Mel knew the city of the Roman Baths like the back of his hands.
Thoroughly enjoyed the trip and looking forward to more such trips.

This tour was great. Amazing sights in the UK. Our guide, I wanna say his name was Jeffery, was hysterical and kept the group moving. I enjoyed the tight guidleines on time, because we got to see everything and learn so much about the English countryside. Very incredible.

Simon was a great guide. He was able to manage a large group and keep us on schedule with humor and respect. I loved both his jokes and information. He was thoughtful about our comfort and provided the tips we needed to make the best out of our trip. Although it was a bigger group than I usually prefer, it felt like a small group because we were able to go off on our own for periods of time and we had headsets to clearly hear what Simon was saying.

From my experience, the tour’s success depends on the tour guide and Lalie was excellent. We departed 2 minutes early, and while driving to the three destinations she educated us with her wealth of knowledge. When driving to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and then onto Bath she provided wonderful facts, tidbits and important information which made the time go extremely fast. Dave the driver, was also excellent and very safe. I highly recommend this tour and because each of these locations have lots to do, Lalie directed us what the high points were that should be visited. No time was ever wasted. It was true lay a wonderful tour and a wonderful day.

We had a great time with Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath tour. Catia knows an incredible amount of European history (from middle ages to today, and also able to tie in facts in the world of English drama) and is an excellent and dynamic presenter. Rafael is an extraordinary driver. He got us back to London safely and in good time too, despite Friday rush hour traffic. Awesome time and recommend it. We felt very taken care of!

Eugene and Behar were amazing! The trip is jam packed with activities. It’s definitely just a sneak peak into experiencing these 3 places. Definitely look into less stops in the itinerary if you need to go in a more leisurely pace. Otherwise, if you do not have much time in England and you wanna see it all, then this is definitely for you. I would also like to add that when you go to the meeting point in the am, check in at the evans evans window by the bathroom and they will give you a wristband and tell your your gate. Pretty good experience and worth the price!

My partner and I won a tour with EvanEvans with work and we had the pleasure of meeting the lovely Katie, the tour guide who was super professional, kind and very knowledgable the entire trip. Would highly recommend using EvanEvans should you wish to sightsee - we really enjoyed our time. We were given plenty of time to explore Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath (including Roman Baths) by ourselves. Katie was absolutely amazing, so kind - we were delayed coming back by 15 minutes as she ran around Bath trying to find one person, normally you would find that we would leave the late one behind but it's clear Katie was not comfortable with that! Big thank you to Steve as well for driving us around safely and even slowing down during scenic spots so the full group can see. Looking forward to booking a trip with EvanEvans in the near future!

Our guide, Peter, was great. Super knowledgeable, funny, and kind. However, the checking in at the bus station was terribly disorganized and took much longer and was more frustrating than necessary. If Evan Evans can print out spreadsheets of passenger lists, then it should be able to alphabetize by name, or do something to minimize the chaos.

We booked this tour and they sent an email a few days before we was meant to go saying they are cancelling it due to it not being busy enough. They offered a different date which we can’t do as they have left it such late notice to cancel. It’s so unprofessional knowing that they could continue with the tour but clearly they CHOOSE not to as taking as much money as possible means more to them than keeping a reliable and professional reputation. To let paying customers down and disrupt their plans because you want to make as much money as you can and ram as many people as you can onto one boat ride DURING a pandemic is awful.

This was our first tour with Evans Evans and was not a disappointment. Our guide was well-versed in the history of the sites and was able to provide informational insights during the drive to each place. The bus accommodations were comfortable and offered unobstructed views. My only critique would be the lack of time to really explore each of the three sites. If you want more time to explore these sites it would be recommended to visit them separately. Otherwise, it was a great tour at a reasonable cost.

A must do for anyone visiting the UK with a tight schedule. Our tour guide, Debra was FAB. Of course she was very knowledgeable about the history surrounding Bath, Stonehenge, and Windsor but what my family and I enjoyed most about her was her humor and knack for storytelling. She was an absolute doll and made the bus rides between sights fly by with her history lessons and personal stories. Highly recommend this tour with Debra aka Mrs. Weasley.

Kevin, our tour guide and Kelvin, the bus driver made the trip wonderful. Kevin was very informative and provided a lot of history along this day trip. I do have to say that we felt rushed at each venue. That is no fault of the company or Kevin - it was just trying to fit so much into one day. I would recommend this trip, unless you want more than 1 1/2 hours at any of the stops. It worked for us as we only had 2 days in London.

We were so impressed with this tour! Saul, our guild, was full of information, interesting stories, and was quick with suggestions on where to eat and shop when asked! Rahn, our driver, was amazing and maneuvered the bus around the crowded car parks with ease! Saul made sure we made it to Windsor Castle before the crowds so we could have the best experience. Like any guided tour, we wished we had more time at each location as they were so beautiful, but we knew this would be a fairly quick visit at each location. We had clear times to meet up and leave and great directions on how to get around. We would do this tour again…especially if we could have Saul as our guide!!

Simon and Earl were fantastic. They were excellent hosts and made the day go by quickly. I highly recommend this tour if you’re looking for a taster, a highlight reel, of Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge.

Our tour guide was amazing! I wish I remembered her name. Very knowledgeable and funny - kept us engaged during our drives from each place! I will say, the line to get into Windsor Castle was insane, we waited for over an hour and felt very rushed to look around. Then the drive back from Bath was 3 hours long, which we did not know. We had very uncomfortable seats which made for an unpleasant drive back.

This review is just for Nick - our tour guide and Adil our bus driver. They made our experience memorable. Nick is such a fun person - a perfect man for the job he's doing. He made everyone feel welcome and shared important bits of information about the places we went to. Usually some tour guide information could get overwhelming or boring - but with Nick it was really interesting. I'd recommend take a tour with him if you're looking to book through the company in the future.

Also, worth to reach the bus stand 30 minutes early, since there are lots of different buses at the same spot and to avoid confusion you'd need some buffer time.

The Windsor Castle was closed so they took us in a very short walk tour and I mean very short.
The Stonehenge is great but we spend too much time there where we could spend more time in the Windsor. The Rome Bath is good but again it could be better with a walk tour or the bus could take us around the city showing a few things like a double deck tour. Too much money for what they have showed us

We took this tour today, it was a great experience, especially if you’re visiting London for a short period of time. You get to see three of most amazing sites near London, yes the time you get to spend in each place is not really enough. I would say Windsor and Bath can each be a full day tour and the Stonehenge probably at least 4-5 hours.
BUT again this was a great opportunity for a short visit. And the most importantly our tour guide ANDY, I cannot thank him enough for sharing all those amazing knowledge, information and great stories.
He shared not only about the three monuments/places that are mentioned on the tour but also wherever the bus drove by he shares some detailed information about it.
Thank you so much Andy for the amazing day!
I should’ve got your information for next two days left in London. 😋
Thank you again

My wife and I enjoyed our time during this tour with Sasha and Kevin. Sasha is one of the best tour guides I have encountered so far, very knowledgeable and with great tips and stories during each stop.

Even though we enjoyed our time at every stop, the tour felt too rushed. We arrived early at Windsor Castle but half the time was waiting outside for it to open, and when we were able to get in, we did St. George's Chapel and practically rushed through the King's Apartments section to avoid being left behind. Not enough time to appreciate the town or the castle itself.

Once at Stonehenge we had a little bit more than an hour to run through it but know that you will lose at least 20 minutes waiting for the shuttle bus to take you from the bus parking to the stones and back. We didn't anticipate the long wait to take the shuttle back and ended up running back to the bus.

At Bath you have to choose if you want to do the tour or check out the town but both are impossible. We only did the tour to take quick pictures of the baths and run out to see a little bit of the town.

If you are doing this tour, bring enough cold food for the day because chances are that you will not have enough time to buy anything.

Word of advise: if you don't have enough time the tour is totally worth it and at least you will see some historic places. However, if you have time I would recommend to do just two places in one day, you will enjoy it better.

This tour was a beautiful glimpse of Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge all in one day. Each are a distance from London/each other, so you get to spend around 1.5hrs at each location. The rest of the time is spent traveling to/from each place, however, our guide Mel made great use of that time to provide a ton of information on each stop. Having a ton of information prior to the stop made it easier to simply admire the beauty of it all. The tour was beautiful and Mel made it even better with his wealth of knowledge, kindness, and humor!

This tour brings you by bus to three very different places with very different histories. Leaving from Victoria Coach Station (which my son and I discovered is NOT the same as Victoria Station) at 8:00 am and returning at about 7:00 pm, you spend a lot of time on the bus traveling from site to site and back to London, but it is well worth it. Peter, our tour guide was fantastic, educating and entertaining us as we traveled. Windsor Castle is magnificent, Stonehenge is mystifying and Bath is fascinating. Each spot, moreover, does a great job of providing information (via handheld devices) during the self guided tours. The only problem is that Bath is 2 and a 1/2 hours from London, so the bus ride home is a bit on the long side. Having said that, it’s also a great time to take a nap after a day of walking, eating and soaking up history. I would recommend this trip, and Peter in particular, to anybody who has a full day available.

Zozo was thoroughly informative and engaging throughout our entire trip! He provided fantastic details about the history of the regions and interesting facts about a plethora or places, items and objects. He is a brilliant guide, and Kirin is an equally brilliant driver! Kirin drove us through several special routes for both a more scenic drive and a quicker trip back to home. Altogether this was a fantastic trip and I would highly recommend it to anyone considering it—it is so worth the money!

It's an absolutely recommended trip, really comfortable coach to begin with, our guide Patricia was extremely nice and welcoming and she explained and told us many anecdotes during the trip. We were extremely lucky that the day we went was very beautiful and it didn't rain at all which is an extra point for our experience. The only thing is that there's not enough time for going through everything in detail but 3 different places during one day, I have nothing to complain about. In general, definitely worth the trip and I highly recommend it!

My family had the most incredible experience on this tour. Windsor Castle was more spectacular than I ever imagined. Our tour guide, Godfrey, was so informative and knowledgeable. It was like being in a fun history class. Our driver, Barry, took our safety serious and we just loved how he drove us through the English country side with such care. Both Godfrey and Barry were professional, kind, on-time and their travel advice was spot on. We definitely recommend this tour!!

We had Eugene as our tour director and Laun as our bus driver. Both were EXCELLENT. Eugene had spent some time in Bath and it really showed based on his clearly experiential knowledge of this location. Eugene provided ‘just enough’ local color to make the trip truly meaningful, while still providing plenty of time for us to digest what he was saying. If you would like to see a tremendous amount of England in a single day and learn a lot in the process, this is the tour for you!

From arriving at Victoria Coach Station to being dropped off at Victoria Train Station, the staff at EvanEvans Tours really took care of me.
The onboard guide, Monica, was great! She engaged with everyone, took extra care to ensure we all knew what to expect throughout the day and even provided visual aids for those who didn't speak english!
The tour itself was wonderful and the pairing of Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath offers a real slice of English history.
I would happily pay to do this tour again.

The itinerary isn’t exact the driving distance is a bit long and we definitely stayed longer at each place. Made for a long day but overall it was a great excursion and I would highly recommend. The tour guides were very knowledgeable and kept us entertained throughout and allowed for free time at each place. Spots to eat along the way but no specified lunch time. They were very strict with departure times at each location, which I actually appreciated because we weren’t waiting on anymore and kept moving along.

Eugene was very knowledgeable and energetic. The experience was okay but it felt a little rushed. That’s understandable because of the distance between each location but also bad for my anxiety. We headed back to the area where the bus was early because we didn’t want to get left and have no why back to our hotel. We were also let out to explore and get back to the bus on our own. Yes, we are adults but we definitely got lost a couple time and my anxiety was high because we were creeping up on time.

I think they should have a meeting spot close by where people exit and we can all walk back to the bus together (for the people who want to do that). I would have spent more time at each location exploring. If they don’t want to do that, they should have a device that we can talk back to the tour guide instead of just hearing him/her. That way if we are lost and it’s close to time, we can reach out for help to the bus. A lot of the time people can’t call the main number because for them it’s international calling.

The tour is absolutely worth it if you are pressed by time and want to visit as many places as you can. Kevin, the tour guide, was absolutely phenomenal! We also enjoyed the bus ride provided by Bill, who took us safely to the tourist destinations and back to London. We highly recommend this tour!

Our guide MEL was incredible! He set expectations, was funny, very knowledgeable and just amazing. How the tour was constructed was not great. There is not enough time to see everything you’d want to. You really need to revise this offer. Because of transit shortages to the Stonehenge site, we were only able to wait, get on tram, take a pic, get back in line to go back. BOO! Only had time for St. George’s Chapel in Windsor.

Our guide Kevin was energetic and upbeat throughout the tour and offered fascinating information and insight during the journey. The tour was very well organised and all three locations covered in the tour were lovely. Future travellers ought to bear in mind that 1-1.5 hours were spent in each spot, so you must pace yourself accordingly.

Barry and Godfrey were amazing tour guides. Godfrey had amazing energy, and left the bus full of excitement. He was very knowledgeable with the history of England and surrounding locations. Meanwhile Barry operated the bus with very good awareness and kept us safe while transporting to each location. The Vox boxes provided added an extra benefit to the trip. Easily said as the best experience ive had in years. Thank you so much Godfrey, Barry and Evans & Evans Tours

Great trip. Catya is a fantastic guide, she gives tons of very interesting and relevant information, she is funny as well. John is a great bus driver, we were feeling very safe with him. Trip is very long, the only drawback is because of traffic it took a while to get to Bath from Stonehenge and we had only 1.5 hours there - barely enough time for museum visit, short snack and walk to and from bus stop. I wish we had at least an hour more in this city.

The tour guide, Rowan, was excellent - knowledgeable, fun, and friendly without being patronizing. As far as the tour itself - really too much in one day. The time allotted at Stonehenge was appropriate; but you need more than 60 or 90 minutes to see Windsor Castle or Bath properly. I recommend picking one or the other of those sights and just doing that with Stonehenge in a single day. The coach was new and comfortable.

Wonderful way to see lots of England, Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Roman baths in one day if your time in the UK is limited. It was a long day and our guide Andrew Jackson was very informative, kept us on track, answered all questions and had a wealth of knowledge about all the sites. Highly recommend!!

Peter, our guide was fantastic! Enjoyed his commentary with his balance of important, informative and some numerous points. Also his timing for commenting vs quiet time was perfect. Earl, our driver was a real pro, even by the end of the day we felt very comfortable. He was obviously driving for our comfort. Earl also had a terrific sense of humor. And the rapport between Peter and Earl was great.

This was a phenomenal tour! Eugene was an amazing tour guide and very knowledgeable about the areas that we were visiting. He was always one step ahead even when they were delays to make sure that our experience was not impacted by traffic or other tours. He was also extremely familiar with each location always giving us hints of special things to do, special places to eat, how to catch the changing of the guards, and in general made our visits very educational and fun! Our driver Raad was also a very good at getting us where we needed to be safely and just an amazing driver. We were going to go on this tour no matter what, but the personality of your employees made it over the top awesome!

This was a great, fast tour of these three classic sites. We spent the most time at Windsor Castle, which was appropriate, especially with Queen Elizabeth's recent interment. You don't get to spend a lot of time at any of the places, but to be able to see these three things in one day as well worth it! The tour guide was also fabulous, accommodating, and very informative. It's a great way to see these parts of England. Highly recommended!

We arrived 30min earlier in the morning at gate 1 and received a wrist band and gate for the tour. Our guide Richard was very experienced and welcoming.

Sadly there was a traffic jam but the guide and the driver added the delay later and we still had the same time in the cities. It was great and I hope Richard will still give these tours for many years!

Tour was great, really enjoyed Sheila’s commentary. We knew if we didn’t do them all together at once we probably wouldn’t get a chance to see them all while visiting London, this was a great way to see everything in one day and we felt as though there was enough time at each of the stops. The only one we would have potentially liked a little extra at was Windsor Castle. The changing of the guard is a must see if there’s one happening the day you’re there. While it’s a long day and you’re exhausted by the end, would highly recommend.

This tour is a great way to see major attractions in one day. Our tour guide, Rowan was energetic, fun and provided so many fun and historical facts about the sights we were seeing. I had a great day!

Our tour guide Debra (Ms. Weasley) was amazing. She was very attentive, gave a lot of detailed history and vital information. She even made sure all her travelers got home safe and knew how to get back to their respective hotels. We had a cold, freezing and windy day. She made the trip enjoyable. A true mama bear taking care of her cubs.

I had initially chosen this tour just to get to Stonehenge and I decided to add on Windsor and Bath on an impulse. I am so glad I did because my guide Nicholas and driver Michelangelo were absolutely fantastic. We arrived at each destination with time to spare and I thoroughly enjoyed listening to the history of each site. I had the added benefit of walking around Bath with Nicholas in some downtime before we headed back to London and he was incredibly kind and a pleasure to talk to. I wholeheartedly recommend!
-Emma :)

The best part of the entire day was the tour guide, Phil. He was extremely knowledgeable, kind ,helpful, and enthusiastic about the topics. He's a real treasure. The who day was well worth it. So many fantastic spots in a single tour!

Exceptional experience! Expert-leader MEL enthralled with detailed history. Passionate & entertaining! The local knowledge made all the difference. Driver Joe was the safe pair of hands you hope for. I would highly recommend this company to anyone wanting a fun, relaxed, educational tour - they will deliver!

We did this tour on 18th February. We had Peter as our guide and Aston as our coach driver. I could tell before we left the coach terminal that we had two very entertaining guys. The about of information given by Peter was more than anyone could expect.
Our coach driver was very professional in the way he drive both in London traffic and on the motorways. I would highly recommend this as a must do event even if you only have a few days in London. Neil

Our family loved this tour! Awesome to see 3 amazibng places in one day. Long day but worth it! Toby James the tour guide was excellent. We have just completed tours in 7 European cities and Toby James was one of the best!! He is informative and personable. He gace us so much information about the history of the Monarachy and Stonehenge and Bath. We absolutely loved this tour and highly recommend

This tour has been an amazing experience. We covered a good distance, spent almost 11 hours on tour but it went by in a blink. That was thanks to our unparalleled guide Cameron and our super skilled driver Mohammad. Cameron has been very knowledgeable, funny, entertaining and witty. Probably in part due to the fact that he is also an actor. Together with Mohammad, they made our experience pleasant and memorable. We highly recommend the tour to everyone interested!

Phil was an excellent guide and was so happy to answer any questions we had about the sites or England’s history. He even recommended authentic local pubs and restaurants for the group to try at the end of the tour. The tour itself was awesome! I felt I had enough time at each site and experiences so much British culture in one day.

This was a long but very interesting day, well worth the early start and tight schedule.

Clean and comfortable coach, expertly driven by Corey, who navigated the narrow, windy roads and was polite, friendly & punctual.

Our guide Kevin was absolutely delightful: a wealth of knowledge and he was extremely entertaining, engaging, humorous and good natured. A brilliant guide who made the day that much more enjoyable, with his warmth, tips/recommendations, anecdotes and little-known facts; we all agreed we’d love to do another tour with him!

A really positive experience and would highly recommend this company and our guide / driver.

Over all, a great tour. It does feel a little rushed as you only have about 1.5 hrs at each place. However, if you only have a day, I recommend it. Otherwise, doing two of these locations in one day would be much better. Our guide, Kevin, was great. He provides info during the travel between locations, and general overview and logistics of each stop. You will get audio guides at each location to provide you more detailed info. Well organized and efficient, not much waiting around. Finally, our driver Paul was also very nice and did a great job.

This was a great way for us to see all we could in a day. The coach was comfortable, Richard was knowledgeable, and our bus driver was wonderful. Everything is rushed because you are seeing so much in one day and the schedule must be maintained!! I would recommend this tour to anyone that has a day to spend traveling in style and comfort.

I remember, just a few years ago when Stonehenge was totally unprotected and open, and the mess of cars parked along the A303 and nearby roads, the hordes of visitors tromping through private land to paw all over the stones.

Not any more. The visitor center, located at the intersections of A360 and B3086, offers tons of free parking, within an easy walking distance. The visitor center offers a free exhibition and a more or less contemporary model village, with liver interpreters on site most days.

There is, of course, a charge to access the monument, which is not unreasonable. Sadly, there are no discounts for military, but you get one if you're and English Heritage member. You can walk out to the site on the wide sidewalk, maybe about 1000m, total, or you can take the free shuttle bus.

The site is very well done, with clearly marked paths all around the stones. The view there is quite good, and you can see all of the surrounding mounds.

When done, naturally you're dropped at the gift shop, and there's a modest cafeteria as well. There are free restrooms, too.

Yeah, it's pretty touristy, but this is one of the things you just gotta see, and it's well worth it.

We went to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath with Golden Tours UK starting from London. Our tour guide Bruce and bus driver Armando was one of the best we ever had. They made it fun, very informative and enjoyable for our group. I highly recommend taking this tour with Golden Tours who made our trip very memorable. Once again thank Bruce for your very informative and interesting explanations on our tour. Your sense of humor is also well appreciated.
Albert & Gladys Comia

Rowan (tour guide) and Barrington (driver) are top service oriented folks. Rowan is very knowledgeable, providing good explanations and funny stories about the different sites visited in this tour.
The tour a really a good choice for those who want a have a little flavor of what England can offer. Then we are obliged to dive deeper into each of these magnificent place

We were lucky enough to enjoy this tour with guide Kevin and driver Alex. Kevin has massive knowledge, speaks beautifully and is super entertaining. He is multilingual and even plays the trombone! An interesting and enjoyable tour made excellent by a wonderful guide. Thanks Kevin.

A great way to get a diverse experience and variety of English history/ culture. I learned things from the royals through the years down to the building of dry stone walls on farms. I was able to appreciate many fine arts at Windsor Castle and ancient architecture at Stonehenge and Bath. Joe was our driver (excellent) and Sheila was our guide (fabulous). She had a lovely Scottish accent and was wonderful to listen to all day. There was time to also enjoy local foods. All in all, it was a very pleasant day.

Our driver Carlos was excellent...I th was a smooth uneventful ride, although I h as ve no idea how he managed to maneuver is coach around those very small, crowded streets. Our Tour guide , Andy, was very knowledgable related to the tour locations and very upbeat. He kept us on time without seeming a pest. Overall well worth the time

Godfrey was an absolute legend of a tour guide! Kept the bus ride engaging and had our walks calm and organized. Bill our driver was nothing short of impressive getting through the narrow roads and on time. The tour itself was a great pace. Enough time at each location to get them all in in one day. Happy we did all 3 instead of just 2. Will definitely recommend this tour on my travel blog!

Manon and Paul did a great Job.
A bit more time at Windsor castle would be perfect.
Manon the guide gave a lot of background information and Paul the driver drove absolutly well

To see an overview of 3 iconic sites- this is the way to do it. To see iconic sites in depth, find a different service. The bus Gide was very knowledgeable, however I wish he had used our personal devices during the commute to each site, so we could choose whether or not to listen. Expect lines no matter when you arrive. Being first just means standing outside longer before gates open (Windsor Castle)

Tour guide Eugene and the driver with him (5/6/22 I can’t remember his name, but I want him to give him credit because he was excellent) were informative, entertaining, and overall wonderful. The coach was clean and comfortable and had plenty of phone charging ports. The sites of course were great, but when booking a tour you’re booking the overall experience.

Although it was raining off-and-on all day, my husband and I had a great 12 hour trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. Richard was a wonderful guide who showed care and concern for individual participant's needs while keeping to the overall schedule. Michael A. was an efficient driver and made the trip comfortable. We especially enjoyed seeing the countryside as we drove to each site and returned to London. I highly recommend this trip.

Liked it very much most likely because of heatwave - the bus had air conditioning. But actually I loved all the countryside and wievs. Of course there was rows and line at every attraction, but we still managed to have a glimpse of everything. Our guide Katia and driver Marek were marvelous companions. Loved a tour a lot.

Peter and Behar, the dynamic duo, did an outstanding job in today's tour. Peter, our tour guide was informative in elucidating the history of the Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and the Roman bath. He also added myriads of information on the different areas as we drove along. Both Peter and Behar made us laugh as well. Behar was a great driver with a great sense of humor. The over-all tour was exceptional... and the dynamic duo was superb.

We echo the review submitted by 480abbiec who very articulately described the same tour with Claudia and Joe. We chose the tour to maximize what we could visit in one day and were very satisfied with the pacing, the information provided and the ease. Fortunately, our visit was on a slower day at most of the sites so we were able to take our time and enjoy each venue without rushing and absorb all the information Claudia had given to us prior to each stop. We very much appreciated her sound knowledge of the area, appropriate anecdotes and enjoyable sense of humor. Although it was a long day (12 hours), we returned feeling we had learned and seen a tremendous amount and went on to enjoy a lovely dinner in an area that Claudia recommended. Time well spent!

It was a nice day trip! Got to see a lot of things in one day, it was nicely paced and I was able to see everything I wanted but it may not be for people who want to spend over 1.5h or 2h at each location. It was convenient not to have to arrange transportation and tickets. I enjoyed Godfrey as a tour guide and his amusing stories. We we’re the first tour group to the locations and beat the long queues that we saw as our group left each location (Thanks to Godfrey keeping a good schedule!). And Bill was a great driver!

A wonderful day exploring the sights outside of London. Our tour guide Chrissy was very knowledgeable and kept our group together and on time. Our driver John was very professional. Loved seeing Windsor castle- wish we had more time it was the highlight of the day. Stonehenge was exactly as expected and in Bath I wish we had spent more time exploring the city and skipped the Bath tour. All in all we learned a lot of history and saw the beautiful country side. It was very easy to find the meeting spot at Victoria Coach.

We had booked a day bus trip to Windsor castle, Stonehenge and Bath with #Evanevanstours. We had such an amazing mind blowing experience.

The trip was well planned and staff were accurate and punctual about timings.

Our guide Jennifer made the trip fun. She was very good with necessary instructions, knowledge, trivia on the places to be visited. It was such a treat. A big thanks to Jennifer for making the trip an exhilarating experience.

Big thumbs-up.

If you have a day and wonder what to do. Do book this day trip with evan evans tours.

We had a wonderful tour experience with Evan Evans. Sheila was an amazing and attentive tour guide, and Joe, our driver, did an excellent job getting us around safely and on time. We had a great time and highly recommend this tour if you don’t have a ton of time in London and want to see a lot!

So many things packed into one day. Godfrey was highly efficient in timing us to beat out much of the lines at the major attractions like the Windsor Castle. He pointed out the highlights that we believe we're absolutely must sees to make the best use of this jam packed Adventure!

What a special visit to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. We used Evan Evans tour company. Our tour guide Richard Morrell was extremely knowledgeable and a wealth of information not only about the sights we toured but so much more along the route!! The bus was so comfortable (Mercedes Benz bus!) and it was a smooth trip all around thanks to our bus driver John. I would highly recommend this tour company as well as our tour guide Richard!!

We really enjoyed this day trip, although with so much to see, we didn't get much time in any of the locations. The wait to enter Windsor took a long time as well. Our guide Peter was great. Not only did he provide history of the locations we went to, but he also gave a lot of commentary about English life and was very open for questions and discussion. He did not accompany us in the actual venues and the self-guided tours were adequate. Buses leave from the depot at Victoria Coach Station and there may be several on the same tour, so ask around to make sure you are checking in at the right spot and on your assigned bus.

I️’m not going to lie - I️ was originally very concerned this would be too ambitious for one day and we would drop like flies. I️ have never been so continuously engaged and in awe of each site. Our guide was an absolute gem who not only brought out the fascinating history in an informative and educating manner, but he also offered up the “other side of the story” so rarely discussed on tours. It was the right amount of time at each location for walking through, snapping lovely pics, and doing some key shopping. Already looking for more of Mel’s tours before we jet out this week.

The tour was great! Mel is an expert tour guide who was able to make everyone laugh and was able to explain the history behind each location. Paul was a great driver and was able to get us to each location on time and smoothly. Thank you to Evan Evans for rebooking us for no extra charge on a different tour for the same day. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone who visits London and wants to get out of the city for a day.

The 250 miles round trip England highlights (Windsor Castle , Stonehenge and Bath) was great. It augments our trip to London and another town we will visit. Our guide Chrissy and bus driver Luan were perfect. We learned a lot. Also hearing on the bus audio system was the clearest we have ever encountered. The bus was very comfortable.

Amazing Day! Deborah was extremely knowledgeable and fun to listen to. James did a great job getting us between destinations... taking back roads to avoid traffic. The only issue all day was the weather but...it adds to the story!

I most saying being my firts time coming to England, I found extremely pleasant and informative the tour guide to Windsor castle, Stonehenge and bath. I was in extraordinary circumstances do the sad news of the Queen passing. However Catia was extremely accommodating and make the whole experience memorable. I was honor to be at the memorial at the castle. The also I was able to experience the cannon salute at the Stonehenge. I recommend anyone to book this tour. Once again Catia was awesome.

Overall, our tour guide, Sasha, was lovely and quite knowledgeable. However, the tour was rushed. We started at Windsor Castle and were lucky to be the second tour group to arrive so we entered the castle grounds quickly once opened. However, we stood outside the property for nearly an hour wait beforehand. We were able to see most everything we wanted in the Castle but didn't have any time to walk around the town of Windsor. We were so rushed, in fact, that another family on our tour was left behind when they failed to return to the coach at the allotted time.

Next up was an hour and a half drive to Stonehedge. Of the three stops, this one seemed the most adequate for touring. We would have liked to visit the gift shop but we literally ran to the bus so that we wouldn't be left behind.

Our last stop by Bath, which was another 1-1/2 to 2 hour ride. Once again, when we arrived we spent a good 30-45 minutes in line for the Roman Baths. Our family chose to rush through the facility in the hopes that we would see more of the town. But we were unsuccessful. All we had time for following the Roman Baths, was a quite pasty and a bathroom break before returning to the bus for a 3 hour drive back.

All in all, just a lot of time on the bus and not enough at the sites we wanted to see.

First thing we were greeted at the Victoria coach station. The folks had the tour set up very well and asked us to line up in the cue for the tour we were taking. We then boarded the coach and were greeted by Rowan and Rafeal. We went to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. During this time we were given lots of history and facts by Rowan. She was very knowledgeable about a each area and was very funny at times. We enjoyed spending the day with her. We would recommend this tour for anyone looking for a full day trip. Rafael was a good driver and got us to and from our stops safely. Thank you for a memorable day trip!

I loved having Cata as our host. Cata majored in Art History, so she was EXTREMELY knowledgeable! Nice with a hint of sarcasm, but ehhh.. This tour is a great was to knock out 3 different events, but it makes for a long 12hr day. I would suggest knocking this out earlier in your visit, as it can be long and draining. Stonehenge was cool, the Windsor Castle was is beautiful and has nice shopping areas, as well as restaurants and Bath from London was okay.

Our tour was led by Godfrey, along with Paul driving the bus. I could imagine it would be tough to keep a multi-hour bus ride entertaining, but Godfrey always had an interesting fact or story along with a great sense of humor to keep everyone interested and engaged. He was very knowledgeable about the sites visited and loved to answer any questions.

Katya and Earl did a great job and were fun trip leaders. I learned a lot of English history on the bus and all 3 destinations were very worthwhile. My only nit is that I was not offered the option to buy my admission to Windsor Castle or the Roman Baths when I booked the tour and it was not sufficiently clear that I might, in fact, not be able to enter those destinations. I'm not sure whether that is a problem with the tour company or Trip Advisor. In the end, I was able to buy admission to Windsor Castle for myself and my daughter on site, but I had to ask them to release two additional tickets for the timeframe that we were there, so it was a close call. It seems to me that there is no point to taking a bus ride to Windsor Castle only to be denied admission, so I can't understand why that possibility would be created.

Fun day! It was a pretty decent tour (even tho Windsor castle was closed). Bath and Stonehenge could have used a little more time, but we still got a lot out of each. The guide (Simon) was quite knowledgeable and funny. I liked how the bus had a/c and places to charge cel phones, however the seats became uncomfortable after a while. Bring snacks because it's a lot of driving! (Best views were out the right side).

Saul and Raphael were wonderful hosts on our trip to Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. Saul was informative, engaging and truly caring about or welfare and comfort on the trip. It was a delightful excursion. Raphael was an excellent driver in a hectic environment. Two thumbs up!

This was a wonderful to experience the three sites. I do wish we could have had more time at Windsor Castle. I felt we had enough time at Stonehenge and Bath. We received good information on each site. It was easy to locate our bus.
A special shout out to our tour guide, Nicholas, and drive, Issa. Nicholas was knowledgeable, and personalized the information. He was patient, kind, and humorous. Issa was an excellent, and careful, driver. If I ever tour in London again, I would happily request the two of them.
Ah, post the tour, Nicholas showed a wonderful luxury car store. He even helped us find a wonderful restaurant. He truly went out of his way to insure we had a great day.
Robert and Jerry were absolutely lovely. Robert was extremely knowledgeable and even though Windsor castle was closed he still took us around the castle and explained the history. Highly recommend.

Excellent tour with our great guide Peter and our wonderful driver Beyhow. Peter provided a wealth of information during the tour and the use of the head sets worked well as we were able to hear what he was telling us as we were walking around. We were given some time to do our own things as well but would have loved more time in Windsor Castle and Bath as there is so much to see in both those places. Thoroughly enjoyed Windsor Castle and Bath. Stonehenge was interesting. All the places we visited had a good choice of cafes/restaurants so you could get food quite easily. Recommend this tour.

Excellent tour. Our guide Richard was knowledgeable and shared many stories to keep us engaged between stops. There is a lot to see in one day but this tour was well organized enough to maximize the time in each spot. The directions to the pick up is excellent but don’t be late! This tour company is very punctual! Highly recommended!

The ride was smooth and pleasant. Chrissy shared knowledge about each upcoming site before we arrived as well as areas we were traveling through along the way. But she didn’t talk the entire trip which gave me time to relax or catch a quick nap, which was greatly appreciated. She was so pleasant and entertaining. On the return trip, she walked back and spoke to each person or group which was so sweet and showed that she wanted feedback from us about the tour. Thanks for the enjoyable tour!!

A wonderful tour visiting major landmarks in beautiful countryside. Peter our guide was very knowledgable and gave a humorous and enlightening bus commentary for the whole journey. Throughly enjoyed it and would highly recommend.

All of it - I went on the tour to see Stonehenge but was so impressed with Bath and Windsor Castle. Bath is amazing and will return again for a day trip. Even the coach bus rides between locations was very scenic, with breathtaking views.

Our tour guide, Eugene was super knowledgable, entertaining and very organized. A++++++++++++

Phil, our tour guide, was an absolute wonder to listen to; his beautiful accent paired with his deep and insightful knowledge of the history of the sites and general region fascinated us profoundly. Many laughs were had, numerous gorgeous photos were taken at Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath, and a safe journey was kept. We would happily do this tour again, especially given that our tour the next day with a competitor company was supremely disappointing in comparison. Thank you so very much, Phil! What a wonderful day with an excellent guide!

Great sights, covered the history of the UK in one day.Our guide Simon was outstanding with lots of facts and information delivered with wit and charm. Rad our driver weaved through some very tricky streets and was flawless.
It was a lot to cover in one day both distance and information.

This tour was really good. Our tour guide was Godfrey and our driver was Paul. Godfrey was really good in giving us information along the way, right from the start in London till we finished our tour at the Bath. Very well organised by Evan Evans too. Started right on time at 8am. Was prompt at each of the stops to resume at the designated time. Will definitely recommend this tour to anyone who is interested in seeing all 3 places and learning some history along the way from Godfrey.

Excellent day trip from London! Visiting Bath and Stonehenge would be impossible, or at least very difficult, as a tourist if you don't have a car so this tour allows you to do just that. They take you on a large, air-conditioned coach bus that was quite comfortable. Our tour guide Richard waa excellent, kind, cheerful, and extremely knowledge about all things England! James was an excellent bus driver and got us to and from each place safely and quickly. Can't say enough great things about this tour, it's a must do!

This tour was amazing. Booked it with my daughter so to see many sights in one day. Well worth our time and money. The tour guide absolutely made the experience that much better - Phil was super knowledgeable, accommodating and possessed that quintessential English wit and charm. Thanks Evans Tours and big thank you to Phil!!

Great trip, worth every penny. Peter ( our tour guide) made this a very pleasurable trip by his commentary throughout the trip interlaced with the typical English humor. All 3 places are a must-see for anyone visiting London. Very highly recommended.

Great mix of free time and guided. Our guide was very informative and entertaining with lots of random facts about the countryside through which we were passing. The bus was comfortable and driven well. Ride home was quite long but comfortable.

If you are reading this, booked it now!
Probably the highlight of our London trip, the best time to booked your trip is now, whilst the world is opening and tourists havn’t packed the whole of London yet. Really nice to see a slice of the English country side, our expert tour guide Ms Deb is phenomenal, very knowledgeable and I feel like we are on an epic podcast of a London history guide and our smooth skipper on wheels Mr Barry was amazing as well. Definitely had a wonderful time, plus don’t forget to ask for Deb’s recommendations on the places to have a snack or some nice desserts. Very note worthy trip and professional crew. A big thanks!

Really wanted to see Stonehenge and Windsor Castle. Originally chose to do Oxford but it wasn't able to run, so we were offered the Bath trip instead.
Our tour guide was Bruce and driver was Armando. Both were amazing and enthusiastic. Bruce was extremely insightful on the history of the places and kept everyone entertained on the way. He made sure everyone was on schedule and kept clear timeline throughout the entire trip.
Definitely would have given more than 5 stars if possible. They both deserve the best praise and made our stay in London memorable.

The tour was great. Visiting 3 attractions far apart from each other all in one day seemed impossible. But this inclusive tour made it possible with enough time at each of them.
Our tour guide (Nicholas) was a funny, well educated and knowledgable gentleman giving you a lot of interesting information in a way that makes you enjoy the journey.
Overall I rate this 5star.

Excellent tour! Mel A, the tour guide and the bus driver, Merrick made it fantastic! They got along very well and made us feel very welcome.

My husband, and mother did the day. Very seamless—plan 90 minutes at each stop. Perfect for a quick introduction to each area, and you really only need an hour at Stonehenge. You couldn’t do all of the activities if you are visiting London on your own as easily- so the bus tour is the way to go. I would recommend packing some light snacks.

The coach bus does have a toilet, but they are also readily available at each spot.

Was a nice way to see sights outside of London. Peter was a great guide with helpful information and Valentine navigated the roads with skill. There is enough time at each sight to take in the highlights. We now know where we would like to go back and visit the next time we are here! Appreciate that we were one of the first tour groups at Windsor Castle. Loved being able to take in the countryside views especially around Bath, which was beautiful. Bing lunch with you so you have more time to take in the sights.

Had an amazing tour with Kevin and Michael! The tour started pretty early in the day, but our tour guide Kevin was extremely energetic and was very engaging throughout the trip. Definitely a bit pressed for time but we expected that since there’s three stops. I thought it was a really good way to see everything out here and as long as you go into it knowing you’re going to have to prioritize the things you want to see and maybe speed walk a bit, it’s an amazing tour. Definitely recommend!

Although we booked this tour upon our arrival to London, during the busy Christmas/ New Year holiday season, they were able to accommodate (2 adults, 2 teenagers). From start to finish, it was perfect! The amount of time at each site was just right. It was certainly a long day, but well worth the trip. Our bus driver & tour guide, Joe & Godfrey were great. Godfrey will give you tips on where to go and what to skip at each site. Definitely a must do!

The tour that was arranged through Evan Evans Tours was great. The guide "Emily" was very informative, pleasant and explained things in a story telling way. The only disappointment was that there was not enough time at each location which however is understandable given that we were seeing three attractions in the same day. This was explained when we got on the bus and as Emily put it...this tour will give you a "taste" to hopefully make you want to come back and spend more time.

If you want to see little bit of the countryside and visit three gorgeous places in a day this is the trip for you.

Though the trip started early it was really worth it. Our guide Manon,(I really hope I'm remembering her name correctly. (She is really knowledgeable about the history, areas and is full of fun facts)) greeted us with a smile when we arrived in the coach. She was lovely, helpful and did everything she could to make the trip a little bit more special.
We started our tour driving to Windsor wich was amazing with all of its history and though the visit was short it was incredible being there. Next up was Stonehenge and wow, seeing it with your own eyes is kind of unreal. The last place was Bath and oh how I wish we had had more time staying there. The town itself is magical. The Roman Baths were so interesting and amazing how much has been preserved.
We were also very lucky with our driver (Greg) he was amazing.

This was a great 1 day trip out of London for those that want to seek something else besides the typical tourist stuff in London! The buses were very comfortable and was equipped with wifi to keep us occupied during the long bus rides between each destination! Peter was a great and friendly tour guide, and very humorous as well! Only small bad thing about this trip was that it was very hard to deep dive and explore any of the 3 destinations, but this is what you should be expecting when trying to see all 3 destinations within 11 hours. If you really want to explore any of these 3 destinations, you would need to dedicate 1 day to each destination to fully grasp the whole thing. All in all, this was a highly well coordinated and recommended day trip for those that need something else to do outside of London!

Tour guide Cameron was absolutely amazing!!! He made the tour so enjoyable- filled with the perfect amount of comedy and history. Driver Muhammad made sure the drive was seamless.

You could certainly spend hours longer in both Bath and Windsor but Cameron made sure that we maximised the time we got.

Everything ran so smoothly. Would absolutely recommend to anyone!!

Simon and Olly are great! This is a fun tour that gives a bit of a taste of everything.
We started our day on Victoria Coach Station where everything was super organized and clear. The tour went on time and the drive was very pleasant.
Simon is a very entertaining guide, explained marks during the drive in a very playful manner and fun.
Windsor castle is great, Bath is beautiful and a must. Will definitely go back there for a longer trip. Stonehenge is stunning!
Had good time, definitely recommended :)

Evan Evans tours is a top notch company. The tour I originally booked was canceled due to low number of people who signed up. Totally worth understandable during a global pandemic in January. Excellent communication from the company and we were able to move to a different tour. They made sure we knew what to expect, where to board, etc.
Our tour guide Reese and driver Joe were very professional and so helpful. We were able to get the best pictures during our stops. They kept the tour safe and moving on time. I highly recommend Reese, Joe and the whole Evan Evans tours.

Everything in this day trip is beautiful! Now the tour guide does not give you a guided walking tour but provides historical information on the destinations before arriving. Leslie and Michelangelo were a great team and highly recommend them.
This is a long trip on winding roads via coach. If you get motion sick consider yourself warned but aside from that the trip is well worth it.

Richard was an excellent tour guide. He is very knowledgeable and kept things interesting. We felt the tour was rushed but that is not the fault of the tour guide or the driver. Richard told us up front that we will be touching things in this tour. I recommend more time especially for the Windsor Castle. That felt very rushed.

I really wanted to see Stonehenge and to make the most of the day, I booked this 3-in-1 tour. Yes, it is a lot in one day and you don't really have time to leisurely stroll through the quaint streets of Bath or Windsor, but you will see and learn a lot on this tour. The only place we felt a bit short on time was at Windsor, but we arrived early and were the second group in line so we were able to get through the castle with almost no one else around. We had the pleasure of having Mel as our guide and Steve as our driver. I cannot say enough good things about Mel. He was on top of things from start to finish and full of facts, stories and historical information. Witty and never boring. He also made sure everyone knew how to get back to their hotel or find a place to eat dinner. I have been on many tours and this was among the best I've done. You'll feel well taken care of with Evans Evans Tours. A tip to maximize your time...bring a sandwich and snacks with you so you don't have to wait in line to purchase food at one of the stops. No hot food is allowed, but you have plenty of time to eat on the bus and see more at each location.

Top of the list is Rohan. She absolutely kept everything and everyone on track if you did what she said.
Windsor castle yes a little rushed but Rohan said grave first then the apartments if anytime left The dolls house. The dolls house was closed the day we went so we got two out of three not bad for a couple of recycled teenagers.
Thanks Rohan for the heads up. Great trip if you think positive.
Then onto Stonehenge. Had just enough time to walk around but not enough time to eat. But hey Bath is next. The delay at Stonehenge was brought on by in sufficient shuttles.
Bath we saw everything plus had lunch and chatted with the locals then it was a well earned 3 hour sleep on the way home.
Thanks Rohan for a great day and thanks to the driver for a safe trip.

Did the Windsor Castle/Stonehenge/Bath trip. Rob’s pleasant radio voice and with Jerry at the helm of the bus made the trip great. Weather played nice after the first stop. If you want to book a trouble free tour give this one a go. Grab a breakfast before you go and the rest of the trip there will be opportunity to buy food at all three stops. The interior of Windsor is closed on Tues/Weds so keep that in mind. Only downside is our coach had inoperative USB charging ports so that was a bummer.

This was an awesome tour! Our guide, Kevin, was both informative and entertaining. Windsor Castle is definitely not to miss. Stonehenge was interesting, of course, and the audio guide helped understand the history. The baths were amazing too, again aided by the audio guides.

We really enjoyed the tour, the tour guide Sheila was excellent- full of information, clear, and good-spirited! Very friendly & good driver, too.
My only “negative” comment would be that it felt very rushed, and I just wish I knew it’d be that rushed before I booked it. It was a great way to get a taste of everything, but we were very tired from traveling and wished we didn’t have to watch the clock so much (site-seeing, using the toilets, and grabbing souvenirs).

We just finished our touring trip with Oliver as our guide, and Mark as our driver
Both were most excellent hosts, as they took us to the Inner Circle at Stonehenge, which is only open to .5% of the visitors there!!! We arrived at Stonehenge about 7:15 am, all to ourselves. There were only 22 of us, our guide, Oliver, and the Stonehenge security. Totally amazing to be up close and inside the circle, to hear about the 5000 yr old location, and to knock out a bucket list item with someone I love! We also had a very nice walking tour of Oxford, where we had a pint inside the Eagle and the Child, or "Bird and the baby", where C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien hang out during attending university and writing their stories. Finally, a visit to Windsor Palace, where we shopped, ate, and people watched. Totally worth the trip! Thank you Oliver, Mark, and Evan Evan's tours!

Catia is the best! She literally saved the tour. The sites are simply breathtaking, but the queues are too long. We spent most of the time waiting in the entrance and on the bus. The tour was in English and Spanish at the same time, which makes it hard to stay focused on the history.

Rowan and Cory were simply amazing. I highly recommend this trip to everyone, the bus ride was great and comfortable, we had ample time at each location. Cory’s driving was fantastic and Rowan’s love of history made this trip do educational. Thank you so much from the Canadians

What a great day! Rowan was a prefect guide and gave a lot of good (but brief) information about the places we were visiting. Really great way to get a lot of sightseeing at major destinations done in one day. Everything was timed exactly right in my opinion. There was plenty of time to see the sites and still hand a little extra time to shop and grab a bite. My only complaint is that the seats in the coach aren't terribly comfortable but that's a small price compared to everything else that was great.

Great tour!

Manon was very knowledgeable and friendly.She has many fun facts and i learned cool stuffs about UK.

Its just sad that windsor castle is closed due to the death of the queen. But nevertheless, Manon was still able to pull off the tour by allowing us to stroll along the city.

Paul was also a good driver and took routes that will allow us to see beautiful scenic places.

Thank you for the wonderful experience!

We had an amazing tour with beautiful sights! Saul and David were beyond amazing and knowledgeable. Saul always having answers to questions and David was amazing rerouting in traffic jams to get us everywhere on time! Couldn’t have asked for a better tour. 5/5!

We used Golden Tours and it was wonderful. Our tour guide, Zozo (I think that's how you spell it) obviously knew his history and presented it as a story. The tour inspired me to want to read more history when I got home.

Had a wonderful tour with our guide, Eugene, and driver, Dave. Our guide was knowledgeable, entertaining and informative. I searched for ways to tour these sites on my own but getting to do all three with as much ease as we did was worth the price. Would recommend!

If you visit London you MUST go to this tour. It was very educating, fun-filled experience. Evan Evans staff were very friendly, the whole tour is convenient and hassle free. Special mention to our tour guide Phil (Instagram @tourwithphil) who was brilliant. He provides information not only on the places we visited but special places of interests aling the way. He was personable, quick-witted, funny, accommodating. How we wish all tour guides are like him. Ask him for any recommendations of where to go around London he will point you in the right direction. You will never get bored with him even if you stuck in traffic. Unforgettable experience seeing Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. Worth the money. No need to queue for tickets and ample time was given on every stop.

Went w/ my son on aThursday and weather was gorgeous! Bruce is the tour guide and Armando is the driver, both are friendly and great! Met at spot where they tell u to meet at 8am (ontime), and came back just as planned. The tour is guided by Bruce and he set expectations from the start which i like very much. Because of covid, no lines at all 3 areas! Such a nice time and not crowded. However i wished a little more time in Windsor to look around but they did warn you about what to expect so no complaints from me. Overall good trip! Be warned, tho, when reserving the tour, because of limited day trips availability, they end up automatically moving the date and tour areas automatically. Pay attention and read.
