We had such a lovely day touring Windsor, Stonehenge, & Bath! Tom is a phenomenal guide; knowledgeable & witty, with great stories. We would highly recommend this tour company to see some wonderful sites in the UK. The time travelled between sites seemed brief as we had a great guide. You get about 1.5 hrs at each location, the tour made it all super easy & fun.

A long but wonderful day tour! Our guide was Richard and our driver was Earl and both were terrific. Stonehenge was a bucket list item and it was well worth it in spite of a very rainy day. Had it not been raining, I think I would have felt rushed, instead the weather put us right on time for returning to the bus. I think more time at Windsor Castle would have been appropriate. The Roman Baths were very interesting and the town of Bath even more so. I did feel a little rushed but I know the guides did the best they could and made the most of it.

I booked this tour from Chile and it was really nice, easy to get to the meeting point once in London.
Our guide Kevin was really nice and he made the trip enjoyable all the way, he did a really good job explaining and giving facts along the way.
I saw beautiful places and I liked the guidance, I would recomend completely.

This is a bit of a late review for me, but my experience was amazing with this package. My tour company was Golden Tours and our guide was Vaughn Chryll who was really good and funny. In all honesty the town of Bath and their Roman baths was cool but in my opinion a not needed stop. On the other hand Windsor Castle and Stonehenge were amazing. Particularly Stonehenge since it was a long time dream of mine and even though the weather was very windy and rainy thanks to Vaughn's anecdotes, jokes and historical info, made it an unforgettable experience. I highly recommend it.

This was a great day packed with so many incredible sites (and sights). Kevin has an exceptional knowledge base and explained the history and historical figures so clearly. I could never get the Kings and Queens straight and he used the long drive times between sites to fill us in. He is also kind, funny, and helpful, especially when the audio guides for Stonehenge were a bit glitchy.

Windsor Castle is incredible. I wish I'd done this tour on a day other than Sunday so I could have gone inside St George's. That should be mentioned, I think, in the description. Stonehenge is magnificent and almost unbelievable. The audio guide provided by EE is good, however outdated. It references fencing that will be removed by 2014. Bath is beautiful and the Roman Baths are really interesting.

I am not rating the tour a 5/5 for the following reasons:

1) we waited about half an hour for people who were late and never showed up. This isn't how you treat your customers who have paid hundreds of dollars (with conversion) and bothered to show up on time. It is an early start, 100%, but it is already a long day and tour and waiting for people who never showed up anyway was really frustrating. I didn't get breakfast because I didn't want to be late, and was still 20 minutes early! Turns out, I had time to get food!

2) Kevin told us 3 times when we were pulling into Stonehenge to get off the bus and wait there. He would get our tickets and then bring us to the entrance. As someone at the back of the bus, imagine my surprise when I got off the bus and the first 3/4 of the bus were already at the crossroads and on their way! If you're going to give instructions that are different from the first 3 times you gave them, maybe give them when everyone is present!

3) The microphone on the bus was insufferably choppy. This wasn't Kevin's fault and he did a great job making sure we could all hear and starting again. The only think that I would suggest is that when you're having a laugh and back and forth with passengers at the front of the bus, those of us at the back can only hear the half of the conversation that is on the microphone. Either repeat what they've said or do it off mic.

4) not the fault of the company or Bosco the wonderful and competent driver, but road closures and a car accident meant that our drive home was well over 3 hours. We got back into London at 8:15 and that's a lonnnnng day. There may be a design flaw in the tour, to drive that far away and then just have hope that the drive back will be 2, 2.5 hours... when it is realistically 3, maybe 3.5 hours.... and each stop is about 1.5 hours, so no time for meals -- I was famished by the end of the day and literally fell asleep eating dinner once I got back to my hotel. I do know that Kevin, gracious and kind as he is, booked reservations for another couple at a restaurant for when they got back into London, which is awesome.

5) if a tour is hundreds of $/£ and you're gone for 12+ hours, there should be free WiFi on the bus. (Loved that there were USB plugs on the bus though! Awesome!)

Robert (guide) and Davd (driver) were outstanding. Tour allowed us to understand and see highlights. Preview of Stonehenge with audio guide provided great background.
Highly recommend Evan Evan tours!

My wife and I first time visiting London. Mel was our guide and was the best. Very passionate and knowledgeable. This tour was fantastic. Couldn’t get into Windsor Castle due to the Queens passing but being there to see all the people paying their respects and leaving flowers and notes was unforgettable. Stonehenge was unique and amazing. Bath was vibrant and very busy, we enjoyed the Baths tour and the history and walking around taking in the atmosphere.

We loved this tour!! The bus was well maintained and they had plenty of Covid safety measures to keep everyone safe. The tour guide and bus driver, Lesley and Michelangelo, were amazing! So friendly and funny! We had plenty of time at each stop and we’re able to grab bites to eat during those times. The tour ran smoothly and we learned so much! We would definitely take this tour again!

Our travel guide Zozo was the absolute best. He was knowledgeable and fun. The perfect mix. We learned so much and he kept us all on time actually allowing us a little extra stop at the end to show us where the show Bridgerton was filmed. With Andreas as our bus driver his fantastic skill allowed us the time at every stop. Excellent value.

The trip was amazing. Visited three places with ample of time for each. The tour was perfectly organized. the tour guide 'Bruce' provided all necessary information and kept us entertained throughout the journey!

Our family really enjoyed this tour. Eugene, our tour guide, was fantastic - informative and funny. Magid was a fabulous driver. You get just enough time in each place to get a flavor of it, which is all you can ask for in a day-long tour that hits 3 sites. Well worth the time (and early wake-up)!

Great tour and well structured despite the unforeseeable hiccups. The tour provides a lot to see in a small amount of time; whilst the amount of free time for roaming is quite minimal, it is more than plenty for the experience as long as you’re expecting a ‘taster’ introduction to the places you’re visiting. Richard is an excellent guide and a wealth of information. For me, Bath was the place of greatest interest as I wasn’t expecting the level of history and surprisingly beautiful architecture - I fully expect to return thanks to the experience gained from this tour.

Excellent day trip. Time is slightly limited at each sight but only because you are packing so much into one day. Guide was very knowledgeable and shared a lot of interesting information. I would definitely take a similar tour again. Thank you to Chrissy and Marek for a great day!

Eugene was very knowledgeable and added useful and entertaining commentary. The driver Dave kept it a comfortable drive. Sights were good. You won't have a lot of time at any stop, but you will cover a lot of ground. If you want more time to walk around bath, skip the Roman bath tour.

Excellent tour. Well planned and good information provided throughout the trip. Also had several free hours to ourselves to roam each location. Bus was clean, spacious, had USB charging, and also curtains which were much appreciated on return trip as the sun was setting. We also had 2 options for disembarking, which was really great and saved us some time.

To little time at the sights and to much time on the bus. Constantly felt rushed. The time we had at Windsor castle was less than the time in line, and Stonehenge was a brisk walk around the perimeter and back on the bus. Time for food and bathroom breaks not adequate. Better disclosure should be done by the tour operator in advance.

We really enjoyed this tour. It gives you a little flavor of Windsor and Bath and gives you plenty of time to see Stonehenge. Their communication with us ahead of time was excellent as we traveled the week after the queen passed and could not actually tour Windsor Castle. Our tour guide, Richard, was fabulous! He is extremely knowledgeable and knows all sorts of little known facts about our stops and the areas we drove through.

Our guide, Simon, and driver, Bill were fantastic. The commentary was just right. Be warned that you won't have a lot of time at each location; this is a tasting tour-you'll get a good taste of each, but if you really want to explore in-depth, you'll need separate tours.

bit disorganized at Windsor castle. guide told us to leave all packs, bags umbrellas etc behind as it would slow entry. No rain in the forecast. Obviously rained on us the entire time in the queue.

every one else’s group kept their bags and had their umbrellas. the packs slowed no one down, do not listen to any such advice going forward

long day but a good one. would recommend

This was a great tour, the tour guide Robert was very knowledgeable and cordial. The bus was clean, with very comfortable seats, wifi and USB charging available. All three attractions were awesome, although it would have been nice to spend more time in Bath ;); we had an amazing driver Earl. Thank you Robert and Earl for a great time!

Our guide Eugine and driver Dave were amazing! Our tour guide was very knowledgable, funny and really helpful. He made the driving portion go by really fast. He is by far the best tour guide we have ever had. The route is really good. Stonehenge was a big disappointment you cant go near them nor touch them anymore. Its very man made and all you can do is take a picture and go. However to experience a castle like Windsor where has been inhabited till this day was amazing. You dont have to imagine how it use to look because is right there. Bath was another surprise. I only wished we could have stay in Bath a little longer. I recommend this company. Great service and very well organized. A million thanks for a wonderful time!!!

Very efficient way to visit these historical sites because they are each so far away. I did the Stonehenge/Bath tour and felt like we were given an appropriate amount of time to tour both fully. Definitely recommend you purchase the ticket to the Bath museum.

The bus was comfortable enough although our wifi was out of order.

If you are visiting London, I highly recommend taking a day tour to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. I loved both Windsor Castle and Stonehenge. Our time at Windsor Castle was a little short, I would liked to have spent more time there. Stonehenge is also amazing. Although Bath was nice, I wouldn’t put it at the top of my list as a must see. Our tour guide was good, knowledgeable, and kept us on schedule. Taking a tour is also a great way to see some of England’s countryside.

Simon was awesome. He went above and beyond when giving this tour. His jokes were great, perfect sense of humor that was seriously needed for me. Each place was mesmerizing and he and made it possible. I don't know the name of the driver, but a huge thanks to him as well. Thank you Simon!

Did the Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath tour on 7/2/22z. Our guide was Peter and our driver was Alex. Alex drove us to our destinations safely and Peter was very knowledgeable and funny. We got to spend about 1.5 hours each at Windsor and Bath and about an hour at Stonehenge. I learned a lot and I do recommend this tour.

Good trip. Clean bus. Godfrey kept everyone on time.
Kay (driver) was pleasant & traveled safe. Usually not a group tour family but Glad we booked the trip…we got to see the important sites, then load up and move on.

amazing guidance from Godffrey and a pleasant trip on coach driven by Paul. we felt secure with the health measures taken and very much entertained by the sightseeing and information shared with us. be prepared for an intense day full of activities. would have liked to stay more at bath but probably because it might need a couple of days to be fully explored. i recommend it.

My wife and I took this tour with John the driver and Richard the guide. We had a wonderful time. Richard was very knowledgeable, polite, patient, and soft spoken. He spoke in a number of languages and made everyone feel welcome. The bus was very comfortable seating and temperature wise. I have gone on many tours and I know the good ones from the bad ones and this was an excellent one. Thank you Richard, thank you for bringing myself and my wife into your world and making us feel at home 😊

Incredible tour with visits to three beautiful and historic sites. Richard, the tour guide, was fantastic. He was knowledgeable and entertaining. Paul, driver, made the drive smooth. Highly recommend the tour with this company. A personal moment for me was when I misplaced my wallet. Richard showed a lot of concern for me and when we found it, he was so kind to just give me advice for the rest of my trip. He showed me he genuinely cared for me not just on his tour. Says a lot to me.

Nicholas & Michael Angelo were fantastic! Nicholas could have his own TV show or youTube channel. He knew so much about the history of England and every stop on the tour and really made this tour the best ever. Michael Angelo's driving was perfection! This tour is a MUST!

We were fortunate to have Richard as our tour guide and Alex as our bus driver. Richard gave us plenty of information and insight and made the entire trip informative and fun. Very professional, I highly recommend this tour with Evans Evans.

Great experience. Super friendly check in and very efficient throughout the day.

We departed at around 0800 and returned at 2000. Almost 12 hours. You will see each site and be spending anywhere from 60-90 minutes at each location.

Our tour guide was super friendly and very knowledgeable, made it a great experience.

The bus we were in was clean and well kept. Definitely good for some shut eye between stops. If you want to see as much as you can in one day, take this trip.

Katia and Lester are a great team!
Friendly, helpful and welcoming.
Katia’s knowledge and engaging way of telling the history are thoroughly enjoyable and really informative.
The tour of Windsor/Stonehenge/Bath is a lot to pack into one day, however, my time was limited so needs must. I would totally recommend a stay in Bath it looks like a beautiful place.
Take your woollies for Stonehenge in winter the wind makes your eyes water. But such an impressive site. Map and audio provided made it really interesting.
Katia and Lester also made sure we got maximum time in each place - great day! Thank you 😊

Thank you to Rhys the tour guide and Joe the driver!. I had an awesome trip and sights and memories to remember forever. Rhyse's is so informational and always thinking about the trip from YOUR perspective. Listening to him speak and use of the English language coupled with his witty humor was something I truly enjoyed listening to. The trip to Windsor Castle felt like an all exlcusive trip where I got to experience the castle as if were a private tour. Stonehenge was breathtaking and to end the trip, Bath was also an awesome sight to see. Again, thank you and wish you guys nothing but the best, keep on!

My friend and I booked a trip with Evans and Evans in August 2019 and Rhys Thomas (guide) and Dennis (driver) are a great team that made this trip worth it! They were prompt and communicated clearly all the directions and time, which is get important on a tour. It was emphasize the time to get back so they respect people's time. They threw in British humor and was receptive to feedback and questions. The bus was comfortable and clean! Would recommend this for anyone who wishes to see these three sites.

Fantastic Tour! Very organized and ran on time throughout the day. Richard was a great guide- very educational and organized throughout the day. Corey was a great diver and felt safe all day, even in London traffic. Would travel with Evan and Evan’s again.

It was a very nice day trip were we visit Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and the Bath. Windsor Castle is very large and there we had aprox 2 hours to visit the rooms and the gardens. For us it was enought but if you want to visit the entire castle with all the rooms you need a minum full day only for this. We understand that even the Queen did not visit all the rooms. :)
Everything was very well organised. Nota 10.

Sorry I can’t recommend this trip as we were unable to attend the Stonehenge and Bath portions. We were left behind at Windsor Castle because we got turned around and got lost looking for the bus car park,which was pretty far from the castle. I was expecting the tour guide to wait for us at the castle exit but no, and so we felt abandoned. Other tours we have had were more carefully controlled. The Windsor castle part was pretty rushed so I didn’t consider it a good value.

The guide (I believe named Sheila) was amazing! She was very informative, friendly, and helpful. We saw exactly what was advertised. Felt very safe with our driver, Joe, behind the wheel! The sites of Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge were worth the trip plus seeing beautiful countryside along the way was very pleasant!

Great tour. Covers a lot of ground in a short period of time and you will find yourself wishing you had more time at each stop. Charlotte was our tour guide and she was simply amazing at what she does. Ask for her if you can.

A great “sampler” tour of three must-see places when in London. Andy was a fantastic and hilarious tour guide: full of interesting information, advice, and great stories. Pro tip: bring snacks, water, sunscreen and dress in layers as it’s a long (but very fun) day.

We have done two tours with Evan Evans and both were great. Our tour guide, Crissy was lovely, knowledgeable, professional and helpful. It helps so much to have a tour company do all the work of getting tickets and not having to wait in lines to enter places like Windsor Castle and Bath. Of course, we wish we had more time in places like Bath but the tour does give you a great taste in case you want to return in the future.

Well, better late than never! I went to London back in late February. The tour was EXCEPTIONAL. This is the best way to see 3 major attractions, especially since they are very far apart. Evans Evans made the transportation/ticketing seamless!! I cannot emphasize this enough.

One of the greatest highlights (apart from the amazing attractions) was our guide, Richard. He was incredible, well informed, funny, and made the experience memorable! An enthusiastic, well informed tour guide goes a LONG way in making the experience memorable. Thank you Richard!!!

Robert was a great guide. The places were far more interesting and nicer than what I saw in pictures. The bus was clean, had WiFi, and usb ports to charge the phone. I'd love to have more time in each place, mostly in Bath town, but that may require a different tour. Being able to visit these 3 places in a day was awesome.

We visited Stonehenge, Windsor and Bath from London recently. We traveled with our family which included our young adult sons. It was a very efficiently managed trip. Peter was our guide and Vin was the driver of the vehicle and they were both fantastic. Peter was very knowledgeable and shared a lot of details about the places as well as stories, and history behind each of the places. He had a great sense of humor which made the tour very enjoyable. Vin was an excellent driver. The tour departed and arrived on time. I would highly recommend this tour to everyone.

Great tour!
Our guide Mel is just Brilliant. He delighted us with so much info about British history on the ride and he is very engaging, super kind and very funny, I have actually laughed a lot - very pleasant day.
I had a great time and he made the tour even more interesting and comfortable.
The driver Mark was very kind as well.
Recommended. The venues are incredible of course, everything went as planned, just a bit of traffic on our way back but not a big deal.

Bruce, our guide, was terrific. Clear instructions on where to go and where to meet, Amrish, our driver, was a treasure! Such a lovely fellow. Longer stays in each place would be nice. Luckily, we didn't go into Windsor Castle or else we wouldn't have had time for lunch! The Stonehenge experience was wonderful however rushed it was but we didn't get to see much of Bath, or have a decent feed there because the Roman Baths took up a lot of our time and even then we were rushed through it. It would be better to do these two sights in your own time.

Our guide Jennifer was so lovely! She was a wealth of information and made for an enjoyable ride to and from the different locations. We arrived 30 mins early to Windsor to avoid long queues and she kept our whole group entertained by telling stories and giving history lessons of the castle. She had a lot of enthusiasm and excitement for the history and worked very hard to ensure we all had an enjoyable experience.

We had a wonderful tour guide, Nicholas, who gave us a bunch of info without it feeling overwhelming. He was better than the audio guides provided at the sites. It was a long day, but we saw so much and the amount of time given at each site was just right. Kevin, our driver, got us smoothly and safely from place to place. This is definitely the best way to see 3 of the best sites in England!

Our tour was March 1, 2020. My wife, 13 yr old daoghyrt and me. We lucked out on the weather, cold and breezy but no rain. The bus was very comfortable and modern. We had a great tour guide who was very knowledgeable about our surroundings and on the sites. We would highly recommend the tour.

Enjoyed the day trip to these must-see touristy spots outside of London. Highly recommend this tour company. Our guide, Kevin, was full of information and stories (and “cheesy” puns), and our bus driver, Ben, is a master behind the wheel. Be sure to mind your time at Windsor Castle as there is more to see - and listen to on the audio guide - than what you will have time for. Lucked out and caught the changing of the guard processional. All in all, an enjoyable whirlwind of a tour!

This tour was absolutely amazing! My husband and I do a lot of traveling and this trip truly stands out. Our guide was informative and humorous. He added in information that we didn't expect about local culture and history. I would recommend this trip to anyone who wants to see multiple sights and have a great time.

We were so impressed with the knowledge Robert shared with us, providing important context for the sites we visited. Windsor Castle could take weeks to truly go through but today gave us a great overview. Enjoyed visiting Stonehenge and thinking about how and why the stones were there. Bath is worth the visit-so much to see, including the Roman Baths and Bath Abbey. For any Jane Austen fans, the museum is worth the walk!

We spent a long and amazing day with Godfrey our guide and Kim our driver <3 They took really good care of us and bought us to the most amazing sights. Everything was organized so well and we had the perfect amount of time at each site. After reading other reviews, we brought food with us so we didn't waste any time. It was also a rainy day, but that didn't stop us from enjoying :-) You might want to bring a small umbrella just in case :-)

Our guide Peter and driver, Behar made this trip exceptional! Peter provided so much information and helped set expectations correctly. This was a jam-packed day that let us get a taste of southern England in just one day. The three attractions are very different so time just flew by.

Tour organization was excellent and there was almost no time spent waiting in lines, making the most of the time we had. The coach was very comfortable.

This is an all day activity. We boarded the bus a 7:30a and got back to London around 7:30p. That said, it's totally worth the price if you want to see Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath. Nice tour bus, pleasant ride through the city and into the country. Jennifer, our tour guide, was great. Friendly, approachable, organized and full of information about the sites and other points of interest along the way. The tour company takes care of everything and ample time is given at each stop to see the attractions and the surroundings if desired. Once at the actual sites, it becomes a self tour, which we liked. Audio guides are available but we chose to wander at our own pace and had plenty of time.

Enjoyed the sites but no time for lunch. Leaving the castle, we were able to purchase bottle water! Stonehenge had pre-made sandwiches and drink selection! Bath had small eateries. If you cut the tour short, you could find the time to relax, eat and drink a beverage!

Thank you for a great start to the new year, Windsor, Stonehenge, Bath.
If your looking to learn more about History this is the Tour to take, our guide Mel Adams had so much Knowledge and delivered it with great understanding and humour.
A long day but goes so quick, the weather was on our side as well, cold but stayed day.
Total recommend, I wish I had a history teacher like Mel, all questions answered.

Sacha was our tour guide- she is the BEST! She brings humor, warmth and a great deal of knowledge to the tour. She was very energetic! You could not help but be captivated by her enthusiasm. Each leg of the tour was organized and well executed.
Our driver Elisa was also helpful. She is an excellent driver - you feel as if you are in good hands. The bus was clean and comfortable.
Each part of the tour had a self paced audio tool so we could learn as we walked.
Highly recommended!

We enjoyed our tour but wish we would have spent more time at Windsor. Because most of the tour consists of driving to different places, we didn't have enough time at Windsor. Still, this is a beautiful castle and we even saw Queen Elizabeth from a distance. Stonehenge was awesome to behold in person and we got plenty of pictures. We were not impressed with Bath. Our guide, Steve, was very good and Eduardo, the bus driver, was also excellent. If booking again, I would get a tour that just goes to Windsor and Stonehenge.

It would be a good idea to get a big breakfast before leaving.

We had a great experience! Godfrey was our guide and he was both knowledgeable and humorous. He gave us little tidbits of trivia and information while keeping us on our schedule. They got us to the head of the queues and the vouchers we needed to see the attractions. We definitely had more than enough time to experience and enjoy the whole place. It was definitely worth it.

Oliver was our guide. He was professional and has a sense of humor. Aston was our driver and he was great communicating his legal time restrictions. Even came looking for us when we were the last guests to come back from a stop.

They warned we would be disappointed with the time spent at each spot, and that was true!! Each place was breath taking and I could have spent significantly more time at each stop.

Very grateful to give me a "taste" of other parts of London!

Thank you!

Our guide was very personable and knowledgeable.

Wish we had more time in Bath. I thought I had purchased tickets for all attractions but somehow missed the entry into the actual "Baths". This turned out to be ok as it provided us time to grab a nice lunch near the river.

Stonehenge was also very neat but wish we had been able to go closer (no fault of the tour guide, just rules in general).

We also were unable to visit St. George's Chapel due to trainings. While slightly disappinted, we wouldn't have had time to visit St. George's AND windsor castle. We were told we'd have two hours to explore but actually only had one hour in the Castle due to wait lines and security checks to get in. Make sure you eat before hand and bring water.

While the bus was nice, the seats were a little cramped.

Make sure to read all fine print and tour restrictions before booking.

Excellent day in the English countryside, visiting Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. Eugene is a 5 star guide and nobody parallel parks a giant coach like Raad. Everything was precisely timed and the commentary was engaging and interesting. Highly, highly recommend this tour.

Very nice tour…All thee locations are great and our tour guide Eugene and captain Bah did an amazing job in organising this. Eugene knows a lot about the place ans covers things in very fine details.

Prioritise this tour our other day tours.

Caution - Be prepared for at least 15,000 steps for this day.

Kevin (tour guide) and Luan (driver) were AWESOME!!!! Kevin was very professional, warm, knowledgeable and interactive with our group. He gave great tips on how to maximize our experience. He was not only knowledgeable about the scheduled locations, but ALL the towns and areas in between. I will definitely be back to try other tours. Thanks so much for a brilliantly executed and wonderful day!!!

Grace & Aidan (U.S.A.)

Phil was our tour guide and he was so nice and informative. He told us tidbits about everything and was always very patient, kind and helpful. There are bathrooms at the office where you meet at 7:30am - very handy. The bus was comfy and nice. It was comforting to go to the English countryside for the day and visit these historical places. I would highly recommend this tour.

We loved our tour guide Robert with Evan’s Evans tours. He was a great historian and delightful.
Gave great history of English royals and history of each place we visited with a bit of humor mixed in. Well done.

I absolutely enjoyed my time, all 12 hours, seeing the sites with our brilliant tour guide Mel and faithful driver John. This is a great way to get a survey of Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. Mel brought delightful energy and graduate level knowledge to the experience. He's tragically funny and his passion for the history of London is a joy! I wish I had more time at Windsor Castle. Do follow Mel's instructions on what to see in a hurry. Windsor is probably best as a stand alone tour. Stonehenge was interesting but the time here was perfect. Not a lot to see or do here. Bath is a beautiful English city and Mel went above and beyond on this tour. The coach was clean and well maintained. The instructions/directions to find the tour were easy to follow. Thank you

Tour guide, Chrissy, and driver, Greg, were excellent. Great way to see highlights in a short period. Do wish had more time at Windsor but understand that Windsor/Stonehenge/Bath all in a single day is a lot and this tour is just meant to give highlights.

An outstanding tour with Peter the guide and Alex the driver.
Even though it seemed like it would be a very long day, it was broken up nicely.

Peter kept us entertained but didn’t ramble as some guides tend to do.

We had a great opportunity to have short visits to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath in a single day.

After visiting Bath we thought it would be a great place to return to for a longer visit!

The coach left the station on time and Peter kept us on time!

Eugene and Cory did an excellent job. The tour was well planned and we had enough time to hit the highlights in Windsor, Stonehenge, and Bath. Enjoyed Eugene and he did a great job providing us information along the way

Deb/ Mrs Weasley was the best.
I’d go on any tour with her operating.

It was just enough time at each location, especially with all that was accomplished in one day. Highly recommend, just make sure you’re getting on her bus.

Full day of fun! If you are crunched on time in London and trying to see as much as you can then this is tour for you. Nicholas was our tour guide and was SO knowledgeable and kept us on schedule all day. We took our 8 month old daughter and had a wonderful day! Windsor castle and Stonehenge are stroller friendly. If you go into the Roman Baths you are have to leave the stroller at the desk and they take it to the exit just FYI. Overall, great tour and great value!!

Nice and compact day tour covering 3 attractions outside of London. Gives you a flavor of England outside of the big city. Our guide Peter was knowledgeable, friendly and helpful. We enjoyed the trip very much. Certainly recommend it if you don’t have a lot of time to visit these places individually!

Each stop was good but there just wasn't enough time at any of them. We felt rushed at each site and couldn't really enjoy the experience. We would have loved at least another hour at Windsor Castle. Maybe make the tour only 2 of the 3- maybe Windsor and Stonehenge. Our tour guide, Debbie was great. She was very knowledgeable and friendly.

Excellent day out....Katia was very knowledgeable and kept everyone interested for the duration. Our driver Lester was true to his word and got us back in the allocated time. While it's an extremely long day it's worth getting a 'taster'of the three locations encouraging a return and perhaps more in depth visit to your favorite of the day.

Wonderful day. Peter our tour guide was so informative and fun. Each location was great. Highly recommend. Realize there is little time to grab anything to eat and it is a long day. So bring stuff to eat and water. Also prepare for all kinds of weather in one day. My only negative is that after we checked in at 7:15 am we got coffee. But then right before we board they tell everyone NO hot drinks. Everyone had to throw away their just purchased coffees. They sd say that in preboard and even have a sign.

We had booked the tour to see all three places along with the admissions to them. Jennifer & Ben from Evans and Evans tour company were extremely helpful & pleasant to work with. I’m assuming that trip advisor is working with Evans and Evans tour company so we had been automatically assigned to them. Jennifer was very informational regarding the history, knowledgeable about the area and was a great resource with recommending us on how to go around London. The bus was on time & because of the admission being included in the ticket, it was so easy & helpful!

Stonehenge is an experience all to itself. I would recommend anyone who comes to England to see it. The city of Bath is absolutely beautiful steeped in history. Don’t miss it. Peter was an excellent guide with a great sense of humor. Paul was an incredible driver who showed us the beautiful English countryside.

I would recommend the trip to my friends. It is a relaxing way on touring three places in one day. Our guide is Robert and driver is Tom. Robert is very good at keeping us entertained with England historical stories while waiting in a queue.

Catia was our tour guide and she was knowledgeable, courteous and attentive. She made our tour one of the highlights of our trip. Our driver Barry was a cautious and skilled driver. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I will recommend Evan and Evans in the future to my friends and family.

Highly recommended that you all have to visit this places. What a pass history. Evan is the best , excellent guide . He is hard working guy I must say . Proper information. We just paid at the counter and he took care if everything including lunch and tickets . The bus driver and Evan was every friendly with us and guided were all we can take stroller. All the three places are highly recommended and you are back in London by 8 pm . No words to say more . Thank you Evan and team .

The guide, Peter was really good! He knew what he was talking about.
Over expectation and you have for more that what you paid for. Since the Queen passed away recently, we were not able to visit inside the Windsor castle. However, they granted us a refund without the need of any action on our part.

If you like history, you should not hesitate to take this tour, believe me, it worth it.

Had a wonderful day. Enjoyed the tour. Our tour guide Richard was very informative. Our bus time was a lot of history about the areas we were traveling through. Time allotted at each stop was sufficient. Would highly recommend Evans Evans and this tour.

Our driver, Walter, and our tour director, Eugene, were superb. Walter got us there safe and sound, and Eugene was so full of knowledge and humor. I’d recommend this tour to anyone. We had our best day of vacation on this trip.

Peter was our guide for this bus tour experience with Evan Evans. He is very knowledgeable and thorough in his history and made the logistics very easy to follow. It is a fast paced trip to see all three sites but still worth it to have the guided tour. It’s a little tricky at the bus station for departure but stay patient and everyone will be assisted.

Evan Evans tour with tour guide Mel Adams was wonderful. During a time of stress and social distancing, it was truly a delight to tour with Mel. He was positive, upbeat and made us forget that there was chaos in the world. He is very knowledgeable about history and is a pleasure to have as a guide. I have been on several day tours and this by far has been the best ever because of Mel. All the stars and keep it up! It was award winning : )

We booked with Evans & Evans. Robert was our guide, Earl was our driver. They made a great team. We went just after Windsor Chapel reopened after Queen Elizabeth’s funeral. Richard advised us to visit chapel first as it was a historic time. Had he not, we would have missed the opportunity as the lines were quite long. At Stonehenge Richard and Earl got us there just ahead of the crowds which kept us on schedule for our visit to Bath. Richard’s love for his country and job were apparent in all he shared with us. His knowledge was vast. We had such a wonderful day. I highly recommend Evans & Evans and the team of Richard and Earl.

Great day and an easy way to get out of London and view the countryside from a coach window and touring the sites. We know now that we would like to spend more time in Windsor and Bath and hope to return some day. Lovely to pay our respects to the Queen in her final resting spot in the beautiful St. George's Chapel. Special thanks to our driver Greg and tour guide Richard. We really enjoyed all of the history lessons and special sites being pointed out as well as recommendations on places to eat and see. The headsets helped a great deal too. Full Fun Trip!

We had a great experience with Evan Evan Tours. Richard was our guide and he did a wonderful job! He clearly communicate times and shared his vast knowledge of England. Highly recommend taking a tour next time you’re in London!

We had a wonderful trip. Mel was a very knowledgeable and friendly guide, he made the day fun and interesting. Would defiantly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to visit Windsor Castle ,Stonehenge and Bath.

The ease and convenience of seeing several important sites in one trip was definitely appreciated. Katia and Earl were superb. They took the time to get to know all of us passengers and made sure we were well taken care of. Katia had so much knowledge. Yes you will be tired by the end as this is an 11 hour trip, but worth it if you don’t have a lot of time to do all you want.

Richard was extraordinary (very kind and knowledgeable) , and our drivel Bill was very professional. It was a great tour for the whole family. You get to see 3 mayor attractions in 1 day (Windsor castle, Stonehenge and Bath). 10000% worth the time and money.

Stonehenge is amazing! The other stops at Windsor and Bath were great too. Nick was our guide and ran the tour in English and Spanish. He did a great job in both languages. He shared his vast knowledge with us in a personable and friendly way. He gave many recommendations too. Only reason it's not a 5 is because the WiFi didn't work. And to his credit - Nick allowed us to use his phone as a hot spot. But that eventually ran out and we were forced to use our own data plans when we needed to go on line. That's bad on Evan Evans. Otherwise awesome trip.

A late review I went in July 2019, but my experience was amazing with this package. Our guide was really good and funny I forget the name sorry it's been a year. Bath was my favorite place to visit during the tour since I am into ancient Roman history. Windsor Castle and Stonehenge were amazing. Particularly Stonehenge since it was a long time dream of mine and even though the weather was very windy and rainy thank's to my guides great personality with jokes and historical info, made it a great experience. From the beginning to the end the tour was well organized. There was enough time to stroll around all the places we visited. I would recommend anyone who wants to explore England In a day!

Interesting, educational, and fun. However, Evan Evans Tour did NOT return us to the starting location as promised and was late in arriving back. Had to walk nearly 2 miles and did not arrive to hotel until after 9 PM! Very bad indeed. The tour guide, Catia, was, however, particularly helpful and knowledgeable.

We really looked forward to this day trip to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath and it did not disappoint! Katie, our tour guide, was amazing. She made the trip even better than we expected with all of her knowledge. We loved the facts and especially the stories. It was amazing. A shout out to Steve our driver too, he did a great job maneuvering through London and the country side and kept us safe. If you want to do this tour I would recommend getting Katie as your guide.

Seats should be 1st come 1st served. Latecomers had better assigned seats. Wasnt given wifi til the end of the day, it should be at the start of the day. Otherwise, such a great experience. Guide was friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. Able to do alot in one day and headphone/box was a nice add on.

We were skeptical about taking this tour vs a private tour. In hind sight a very wise decision to go with a Tour Operator and Coach. We saved almost 1k pounds and the trip was fabulous.

The whole trip was managed in typical British timing...on time and perfectly set up. Best of all was our Tour guide (Mel). Great sense of humor, detailed and respectful of downtime. Would do another tour with him in a heart beat!!!!

The logistics of seeing these site on your own are simply impractical. Nigel was an excellent guide and host, and Tom's skillful driving made the ride so comfortable. I truly appreciated the sites, but most of all the Evan Evans staff.

Amazing day with a fabulous guide/driver Duo! Eugene and Paul were professional, courteous and knowledgeable. Paul was an expert driver, took us through all the narrow streets like a pro. Eugene kept us entertained with facts, stories and anecdotes. We truly enjoyed our day and highly recommend the tour.

An amazing trip to three awesome places. Though the weather was not so friendly specially in Stonehenge, It was a good memory specially after Covid times. Mel the tour leader was a great and knowledgeable person.

It's a lot to pack into a single day but a really fantastic tour. We started at Windsor and had about 90 minutes to look around. Then we drove 2 hours to Bath where we had about 2 hours to look around. Then drove 1 hour to Stonehenge where we had about 90 minutes. Simon was our very excellent guide. He had us well prepared for each stop. He shared lots of history, tips, jokes and was all around a very good human. Raad our driver was very professional. The coach was very comfortable. The headsets provided worked great. It was all perfect and we felt like we accomplished a lot of travel goals. I highly recommend.

Had a tour with Richard as our guide and his driver, we enjoyed this day with my daughter, grandkids and her husband. Very very nice. Be sure to wear comfortable shoes, you’ll be walking quite a bit with a lot stairs. Had a lovely educational day, one I will never forget. Thank you so much for this trip, it was a dream come true.

Amazing experience. Make sure to be back at the bus on time for whatever the guide tells you as they will leave you behind but you might get lucky and catch the next one if you aren’t the last group of the day. The guide was funny and very knowledgeable.

This trip was really good. Different people liked different bits.
However, Eugene and Jermaine from Premium Tours made it super interesting and bang on time.
So many facts and useful information.
Would definitely recommend 😁

Our family of 4 did your tour number 21 to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath today. Our coach driver Laurie and our delightful tour guide Manon were both a joy to spend the day with. Manon was very informative and engaging, we learnt a lot across the day. Thank you Laurie and Manon 😊 Janette, Debbie, Sue and Ian

As my first ever tour (and going solo at the same time), this was amazing. Leila and Dan were great, friendly, and very knowledgeable! I felt well looked after and had an incredible time. I actually enjoyed that once we were at the destinations we got guidance on where to go and how long we could stay, and then were left free to do our own thing.

Only downside was that there wasn't enough time at Windsor Castle to have a look at everything - but that's just the nature of doing so much in one day.

If you're wondering whether to book a tour - just do it!

With the Queen's death and the closing of Windsor unexpectedly falling in the middle of our trip we were concerned it would negatively impact our tour. But our guide Robert and driver Luan made the day memorable and special. We highly recommend Evan Evans.

Had a fantastic time on this tour. Unfortunately, I did not see that Tuesdays and Wednesdays Windsor castle is closed, but was still able to see the outside and learn more about the history. Robert was a great host, he’s very knowledgeable about the history. Jerry was a great driver. Was able to see a lot on this tour.

We took this excursion the day after Queen Elizabeth’s death so Windsor Castle was closed. They gave us the option to cancel or get a partial refund which I chose, and received the next day. Even though we only got to go around the outside of the castle, it was a great experience. The full day trip was well worth it, because of our you guide Catia. She was so knowledgeable, professional yet personable! She made our trip! Our bus driver John was great and accommodating as well!

Andy shared his wealth of knowledge in a very entertaining and balanced way. Andy personalised the experience by checking in with each of the tourists to make sure their needs were being met. We had a great day with all the places we visited providing lots of memorable experiences. Mark drove the bus in a safe way.

The boarding of the coach bus at Victoria Coach Station was orderly and on time. Each of the locations was interesting and fun. I think our excellent experience mostly came from our tour guide, Manon. She is very knowledgeable, kind, and patient. Overall, she’s just very caring which made our holiday very relaxing. Thank you Manon!

While visiting London with my family of four my family and I spent the day with this tour and absolutely loved it. The tour operator was helpful and entertaining. While I wish we could have more time at Windsor I understand the time constraints since this is a lot to do in one day. The bus was very comfortable and had great air conditioning. I highly recommend!!

our Tour Guide Rowan was amazing made the tour much more entertaining and fun with her bubbly energy. Stoneheng was interesting a concept of what a sundial orrery would look like and the resemblense to the Japanese Torii Gates and the Moon Gates all that was interesting. The three ancient civilizations of Bath and there development of the town was a wonder to consider.

This was an amazing tour! Great way to spend a day in England. Eugene was an excellent tour guide, and extremely knowledgeable and funny! And Bill was a great driver.

I only wish we had more time in Bath, but this really was a full day of sightseeing.

Would 100% recommend taking this tour!

Saul was an excellent tour guide! Well organized and informative - easy going and good with people. Conscientious of the tour’s needs.

Would recommend to friends, and would be interested in taking other tours w this company.

Thank you for a lovely time!

This was a great tour. All 3 places were amazing!
Mel, our guide, was friendly and personable and was a wealth of knowledge and informative about each place,it’s history. Mel added to the adventure by speaking on points of interest along the drive.
John, our driver was also great. Got us around safely as as quickly as possible to allow as much time in each place as necessary.

Highly recommended!!

Booked because I wanted to see Stonehenge which for me was a bucket list item. I didn’t do entry to Windsor Castle abs wondered the town which has lots of little shops and quaint. I do regret not going into the Roman Baths but walked around the town. Godfrey and Barrington were excellent and informative. This is a very good tour but a long day so do it early in your trip is my suggestion

We had a great day with Evans Evans tours to Windsor castle, stone hedge and Bath city. We had enough time at each place and Richard (the guide) and Alex is really organized and helpful. We really enjoyed the trip!

The trip was amazing and Patricia was a terrific guide. So much information! Hats off to our driver Luan who navigated us expertly. My only wish was that we had more time at each destination. But we knew there was a lot of ground to cover. Recommend for anyone who wants check these sites off your list.

Misses our original bus but was able to get on the next one. Our guide Robert and Driver Walter were great! Robert pointed out the must see things at Stonehenge and Bath. He also gave us an extra walking tour of Bath. He took us to the Circus streets...and I immediately recognized the houses from the movie musical Oliver! Stonehenge was fascinating too. Really enjoyed this trip!

Had a great time on this tour. our guide, Richard, was extremely knowledgeable and personable. Our driver, earl, did a great job getting us places safely. We covered a lot of ground and saw so much of England in just 1 day.

Godfrey is a wonderful tour guy. He is funny and make sure everyone has a good time. We got a lot of time to visit Stonehenge and Bath. Windsor Castle is’t open yet but we still get to walk around and enjoy the view of the castle from the outside. As a solo traveler, I highly recommend the tour! Book it and have fun guys!

Great tour to see so many sites in one day. The day was full with 3 different sites, but there was still enough time to spend at each location. Definitely recommend the trip for someone who wants to get out of London. Deborah was a fantastic tour guide. She provided a lot of knowledge but did not speak the entire tour.

This tour was overall a great experience! Our tour of Windsor got cancelled due to the Queen's passing, but we were able to explore the town and see the changing of the guard. There was just the right amount of time at Stonehenge and then we were off to Bath. The Roman Baths are a must visit, but it did take away from exploring the city. We are definitely planning on going back!

In addition, Rowan and Corey were great! Rowan provided history, fun facts, and was a great guide! Corey got us to our destinations safely and also checked-in about our experiences between stops. I would definitely go on another tour with them!

Very much enjoyed the day trip. Our tour guide was Sheila, and she was excellent. The time to browse independently after formal portions was perfect. The historical information throughout the day while travelling was an added bonus.
Definitely recommend.

Loved Windsor Castle. Followed our tour guide Bruce's directions and saw everything! Driver Armando got us to all 3 destinations in great time. Really enjoyed Stonehenge and Bath! Our British Cousin Bruce was very informative and kept us laughing!

Excellent tour! Our guide, Eugene was fantastic - very knowledgeable, funny and gave great directions. At each stop you have enough free time to explore. The coach was also very comfortable - thanks to Raad for safely driving us to each of the sites and back.

Had a fantastic one day tour to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge & last stop Bath. My guide was Mel who made the tour fun and has so much knowledge it’s unbelievable. Very informative &
seems to care about everybody on the tour. Thoroughly recommend this tour if you get Mel you would have the best tour ever!

Our tour guide Richard and driver Alex did an awesome job! A very well-organised trip. Richard knows a lot about England and I learned a lot of historical facts and trivias during the trip. It was worth booking and waking up early. Will definitely book them again for the other tours in the future.

It was fabulous. Our guide, Richard, was delightful and full of great insights. I would not have had these insights if I went on my own. I also would not be able to see all that I did in one day. The coach was comfortable and the sights were fantastic. It was cold and windy and I loved every moment of it.

What a fabulous day! We absolutely loved it! Great to see so many places in a day, and Richard’s commentary and knowledge really enhanced the day.
When we visit London we normally stay in the area, but I’m so pleased we headed out and experienced other cities.
A truly fantastic day out thanks to Richard and Bill!

Overall, it's worth a one-day trip. Winsor Castle is excellent. However, don't quite understand why the early (before it opens) waiting is necessary. Should describe clearly for the items which excluded on the ticket, e.g. Lunch for example.

This was a great way to get a quick look at some of the most popular attractions near London.Very well organized. Very comfortable buses. I appreciate the WiFi. Our guide was very welcoming and knowledgeable Would never done all that any other way.

Peter, and our driver Bill, took us safely to some of the coolest places I’ve ever been. He was full of knowledge of each of our tour locations, as well as places we would pass along the way. It was such a treat to finally see Stonehenge and be introduced to the beautiful city of Bath.
This tour is great for those of you looking to visit new places! It is full of beautiful sites, and gorgeous countryside. Be aware of the time constraints at each stop, and you’ll enjoy this day trip!

Our tourist guide-Godfrey and bus driver-Barry were very efficient and experience. They shared lots of interesting facts about the attractions that we had visited. The activities were planned timely to perfection. Cozy bus with free wifi onboard and they had USB charging port too. Highly recommended and thumbs up to our tourist guide and bus driver. Thank you for this memorable journey.

Peter is a very knowledgeable, patient with good sense of humour tour guide. We enjoyed our day exploring Windsor Castle, Stonehenge as well as Bath. I would suggest more time at Bath.

Thank you Peter and to Sam for driving us safely.

This trip was an awesome stress-free day. It was seriously like being a kid again with your parents. Your only job was to report to the bus at the designated time. This was our favorite day of our weeklong stay in London. Sheila (or host) and Mickey (our driver) were friendly, gracious and informative.

We had a lovely day visiting Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. Our tour guide Manon was excellent…she was very informative and nice. She made the day smooth and easy.

The three locations are a lot to cover in one day but Manon gave us a run down of our schedule; what to expect, what not to expect ..when we first boarded the bus so having that knowledge from the beginning was super helpful with expectations for the day.

Would highly recommend this day trip!

There is no dull moment for the whole trip. Peter, our guide, and Behar, our driver for the tour really did a great job. The places we went were all amazing and I had a great time. Really recommend this tour to anyone planning to go to London.

I always try to go a lot of places in a short period of time. Last time I visited London, I didn’t get to go see Stonehenge. Based on the reviews, I chose this company’s tour. From the beginning to the end, the tour was well organized. There was enough time to stroll around all the places we visited. Stonehenge was incredible, Windsor Castle was breathtaking and surprisingly Bath was my favorite place to visit during the tour. The place is a good mixture of ancient and modern culture. Omar, the tour guide was professional and knowledgeable. I would recommend anyone who wants to explore England In a day!

Sheila and Paul were a phenomenal team for our tour! Paul ensured we made the sites quickly and safely. While Sheila made sure to fill us in on as much at each site and along the route as possible. We only had one day while in London to take in some history and this was the perfect way to hit the highlights!! Thanks to them I will definitely be booking another Evan Evans tour!!

Our tour guide Robert was amazing! He was funny, kind and very knowledgeable. He gave us so much interesting information. Our bus driver Earl was hilarious! Every stop was fun and absolutely beautiful. I would highly recommend this tour.

We choose to visit 3 places in the last day of 2019. The guide Phil is the nicest guide we have met. He is humor and knowledgeable. He thought of and take care of everyone. The driver Ving is kind and professional. My 11 year old said this is the best 1 day trip she had in her life. Thank you.

We loved everything about this tour! From boarding to departure, this was a fun filled day. Our tour guide Eugene is charming, knowledgeable and very professional. Alex, our driver is an amazing driver and got us from place to place effortlessly and safely. All 3 points of interest were truly wonderful in their own way. Windsor Castle is dazzlingly beautiful, Stonehenge is a mysterious structural miracle and Bath is a truly beautiful and charming town. The Roman baths are a fascinating, immersive lesson in ancient history. I absolutely recommend this tour!

I loved this tour!

Tip: upon entering the Victoria Coach Station, walk around to the back and you'll see Evan Evans office as well as workers.

This tour was awesome because tickets to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and the Roman Baths museum were included.

Our tour guide Peter was fantastic; very informative and entertaining! We had a great driver Sam as well.

It's a full day, but it's a great way to experience multiple places, would recommend.

We had a great time visiting Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath! We were only in London a few days and wanted to hit as many attractions as possible. It was our first tour we did and will definitely do another! It was a great way to get to each location without the hassle of getting a car, all while learning along the way! Our tour guide was Rowan, and driver Merick were terrific. Rowan was very knowledgeable, kept everyone engaged and made the time on the bus go by fast!

It is a full day, but a great way to get a taste for each area! Highly recommend this tour!

Our guide Rowan was amazing . She very informative on what to expect and how to best enjoy the trip. She was super knowledgeable on our activities on the tour. Plus, She fills in the gaps while waiting in line perfectly...

Our Tour was great was 3 sites. You will get 2.5 hours at Windsor, 1.5 at Stone, and 2 at Bath. It may feel rushed but you get alot done. I would definitely recommend this company.

Our tour was splendid! Our guide provided great information about London as we traveled out of town, and had brilliant facts on the entire tour. The tour was easy to access, and in the end we were even assisted to find the nearest transportation to our lodging! The driver did an amazing job getting us back in a windy rainstorm. Thank you!

The coach was late by more than 30 minutes and they didn't give enough time to see Windsor. I would have preferred to spend 30 minutes in Stonehenge so that there would be more time at Windsor and Bath. Tour wasn't in Spanish as I had booked it for so my sister couldn't understand much. The tour just wasn't what I expected.

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. This is a perfect way to see the English countryside and visit three beautiful locations all in one day. Our guide, Sheila, and our driver, Andy, did a fantastic job telling us about the areas and things to look out for. We will definitely book another tour with Evans Evans when we return.

We had an incredible time on this tour! The tour guide Nicholas was extremely knowledgable and funny. He kept the tour interesting with facts all along the way. The bus was comfortable and Jose the driver was excellent, we made great timing! Would highly recommend Evans and Evans tours.

Got the full access tickets that include entrances for Windsor, and Stonehenge. It was great! Just mind the time to return to the bus! Richard was our guide and he was awesome! Very knowledgeable and fun and interesting stories to make the whole experience richer. Def recommended

I booked a tour with #evenevenstours. Our guide Rhys Thomas was one of the best guides ever, really knowledgeable. Our driver Joe was also a professional.
The trip was an amazing experience. The Windsor Castle is breathtaking and majestic. Stonehenge is one unforgettable and mysterious landmark.
And Bath was such a nice city to walk around and just enjoy the view!
I wish we had more time to spend in these three places, but as Rhys said, this was just a "highlights tour".
All in all, everything was perfect, I'd do it all over again!

I had a memorable Evan and Evan. They drive well on time and the host was amazing. Godfrey and had kept us engaged and was kind enough to talk almost 8-9 hours continuous about the history and architecture. You have a great spirit ☺️ God bless you!

The tour was wonderful, everything very well organized. The times to visit each place are correct, it is enough to see everything. Our guide Rowan was the best, very kind, very happy explaining everything. She always in a good mood. Thank you very much.

Mel was an amazing guide with great fun facts and stories! He even managed to fix my morning mood with that infectious energy. Yes, his coach announcements are thát good. (Seriously, I had to get up at 6:30 for this. That's a challenge.) Shoutout to Joe the coach driver. Wouldn't have been the same without him. Oh, and those stones are amazing. Best piece of Neolithic engineering I've ever seen. Also probably the only one.
p.s.: the Queen was home! whaaaaaaat

Was well organized and worth every minute. Kevin was funny, informative and very kind. His knowledge of history is great. Greg our driver was fantastic driving a coach of size. Both Kevin and Greg are huge assets to the experience and the company! I give them both 10 stars of excellence!!!

Our tour guide Saul was knowledgeable and had excellent communication skills. I felt like he did not go out of his way to help those of us who asked to see about getting entry tickets to Bath, since some people had that and others did not. While he heard that that was a concern, he did nothing to help with that situation, which was disappointing, since he seemed otherwise to be a careful guide. The time in places was very limited, esp Windsor Castle, which was hard.

Loved! the tour, only reason for a four is we were away much longer than we expected. Tour said 6 hours and we’ll be lucky to be back to London after a 12 hour day. We had reservations for a show this evening and will miss it. Plan accordingly.

This was a wonderful tour to get a lot done in one day of short on time. All stops were lovely (Bath and Windsor were my favorites). The tour guide was very knowledgeable and personable. The driver was courteous and did not make me nauseous at all (and I usually do). Highly recommend!

Richard our tour guide and Cory our driver did an outstanding job. This tour was beautifully laid out and organized. Richard kept our schedule and Cory got us everywhere safe! We lucked out with weather which made it 10 stars! Sad we couldn’t go into the Windsor Castle however that was only due to the recent passing of her majesty QE2.

We had a great time. Robert has very interesting stories to tell. He was very polite and helped us get the best of all stops. We got around 1,5 hour at each stop. It’s not a long time but it was enough to see the highlights. Mason our driver was able to get us to every destination swiftly and quickly. Great experience.

Jennifer & Steve were very knowledgeable and friendly. It was fun. Definitely recommend the trip .This trip worked out perfectly for me as I only had weekend to go around the town and didn't had to rent a car as this places are away from city.We had issue on the way to Roman Bath due to cracking of windshield sue to bird flying to it but Steve and Jennifer handled it so well and we got additional hour in Bath which was plus !!

Excellent tour for first time visitors looking see some of the top UK attractions! Our Tour Guide, Rowan, and Driver, Mo, were AWESOME!!! She was very knowledgeable, funny chill, I could go on and on but I think you get the point. This was money well spent. I HIGHLY recommend the Evan’s tour!

We had a great day touring around England with Godfrey and Mark. Windsor Castle was phenomenal and the Roman Baths were very cool to learn about. Godfrey was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions. I would recommend sitting in the front of the bus!!

It was a good tour. Everything was on time, good schedule. A little bit hurry in each stop. If you want to be relax and have a slow experience in Stonehenge, it should be good take only tour to there. For Windsor Castle and Bath time was perfect and enough.

I took the tour of Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and the city of Bath. Peter and John were great. I highly recommend them as your tour guides and driver. As probably has been stated before I wish I had more time in Windsor and in Bath. I'll have to make a separate trip just to visit those places. All in all, I loved it.

Had a great day with Robert and Sam! Robert explained details and historical facts for all locations. He also pointed out numerous activities to do while in each town! Getting into each location was smooth, as Robert handled the tickets for entry. Would definitely recommend this tour company! Very efficient in terms of schedule, so we didn’t run behind at all. They were both very nice and personable!

Rowan was a wonderful guide. She was funny, knowledgeable and very friendly. Even the driver Winston was funny and friendly and brought us back safe and sound. My two teens really enjoyed this trip (one of them is hard to please) and I do believe Rowan had a lot to do with that. This trip was worth the cost.

Had a great tour today. Mel our guide was amazing, he was funny and very knowledgeable. He did a great job explaining things and was very patient with the group. Tom our driver was great also, he drove safely and was pleasant. Would definitely recommend this tour and Mel as your guide.

Rowan and Barrington were excellent. They provided interesting information on our way to each location. They kept us engaged. Normally I don’t go on tour group adventures but this was so positive I would go again. Highly recommend Evan Evan tours. Once again Rowan was passionate and engaging. Barrington very engaging and excellent driver!

Deborah was a great tour guide who shared a lot of history with us. The tour was great fun and allowed us quickly stops at the the destinations. All of which were you could spend days at but being able to see what we did was great. Would suggest skipping the tour of the Roman baths and walk the town more though.

Simon was a fantastic guide! Very witty and the right amount of humor and fun facts. The tour is a long day, but you see a lot. It’s a very efficient use of time. When we went Windsor palace was closed, so the tour made up for it by having more time to tour Bath.

We just finished an excellent tour with Cameron (tour guide) and Muhammad (bus driver). We were laughing the whole time as we explored Stonehenge, Bath, and Windsor Castle. Just a lovely crew and we had an absolute blast! 10/5 review!

Enjoyable family experience accompanied by warm weather which was a bonus. Nick our tour guide was knowledgeable and very friendly. Interesting history and information. Good walking pace throughout. Would return!

This is a very nice one day trip from London. It’s very hard for a tourist to see all these places (1-2 hours from London) without joining a tour. Our guide, Simon, was knowledgeable, nice, and humorous. He explain the schedule every well to make sure everyone comes back on time. Overall it was a fun, informative and smooth trip.

We really enjoyed our trip to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. Manon was a wonderful tour guide. She was super knowledgeable, personable, funny and she wanted all tour participants to get the most from this tour. The driver, Corry was fantastic and ensured we were safe and stayed on time or ahead of time. We highly recommend this tour!

A fantastic full day tour to see three must see sites. Our tour guide Claudia and driver Joe did a fantastic job taking us around southern England. Would recommend for anyone keen to get out of London and see some history and countryside!

We really enjoyed our trip! Kevin was an amazing tour guide. He was knowledgeable and fun to be around. Obviously, because of the Queen's death, we were unable to enter Windsor Castle, but just seeing the grounds and areas around the castle were interesting. I really was amazed at the amount of flowers placed around the drive!! Stonehenge was nothing like I thought it would be. I got a totally different perspective about the area. Bath is a beautiful city and the baths, themselves, were so detailed! By the way, if you're a Bridgerton fan, it's filmed in Bath because of all the beautiful Georgian buildings!

We were in London just for three days. This tour was perfect for us since we had such a limited amount of time. The tour guide Lesley was very knowledgeable and friendly. Greg our driver, was great! It was a pleasure getting to know them both. The amount of time spent at each location was adequate. All three places were beautiful, but Bath was mesmerizing!

The tour qas very educational, we had a really great time though it was rainy.

Special thanks to our guide Mel who was very good, we learned a lot and was very entertaining trip. He was very friendly and ensuring we had a good tour.

Overall, very good trip!

My mom and I got to London and booked a trip to see some great sites. This trip is great where you see sites people from Britain still need to visit. Chrissy was our tour guide. She was very entertaining. She shared knowledge and we had the right amount of time at each stop. Thanks for a great first look in London. It helped us to decide another tour later in the week.

We had an awesome tour today to the beautiful Windsor castle, stonehenge, and Roman bath! Godfrey was an excellent guide, he was very knowledgeable, friendly, and experienced. Our entire day went very smoothly! Barry was a wonderful driver as well. We really enjoyed our time today, we would recommend this tour!

Emily, our guide, and James (I think?), our driver, were both excellent. Emily was efficient, knowledgeable and engaging and James managed to get us all in and out of the places in great time. I had the all entrances included trip and I enjoyed all the 3 locations.

Nigel was the most amazing tour guide! The sites were magnificent especially Stonehenge, however Nigel made the experience even better. Such an awesome planner, entertaining and kept us all on schedule. He even got us in line at Windsor Castle right up front so our wait was minimal. Truly an awesome adventure!

We hired a car & drove to Stonehenge! Very pleasant driving down, easy to find & easy to get entry tickets. Nice Welcome hall, bus to drive you up closer to Stonehenge which was nice as it was drizzling a wee bit at first! Lots history on display, great to view & understand. Small museum back in Welcome Hall, along with gift shop! Worth the trip! We had a very lovely day!

It was an excellent tour! Andy Jackson was a fantastic and knowledgeable tour leader. Evan was a safe and wonderful driver. My 16 year old son and I had a great time and learned a lot. The driver and guide were very helpful and friendly.

My husband and I really enjoyed this day trip! It was a taste of all three stops which is what we were looking for since we’re not in England very long. Monica was our guide and absolutely wonderful. She has a great, upbeat personality and answered all of our off the wall England questions. Steve was our driver and did a fantastic job getting us around safely.

My boyfriend and I went on the tour from London to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. It was a wonderful experience. Peter, our tour guide, was knowledgeable, friendly, and professional. Aston, our driver, was a safe driver and very friendly. I would highly recommend this day trip to anyone!
Fantastic tour. Nice Bus (with USB chargers), left promptly and where all day in schedule. Our guide Bruce was super, knowledgeable, fun, etc. Driver Armando made it a smooth trip.

You would need lots of time in each one of these places. This tour is perfect when you have only a day. Windsor was majestic...so much nicer than Buckingham. We got to see the changing of the guards there...how traditional!
Stonehenge is mystical...unexplainable!
The Romans sure understood the Spa/Bath experience. Was disappointed that the water is so disgusting. I’d go back and spend time in the city of Bath. Looked so pretty.
Chrissy was an excellent tour guide!

First visit to London. A pretty long day trip and could only spent limited time on each place, but enjoyed every part of it. The schedule was tight and we got to time ourselves carefully not to risk missing the bus. Our tour guide Toby was very good and had a lot of stories to tell.

Amazing 1-day tour to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath. Our tour guide, Richard, and the driver, Erol, provided plenty of information and care. Definitely recommend this trip. Hope you can get them as your guides as well.

I loved the 3 stops. It was a long day but guide Charlotte kept everything and everyone on track. She ensured we made it on time. Especially loved the city of Bath. I could not have gotten to these three great places any other way.

My reason for a 4 is due to the lack of communication and organization upon arrival regarding check-in procedures. The company needs to be more specific with online info and/or have visible signage at station. Tour itself was excellent and our tour guide, Simon, was terrific! Would absolutely give him the very highest rating.
Our guide Reese was a total pro. Articulate, engaging, polite, and great knowledge of Windsor Castle, Stone Henge, and The Roman Baths. He helped us pack a lot into a great day!

A long but wonderful day tour! Our guide was Catia and she was terrific. Stonehenge was a bucket list item and it was well worth it. I'd have liked more time at Windsor Castle and less time at Bath. To me, The Roman Baths were interesting but nothing compared to the grandeur and opportunities at Windsor Castle.

Booked the Windsor, Stonehenge, Bath tour and all was going great until left behind at Stonehenge. Appreciate there are tight schedules but the solution is definitely not leaving guests behind - suggest reviewing operation procedures for a better way. Luckily the lovely Catia took us in on their coach and we had a lovely afternoon in Oxford.

Pros: nice coaches, Catia, lots of local insight
Cons: VERY tight schedule, left behind

Our tour guide, Godfrey, was very nice and knowledgeable and the tour was fantastic. Our driver, Paul, was lovely - the bus was clean and comfortable. Very well organized, and incredibly easy for you to navigate. At the end of the tour, they both went out of their way to get you to your final destinations at close as possible. We had a wonderful day and would definitely recommend!

It was FANTASTIC. Our travel guide Mel, made it worth every penny. Indeed it was the best way to see the three places with information on other things near by. Will look forward to planning another trip. History came alive.

We had a great experience with Godfrey and Shawn. They were friendly and accommodating. Godfrey is very knowledgeable about the sites and is happy to share his knowledge with you. They made the jam packed day very painless and enjoyable. Would definitely take future tours with them!

The tour was well organised. Unfortunate that Windsor Castle was closed (which was understandable) but Mel was awesome in providing a walking tour of the town. A day well spent, not just because of the beautiful sites, but Mel our tour guide was just amazing!

Overcrowded attractions were a bummer. Maybe we could have started with Stonehenge and work our way back. We still managed to see everything and our guide and driver were friendly and knowledgeable. Positive and informative experience

A full day but worth the trip. Andy the tour guide was very knowledgeable and relaxed. Windsor Castle and Stonehenge were great to see. Had time to see the tombs of the late QE and her husband. Bath wasn't on my list of places to see but it was great to get out in the country and we enjoyed a nice meal in Bath.

A lovely and jam-packed day out and about away from London. Godfrey our guide gave us great tidbits wherever we went. Not too much where we couldn't nap on the bus ride, but enough to keep us all entertained with a smile, back on the bus at the proper times. Make sure you aren't late!

Excellent tour of some of the major highlights of England. Our tour guide Oliver and bus driver Raad provided a comfortable and entertaining trip. Just as most have said, there is just not enough time to do everything! You really need to plan another trip to come back to enjoy Windsor castle and the beautiful town of Bath.

Eugene and Walter were the best!! 5 stars.
Wonderful day seeing so many things while I sat back with my family and enjoyed the countryside. Eugene was able to make enjoyable history and insights to the entire experience.

I was blown away by this tour we saw so much in a day and at our own pace .. it is a tight schedule to see but if your time poor like me and want a jam packed day this is it! Monica was amazing very knowledgeable and made the day perfect. Loved every minute of it!
Highly recommend! Tour guide Saul was very knowledgeable. Bus was clean and comfortable. Great way to pack a lot of sight seeing in one days. Guide was great and keeping a workable time table.
