Very energetic & detailed information given throughout the whole journey, & both are having good sense of humour, making the journey relaxing and wonderful. Worth recommending! :)

Phil was our guide and I would have to say that he is probably the best guide I have ever had on one of these tours (and I have done quite a few)
Very informative and made things interesting he did not just drone on about facts he brought them to life
I would say the tour itself does not give you enough time in Bath if you are going to see the Baths themselves - by the time we finished wandering through the Baths you had to go straight back to the bus with no time to get food or see anything of the town - now this may have been as we had to wait 20 mins to get in the Baths - it was very busy in the town that day
Everything else I felt I had enough time for at least a good overview - there is not enough time to immerse yourself in any of the locations

Undertook the Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge tour and can say that I was extremely underwhelmed. The first issue was the attitude of the tour guide, who firmly stated that late arrivals back to the bus would be left behind. I find this to be very unprofessional and put stress on the entire day for fear of being stuck out in whoop whoop and not get back to London (the appeal of this tour after all is to visit these sites and get back to London in the one day!). The second issue was assigning seats on the bus so that I could not sit next to my best friend whom I was travelling with (I did not pay this much money to sit next to a complete stranger!). The third issue was the pace of the first two activities- it was intense! More time was definitely needed at Windsor Castle and Bath (but again watching the clock perhaps made me a bit more punctual than necessary). There was plenty of time for Stonehenge which was good, however some of that time would have probably been better spent at Windsor or Bath as the site doesn’t take very long to get around (and I am a person who takes my time with these things). All in all I’d say this tour is a good means to get to these sites in a day (they are all AMAZING!), but in hindsight I should have probably just hired a car to drive.

The day tour with Rhys and Andres was fabulous. Rhys has excellent knowledge of the area and made the history come alive. He also aptly managing the group and kept us on schedule without the feeling of being rushed. Learned much. Great value. Bravo!

My wife & I thoroughly enjoyed this trip on her 60th birthday adventure. Leaving early from Victoria Coach Station we were pleased to meet our highly knowledgeable tour guide, Mel A. With his deep understanding of the upcoming sights, his keen wit & perspective, we learned a great deal. All stops became special memories, from the changing history of Windsor Castle, the continuing discovery of the Roman Baths to the prehistoric wonders of Stonehenge, We thank Mel & his bus-driving partner, Lester for keeping us on track & on time for an extremely fulfilling journey across England's history.

We went on the Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge tour today and the outstanding part of this tour was our guide Manon. She was simply everything you could want, intelligent, articulate, a great storyteller, humorous and friendly. We honestly could listen to her talk all day long, she's like a young female Attenborough. We've travelled the world and been on many tours but Manon was on a different league altogether, a rarity, so the five star rating is for Manon - thank you again!

In terms of the tour itself I felt there wasn't enough time at Windsor castle, so would have preferred an extra 30 minutes there and less time at Bath and Stonehenge. But we had a great time on this trip, so if you are lucky enough to have Manon as your guide definitely book this tour.

As others have said, the trip was quick moving due to the travel time between sites. However, we got pretty lucky by being the first in line at Windsor Castle, so we pretty well had the full amount of time at each.

The tour guide, Andy Jackson, was amazing. He was incredibly knowledgeable and entertaining. If they would let you request a guide for any of their tours, try to get him. It wouldn't have been nearly as good without him. It was definitely the best tour of the trip.

Me and my wife had an amazing time on this tour. It was a beautiful day. Our guide, Rhys was phenomenal and had so much information to share and even helped us find our way back to our hotels with a map of the tube (buses, subway). Its rushed since you see 3 things in one day but so worth it!!!

Rhys does a great job as a tour guide. A lot of information is shared. Rhys holds the people accountable for returning to the bus. Think that Bath should clean up the water. It was rather disappointing. Stonehenge was great and so was Windsor Castle.

There was not enough time to visit each site. You have to manage your time very carefully or you will not be at the meeting point on time. I would suggest to add another 2 hours to the tour to avoid the constant rush. Also, our tour guide was really hard to understand in both English and Spanish. His ideas were no clear and his articulations made it even harder to understand.

My wife and I only had one full day in England so we wanted a way to see as much as we can in a short amount of time. This was a perfect tour to accomplish our goal. Rhys is an extremely knowledgeable guide. He helped us focus on the key items at each location and that allowed us to make better use of our time. The overall tour was over 12 hours and Rhys was energetic from beginning to end. Coming back to London, he spent a lot of time trying to help a couple in our tour group with the next booking or something. We also greatly appreciate our driver, James D. The roadways can be narrow and winding. We felt like very comfortable with his driving and were able to take in the beautiful sceneries. We'll spend more time at the various locations the next time but this trip could not have been better.

Had suuuuch a great time on this tour! Rhys (tour guide) was so knowledgeable and really helpful in every way! Dennis (driver) is such a pleasant and kind guy as well! Def ask for them if you do this tour! :)

My sister and I only had 2 more days in London. We decided to take this tour to see the amazing sights in a short period of time. Our guide was Rhys, and he was an amazing tour guide! He made sure that everyone knew that we wouldn’t have much time in each city, and that we had a schedule to follow. The time slots were pretty short, but it is 3 major stops in one day! Rhys was very knowledgeable and was very kind. Our driver, James D. was very kind and got us to each destination quickly and safely!

Thanks!

Fabulous tour if you have only a short time in London and want to maximize your time. Be ready for a well organized, but fast paced tour with great history lessons, advice on how to pace yourself through self-guided (free time) part of the tour and their smart planning so you’re one of the 1st groups at Windsor Castle, avoiding long lines. Too bad you can’t request a guide as would highly recommend Rhys, who is knowledgeable, entertaining, just-right kind of funny and strict about the schedule, so slow-pokes do not spoil your time. Born to guide! Only recommendation would be slightly more time at Stonehenge (15 min more?) as tourists are not in control of when shuttle buses run and how long the lines are. We happened to spend more time waiting for the shuttle bus than at the site.
Definitely worth the money and highly recommend!!

We did the tour without lunch and admissions and we’re fine. We bought the admissions on our own and got family rates. We opted to just walk around and explore the town of bath. It is a very long day, but is good to see Windsor and Stonehenge.

Having been on many tours in the past, we wanted to give a special shout out to thank guide James and driver Kee on a job well done. Our coach was the first to arrive at Windsor Castle thereby skipping all the crowds that go along with touring Eurossspe in August. Ditto for the Roman Baths in the city of Bath.

James' knowledge of the places we visited went far beyond what one normally finds in such a tour. His in-depth knowledge of history (and inside stories) clearly shine through.

Our tour started like any other but as soon as our bus started moving, we met our tour guide for the day, Mel. We quickly realized that we were in for a really fun and history filled day! Mel was very engaging and full of energy with an accent and sense of humor you can listen to forever. After a long 12 hour tour, he helped everyone by making recommendations on nearby restaurants and made sure we all had an amazing time.

He is a true gentleman, storyteller and historian. Kudos to Evan Evans for recognizing his great talent. They are lucky to have him! We will tell everyone we know about the amazing your time we had!

A great tour to see 3 UNESCO world heritage sites in one day. @RhysThomas was sensational, effortlessly instilling 5000+ years of English history to my 3 teenage children. Our driver, Steve O. pleasantly and professionally drove us smoothly through the undulating hills of England. The tour (and it’s early start) enabled us to get ahead of the endless lines to the sites, a definite bonus. Highly recommend!

We've just finished this tour today to celebrate my wife's birthday and we're both teary eyed at the end of the tour. The tourist destinations exceeded our expectations and we were both served by top-class, if not the best in the business, tour guide Mel and Driver Lester. They really know and love what they are doing as illustrated by how they treat and communicate with us tourists. Not to mention that they were considerate and compassionate when we were 2 minutes late to get on the bus during our Windsor Castle stop. Hats off to these gentlemen and they truly are an exemplary staff to showcase what Evan Evans Tour has to offer.

This is a long day! You leave early and get back late. That being said, all the sites are fantastic and well worth a visit. We were traveling with a 14 yr old and an 11 yr old and they held up fine. Manon was our guide and she is great! Get your coffee beforehand because they will NOT let u bring it on the bus for some reason. We had to throw ours away and we had just purchased it at Starbucks. Not a good start. Other than that the tour company was very good.

After spending 3 days in the city my wife and I wanted to see the historic sites and the countryside for our last day in England. Our tour guide Ben was fantastic and the driving skills of Andrei were impressive. Ben was very informative on the history of the city, the culture and the sites.

I would recommend eating breakfast beforehand, packing a few snacks and bringing a bottle of water or two. There is time to stop and get food at all the sites.

Here is an itinerary if anyone is interested:

Bus leaves at 8am

Arrive at Windsor 8:40am
Castle doesn’t open until 9:30am
Leave Windsor Castle at 11:40am

Arrive at baths 1:55om
Hour to eat
Hour in the museum
Leave at 4:20 (we were running behind due to a woman getting lost)

Arrive at Stonehenge 5:25
Left at 6:40

Arrived back in London 8:30

After a bumpy start trying to figure out where to check in for the tour (and glowering looks from the driver of bus 288 who refused to help), the rest of the day went surprisingly smoothly. Yes, as many have commented, this is a fairly grueling 13 hour day, but how else can you cram in three, major, spectacular sights in one day? Forget about doing this on your own, driving on the "wrong" side of the road, finding parking and hustling for tickets. All is taken care of for you. Claudia is a fantastic guide. She's patient and so informative I'd swear she's really a docent. Just the right amount of information and some cool facts. Bob, our driver, is a saint. A laid back, but careful and skilled driver of this hulking monster of a bus. Take this fantastic tour and get your rest some other day.

What a wonderful day. Mel was our guide and he was funny and very knowledgeable. It was a very busy day with a lot of riding, but it was worth it. If you have time, you may want to do Windsor castle on it's own. There is so much to see and really did not have the time I would have liked to see everything, but that was alright, because I got to see enough and the changing of the guards. Be prepared, there is a lot of walking and a good number of stairs. This tour was a good taste of these places. I will be coming back.

We decided to do this tour while visiting the UK in July 2019. We met our tour guide, Alexandria and she kept the tour lively and on track through the day. The first stop was Windsor Castle and she insisted that we arrive early and as soon as we got there, we understood why. The queue to get in was quite short when we arrived however within 20 minutes it was a good hour or so wait to get in. The next stop was Bath and again, Alexandria was great, full of knowledge and the occasion dad joke which got a good laugh (and moan) from everyone. After Bath was Stonehenge. We arrived at 4pm and were given approximately 1.5hrs to explore the site, check out the gift shop and all around enjoy the sites.

We headed back to London and our driver got us back in about 2 hours. Alexandria came up and down the isle chatting with us all, giving recommendations as to where to check out, things to see, places to eat. Definitely a great guide.

This is a fantastic introductory tour however one day is not long enough to enjoy all of these sites and you really only get a small sampling and Alexandria herself mentioned this when we startled.

This tour was really great! We had a full day of sightseeing with plenty of time at each area! Our tour guide did a really good job telling us about all the sites and giving us additional stories! It was a nice bus as well.

We booked the tour through Viator. Evan and Evans ran a very professional tour. Our guide was Sheila who is fluent in Japanese and Spanish. Obviously we were there did the English tour as well. The bus left Victoria station on time and we proceeded to Windsor Castle. Sheila made sure we were well informed and shepherd us through what easily could be a dizzying process. While at Windsor the Queen flag was flying reflecting she was in residence. We proceeded to Bath which has a very impressive museum reflecting Roman presence in England. Finally to Stonehenge. If you have mobility issues all sites may prove challenging. We would like to compliment all the employees at each site which helped when asked and May our experience seamless. Our thanks as well to Sheila.

This tour is an excellent day trip for those who don't have much time but want to get out of London town and see other significant historic sites! My husband and I found Ryhs our tour guide superb his knowledge and good humour and little hacks of how to navigate each site were helpful and entertaining! James D is a very safe and pleasant driver! Thanks Guys for making this a memorable experience!

-The actual trip is 3 hours and the rest is only driving
- bad time allowance for the sites to visit , you will not have the time to listen to the media record about sites highlights.
- Guide is speaking english and Spanish , his accent is not clear at all , i am not english speaking guest so i found it very hard to understand him ,
- Guide made a lot of noise for me when speaking Spanish
- A lunch break was not planned during this trip , it was crazy to waste from our time to go and eat.
- you are not allowed to take hot drinks inside the bus!
- The sites are fine, but you will never manage to visit them and understand them all in one day, so please remove this trip from the list .
Either a quality visit or no need to offer such visits.
- Bath is a very nice city , it worth to explain about it in the tour.
- crazy expensive in compare to what is offered in the tour ( about 140 USD )

It was a good one day tour, packed and suitable for people who want to see a lot in short time and ready to put around 12 hours.
So if you wanna see much, but don’t have that much of time! then give it a go.
Our tour guide Claudia was funny, knowledgable and genuine, which made the tripe more pleasant.

Mel, our tour guy, was very engaging and knowledgeable of English history. Did I say that the was funny too? 👍
The level of coordination was impecable despite the traffic on the road. I have to say that if you are looking for a slow pace tour, this is not for you. This is the perfect tour to get a taste of these sites.

Great tour. Thought I would like Stonehenge best, but I ended up liking going to Bath more. Eugene was a great and funny tour guide with a wealth of information! He recommended the ice cream in Bath and it was delicious! The views on the way to Bath were just lovely! Windsor Castle was a little disappointing to me as there felt like not a whole lot to see plus you can only take pics of the outside for security reasons I suppose. Stonehenge was nice to see and check off my list, but it really was just a collection of stones. Lol.

Driver Tomas and tour guide Jennifer were excellent today! Jennifer gave detailed directions to navigate each stop efficiently, and kept us on a timeline to minimize crowds and lines throughout the day. Great commentary and useful tips for London. Thank you from a family of 5!

We took a bus from Victoria coach station early in the morning. I advise you to go there at least one hour earlier because we were at the end of the queue and my husband me and my daughter had to sit at different seats. The company and our tour guide had nothing to help this out but fortunately a very kind couple gave us their seats and at least me and my daughter had the chance to sit together. The tour is almost 12 hours hence very tiring but if you have only one day to see as much as you can it is a good one. Bus was comfortable, our tour guide was a lovely lady who gave precise instructions. Overall we had enjoyed and had a good time.

Our tour guides Katie and Steve were AMAZING!!! Katie has so much knowledge and passion about the royals and Windsor, bath and my new favourite, Stonehenge and Steve made the journey quick and safe. Overall a great way to see some of the harder reached sites of England with great tour guides and service!

Got a decent rate and worth the amount..though a long day bit covered three of the amazing sites to be seen

Windsor and bath are decent but loved the Stone Henge...its fascinating to see the rocks standing

Good tour guide Kevin and good driver Paul...my wife amd som of 2.5 yrs plus me went on the tour

Only drawback - the tour is completed in a nit of rush cause of the coverage thus no time to sit and have food

So stock your food before you go

Would give this tour a thumbs up but would highly advise that you bring your lunch for this day trip. We didn't have time to view everything at Windsor Castle and had to find a place to buy a few sandwiches before leaving for the next site. Forget going to have a bite at a restaurant during this outing.

I took my family to the Stonehenge tour from London with Evan Evans. Previously we had gone on the local tour with them and found them ok. But this particular tour was a night mare from the get go. I booked on the web with them and somehow my booking got doubled. Instead of booking for 5 they booked us for 10. And the email they sent confirming ended in my spam (even though their promotional emails did not). On the day of the tour, we were assured that this will be corrected and we will be refunded. We were asked to send them an email. Several emails and expensive phone calls later, they tell us that they cannot refund. This is close to a $1000.00.

The guide on the tour had a humungous chip on his shoulder. Some kind of historian who let it is his right to belittle folks. Any question we asked was met with disdain and arrogance. It felt like he was targeting the only brown family with this extra special superciliousness. He had no patience and made my 80 year old father feel as if he should not have come out to enjoy the trip.

All in all, we had a rough time on and off the bus. When I called them about refunding me, they were super unhelpful. I would not recommend this company to any one.
Jennifer and Aston gave us a great tour. Jennifer was very personable and informative. Aston was a great driver. Would do it again in a second.

We recently toured Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge, with a pub lunch in Lacock, and were disappointed with the very short time we got to spend at Windsor Castle, and Bath. This was largely due to significant a delay in leaving Victoria Coach Station as well as a significant delay in leaving Windsor Castle, both were due to inconsiderate other passengers and the tour guides waiting for them to return.

If you're on a tour and 68 of 70 people have managed to get back to the coach at the required time, you've got to leave those other two inconsiderate people. Tell people right up front that this is what will happen and they can get back to London by train or tube of their own volition.

We selected this tour as it explicitly stated that we could tour Windsor Castle, but due to leaving London late, we were later getting there and the tour coach line-up was ridiculously long; we waited in lines for almost 2 hours, to get less than an hour to tour the castle, then waited another 30-40 minutes for two late passengers to return, giving us only about 40 minutes at Bath (hardly enough time to see anything).

Victoria Coach Station was very dirty and dated. This is in serious need of a freshen-up!

It was disappointing that there was a big speech given before we boarded that no food, including hot beverages, was allowed on the coach. I threw out a coffee I had JUST purchased, only to get on the coach and see other passengers being permitted to bring their coffee onto the coach. This continued throughout the day, with people bringing ice cream and other food. Don't announce it if you don't enforce it.

The driver and tour guide (Magnus) were both very effective and entertaining.

We knew going in that we'd be rushed at the attractions, but the delays mentioned above really, really negatively impacted the day.

The village of Lacock was really neat to visit and we ate our lunch quickly so we could explore a little bit. We really enjoyed it.

The Evan Evans tour is an extremely convenient and efficient way of seeing Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge all in one day. Although you'll likely feel a bit rushed at the attractions, I'd recommend the tour if you want a stress-free way of maximizing your sightseeing in a short amount of time. The tour guide, Jennifer, did a brilliant job of keeping us entertained throughout the drive and guiding as to each attraction. She was incredibly informative and engaging. Dave, the bus driver, navigated the motorway like a true professional. Very happy with the experience overall!

First of all, let us see this for what it is: Visiting three historic places on self guided tours (and two historic and quite interesting towns) spaces far apart in 12 hours will offer only a glimpse of what these places have to offer. And if you are ok with it, this is the tour for you.

Our day started early with an early departure from the Victoria Coach Station. It was made easier with our tour guide Eugene and our driver Moe, both of whom are ultimate professionals. Eugene was funny and knowledgeable, and explained the history of the neighborhoods we passed along the way.

Our first stop was Windsor Castle. Eugene was very helpful and informative. Guided us to the entrance of the Castle through security checks and told us where and when we should meet. As expected, we had a self guided tour through the castle but didn’t see everything we wanted to see because we only spent about 1.5 hours there. It would have been great to spend more time there, but we knew that this would have been a brief introductory tour, so we are ok with it.

Next was Bath, the genuine surprise of the three places we visited. I didn’t know much about the place so I was quite surprised at the historic aspect of it. The town Bath was very quaint and relaxing. Again, Eugene was helpful in pointing out where to go, what places to visit, and what to expect to get the most out of the short stay.

Last was Stonehenge.

We got back to London at around 7:40 and exhausted. But the tour was made quite interesting and fun by our tour guide and we highly recommend this tour for anyone who has limited amount of time in London and want to see these great historic places outside of London.

We took a tour of Windsor Castle, the Roman Baths in the city of Bath, and Stonehenge. Our tour guide, James, was fantastic. He's a historian by training, and provided layer upon layer of detail in his commentary. He also has an excellent sense of humor. Our driver, Bob, commanded the bus like a hot knife through butter along the narrow streets of Bath. Very impressive tour and highly recommended.

I'll start the review by saying that these three are indeed top attractions if one needs to get out of the hustle bustle of London and take a plunge into the gorgeous countryside and rich history of England. So in summary, a "must-watch".

However, it is very difficult to do justice to all the three magnificent sites, if you have children and elderly people traveling with you. The actual travel time was 6-7 hours and the time allocated for touring the actual sites (specially Windsor) was too short.

The tour guide (Ms. Katia from Evans Evans - Tour No 21) was extremely impolite and inconsiderate - we were delayed by 5-7 mins at Windsor Castle - had genuinely lost our way a bit and took us a couple of mins to find the bus (was not there at the drop point). Ms. Katia was extremely rude to my family which included my elderly parents. A similar incident happened to another family at Stone Henge and they were meted with similar response from Ms. Katia - this time a public shaming inside the bus! This was absolutely atrocious and she lacked minimal professionalism.

To state the obvious, all of us (and all our friends on that bus) respect the importance of timeliness but unfortunately on such long day tours, some of these delays happen and not always within our control (specially with kids and elderly members). I would really appreciate if experienced operators like Evans Evans care to share this feedback with their "so called experienced" tour guides specially in this world where "inclusiveness" and "diversity" are key pillars of success in any service industry.

I would recommend my friends to either take a tour which just covers two of these places (preferably Windsor and Stone Henge) or book them independently (not a big deal specially in a country like UK).

Last but not the least, we were one of the few to leave a tip for Ms. Katia - at the end of the day, despite her disrespectful behavior, we couldn't ignore our culture and manners which have been ingrained in us for ages.
Jennifer was outstanding! So was driver. We had great weather, which made it all the more fun. Jennifer was so informative

I did this tour on Tuesday as a solo traveller. I really enjoyed the tour and it was a great way to see three really impressive places in one day. Our tour had Alexandria as our guide and she was super lovely and knew so much about each place. Alexandria also gave us a bunch of tips for making the most of the time in London. I’d highly recommend this for anyone wanting to take a day trip out and see some of the countryside.
Very interesting, Rowan is a wonderful guide, very knowledgeable and interesting, her enthousiasme was contagious!

This trip was very good. The bath and Stonehenge went at a good pace. Windser castle 🏰 could have had more time because of the great number of very interesting things to see. What made the trip special was how knowledgeable, easy going, and fun, our guy Mel, made it happen. We liked him so much that we actually booked a private excursion with him. xo

my guide, James (cant remember his name - he is an Irish with 2 sons!). he is funny and really the best guide i came across. however, it is quite rush to fully enjoy the 3 places. at windsor, there was a guy who had lost his wife and 2 kids while coming back to the tour bus. guide was nice to have waited for him. i felt quite unfair as the trip was already quite rush to wait for people who have no time management. However, i saw guide chiding the guy stating he has to understand the tour included many others. i find the guide really professional and patient.

i enjoyed my time, just hoping more time for the trip. however, it is the nature of being in a tour and no one can be blamed.

OK lets get this bit in early. This is a BIG DAY, you are packing a lot into a day trip and you will be quite exhausted at the end of the day!

BUT it is more than worth it. Our guide ALEX was brilliant. We were picked up on time and she quickly settled us in. Stonehenge is almost a religious experience, solemn, spiritual and meaningful and very cold.

Windsor Castle is just perfect, you may feel like you need more time here, keep moving, eat later and see as much as you can.

The Roman Baths ( and Bath in general) is beautiful, obviously historic and more than worth the visit. We ate buns and pasties here, drank coffee and walked by the river and cathedral.

This wonderful tour has wet our appetite for the areas visited, each of which we can next time spend an entire day visiting!

Our tour with James and driver Mark could not have been petter. Specifically, as a historian, James provided easy to understand information mixed with humor that kept us entertained during this full day tour. Keeping aside the wonders of Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath which on their own are stunning, James gave us commentary that helped us understand the lengthy history and importance of each site. In addition, both he and Mark kept us on time and ahead of the crowds. As an experienced taveler, James must be among the top guides I've ever had!

This trip is a lot to squeeze into one day, but well worth it if you have limited days. Windsor Castle is beautiful and most of the grounds and apartments can be seen in less than 2 hours. Stonehenge is awe inspiring and the educational programs there are top notch. Bath is a great little city and also a UNESCO heritage site. Great shopping and pubs in Bath (The Roman Baths themselves are interesting, but not necessarily a must see).
Our guide (Rowan) was phenomenal. Probably one of the best tour guides we have ever had. She was highly knowledgeable and entertertaining. Thanks Rowan.

Oliver (guide) and Kevin (driver) are a great team. Oliver’s friendly English wit and charm made the day! While the 0530 departure makes for an early day but you have Stonehenge all too yourself for a very exclusive VIP experience. If you are not in the inner ropes it’s almost like they are a ‘bunch of rocks’. Oxford is enjoyable with a good history of the town, university, and 38 colleges. There is never enough time at Windsor but not the tours fault as the day is long with the main event Stonehenge. Their is an option to stay in Windsor longer and take a train back to London. Inner ropes is highly recommended as the only way to see Stonehenge with Oliver and Kevin.

If you don't have a lot of time to spend in London, this tour is perfect. While the schedule might be tight, I feel like it's the right amount of time to spend in each location. It was well-organized. Our guide was very warm and engaging and she was able to get everything running within schedule. She even recommended a few restaurants near the last stop so we could get dinner. It was an amazing experience.

Great tour from start to finish for those with limited time in London and the surrounding area. They manage to fit all three sites into one day with enough time to catch all the important highlights at each.

Excellent commentary from the guide as well that really added to the experience. Remarks about the surrounding countryside and landscape while traveling on the coach were very informative.

Meals are not included and you can find yourself a bit rushed to buy food and eat on the go. I'd recommend packing some easy snacks for the trip.

Huge shout out to Claudia and Dennis for making a packed touristy tour day great! I will rate the attractions separately, but lucky you if you go with evanevans (which I recommend you do) and happen to get Claudia as your guide. She speaks of history and tidbits as of it were casual gossip and brunch conversation. She clearly really loves what she does, which is making peoples often harried and stressed vacations a day of learning, wonder and fun.

Coach was a bit cramped for me, but navigation around unplanned traffic detours was excellent and timeliness of beating all other coaches from London everywhere we went was impressive. Left on time and back early. A Wonderful team!

Carol our guide was the best! She would go out of your way to make you feel comfortable. She was also very helpful - she went to each and everyone on the tour and asked where our next destination is after the tour so that she can recommend where to drop us off. She also shared a lot of back stories of England's history along the way. The tour itself was great! It was a bit rush but we got to see and do everything we wanted.

Our tour guide James and driver Graham were fantastic! James kept up entertained the entire time and Graham’s ability to maneuver that giant coach was very impressive. We received extra facts about Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath due to James vast knowledge of all those places. James even provided us with travel recommendations for the rest of our trip. He suggested I go to Brighton and he was right on! I would have completely missed this lovely town if it wasn’t for him. James and Graham are highly recommended!!

One day tour that will bring a bit of the English countryside to your trip. I took this tour some years ago. I was travelling for business and this is the perfect one day escape from London.
This visit will leave you possibly wanting to stay in Bath for a night or two.
I visited Stonehenge again in 2018 and the premises were all updated, the reception area, the restaurant and coffee shop, everything in excellent condition. Audio guides are available for everyone to listen in numerous languages. Great trip for all the family, specially during the summer.

We had an amazing day with the most wonderful guide Celia, her passion care and patience makes her for sure one of the best tour guides I've met. The tour is 12 hours, but it is totally worth it, I recommend bringing warm clothes and rain proof clothes aswell. It is a quick tour meaning that there isn't really time to sit and relax and order warm food, but if you are like us that are only going for a few days to London, and don't mind eating a sandwich, fruit or water during the day, this is the way to go!

We were warned that this would be a 'whirl wind, taster-style' tour and if you are prepared for this you will not be disappointed. There is so much to see at Windsor and Bath, that this tour will leave you with the desire to visit both towns again and spend a day. Knowing this I was glad i booked the all inclusive tour which included entry into the Baths. We were very lucky to have Alexandra as our tour guide, extremely knowledgeable and passionate on all facets of English history, she kindly even offered her time as part of a personalised tour of Stonehenge. She also offered to hunt for travel sickness in Bath for me so that I wouldn't loose anytime at the Roman Baths, so kind! Also very thankful that she got us to the front of the line to get into Windsor Castle, otherwise we would have missed time just waiting to get in; the groups line was very long and would be worse in summer. Overall the service of the company was very good, I only booked tour the day prior, however in peak season you may need to book further in advance as this company alone will have 10 buses leaving in one day. Buses were very clean and well-maintained, even had WiFi on the bus which was very handy.

Mr. Andy Jackson (our tour guide) has by far been my favorite tour guide from all of London and Paris, and consequently, throughout all of Europe (and UK). His background history and extensive knowledge of the royal family, architecture, and land make the tour beyond a tour but knowledge I would have otherwise not have known. His quick wit is to be respected and his comfortable presence to be commended. Overall, he’s a tour guide you would on any tour and on any staff.

This is my first visit to London. My sister and my family (total 8) are here for 10 days free and easy vacation. We took a day trip to Windsor castle, Stonehenge and Bath on 21/12/2018. The tour guide Deborah is very knowledgeable and friendly. She was very helpful to one of our wheel-chair tourist too. She even made an effort to come up to everyone in the bus and asked where we stay so that we can drop off at the correct station. She is amazing! Needless to say, driver Paul drove us back in one good piece with his super smooth driving skill! We totally enjoyed ourselves. I will definitely recommend this tour to my friends when I am back to Singapore.

This is our first time in London, this tour of Windsor castle, Stonehenge and Bath is good. Be prepared for a long day good walking shoes and comfortable clothes. Doing this tour in Dec. It rained and it was cold at Stonehenge. Even if you are not into history, you will enjoy this tour. Gives a good over view of England in a short time. Our guide Kevin is the icing and the cake. He was entertaining and very knowledgeable of English history and more. He also spoke Japanese. He has good information on places to eat and visit on places along the way. And Kevin was helpful to everyone on our full bus in getting back to where we need to go at the end of the tour.

It was a very long day, so be prepared for some fatigue on the trip back to London. While the trip description does explain that the trip lasts for 12 hours, it was still a little exhausting 2.5-hour bus ride back to London from Bath in the dark. Yet there is no other way to explore three great sites outside of London on a single trip without a little exhaustion. Our guide Oliver was quite good; very helpful and friendly. Mark the driver was terrific. Both work well together. Would absolutely recommend this trip, just be well prepared.

Our tour guide, Anthony Matthews, was awesome. He was extremely informative. You could tell that history was his passion and he was very excited to share his passion with you. Throughout the bus rides and at each of the sites he provided valuable insight and entertaining stories of British history, and even some American history. We started off at Windsor Castle, followed by Stonehenge, and then Bath. I personally wished we had more time in Bath, but overall the time spent at each place was reasonable. It is an extremely long day, but totally worth it.

we booked this tour and by the end of the day when we got to Stonehenge, we barely had time to walk around it once. I did a constant walk and snapped pictures all the way around then had to go back to meet the bus. I'll bet we didn't get 30 minutes. It was very frustrating. It was the place we wanted to see the most but had the least amount of time. Windsor Castle was about the same, we had enough time to either go inside the castle or walk the grounds and see the town. We chose to walk around the grounds. Then we had to go. Bath was probably a bit on the long side. Could have made that a bit shorter to even the other two.

Our tour did not start off so well -- When we arrived to Windsor, there was a very long queue line for group tour admittance; we waited here, outside in the elements for approximately 45 minutes, without prior notice by our guide. What was upsetting, was our tour guide recommended to leave everything behind on the bus, which included our jackets and umbrellas as the weather seemed nice. It started to rain as soon as we got off the bus, and we stood in the rain for the next 45 minutes, getting soaked. Obviously, this is a common occurrence as every gift shop sells umbrellas for 5 pounds, and even Golden Tours offered their group members ponchos. It is the responsibility of the tour guide to alert you there is a long standing period, to which you are exposed to the elements, in a place that commonly rains. Furthermore, after 15 minutes standing in the rain, I attempted to go back to the bus station (about a 15 minute walk) to obtain our things -- the Evans bus drivers were all gone, while every other bus driver was in place on their coach. Very disappointing, as again, our tour guide did not warn me that perhaps the driver was already gone... Shameful to waste my time.

We ended up only having less than an hour at Windsor and St. George's Chapel. Very disappointing for an hour drive + an hour wait.

Next was an hour detour (this is not the tour's fault) to the Roman Baths. We didn't even see the Baths, as we were starving, unable to grab anything at the Windsor location due to restricted time; again, the tour guide could have warned us that we were going to be on a bus for the next 3 hours uninterrupted and to grab food.

Next was another 2 hours to Stonehenge. This was a beautiful location, but very cold. Bring warm clothing.

We had already spent 1 week in London and this was our last tour, but by far was the worst. It is too long (12.5 hours), and highly dependent on the quality of your guide. I am very disappointed by Evans, as they are the most highly rated of all the group tours. Ours failed to tell us relevant information for the comfort of our trip, and also failed to tell us any relevant information about the actual destinations we were visiting; he droned on an on for hours, without actually providing interesting information. He also seemed to care little for our interest, comfort or return.

Be prepared for a very long trip, majority of time driving in the bus (not at the destination), a considerable amount of walking at Windsor/Stonehenge without warning - not suitable for handicap or less mobile - and amuse yourself if you have a terrible guide. Evans does not provide any food, unlike Golden Tours, so also remember to get yourself food in between the very long drives otherwise you'll starve. Also, no bathroom on board the bus or well advised by the guide at each location.

I recommend Golden Tours instead.

This trip was perfect. We had a tour of Windsor castle including part of the town. Next we went to Bath and saw the Roman bath plus a lot of this beautiful town as well. Finally, we had the best for last. Stonehenge was a outstanding stop. The visitor center was great AND the site was spectacular! Out tour guide Mark was fantastic (very knowledgeable & helpful) and our driver Thomas was professional & a great driver!!
I highly recommend this day trip. Well worth it!!

Yes, you will see all three of the places listed on this tour. However of the entire 12 hour day, only about 3 is spent at the actual locations. You have to rush though everything to make sure you get back to the bus on time so you don't really get to "experience" the locations. That can kind of be expected given how far the locations are.

What is unforgivable however is that the ad specifically says an air conditioned coach. The air conditioning on the bus is close to non-existent. It was 60 degrees the day of our tour so I didn't think it would be an issue but I was very wrong. The inside of the bus ran very hot and combining that with the driver's jerky motions, my wife and I both almost threw up multiple times. And there is no restroom on the bus.

Also, at the beginning of the tour our guide requested that everyone return to the same seats they started in. One couple decided they didn't need to listen and when the original people sitting in the seats returned, the tour guide offered no help in assisting the situation. Not necessarily the companies' fault, but with as rude as the woman was at check in I would have expected there to be some sort of backup provided for the rude tourists who decided they were above the rules.

Upon arriving to Stonehenge we were given approximately one hour to get to the stones and back before the bus departed. We were told that there were shuttles that drove people directly to the stones so we figured that wouldn't be an issue. However, we stood for 20 minutes (legitimately, not exaggerating) waiting for a shuttle while two empty ones sat idling nearby. So when we finally got to the stones, we were incredibly rushed and really didn't get to enjoy it. Once again, not necessarily the Evan Evan's tours fault, but just be aware that the employees of Stonehenge do not care about how long it takes for you to get there.

On a positive note, our tour guide was great. She spoke four languages and was positive and upbeat the whole time. However that's not enough to justify the rushing and constant sweating.

If you like to sit and sweat through your clothes multiple times, be forced to run to McDonald's (because that's all you have time for if you're lucky), and sit on a bus with groups of rude tourists, then this is the tour for you.

Otherwise save your money and figure out a different way to see these things. This was definitely not worth the price.

Wife and I took grandson (12) on his first trip abroad. We had been to Bath and Stonehenge and thought grandson would enjoy it. We had never been to Windsor Castle. The trip through Windsor Castle was so quick, you didn't have time to admire anything, and there was a lot there. Tourist season, so the queue was quite long. Rushed through Bath as well. Stonehenge was rainy and we didn't have a lot of time there as well. Enough to see it considering the conditions Grandson still enjoyed it. When we went before, we took a cab to Bath with another couple, which was cheaper than the train. Rented a car and saw Stonehenge and surrou8nding area. Better way, if you have the time. Also, no facilities on the bus either.

Prior to a cruise, my wife and I had one free day for a tour out of London. We had phoned several tour companies after reviewing information on their websites about a full day tour to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. Evan Evans was our choice as they were the most responsive and the only company with phone staff who knew the details of the tour and could answer our questions about the schedule and tour commentary delivery (live commentary vs audio guide).

We booked the July 20, 2018 tour of Windsor Castle, Stonehenge & Bath (admissions to the attractions included)
• 7:30AM boarded comfortable, air-conditioned bus at Victoria Coach Station
• First stop - Windsor Castle - walked at our own pace with an audio guide through the state apartments and St. George’s Chapel
• Second stop - city of Bath - panoramic driving tour followed by audio tour of the Roman Baths, walking at our own pace; free time to grab a bite to eat
• Third stop – Stonehenge - strolled around the monument with an interactive map and audio via the VOX Radioguide® system provided by Evan Evans. The VOX was also used by our tour guide when he was guiding us outside the bus so we could easily hear him.
• 7:30PM returned to Victoria Train Station

Andy Jackson was our knowledgeable tour guide. His delightful personality (friendly, engaging, sense of humor, no bragging) enhanced our tour experience. At the start, he reminded us that this tour is an overview of three historical sites with substantial driving distance between each, but he assured us we would see the highlights in each place. In an entertaining manner, Andy taught us a thing or two about British history as we motored between the sites and waited in line for Windsor Castle to open. He provided just the right amount of information, commentary, and stories about the places we visited, and he also gave us some quiet time between stops. At each site, he clearly explained what we’d do, how much time we had, where the bus would pick us up, etc. and then ushered the busload of us through the ticket entrance.

Our bus driver, Mark, got us to each site and back to London safely and in good time. (Our tour group was first in line at Windsor Castle!) Mark appeared with the bus at each the pick-up site at the appointed time and even had bottled water available for a small charge.

Based on our 12-hour tour experience, we’d recommend Evan Evans to others. We enjoyed a quality tour (at a 10% senior discount) and accomplished our goal of getting an overview of three historical sites in a single day.

Had the best 12 hour tour. We went to Windsor Castle then Bath and ended at Stonehenge. OUR guide MEL was FABULOUS as was our driver JAY. I am sure all the tours are amazing but MEL you rocked. Thank you for making 12 hours seem like 1. Jazz hands to you. Oh you will have to book a tour with MEL as guide to get that. A definite 5 star tour. Thank you for a wonderful day full of knowledge of all sights and fun. What a GREAT DAY!!

We took this full day trip , leaving from Victoria Coach Station , with Evan Evans.
It was a full day, leaving at 7.50am and getting back to London at 8.00pm.
The 3 attractions were quite interesting.
The tour guide Andy was both interesting and informative. His knowledge and stories made the day go quite quickly. Bob seemed to be a very good driver, especially around some of the really narrow streets in Bath.
We are not seasoned coach users and normally prefer self drive options. So if time is at a premium, this is a great option to see 3 iconic English attractions.
So my key learnings from this tour are
1. Be early. They had 5 coaches doing the tour the day we went. We got in the first coach, so was front of the line at Windsor Castle ( which opens at 9.30)
2. Don’t dilly dally at Windsor Castle. There is a lot to see in the hour and three quarters we were there. This includes the chapel where Harry and Meghan got married.
3. The best eating option is to bring your own sandwiches and drinks for the bus. Note you can’t take hot food and drinks on the coach
4. Bath and Stonehenge are interesting. Nowhere near the glitz and glamor of Windsor Castle, but interesting in their own right.
So if you are not into self driving etc, this is the option for you.

Apologies this is a very late review as I did the tour in August 2016 but I can see from reviews some of these issues may still be current- Tour was very badly organised as firstly we had to wait for over 45 minutes at Victoria station in the morning where there was a chaotic scene of buses and guides leaving for the same destinations (our bus was late leaving). This was after a very late hotel pick up (delayed by almost 40 minutes).
We had to queue for over 1.5 hours (!!!) at Windsor Castle which was terrible as it was a hot day, and there was nowhere to sit except on the concrete or the brick wall. No refreshments or water was provided during this time. The queue stretched all the way down the street outside the main entrance. The Tour guides and advertising should specify that absolutely no preferential entry is provided by this tour. You have to queue up with everyone else that turns up for a very long time. Due to the early morning chaos and late departure we arrived at a time when about 8-10 huge tour buses also arrived at the castle. Our guide was in a massive rush and did not specify our meeting time to everyone on our bus. My friend and I and several other people heard him say we had only 30-40 minutes to see the whole castle and get back to the bus. We ended up literally running from room to room and missed most of the key castle rooms. We raced back to the bus and the guide said that we actually had more time and was unapologetic for the mix up.
We ended up getting lunch and sitting in the park as the queues were too big to get back into the Castle. This was really upsetting and disappointing as the castle should have been the highlight. We spent way too much time at bath and Stonehenge and hardly any time at all at Windsor. We were sick of the queues by the end of the day. I don’t think they should try to cram all three sites onto this tour during summer as it was really bad to just stand around wasting time then rushing to miss most of the key things.

Also- this is not a guided tour at all (well ours was not- this might have changed). They handed out ear phones and travel radios for the guides but did not use them except to tell us we were running late. I thought we would find out some facts and history on the bus and at each site but we ended up using our own guide books to find out information as we were not told anything. Luckily we found a historical archeologist at Stonehenge who was chatting to tourists and explaining so much about the site it was brilliant. Stonehenge is amazing , Bath was great and Windsor looked like it would have been amazing too- I would probably see Windsor separately and spend a day exploring. This “Tour” was just a bus that moves you from place to place, not an organised guided tour with preferential entry to the sites. The guides were quite offhand and disinterested in talking to people on the tour. They dropped us off then walked off to talk to other tour guides.
Very disappointing experience but very glad we saw Stonehenge and Bath in the end.

It was a long day trip but an amazing experience. I particularly liked Bath...but I think the best part of the tour was our guide Kevin and our driver, Paul. I don't think the tour would have been as interesting as it was but for the tour guide. He was smiling and gave us loads of information not letting us get bored even once. I would certainly recommend this tour!

I've wanted to see this for so long!! You used to be able to walk right up to it, see it up close. NO MORE. You have to park a mile or more away, take a bus to it and you can't get near it. VERY disappointing.

Our guide Emily was lovely- knowledgeable and informative, fun and considerate of the people in the group, Barry was a really cool driver- negotiating the narrow lanes entering Bath, and in getting out of and back into London with all that traffic! And both of them made the trip to Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge so worth it.
The sights are super all by themselves, but Evan and Evans crew made this day coach trip all the better- the sitting-in-the-coach times were livened by Emily's little nuggets from history or humorous commentary about the English countryside, and her keeping us visitors in the loop about what's coming up an d timelines and such.
I and my family will be only too happy to take other tours offered by Evan and Evans whenever we get the opportunity next.
We had a fun day all-in-all, and I'd certainly recommend Evan and Evans to visitors from back home in India.
Suganthi.

Good tour. Nice bus. Disadvantage of large group tours is that you have to wait on that one person or couple that is always making the group late. When dealing with such a tight schedule every 15 minutes counts. My recommendation for the tour group is to make the time at stonehenge a half hour or so. The bizarrely fascinating pile of rocks is still only a pile of rocks and the sculpted rocks of architecture in Windsor and Bath could use a little more time. Windsor is a must see. That was Amazing.
As soon as we started the nice tour guide informed us that the sound equipment was broken and we'd have to stay close to him. ALL 40 OF US. We couldn't hear a thing all day. It was horrible

Despite having missed the coach and not seen Windsor Castle (my own fault for getting lost) I enjoyed the last two-thirds of the trip immensely after I met up with them using the train. Our guide Oliver was both helpful and fun! He was truly knowledgable about the destinations, not to mention England itself. He offered many interesting anecdotes which bounced between educational and entertaining. I found the trip to be worthwhile and a great deal of it was thanks to Oliver and of course our driver, Tom. I would highly recommend this tour for a perfect taste of England!
This was an amazing day! A must do if you’re visiting London. Our tour guide Mark and bus driver Paul were wonderful. We enjoyed the humorous and knowledgeable banter. Highly recommend this tour!

Evan Evans' tour from London to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath was fantastic. Nigel, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable giving us facts along the way, and cracked some funny jokes too. James, our bus driver, did a great job navigating the country roads. There were many times my husband and I were grateful we weren't driving ourselves. The bus was very comfortable. The only thing I expected for the bus was that there would be outlets or usb ports to charge our phones. It's a long 11 hour trip and while we had our camera to take pictures, we also wanted to snap pictures on our phones. It's also a 2.5-3 hour ride back to London from Bath, so having your phone for some entertainment for the ride back is nice. But since there were no outlets or usb ports for charging, phone usage was limited to taking a few pictures at each site and that's about it. My only other qualm was that our tour guide didn't come around any of the sites to give us tidbits about each place. He only does it on the bus beforehand. Once you get to each sight, it's all audio-guided tours, which aren't my favorite. It did allow us to go at our own pace, but I would have enjoyed 20 minutes with our tour guide at each site to start. Oh well. Overall, it was a great way to see three magnificent places in one day.

As other reviewers mentioned, this tour packs a lot into one day. When one considers that the journey is part of the adventure, time on the bus becomes part of the tour. We saw English villages and countryside that we would have simply missed if we would have been navigating ourselves to the three sites. And time to rest up on the bus at the end of the day before heading out to dinner was welcomed. The only downside was the lunch at the "carving" style restaurant. The meat was dry, but the vegi sides were excellent. Overall, a truly enjoyable day for our family and we were able to all relax rather than hassle with navigation.

we had a great time on our tour. yes it's a long day. yes it's yucky weather. but wow. we were able to see some amazing sights and our tour guide Emily was amazing! she was very informative and pleasant! I would highly recommend!
Was more like a bus trip. Saw more of the bus than we did the other sites. Not worth the cost in my opinion. Was well organized but would not suggest it as it is an all day commitment.

Our guide, Simon, was fantastic. SO knowledgeable and very entertaining! What should have been a very long day went by in the blink of an eye! I do have one negative. Why I called Viator to book this tour, I said that I was looking for a small group tour. I was told this one would be no more than 18. The operator actually looked at multiple tours before suggesting this one based on its size cap. It was 52 people on a large bus. Although I thought my family was getting something much smaller that included guidance at the stops, it was all very well-timed (we got to Windsor before the crowds and did Stonehenge at the end of the day, once again missing the crowds). Simon did such a nice job that I’m still giving it five stars. I’m glad we did it. It was a great way to pack a lot into one day!

Great day trip...saving from the hassle of driving and parking, well organised by the company and with a balanced schedule to enjoy the three locations

We had the pleasure to have Godfrey as our chaperone and Paul as the bus driver...Both exquisite "hosts".

Just a note to the organisation and prospective customers: while our 5 y.o. daughter fully enjoyed the trip, unfortunately the headset kindly provided was not child-friendly as it did not fit in her ear. You might consider having an 'in-ear' model or - advice to parents - bring children headsets (with the jack to fit into a standard plug) if you have one.
Need a blitz tour of what is really English? Go for this one! You can see a couple of the nation's most iconic landmarks in the fastest way possible!

Andy and Mark were great! Very knowledgeable and the trip went stupendous! Had a great time!
Learned a lot!
Sacha was a fantastic guide!!! Our driver Elisa was awesome. We had a great time on the tour and learned so much. I highly recommend this tour- worth the day trip!
Saul was amazing! He made the day easy with always communicating times and what was happening. He was also extremely knowledgeable and friendly. The sights were amazing but Saul really made it!

Loved this tour! Our tour guide, Kevin, was great. He was funny and very informative. All the sights were beautiful. I only wish we could have had more time in Bath. Highly recommend this tour and Kevin as your guide.

Loved our tour guide, Simon and our driver, Michelangelo. They really took great care of us all day. Simon was witty and entertaining and full of interesting facts. It really was a perfect day and we very much enjoyed it. 12 hours sounds like a long time but it goes by so quickly. There’s not a whole lot of time in any one spot but that’s just part of trying to do so much in one day. There’s no other way to have seen and experienced all this. Definitely want to return to Bath to spend more time there. Do bring snacks and cold drinks and take advantage of any opportunity to buy more snacks as there is really no time for a sit down meal anywhere.

If your looking for a day full on excitement and information then this is the tour for you! The tour took us to Windsor castle, Stonehenge and Bath (to see the old spas) the drive there was nice and relaxing the tour guide Godfrey was full on information for the day ahead and was great at telling us timelines for each of our stops. The day went by so fast in a good way. Time flys when your having fun. 10/10.
Great trip! Professional Tour Guide (Chris) and Tom our driver. Highly recommend you won’t be disappointed.

Loved the tour! It was just the right amount of time per each stop!
Forgot the tour guide’s name, but she was very informative!

A nice trip outside London, all well organized, new clean and comfortable buses with the wi fi service inside them! Despite the many kilometers made, the day flew pleasantly also thanks to our guide Leila prepared nice and available. The three destinations in question, extraordinary in their diversity, are all worth visiting

It was great but the castle was closed and no one told us until we arrived at the castle and I am currently trying to call to receive a refund on that entrance ticket and no one is answering so be aware

Our tour guide Godfrey and bus driver Joe provided an excellent day out from London exploring iconic places and with interesting commentary. We particularly liked how punctual the tour was and the Vox headsets that allowed us to hear our guide whilst out and about.

Monica (guide) and Michael Angelo (driver) worked very well together to provide us an amazing tour of Bath, Stonehenge and Windsor. The tour was well planned and timing allowed for us to have a great balance of tour guide information and independent observation.
An excellent tour if you’re short on time. Tom was an entertaining guide (love the British humor!) and Sam was a very safe driver.
Trafalgar put on a great tour of some of the gardens in England: Kew, Physic, Chelsea Garden Show, Royal Botanical Garden and surrounding areas. The tour director was exceptional
It did not take long to see the stones. Not very interesting. Once is enough to see all. It relates to paganism.

Amazing visit to Stonehenge so many myths and stories but it is indeed a marvel of human enterprise in in stone age . It shows they were hard working conscious of time and calendar and had continued principle of progress ; reminds me if Mohenjodaro in Sindh Pakistan . These were advanced communities many many centuries ago. Bath is a beautiful town had an amazing afternoon tea at Bath Bun tea shop had great scones with clotted creams with jam sandwiches and of course tea and cakes. The Baths and the “healing water” was a great insight in history the water was warm and strong tasting as if having iron and metals . The mix of greek and old England was very interesting. What started as leprosy healing waters became what today would be a sanatorium for sick. Our guide Julia and driver Hulio were very friendly and both very efficient in their respective jobs. Baath is a town to stay and enjoy for atleast two days . Next time perhaps!!

- as a progressive liberal it was disgusting to see the wealth this one family has. If you share similar views, don't waste your time and money. If you're obsessed with the royal family then it's for you. If you're some where in between, you'll probably think it's OK.
- Stonehenge was quite the marvel, it was chilly in the beginning of Dec, but tolerable if you bundled up. What a sight to see! The guided tour was great to listen to through headphones on a Vox box. That way you were able to explore at your leisure for a little over an hour. There is literally nothing else around it though. It's in the middle of no where.
- Bath was amazing. I wish I would have known and stayed there instead of London. The Christmas festival made it even better. Such a cute little place with lots of character. The Roman baths were marvelous. It's incredible to see how ahead of their time that they were. I wish we had more home here and didn't go to Windsor Castle at all, but it didn't ruin the trip.
- Tour guide Oliver was great!
- Wifi on board was, nice but didn't realize it capped you at a certain amount since it said 24 hour access.
- Definitely suggest this to get out of London a day!

Mel our guide and Aston our driver made this a great experience. This was a very comfortable way to visit what are distant places. Each stop had it’s own highlights but if you’ve never been to any of them as we hadn’t it is truly amazing. Hearing the history of each spot while experiencing it is great. Each provided a “vox box” that you control. We highly recommend this tour.

Perfect fast paced tour just the way we like to do it! Visited the doll house, Statesroom & Chapel at Windsor! Then wisked away to Stonehenge for a circle of the rocks & finally for a quick tour of Oxford! Godfrey & Nicholas did an excellent job of Keeping us well
Informed and on the road!

It was a quick tour indeed for which I feel very sorry💔.
We didn’t rent a car as usual because we couldn’t risk driving on the left hand side of the road! WEIRD UK (Nobody likes us, the guide said😂)
That’s why we had to choose a one day trip to the places above and back to london again at 8:30 PM.
Bath is amazing, it reminded me of great luxembourg 🇱🇺. The houses by the edge of mountains and hells, the cozy shops and streets, the river streams everywhere and cold air. I wished i hadn’t have to abandon such charming town. Talking of Roman bath, it was a unique site and we were bewildered how such historic hot springs still flows very normally!
The baths are worth it; go for it without thinking.

Stonheng was a good choice but what else was there to see aside from the well organized rocks?! We had to queue for more than 30 mins in that freezing weather to get to the bus taking us to the rocks. Isn’t there any plan to stop just beside the rocks?! Could be a smart idea.

Windsor Castle was HUGE; the opened part of the castle was for tourists and could take you up to 40 mins to have a round. Enjoyed the audio guid and the very old furniture back in the 16th century and beyond.

The tour is recommended, but highly recommended if you have a car so that you get the chance to spend 2 nights at least in beautiful Bath.

Nigel was a great guide and gave a lot of insight into the history of Windsor castle , Stonehenge and the Roman baths . It was a pretty packed and eventful day , as we visited three sites that were each an hour drive apart from each other . Nigel did a good job of rounding up people and making sure we got to each site before all the other tour groups . Definitely recommend this tour if your time in London is short .

The tour is very packed but absolutely worth it! We enjoy the special feature of Stonehenge but I wish i would have more time for Windsor and city of Bath. I enrolled myself to the Roman Bath and i think it really worth going. However, the tour guide wasnt too nice to us.

FYI- This is a LONG day. You will spend lots of time on a bus. Good news is, it’s a smooth ride and a very comfortable coach bus. I actually found this to be a great opportunity to nap! :) the first stop was Windsor, which was really cool. The castle and grounds are gorgeous. We loved this stop. Would have liked to go into St. George’s Chapel, but it wasn’t permitted while we were there. Next stop was Bath. Bath is such a beautiful city! The Roman Baths were interesting and if you’re going all that way, you should make sure you pay to go in. Last stop was Stonehenge. Each stop felt a little rushed as they’re so far out of the city, but hey, if you want more time at each one I’d suggest renting a car and going at your own pace. This was to be expected as it was a day trip and you had to cover a lot of ground in short amount of time. Still a great tour and glad we did it!
Beautiful place happy I visited but we where here in December very cold .. I would recommend to everyone ..

Our Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath from London tour was with Evan Evans Tours. Our guide was Rhys and driver Joao. This is a bit of a whirlwind type tour with three stops over 11 hours and about 241 miles (387 km) round trip; however, we were able to see three great historical sites in one day. Our tour guide, Rhys, was very helpful by insuring that we all knew what was coming up, useful tips on what to do at each location, and kept us on track. Rhys made sure we could have the best experience on this tour.

We began at Windsor Castle, where the Queen was in residence at the time but none of us got an invitation to tea but maybe next time. We visited the state apartments and even saw the newly restored Queen Mary's Dollhouse. My friends wanted to spend our time in the state apartments, which meant that I did not get a chance to visit St. George's Chapel, so that will have to wait until my next visit. It is the nature of these types of tours that you need to make choices on how to spend your time, which is really true for all travels.

Next, we headed to Stonehenge. Rhys provided some overview and Evan Evans has a nice interactive audio guide that we could listen to beforehand, preparing us for the visit. With both rain and being off season, there were few people at Stonehenge that day, providing us with an opportunity to really enjoy one of the most famous sites in England and take photos. The site also includes recreations of Neolithic houses, exhibition, museum, cafe, and shop too.

Our last stop was at Bath. We opted for the admission tickets to the Roman Baths, which was a good idea. We were able to enter with our group, saving us time getting tickets and waiting in line to enter. The Roman Baths were interesting and the museum provided examples of what the baths would have looked like. We even had time to wander through the City of Bath's Christmas market.

Overall our whole group enjoyed the tour. Rhys was instrumental in making sure we could have the best experience. Joao made sure we got to all our location safety and was helpful at our stops. I would highly recommend this tour and Rhys as a tour guide.

Thank you Jennifer (Guide) and Rusell (Driver) for this great tour.Time is quite packed to visit 3 places in a day but we managed to cover all 3 places smoothly and on time. Thanks Jennifer for the recommendation to buy the Sally Lunn's bun at Bath, its really yummy! :)

Strongly recommend people to take this tour if you want to cover these 3 places in a day.

Evanevans had provided us with great tour and especially with great service from Mr. Andy Jackson. The tour was ran very professionally and Mr. Andy was very knowledgeble and experienced. Definitely recommended!! :)

Not complete visit to the UK without the Stonehenge and the Windsor castle.
Fun day tour with Andrew Jackson.
Passionate and knowledgeable about history.

The beauty of this trip is that you get to see so much that would be impossible (or a very big headache, at least) to do alone. I did this trip several years ago also, and Richard made it much more memorable. He is an English gentleman and was so polite but also firm in keeping us on our schedule, which was greatly appreciated. I felt like the time at each location was ample, except for maybe Bath since it was such a charming town. I could have spent a full day there. Maybe next time!

Wonderful way to visit 3 major point of interest. Long day, minimal time at each location, maybe 1 hour. Comfortable bus. Mel is a great guide, very knowledgeable. The driver Valentine was also great.
Must visit place very peaceful and relaxing not a great weather but still enjoyed it very much. Must visit place at least once in a lifetime.

Great attractions POOR tour guide. The tour guide was terrible and rude. The tour guide was short and not very friendly. She wasn't very informative and just did the minimum. Luckily we had an audio tour that was handed out that gave the history and information.

Definitively we liked Stonehenge site, I had thoughts it was much bigger than what we saw which was a little disappointing. I recommend to do both Windsor castle and Stonehenge together as you need only 30-45 minutes at Stonehenge.
We loved the Castle, there are tons of shops and cafes to wonder around and check out.
We don’t do a lot of day coach trips, bit did this one. Andrew Jackson was the tour guide. He was perfect. What a great tour guide. I would deff do this tour again!

The trip was great, and the sights unparalleled. A bit disappointed that no pictures were allowed in Windsor Castle (but that’s the Queen’s edict). Our guide, Nicholas and driver, Valentine, were excellent.

This tour is an excellent way to take in some incredible parts of England, without having to drive. Deborah, our guide, was quite knowledgeable and provided us with loads of great information, as well as bits of humor. We were given approximately an hour at each site, to allow travel time between the locations. I don’t think much more time than that would be necessary. We were able to see everything and enjoy each place. Bath is a wonderful town and we were fortunate to end up with a little extra time there to walk around, shop, and enjoy some of the local food. I would definitely take this tour again and recommend it to friends.

My teen son and I had a great time. Our guide, Godfrey, was knowledgeable and friendly, with a good sense of humor. He kept the tour running smoothly. Our driver, Steve, was also just as good. He provided us with safe and timely transportation. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Fantastic tour! Rhys (@RhysThomasTours) our guide was extremely knowledgeable throughout the tour, with a great sense of humour. He was the difference between average and brilliantly fantastic. Loved the information he shared on the bus about the Royal Family among many other things about London. Highly recommended! Thanks again mate! Cheers!

Rhys was extremely knowledgeable and gave a pleasant tour. Had a fun time today and gained a much deeper insight not only on the places of interest we visited but UK's history as a whole. Thanks Rhys!

I was contemplating on canceling this trip since I wanted more time in London. I am glad I ended up going! Our guide, Mel, was funny and entertaining. Also appreciated that he wanted us to be first in line to the places, which is great for Windsor because the line was super long. Highly recommend!

The trip was great overall. Our tour guide, John, was knowledgeable, funny and knows what he was doing. The bus driver, Win, was also reliable.

The tour itself is very informative and it was a great experience to explore all 3 places in 1 day (I do not think we could manage that by ourselves within 1 day without a hassle). Luckily that everyone in our tour was so on time and the traffic was not so bad and therefore, we managed to leave London at 8 and arrived back before 8pm! Thank you so much once again!

Anthony was an excellent tour guide. Everything he said was informative and delivered with a good amount of enthusiasm. An adequate amount of time was allotted for each site. Would recommend this tour to anyone.
Excellent,nice Stone slab arctiture on hilly place, queen ,s palace ,many old age collection s,sorrounded by high walls, excellent maintained.

Very interesting, compact and educational tour of 3 sites! Our tour guide Jennifer was extremely knowledgeable, easy to understand, and gave excellent instructions. Make no mistake this is a long day. However, after researching various options, this was the most efficient and stress free way to see and learn more about Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and the town of Bath. There is a bit of walking and you do spend a decent amount of time on bus, but it was very well planned . Have taken many tours in different countries and it is worth it.

My wife and I are in London for our 30th Anniversary and decided to take this tour! Kevin (our tour guide) and Steve (our driver) did an excellent job on the journey, keeping us very entertained as well as informed. Thank you for making this part of a great Anniversary trip!

The pick up point is at Bay 1-2 at Victoria Coach station. Mel the tour guide and Steve the coach driver really was very accommodating for this tour! Happy to have Mel for this tour. Friendly, witty and full of facts! He shared interesting facts about the country/city. While waiting for entry to Windsor, he talked about the history. He ensured everyone know to come back for each of the pick up point. Very efficient! On the way back from Bath to London, he included a personal touch where he approached every single one of us and asked how was everything and recommended us things/food to do/eat in London! Two thumbs up!
Our tour guide rob and driver George gave us an excellent tour with some very funny jokes to pass the long in betweens from destinations and they were a great help on how to get around. Thanks again!

Really enjoyed our Evans Evans tour to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath. Typically we do individual tours and tend to stay away from the big bus trips...just like the attention and flexability but this tour was really great. The places were amazing to see. Our trip was really made wonderful by the charm, and knowledge that our tour guide Alex (Alexandra) provided. She gave just enough history and insite to make us feel prepared for our stops but also was ready to provide more info if we wanted to dive deeper or had more questions.

Not only did she make our trip memorable but she offered to answer questions about London and other places we were traveling. She mentioned that she grew up in Paris ...our next stop. She make some excellent recommendations on places to see and restaurants/ river cruise suggestions...all right on and made our Paris time even better than originally planned.
