Fantastic tour. Leila, our guide, was so well-informed. She knew everything and more about Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. She was a pleasure and such a great speaker. Dave was an excellent driver, especially with the evening traffic. Highest recommendation to see!
Our tour guide, Andy Jackson, was excellent. His knowledge of British history was extraordinary, and he was very enthusiastic to share it with all participants throughout the tour.

The UK is amazing! We stayed close to Westminister for it's central location. It waas great, with walking distance to most of the places of interest. On the one the days did the Hop-On-Hop-Off bus which is a really good way to learn how close or how far apart things are. You really don't want to drive in London, rather use th public transportation which is really easy to figure out, plus the people are quite helpful in answering questions and giving directions. - When venturing away from London there are a variety of good tour buses that are clean, comfortable, and reasonably priced. The one we took went right to Stonehenge and it was totally worth it! Plus, the bus got us to the head of lines and had our tickets ready. On the same day trip we went to Bath and also to Stratford-On-Avon. Both towns are worth the visit and give some insight to both history and to rural UK. - Weatminster Castle is amazing and not to be missed. Book a tour ahead and avoid any lines. If you have the time book a two or three day trip to Scotland, taking the train. The UK, Wales, and Scotish countryside will amaze you with all of it's greenry.

1. Very professional
2. Extremely knowledgable guide, Mr. Nigel
3. Excellent Bus driver, Mr. Michael
4. Just the perfect amount of time spent at every attraction.
5. Good commentary by Nigel along the way.

A day very well spent.

This is very exposed sight as we were lucky enough to visit on tour in dry conditions. Very well played out and great commentary provided. Loved the old cottages & logging equipement set up at the entrance/exit area.

Nicholas and Mo were a phenomenal guide and driver! We left right on time and Nicholas kept us on a tight schedule. We were able to be one of the firsts at Windsor and Bath. He had so much knowledge about each place and offers many fun facts along the way. Not to mention he's also pretty humorous. We had time to roam each location on our own for a bit and fortunately, we didn't run into any problems in terms of timing. We met back at the bus a few minutes before departure each time and everyone was accounted for. The bus ride was smooth. This tour was super cool and it is jam packed but I'd recommend it to anyone who has a free day while visiting the UK! Well worth it!

We went in 2018 . We enjoyed all 3 sights . I just wished we had more time at Windsor and Bath. Stonehenge was awesome BUT he walk up to the stones and that’s it. I would like to leave earlier in the morning so you have more time!

I really enjoyed this tour! It was a great way to see these 3 sights if you are on a condensed time-frame. This is key to remember. Our first stop was Windsor. We were the first tour bus to arrive, which is a big deal because then we were the first group to get in line (your departure time doesn't really adjust since you need to leave by a specific time to get to the next stop....so get to the tour departure sight early so you can leave on time!). There is an audio guide; however, it's 2 hours and you'll only have about an hour and 15mins. My suggestion is to go directly to the State Apartments as there likely will be a line. I did use my audio guide a couple times there, but honestly, you really only have time to slowly walk through if you want to go to St. George's Chapel (for us it didn't open until 10:30am) and Queen Mary's Doll House. You'll want to allow enough time on the way back to the bus to pick up a lunch to go (I'd recommend Eat). We next went to Stonehenge followed by Bath. Bath is a very charming town, but most of the time was spent in the Roman Baths with little time to explore the town. Our guide Mel was fantastic and our driver Vinh was excellent! Highly recommend doing this tour!

I have been to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath twice. 2/3 are great. Stonehenge is on the dull side but better than first visit. There is now a good visitors center with above-average cafe. Used to be only a food truck. Windsor Castle is outstanding. Full of great art and architecture and lovely grounds. Bath is a beautiful town and the Roman baths are displayed well. All tours seem to include Stonehenge and for no other reason than it is located off a major roadway.

We had an absolutely amazing time! Our tour guide Alexandria and driver Ben were phenomenal! Alex was enthusiastic, informative, relatable, upbeat and kind. She made the whole trip even more memorable and enjoyable. The locations were a fantastic choice. I definitely recommend this tour!

We booked our tour through Get Your Guide. The tour was London: Windsor Castle, Stonehenge & Bath Full-Day Tour and was certified.

I couldn’t recommend this tour enough! We had such a great time. Deborah, our tour guide, was absolutely lovely! She was very knowledgeable and personable. She felt like our mom away from home! And our Driver, Valentine, was amazing as well. The ride was smooth and we wouldn’t have gotten to each place without him, so cheers to him! You see a lot in one day on this tour but it was so worth it. Bath is beautiful! A real hidden gem. Windsor Castle was stunning and Stonehenge was mesmerizing. You won’t regret booking this tour!

Absolutely loved this tour ! So much done in one day ! Our guide Charllote ( princess “ ) was very knowledgeable and sweet ! Stonehenge is a must and Bath is beeeeeautiful !!!! Get the tickets to see the Roman Baths cause is impressive !! The town is so charming and with so much to see !! Me and my husband loved it !

The Windsor Castle/Stone Henge/Bath day trip was just the excursion we were looking for. My husband and I travelled to London for a short trip and wanted the opportunity to visit these sights and see a little of the countryside. Our guide was pleasant and knowledgeable and I left with a better appreciation of English history and customs.

Godfrey & David were Amazing! Godfrey's knowledge, personality and inside tips for each location were perfect! We were able to enjoy the sights at Windsor, Stonehenge, & Bath without feeling rushed. I would recommend packing a lunch/snacks. There are food shops at some of the locations but you have to use your time wisely; you aren't allowed to bring hot foods/drinks onboarding.

Mel and Micheal Gave a full day of extremely well organized historical fun. Knowledge and worked like the Dickens to make sure the day was highly enjoyable. Great insights and historical stories- obviously Mel knows his business. Nice personalization too making sure to include restaurant recommendations as well. Hooray Mel, job well done. We would book with you again.
Fantastic day. Mel our guide made English history fun. We would do it again. Lovely countryside. Saw Ascot as we left Windsor

It was a fun trip, we really enjoyed it. We left from London at 8 am and got back around 8.30 Pm.
If you decide to get out from Londonit is the best combination ever, warmly recommended.

It goes quickly, but it turns out to be a great first look at these places. About an hour and a half at stonehenge is plenty, but now I know I want to go back to see more of Windsor and Bath. The castle is amazing, we got there early and got in without a long wait. Bath is a beautiful little town, after you see the baths, which are also amazing, take a look around town. Great little shops and a good pizza place. If you only have a day, this is a fantastic way to see these places.

Our guide Mel was absolutely amazing, so knowledgeable and witty, great senses of humour. He made quite a long day trip totally enjoyable.
From the get go was Punctual, helpfully and knowledgeably.
Would recommend this company and Mel every day of the week and twice on Sunday’s. Tks for a great experience.
Jazz hand’s 🙌

Our guide, Peter, was very knowledgeable and entertaining as he taught us about the sites we were headed to see. The tour was organized well, executed smoothly, and we left with lots of information about each place we visited. Would highly recommend.

We traveled with Evan and Evans. Claudia was our fantastic guide and Steve our safe driver. Each site offers a great experience and was given enough time to explore. I wouldn’t have asked for more although the sites at Windsor and Bath could have taken more than a day. Overall I think it is just nice. Good job entertaining us and keeping us safe.

This tour was entirely too rushed. The second you get to the attraction it is time to turn around and head back to the bus. They should remove one stop so you can fully take in two of the attractions for at least 2 hours each.

You won't have a lunch break. You can only bring COLD food and drinks on the bus to eat on the way to Stonehenge. The staff was great, they were very patient with us and seemed to be well informed. However, nothing could save the experience for us because we paid to see the sites, not to see how much we could take in before making a mad dash back to a coach bus.

Also, this is a very long day. We woke up at 0530 to be at the Victoria Coach Station by 0730. We didn't return to London until after 2030. Exhausting and disappointing.

I was traveling London alone and really wanted to see all three attractions and feel safe in a tour. It was one of the most positive experiences. I loved every single moment of walking the castle, seeing stonehenge and being able to go to Bath and walk around the square. So worth the money, and a great opportunity to see 3 amazing places!!

We really enjoyed our day trip with James and Nicholas. It was nice to sit back and enjoy the countryside on our way to Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. Great way to cover a lot of ground in one day. I thought we had enough time at each location. Definitely a great option for a day trip out of London!

We took this tour we guide Mel and driver Vinh. Both made the day really enjoyable with their easy nature and care. The information received from Mel was both informative and delivered with humour which made it more enjoyable and something I wanted to listen to. I would do another tour with these guys any day. The bus was both clean and tidy which makes the trip more enjoyable and I think Evan Evans put together a fantastic tour would use them again and will recommend them to our friends.
Our tour guide, Mel, and our driver, Vinh, did an awesome job of leading our tour. We got tons of information regarding each of our destinations and we were led efficiently everytime.

Highly recommend this tour! Ample time to see and enjoy each place, while also grabbing a coffee and a bite to eat here and there. All three stops were great and nice to see!

Our tour guide, Godfrey, was great & provided excellent knowledge and commentary throughout the trip! Thank you for an enjoyable day!

We took this tour with Evan Evans booked through Viator.com. The coach was nice and comofortable and they were very punctually. We went to Windsor Castle first and actually were the first in line, it was nice to be in front of the crowds. I loved this Castle and enjoyed walking around the property. I did feel I would have liked more time there and also to see some of the town of Windsor but I do realize we had 2 other stops to make. We were lucky enough to see the changing of the guard and had good weather most of the morning before the rain started. We had an excellent guide FRANK who made the trip more memorable with all his facts, information and stories. It was a rush to grab something to eat and get on the coach but we managed to do it. We are glad we toured Stonehenge, this is a bit out the way and didn't seem close to anything else so it was nice to go with a tour. I can't see renting a car just to go out there. There was enough time to view the Stones, shop and get a small bite to eat. We continued to Bath which I found to be a very nice town, with shops and restaurants and the Roman baths. We looked at the Baths for about 30 minutes. It is not a very big place and later walked around and got gelato at a place recommended buy Frank. It was delicious. Bath seemed like a place where one might return for 1 day to explore its charm but it is a bit far from London. Overall, excellent tour and again excellent guide. Thanks Frank for all your info.

Nothing but positive comments on our guided group trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. Aside from finally able to see these sites with my own eyes, the true gem was our guide Oliver!

Oliver provided “key” insight, back story, and historical perspective along the 12 hour journey. The information he shared really enhanced the overall experience. Thank you Oliver and also our driver Michelangelo who were a great team.

Cheers!

We had an excellent time on our tour day with Rowan. The morning started early so it was nice to get a head start. It was also on a Saturday so it was extra busy at all of our stops.

We went to Windsor first and with good reason! The line will wrap around the streets and if you don’t get there before 9am you will be waiting for a very long time! We enjoyed the castle and exploring, it was free exploration time, with no guide. We did pick up an audio tour on our way in though. We immediately beelined it to the state apartments. They were gorgeous. After we went down to St. George’s church and there was a changing of the guards going on. I would say the biggest problem with our Windsor castle stop was the amount of time. It was all very rushed. Half the time was spent waiting in line to get in even though we were the first there. They don’t open the castle at a set time, it opened when they have enough staff. So we feel like we need to go back just to enjoy it.

Next was Stonehenge. Honestly it was cool to see Stonehenge but the place is crowded and there isn’t so much to do or see there. Obviously the stones are neat but there are just massive people, you can also not go in or near the stones. There’s also a visitor center and a cafe. We had about 1.5hrs here and that was plenty of time. You ride a separate shuttle up to the stones (or you can walk the mile walk) and you also ride the separate shuttle back (or walk). It was neat to see, but a one time thing. It’s also quite a ways out in the country so we were happy to have a driver and to relax on the way out. Oh, the tour group also gives you a Stonehenge audio tour if you want to listen. You can listen to it on the bus or take it with you to Stonehenge.

Third was Bath and the Roman Baths. We loved Bath. It was a neat town! The Roman baths themselves were crowded and busy. It was really hard to enjoy the museum because it was so packed. The museum also provides an audio tour. Also, please DO NOT touch the water. The employees said it’s so disgusting as rats swim in it, and it’s just not sanitary AT ALL. They do offer a sampling of fresh water though at the end for tasting. Truthfully we were not overly thrilled with the Roman baths museum. It was crowded and that is the main reason why. Great history and fun to learn about but not fun when you’re packing so tight in there. We loved Bath the town though and would have loved to explore it more!!! We had approximately 1.5-2 hours here as well.

Overall, we were very thankful to have been on this tour. We wouldn’t have known where to go if we hadn’t booked this tour. We loved Rowan and the organization. She was very kind and offered up any help and information she could! She did say at the beginning it is a lot of activity to pack into one day and she was right! We didn’t get back to London until about 7:30 or so at night. A lot of the day was spent in the bus driving but it went by fast because of all the information and stories. We would recommend this tour especially if it’s your first time to England or these sights.

A few notes:
No HOT food or drink on the bus (cold okay)
No restrooms on the bus
No headphones required as you are provided them at all stops and on the bus
Wear walking shoes
Bring rain coat
Bring water
Can leave items on the bus at all stops
There isn’t a lot of time at any of the stops, try and pack snacks or food or plan time at at least one stop for a meal TO GO
Bus will leave without you if you’re late!

If you only have a limited time in London and would like to see Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath, here is a good way to do it. Tour guide Phil Is entertaining and knowledgeable about each location. Use this as an introduction to the three areas and then you can choose to follow up with a longer visit another time. Well worth the time spent. Highly recommend it.

Excellent Tour. The tour was great, seeing all the cool things like Stonehenge, Roman Baths & Windsor. But what made the trip that much more special was Andy. He was literally awesome. His knowledge is unparalleled, and you could tell how much he truly cared about making it the best experience possible. I will recommend this to anyone who visits London and looking to go on this trip. Its a long day, but well well worth it!
Outstanding trip. Wonderful guide and driver. So much to see! Very well organized. 8am-8 pm. Dropped us off close to our hotel on the way back. Line up early!! I would get there by 715am.

Our guide Jennifer and driver Elisa were very friendly, helpful and patient with our multilingual group.
My only complaint was that I did not get to see any aliens at stone henge.

This is a 12 hour tour. We were only at Windsor Castle for about 1.5 hours. You could only see one of the tours offered inside the castle and the Changing of the Guard. Not enough time. If you want to spend more, then make this stop a separate tour. Even Viator is now just indicating this is just an overview of the 3 locations. None are close to each other. There is sufficient time at Stonehenge and Bath. You do need to plan your lunch location. The coach doesn’t have a restroom facility. But it does have free WiFi.

The tour was nice. What was terrible disappointing was the seating arrangements. When we arrived at the meeting location, we were put in a line for a bus. When we got on, there were no seats left that my daughter and I could sit together. They would not let us change buses even though there were several going to the same place. So my daughter sat with a strange family and I sat between another family. No attempt was made to sit singles together or families with an odd number together. We were also asked to not change seats later in the trip. Everyone had to stay where they started. This was a full day trip that we had looked forward to for several weeks. It was very disappointing that we had to sit apart for the whole day.

Godfrey and Barry took great care of us. We got to see three iconic English landmarks in one day. We could not have done it without booking the tour. Godfrey was knowledgeable and kept us ahead of many lines. This easily could have eaten up a majority of our day.

We spend the day with Mel and Michael, as we like to call them M&M. They were amazing. Mel was so funny and informative. He made the long trip so pleasant and Michael was a great driver. The way he was making those turns up on those little tiny streets was like magic. We highly recommend this tour with Evans and Evans! Stonehenge and Bath were incredible!! Thank you M&M!!!

Overall my husband and I liked this tour. It was a great way to see all three places in a day. That being said, you spend very little time at each location. By the time the tour guide gathers your tickets and you get into the attraction, you have about an hour at each place which is really not enough. If the company was able to pre buy and distribute tickets to passengers, this process would be greatly improved.

We arrived early and were originally placed on a bus where we were unable to sit together. The guide was accommodating and moved us to the next bus. Our tour guide was knowledgeable about the places we visited but took very few talking breaks through the day.

We did 3 tours with different companies during our 2 week trip, this was our least favorite. If you can sacrifice one attraction and choose another tour than I would. If you absolutely have to visit all 3 places, this is a great option.

My family visited London as part of the Chicago Bears football game in London on Oct. 6. We wanted to see and experience as much as we could and turned to Evan Evans for one of its one-day bus tours to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. It turned out to be the perfect way to see three of Britain's most popular attractions.

The tour included 90-minute stops at each site and stayed on schedule throughout the day. Doing it this way helped avoid long lines at the entrances and easy access.

What made the day particularly worthwhile was the tour guide, Richard Morelli. Richard obviously has done many of these tours throughout his career and his knowledge of each site was most appreciated. It was as if we had a living library riding with us.

Definitely consider this tour when in London. You won't be disappointed. And be sure to ask for Richard when you book your excursion!

Our guide Godfrey and driver Joe were so awesome! This tour is a great way to see all three of these English highlights in one day! Our guide was very nice and told interesting stories and facts along they way! Would definitely recommend to any London visitor!!

The trip and the guide, Mel Adams were the best. Mel was one of the best guides I have ever had the good fortune to have traveled with. He was well informed, knowledgeable, witty and made the trip interesting. and fun. Michael, the bus driver, was also very professional.

What we didn’t like was the fact that my friend and I were seated in the rear row with 3 other men. We were crushed and very uncomfortable so when I mentioned the uncomfortable conditions to Mel, he graciously surrendered his front row seat to us making the rest of the trip comfortable for all the 5 people shoved into the rear row. The company should not be using the rear bench seats.

We spent a wonderful time with Tom (tour guide) and Kee (bus driver) visiting some of the most beautiful sites England has to offer. This is the kind of tour where you have to move quickly but you do have time to see the most important spots of the tour. Tom was excellent providing information about the history of the places we visited. But again, if you want to spend time walking around and site seeing, this is not the tour for you.
We really enjoyed our day trip with our guide, Tom and driver Kee. Tom was knowledgeable and engaging. We highly recommend this tour if you’re in London.

Our guide, Mel, was very entertaining and informative. We felt very safe as our driver, Kee, navigated the busy streets. We were able relax on the bus and enjoy the commentary. By purchasing the tour with included entrance fees we did not have to wait in line to purchase tickets. There was enough time to visit all 3 sites. We bought COLD (hot food and drinks not allowed) sandwiches and drinks to eat on bus while traveling.

Mel Adams the tour guide was good. He talks on the bus, but doesn't give you a tour at the sites - you use the audio guides instead. The bus has a PA system which is great - Premium Tours does not.

You get 1 to 1.5 hours at each location. The bus has no restroom. Keep in mind the travel times doesn't really take into account the traffic - so it took 30-45 minutes to just get out of London from Victoria coach station. Then, on the way back, it took 45mins to get to Victoria coach station once we got close to London. We actually got dropped off a few blocks from Victoria Coach because the traffic was so bad. Bring 30p for the bathrooms at Victoria coach station since they charge, and there is no working change machine in the station.

You will have plenty of time at Stonehenge & museum. The amount of time at the Roman Baths was ok, but don't go too slow, Check out the church across the street. There was also a musician playing in the square.

Windsor Castle will be tight, I walked thru the state rooms without stopping much, then checked out the chapel. Many folks said they couldn't get to the chapel and still make the bus. I used the audio guide sparingly, because I thought hearing everything would just take too long.

We were told to be outside of the castle during the changing of the guard because as it happens, they do not allow passage out of the castle - so don't get stuck inside and miss the bus.

We arrived first in line, which really helped. We got there at about 9am, they opened at 9:30am, and by then there was a long line for security.

There is a train from London to Bath, so you could decide to do a day trip, or over nighter just to Bath. You need a car to get to Stonehenge. If you rent a car you could do all three and have more control over your timing - I would go to Windsor Castle early, then Stonehenge, then Bath and maybe stay for dinner or overnight and try to avoid the London traffic.

Worth seeing. This day trip is a good 'downtime' to get off your feet, after walking around London for a fews days.
this has been the best tour that I have been so far. Our guide Andrew Jackson is very informative and you can feel that he loves what he does. Looking forward to our next tour with evan evans...

Worth mentioning first is that Armin, our guide, and Winston, our driver, were absolutely great! Amazing, wonderful, and so informative. More than once, I was so glad Winston was driving - I wouldn't have wanted to take a car, let alone a bus, down some of those roads.

Overall, it's a great tour and I'm glad we went. I'd recommend it.
It was easy to find the Victoria Coach Station, about 2 blocks from the Victorian Underground/Train station, and the Evan Evans office is tucked into a small office near Gate 2. All of the staff were friendly, reassuring, and helpful in making sure everyone got onto the right bus at the right time.

With three distant stops, there is a definite schedule to keep, and everyone is responsible for their own time management. When the guide says the bus is leaving at a certain time, it's really leaving, with or without you. While there is a window of time for each stop, you need to determine how much time *you* have, including stops at the washroom or getting food.

Time is limited at each stop and that means not begin able to see everything, or in as much detail as one would like. A tour like this is like having appetizers - it's tasty bite, but it's not a full meal.
We had an amazing day, it goes by fast! We will keep good memories of that day. See pictures below 😊

Our tour was with Earl Earl's Tours from the Victoria Coach Station in London. We were on a hugs bus with 50 other visitors (one of them with a toddler) - the bus was packed. That was OK since it was comfortable. Our commentator was Rowan - a young lady who told us she was from Scotland. Her dialogue felt extremely rehearsed and not at all original. She tried to incorporate some humor in the presentation but that also felt fake and very unnatural. We had two previous tours before this one with guides that were fantastic - very real and down to earth where you felt like they were drawing from their own past experiences and knowledge. This felt like a canned commentary that was being memorized word for word without any originality at all. That got old very quickly. On top of that - Rowan would round us up - get us to a location and drop us in a queue to stand in line to gain access to the location. She would then return to the bus and leave us to find our way back (although to gave instructions) - she didn't bother to stay with the group while our other guides remained engaged. It felt more like hustling cattle, putting them in the pin and then rounding them up for the next cattle drive. Aside from that - we still enjoyed the locations we got to visit. Just extremely disappointing in how it was organized and delivered. I'd look for a different tour company next time. Also - don't expect to be able to take any pictures inside the State Apartments at Windsor. They're gorgeous - but no photos allowed.

This was a big day but quite manageable and we had sufficient time at each place. Comfortable coach and it was worth paying extra for the front seats and wine. Excellent variety, and great guide Andrew.

So we were short on time and we ended up canceling the trip and just did the Windsor Castle on our own and we loved it. We ended up taking the train from the main station and the ticket was 12 pounds roundtrip, we took to train to Slogh and then from there another train to Windsor Castle and it took us 25 min. Which was great. And it's a 5 min walk to the castld. The entrance we bought when we were at Buckingham Palace, but you can also purchase on the spot. The proce was 25 pounds I believe and that's all. You can get the ticket stamped and can go back for an entire year as well (if you purchase straight from them or thr palace). We spent about 3-4 hours there and ate a nearby bar. Definitely recommend going. Very beautiful place.

We went to Stonehenge and it took my breath away. You have to walk around the circle and look at Stonehenge from all these different angles and each one is like a unique sight. To listen to the history of this community, it just blows your mind how they existed and what they did to live, it is hard to fathom. Stonehenge is something not to be missed.

I LOVED this trip. Our guide, Karen, was a fabulous tour guide. She was so knowledgeable and funny-- I loved listening to her. I would highly recommend taking this tour. If I would change anything, I would want more time to explore Bath! What a cute little town!!!

This tour was fun. I was worried it would be oversized. Our guide was very good at his job getting us to all the sites on time and we didn't miss a beat. I loved it all except I wanted mote time in Windsor to go shopping in town. I think they should take 15 minutes off Stonehenge and add it into Windsor.
The sites on the this tour speak for themselves. What made is great tour was our guide Andy. He is a font of information and funny without being too corny. Great tour.

Our tour guide Angela and driver Mark were great! Angela is very knowledgeable and full of historic facts which i loved! Mark got us to our stops promptly and safely. As a first time visitor to the UK it made our day nice and easy! Would recommend definetly 😊

This day trip was great and our guide Phillip was exceptional. The coach was comfortable as well as the visits to all of the locations. We want to go back, especially to BATH! Don't bother eating the included lunch, eat on the road somewhere.

Manon was our tour guide and Steve was our bus driver. They both did an amazing job!!!

Manon was very organized, super sweet, and a pleasure to be on an all-day trip with! She answered all our questions, made the transition from one site to the next easy for us, and gave clear directions on where and when to meet the bus.

This trip packed a lot into one day, but it is so worth it. We had plenty of time in each area to explore the main attraction and the other sites in each town. (Don't expect to find anything more than the gift shop and small restaurant in Stonehenge though.) Both Windsor Castle and Bath were amazing! We toured the castle, watched the changing of the guard, and had time for a quick bite to eat.

Bath is absolutely beautiful! I highly recommend exploring the other sites in this small town when you've finished with the Roman baths.

The tour starts early in the morning the bus station (not the train station) for a good reason. Note that this station charges to use the toilets, so I recommend stopping at the train station first if you want to go before you leave. There were about three groups of 52 ppl, but everything felt like it was very well organized and it didn't feel like 52 ppl were in the group. The tour guides hand out wristbands and devices that sync to your specific tour guide once you are on the bus. The first stop was Windsor Castle. Luckily, we were the third group in line, getting there about 30 minutes before the Castle opened. You get a separate audio device and tour the grounds on your own after your tour guide gives you your ticket and drops you off at security check point. The town of Windsor itself is a delight, but if you do the entire Castle, you will only have time to get a take away sandwich to eat on the bus on the way to Bath. Same drill as Bath, which is also a nice town filled with shops and cafes. We had time to get some ice cream after we toured the Baths. Lastly, Stonehenge. I could have probably spent a little more time at this location. Once parked, you get in line to take a separate bus run by the facility to the site. We were given a map and was supposed to be able to listen about the different places in and around Stonehenge by tapping on the map with our audio device. However, it stopped working about halfway through. But that may be because it was raining so much. The downfall to this site is that you have to wait for another bus to take you back to the visitor center/parking lot. So we waited, but this time two loads got on prior to us, so waiting definitely chipped away at the limited time we had at the site. By the time we got back there wasn't enough time to go to the museum if we wanted to use the facilities or purchase a drink/snack. We had approximately 1.5 hrs. at each stop. Our driver, Lawrie, and the tour guide, Tom were great. Tom had a perfect voice that projected and annunciated everything so he was easy to understand. He was very knowledgeable about the history and background and prepped you for each stop along the way. Lawrie got us to each place ahead of schedule and even got us back ahead of time too. It was still an all day activity. We were exhausted but I would definitely recommend it.

Full on day - not enough time at Windsor Castle due to crowds and line up time which was disappointing but no-ones fault. Bath was fantastic and Stonehenge just amazing. Our tour guide, and I cant remember her name was fantastic. A long day but totally worth it.

We had a wonderful time on this day tour. Being in London without a car, this was a way to experience these things for the first time without having to worry about the travel or choosing.

It is a full day, but you still must be quick at each of the stops. Our guide said it best, it is a Highlight Tour. It's a way to experience these things quickly and get a feel so you can say you've done them. But also so you know what you want to spend more time on if you ever come back.

Our guide, Rowan, was amazing. She was so enthusiastic and genuine in her love for the history she was sharing with us. She was so knowledgeable and also full of the really fun facts that made it truly interesting. She had more up to date and interesting information than was included in the audio tours at each location She was also a hoot and had a great sense of humor.

Our driver, Winston, did an amazing job navigating the bus coach through the small roads in the countryside, within Bath, and the heavy London rush hour traffic. It would be easy to make many of the patrons travel sick, but I don't think anyone had any issues. I know we didn't and we were all the way in the back row of the bus coach.

I would highly recommend the tour, Rowan, and Winston to anyone coming to London and wants to see some of the sights outside of the city. 10/10.

We were very lucky to have Andy Jackson as our tour guide. He made the trip very enjoyable with his stories and commentary. We felt we had enough time to see each place and would definitely want to go back to visit Bath. At each location you’ll be able to buy some food and drinks.

This is the first time are family that we were booking a full tour on our own rather than going the old SOTC route . So we were all the more weary of how these guided tours and visits would go.!
Turns out it was one of the upmost fun days of our lives... Mel Adams, our lovely guide made the trip all the more special with his commentary and insights... I do recommend Evans Evans Tours to everyone. We even did their full day London sight seeing tour and they are really professional and take care of you.

Mel and Kee were absolutely marvelous. Thank you for all the amazing history and wonderful stories that kept us intrigued all the way through! Mel is an absolute delight, and Kee kept us safe and on track through a very busy day! Would highly recommend.

This tour was the highlight tour of my stay in London, as it covers all must sees in one day! Windsor castle was spectacular inside and out, and Stonehenge takes you to another world of historical mystery and wonders. I loved the beautiful town of Bath, and I would stay there for a night when I come back next time. Although many hours of road travels required, beautiful view of English country side, as well as our guide, Andy Jackson’s entertainment really keeps you alive! I was so lucky to have Andy as our tour guide, with depth of history, knowledge, and passion made this tour so much more special. Highly recommend!!!

This is definitely a tour packed with activities. Time per stop is limited but Kevin and Mark expertly kept the tour on time and moving. As they mentioned you will probably want more time in one or all of the stops but unless you have unlimited days in England this is a great way to see tons of stuff including the Unesco heritage sight of Stonehenge. I was somewhat excited to see a bunch of stones sort of placed in a circular pattern, but once I got there I was taken aback of how “magical” the place felt for me (full disclosure, the weather was great for it cool with strong winds low gray clouds and surrounded by green fields).

This tour was so good! Something of a “highlights” tour where you get to sample a few must see sites. As a foreign traveler this was the best way to see part of England. What made the tour exceptional was our outstanding guide, Andrew. Masterfully blended information and entertainment into a captivating trip. He also went above and beyond to make sure everyone knew where to go and how to get there, even back to our hotels from the drop off point. Andrew was a superb ambassador for the city of London and the UK in general.

Also, the included lunch was fantastic!

Since we booked together we should have been able to sit together which we couldn’t.
We would have like more information from the tour guide. We seem to waste time queueing.

We had a great day exploring the 3 areas. We actually found Windsor Castle more interesting than Buckingham Palace as it actually felt that royalty has lived there. The Castle is huge (the largest working castle in the world) and full of history. The town of Bath was quaint and of course, we loved visiting the Roman baths. The day culminated with a trip to Stonehenge. I know that it is just a bunch of rocks but there is a real sense of history and mystery surrounding it. I am glad that I got to check it off of my bucket list. All in all, a wonderful day.

Excellent driver, and our tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable although a bit long-winded. With three activities in one trip, we were a little pressed for time; this could have been extended if our guide could have completed his discourse before we got off the bus. Given the opportunity to plan it again, I would choose a trip with only two destinations-but which destination could we have given up? Each was amazing. We just needed more time at each location!
Mr. Jackson was a great tour guide for us. He was eminently engaging, affable and a wellspring of knowledge. I felt as if I were in a seminar of English history at King's College. Fantastic!

This is a self guided tour with a very informative bus host. We started our day at Windsor Castle where our bus-host/guide gave us great info on the town leading up to the castle. We stood in line for a while so he entertained us with factoids about the history there. Once inside the gates we were on our own with a self guided ear piece. It was hard to get around and understand where to go in the time allotted. 2nd stop was Bath where we had to go see the ruin and eat before our final destination (in under an hour). My elderly mom and I zoomed by the bath ruin and tried to get lunch but all we could do was get salads to go and eat inside the bus (which took about 30 mins to prep, pay, and hand over to us at restaurant).
The highlight was Stonehenge and the time plus self guided ear piece seemed fitting for that one. I feel like I paid too much and spend too much time running around just to get to the stones but, overall it was OK.

The tour was nice - Bus was clean- guide was good on telling us where to meet & procedures in the Castle.. At the end of our tour he help guided each of us how to get back to our hotels - the bus stop at different Tube lines instead of going back to our pick up point - that was great!!
Our only issue just wasn’t enough time to really see things —
All in all we saw a lot !!! Busy day !!!

I liked what we did see, but stops were 2 hours apart, more if you include walk and wait time to enter, 1.5 hours or so in time spent in locations and much of that 1.5 hour there spent in bathroom line when you got there ( as it has been 2.5 hours by now) and before you left- as it will be another 2 + hours until your next chance. Although we liked what we saw, and now that it is over I am glad we went, but 2.5 hours between bathroom opportunities pretty much ruined my day. While the memories and pictures will last past a difficult day, I would not have gone had I known. Our tour guide was nice and knowledgeable.

On the panflipt it did not say how long we were going to stay at each place or how long it takes to get to the places,so we thought we would have anough time to sight see. In bath for example, we go around 35 minutes to see 1 tiny bit of the town. The food was nice, and the tour guide was very informative but again very rushed but also enjoyable.

We paid for a guided tour including all entrances, but the guide was only on the bus. While on the bus, she would direct us where to go and what to see once we're inside, but this was NOT a guided tour. We were rushed through everything and spent too much time waiting in lines. Windsor has a very interesting train station, but we were quickly ruched trough it, without even time for a photo. I took similar tour years ago with a different company and it was much nicer. The guide was always with us and there was plenty of time for pictures. Here, everything was rush-rush. Bring your own lunch -- there's not enough time to buy one. They expect you to eat on the bus, but no hot liquids.

We booked this tour after a friend recommended it. I expected to see the sights as per the schedule but we got so much more. Our guide was Manon - her knowledge was fantastic and went above and beyond my expectations. The day is long but the amount of commentary and amusing stories was excellent. Then we had Steve as our driver - so skillful and we felt in very safe hands all day. Definitely recommend this tour.

The tour guide Andy Jackson was very knowledgeable and helpful. The tour itself was a very long an busy day but well worth it. As expected the pace was fast but did allow for seeing three wonderful historic sites. A good idea for people without a long trip in the UK who want to maximize a day trip.

My friend and I took the tour led by Carol and Steve and had an amazing time. It was a long day, but we would have not been able to do all 3 otherwise during our short stay in London. All 3 locations were amazing for different reasons, and Carol ensured that our group was top priority in any line we had to wait in :) Organization was on point with all agenda logistics and 10/10 recommend for a fantastic day.

Our tour guide was Robert and he was amazing - so knowledgeable about the history of each place. He was an expert at educating through story and made us laugh a lot!
It is a very long day so be sure to plan time to get snacks and water. We got to Victoria Coach Station at 7:30 and found Evan and Evan tours easily and got in the que right away so we could all sit together. Definitely recommend this trip if these sights are on your list for London! Be sure to bring cash with you because the best ice cream shop in Bath only accepts £! We arrived back at the station at 8 pm and were starving so went to Shakespeare pub for food and it was good.
Thank you Andy Jackson for your passion for all things English and your incredible knowledge. You have made this trip today magical, you are a gem.

I have gone on many good tours but this has been the only one I have written a review for. Why? Because our tour guide Mel and bus driver Lawrie were outstanding. Mel was very very knowledgeable about British history and I love his approach he took with sharing his knowledge as there tends to be more than one perspective. He was very determined to beat the crowds which he successfully did and entertained us along the way with history stories.

Eugene was an excellent tourist guide, cracking his jokes as well as delivering abundance of knowledge on the destinations. Together with our finest driver Aston Martin who skillfully glided along the roads to the royal Windsor, breathtaking Bath and awesome Stonehenge, both made our trip worthwhile and definitely a must to repeat! 😀
Great deal for a day trip to see all destinations. Gives great overview of what’s available to see at each. Solid value.

We were on a Rabbie's tour, the lead prepped us for the walk of at least a mile round trip, seems longer (paved walk) or the 19lb bus ride. The stones are corded off so you can't get close, but the zoom lens worked great. This place is serene and beautiful, surrounded by cows and sheep grazing. It takes only a short time to see, then on to more incredible country side. But, if it's on the bucket list, a must see. Enjoy. Just a note, there are other stone circles close by, perhaps better then this site. Check them out....

Really enjoyable for the trip
although have some traffic but our guide Cameron was control the time very well
He was humor nice and gave us many other details around London,It’s really great
The driver Alan was drive very safety and stable
Hope one day can join with them again for another trip

One day is too short. Windsor Castle and Windsor is worth a whole day's visit and Bath and Stonehenge or combine Bath and Oxford. One could also spend a day in each. So much to see and absorb and lovely shops, and dining spots. A tourist's dream.

First, its necessary to set the right expectations. All 3 sites are amazing and definitely need at least 2-3 days to cover them well and at leisure. That said, if you have limited time and these 3 sites to visit, this is definitely the tour to take.
We took the trip on 9th September a rainy English day!

The trip was an intense but great experience, enlivened by the guide Richard and driver Tom. Richard was very knowledgeable and able to concisely explain the complex royal history of England as well as various other interesting items. I am happy to recommend both for a great performance (in spite of reminders that we will be left behind if we turned up late! )

The tour starts from Victoria Coach station close to Victoria tube (metro) station. You need to show your tickets and get some band. Queuing starts from 7-7.15 am and departure around 7.30-7.35am. Get there early if you want seats together.

The trip starts with Windsor castle and being on early and on time meant a very short waiting time to get in. (this is important, you dont want to waste precious time queuing up). We were to pick up lunch on the way back at Windsor rail station and have it on the bus. No hot drinks or hot food were allowed on the bus. So time your tea/coffee properly !

The castle is beautiful, scenic and this is but a teaser for a more detailed visit, which is true for the Bath section as well. St George's chapel is a must visit. One can understand why the royal family prefers this over Buckingham Palace.

Bath is the next stop. A medieval town with a Roman Bath built on a hot spring. Looks more like similar towns on continental Europe. Very beautiful. The Roman bath visit is interesting but you can also enjoy if you decide to skip it and explore the town. Absolutely beautiful and worth spending time. (we chose the roman bath visit option also which costs extra)

From there we proceeded to stonehenge. The site itself is awe inspiring. All tour buses take tourists to the bus parking and after that its a local company which provides a shuttle services and there's a pretty decent souvenir shops. I have not seen stonehenge souvenirs anywhere else, so pick up some if you are a fan.

All in all, an intense time bound (you WILL need to watch the clock) - but satisfying day. The in between journeys were interesting with Richard providing interesting information.
Rhys was the tour guide. He did a fantastic job. He was extremely knowledgeable. He was also personable and able to manage a huge crowd of people.

My wife and I here in London for my business meetings. We had a full day open for sightseeing, so we booked this tour that visits all three of the iconic sites of Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath. We knew going in the day would be long, the bus drives to each location would be long, and the visits at each site would be short. Knowing all of this, we had a terrific time at all three locations. Katie was our tour guide, and Aston was the bus driver. They both are PHENOMENAL!! Katie briefed us on the history of all three locations during our bus trips, so we didn't feel a need to use the audio guides at the sites (not enough time to do that anyway). It was a beautiful sunny day, the bus was spotlessly clean, and just an overall great experience.

It was great to visit all the three amazing sites full of history and stories behind. Thank you our guide Eugene and driver David B. for the hilarious, funny and entertaining experience:) Will definitely recommend!

This is a great trip if your time in London is limited. Be prepared for a very long day. Twelve hours. With lots of time on bus.

We stopped first at Windsor Castle for 2 hours. I thought the guide walked way too fast for us, we're over 70. We lost her and only caught up on the entrance line. There was a long flight of stairs up to train platform where we entered. Crowded and you had to move quickly. Then we raced through shopping area and up hill to castle.

While I enjoyed seeing the Castle, I felt very rushed on this part of the trip.
If I had time, I would just do this as a separate trip on my own so that I could enjoy the castle, grounds, shops and restaurants. In 2 hours you had to walk at least 10 to 15 minutes on each end. Wait on line to get in. Use bathroom facilities. Definitely should be more time allowed. I also felt that guide should recognize that older travelers just can move as quickly as young people.

The guide had us skip bathrooms near coach parking and instead sent us back to guild hall. First set of bathrooms were ground level. At guild hall they were downstairs. Not convenient especially since it was an extra walk back down and up a hill.

As soon as we entered castle grounds there were convenient bathrooms.

I swear that no one in Europe ever has to use the loo.

It was a 2 hour drive there, we were advised to pick up lunch to eat on bus because it was a 2 hr drive to Bath.

Again, rushed through streets, waited for bathrooms until we got to Roman Baths.

The baths were interesting. Roman's did amazing things. Again 1 1/2 hours wasn't a lot of time to explore.

Another bus ride took us to Stonehenge. Again, amazing to see. With only an hour spent there it was enough for us. We didn't go into exhibition.

In all, I enjoyed all 3 sites and the guide was very knowledgeable. All are well worth seeing.

I know many people say it is too crowded and not as cool because we can't go inside the centre or touch the stones, but there is something still so beautiful about the mystery of the stones and I wonder what it would be like to be there during a solstice. The walk to the stones from the parking lot (you can get a shuttle) has a gorgeous farm along the road and many of the people actually walked back through the pasture afterwards. I loved taking photos of the faces of the cows and wondered what they thought of all of us. It is oddly enough a very peaceful place even in the midst of hundreds of tourists. Take your time.. Find a spot with no one in it and take the time to just imagine what brought about this amazing structure and who may have built it. Getting caught up in the history of Stonehenge is where the magic is. This was back in 2016, September.
Claudia and Steve were great! If your looking to fill a day with interesting facts and amazing sights I highly recommend this!

My tour was lead by the lovely Alexandra, she was bright and bubbly but knew all the history of the area.
The tour was well organised and efficient and we were back on time.
The included sites were all fantastic and Bath was a beautiful city to just wander around.
My only complaint is that i wanted more time at place and even the guide said that this was only really a taste and advised us to go back.
Overall a fun day but it did feel a bit rushed at times

Great trip with Rhys and Derek! @rhysthomastours
I very much recommend this company. The entire day was smooth and entirely educational. I especially liked the way Rhys periodically walked the bus talking with the guests and answering questions. Very funny and entertaining. I also enjoyed the bonus tour of London on our way back into the city

My daughter and I just finished the most delightful tour today.... lead by Rhys Thomas? a most informed and experienced guide who turned the gray, damp and rainy day into a joyful, memorable and educational London experience that I recommend to anyone looking to cram a lot of great stuff into a small amount of time...In one day there is No way we could have done this on our own or learned so much...Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge will be remembered with stories and all sorts of tidbits I will cherish. Thanks Rhys...Lucky Evan -Evans for having you!

Loved the tour - the sites were all incredible and our tour guides were top notch. Windsor Castle was more spectacular than I'd anticipated - could have spent many hours there. Bath was lovely - note: the Roman baths are interesting but if I had to do it again I would spend the majority of time wandering around the city. And Stonehenge is just epic. So there's that. :)

Jennifer was our guide, and she was fantastic. A guide can really make or break your tour, and she was informative and funny. I think the time we had at each place was pretty fair. Bath was our favorite so we would have liked more time there, but that’s not the nature of a tour like this.

We had a great time on the tour! Everything was exactly as expected and on time. Yes it’s a long day but the coach was comfy enough and we napped between stops. We stopped at Windsor first, then Bath then Stonehenge. A little over an hour at each stop. I will say I think I could have spent more time in Bath and less at Stonehenge but that’s just my personal preference. We brought lunch with us on the bus and it worked out well. Note: this bus didn’t allow any hot drinks or food aboard so make sure you don’t buy it beforehand. Our guide Mel was fantastic! He provided so much interesting information on the places we went as well as history of England. He gave all the commentary on the bus or as you wait to go into the stops. He doesn’t go with you to the actual stops. For those you get audio guides which are just fine! It was actually nice to have his commentary during the bus trip to add some entertainment there. All around good time and a really good way to see all these sights without having to rent a car and learn to drive on the opposite side of the road!!
Andrew Jackson was so good as a guide. Incredibly knowledgeable and very approachable and kind. Would highly recommend him and this tour.

Deborah made this tour go from good to great. She was friendly, funny and knowledgeable. I really enjoyed everything about the tour and seeing Stonehenge was a dream come true. I didn’t pay to see the Roman Bath and decided to drink at a local pub instead. Highly recommended! One tip I would suggest is make sure your seat on the bus works. My seat kept reclining which made the trip for me and the person behind me not as comfortable as I would have liked. Highly recommended the tour otherwise!

Dream of civilisations that were here before and continue to echo in our minds and hearts. Makes me think of the parts of ourselves that are parts of ancient civilisations in our DNA. If we are all one and Attila is my family this beauty is all I need to see until the rest of my days. I see the perfection in every molecule. I see that I have to keep coming back only to be reminded that part of them still lives in me. Why should I ever deny myself that treasure? Also check out the oldest pub in Bath that is the oldest gay pub in the known universe. Supposedly Oscar loved it!

Angela (Angie) is an amazing tour guide. I learned more from her about the history of the Kings and Queens in 2 hours than I had in my entire school career. The tour is really good, we had enough time at each location and everything went off with out a hitch. After the trip Angie helped us with directions to our restaurant and even gave some history into the areas we would be walking.

Went on day trip 3 september to windsor castle, bath (including Roman bath entry) and stonehenge. Our guide was Mel, who also has a company of his own, guiding angels agency; driver was Steve. Mel was a really informative guide; with plenty of knowledge regarding the history of the above places and london in general. He noted that he teaches history at a university. Steve was a good driver, he even slowed down coning out of bath on the way to stonehenge so we could all admire the view of the hills passing by. I personally thought windsor castle was a bit rushed. However there was sufficient time at Stonehenge and bath. Roman baths was amazing and really interesting. I find with any of these day tours you always wish they had more time and thats just how things are. Before coming back to Victoria station in london, mel listed various suggestions for dinner and places to check out. He also went down the coach, and spoke to everyone approx 50 people, and checked that eveyone was ok to get back to where they were staying. Really considerate of him. Thanks mel and Steve for an awesome day (if you guys see this)

This tour covers several historical places and a must-do if you have limited time in London. Would have loved to stay a bit at Windsor castle but due to time constraints, only explored 1 building inside the castle so as not to miss watching the parade of royal guards. Nevertheless, trip was good. Rita has looked after everyone of us and provided informative commentaries of every places we visited.

While visiting London you must do a day trip to Stonehenge and Windsor Castle. Evans Tour offers an excellent opportunity to accomplish this. Their professional guides provide meaningful and fun historical information. Because of time restrains, I would recommend that you select a tour option of Windsor Castle and Stonehenge and skip Bath for another day. And tour. Doing all three on the same day as we did can be a bit rushed. We felt we could have spent more time at Windsor Castle and explore the town and perhaps catch lunch there before moving on to Stonehenge. Having said that, I highly recommend this tour.

I had a great time throughout the activity. Seeing what best Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath have to offer in half a day was awesome! Our tour guide (Rowen) and bus driver (Nikki) were great. Rowen has a great understanding of history and current affairs. She entertained us really well, ensured we are safe, ensured that the time is utilized well! Thanks to Evans for organizing the activity!

The three stops tour was carefully and thoughtfully designed by Evan Evans Tours to make sure that you get enough time to enjoy each one of the stops. For the purpose of our tour, they used their brand new Mercedes coaches(Buses). With reclining seats, a lot of legroom. And feet rest. On our way to each stop our brilliant tour guide Rhys, mad sure to give us all the historical facts behind each location which made the trip very enjoyable. Not to forget about our experienced driver Andres. He was a smooth operator. We felt very safe with him behind the wheel. If all drivers and guides with Evans Evens conduct themselves in the same manner as Rhys and Andres, I will definitely use Even Evens for all future tours. Be mindful this is an all day trip. We left at 8 in the morning and returned back to London at 7 in the evening.
Mel was a great tour guide with great insight and an awesome attitude. Bob the driver got us to our destinations safe and quickly. Awesome trip for me and my 4 year old. Thanks!
Excellent day with Mel, our tour guide and Lester our driver. Very entertaining and had a great history lesson on London as well! Highly recommended.
The tour guide Nicholas was great and very knowledgeable. He seemed to know so much about the area and really seemed to want to make our tour enjoyable to everyone.

We went to Windsor castle,Stonehenge and Bath today. I would highly recommend this tour. We had Mel Adams as our tour guide who gave us one of the most engaging, knowledgeable and interesting commentaries. If only History class was like that at school!!! Such a great day which the whole family really enjoyed. I would now consider other tours by this company as we were so impressed.

What a great tour! It’s a fully packed day but this tour guide (Mel Adams) made seriously everything run super smoothly and made us laugh along the way. We were able to relax and enjoy each part of the perfectly timed tour knowing exactly what to expect at each location. He was super knowledgeable and relayed an enormous amount of history to us as if he was telling us about our favorite soap opera! He made history come to life. I wish my history professors had been as entertaining as he was. Thank you Mel for a great day!

Mel was an absolute fantastic tour guide. Of all the tours in all the countries he’s one of my favorites. Very knowledgeable of course.....but also with a great sense of humor. He had an ease about him as he breaks down complex historical stories and it helps as an audience to soak it all in. So much history to hear about in this tour combo, and he did a great job making it fun to learn. Bob was our driver and the combination of Mel and Bob had them making sure we were always near the front of the line, getting us ahead of other tour groups. This made it possible for us to get into the locations fast and maximize the time slots we had for each place.
Great tour! This tour gives you an excellent sampling of other parts of England. Rhys is very knowledged and keeps the history of these great locations fresh with his clever story telling.

I joined the tour to stonehenge, windsor castle and bath yesterday. It was a pleasant experience. Katie is the most informative tour guide I ever have. I learned so much about English history! I wonder if she was a history teacher. And Jane is an amazing driver, I had a few wonderful naps on the tour bus because of her wonderful driving skills. The only thing I wanted to change is I wish we can stay a little bit long in Bath!
Overall I recommend this tour to everyone!

This is a wonderful opportunity to get out of the city of London and see a bit more of the country. Our tour guide, Peter, was fabulous! He was informative, funny, made sure that we understood important points (when to return to the bus, how to remember which bus was ours, where the bathrooms were). He gave us a wonderful overview of the history of the area in a very entertaining way, but he also had a good understanding of when to allow us just to look at the scenery. We learned SO much and really enjoyed it. As others have said, there is not enough time to see everything at the sites (we could easily have spent an entire day at each site if we had the time), but the speed was worth it to be able to get a little taste of everything in the time that we had available.

To whom it may concern:
My husband and I took a tour to.Stonehenge, Bath, and Windsor Castle and lunch at a pub in Lacock on Tuesday August 13th.
1. our tour left 45 minutes plus later than the designated time due to our bus not being able to get out of the depot because another bus had a flat tire and was blocking their way.
2. We were told we would have to forego Bath. Our tour guide David who I will Mention later said he was determined toGet us there so after a briefed tour of Windsor Castle where we were left on our own, we rushed to Bath( so we could say we were there) but had no time to do anything in the 30 Minutes allotted there. Part of the reason We chose the tour was to enter and see the Baths at our own expense but there was “ no time”.
3. Then after waiting At the designated area for the bus.. it came 15 minutes late because it’s transmissioon was not working. He had to drive a maximum of 10 miles an hour to Lacock where another bus was going to meet us
4. Our 2:30 Lunch at Lacock happened at 4:30 and ours was inedible.. probably from sitting around Our fish and chips were dried out so we basically had no Lunch.
5. By this time it was late and we were told we might have to forego Stonehenge... the highlight! Our tour guide rushed us there and although if was already closed got us permission to rush down to take a picture of the main. Stones and come back to the bus.. not having any time to spend at the site and truly see it. We then had to switch to a 3rd bus!!!!
6. Our guide was amazing and said he had NEVER had so many things go wrong on a tour before and apologized profusely the entire day. He told us to contact the company we purchased from for a refund . We feel totally justified for multiple reasons in asking for a refund.
7. Our tour number was and our guide was David.
8. We will wait to hear from you before writing a review.
9. The day,which we were so looking forward to was a total disaster!
10. Thanks for your attention to this matter. Ellen and Jan Stern

The guide Rhys Thomas and driver Steve O were excellent. Friendly and cared for our safety as well as very informative and pleasant. I would have given an excellent rating if I didn't feel a bit rushed. So much to see and do in a day trip. Knowing what I know now I think I would look for only two stops per day. Did enjoy seeing Windsor Castle but again i could of spent another 2 to 3 hours. Same is true for Bath but I did enjoy
the trip and thought your driver and guide were exceptional.

Had a great day with Evans & Evans, Windsor Castle is amazing to visit, Bath is a beautiful town, make sure you leave yourself enough time to walk around the town after you visit the Roman Baths. Stonehenge is also something you need to experience and is worth the extra couple of hours of travel, more time at Windsor Castle and Bath would be ideal but it’s an already a full day so there’s no way that can happen, our tour guide Kevin was very knowledgeable, pleasant and always happy to answer questions and Mick the driver was also great at navigating the tight roads, all in all we had a great day and highly recommend the tour,
Wonderful guide and driver. Whirlwind tour but very glad to have the opportunity to visit all three with limited time. The guide was most helpful and shared interesting information and history.

Great tour with evan evans. Very organized. The guide, Mel, was superb. He is very knowledgeable and entertaining at the same time. I would definitely recommend this tour. Look for Mel, you'll have an awesome day. And thanks to our wonderful driver, Lawry as well.

This tour is everything you expected and more. Our guide Rhys was funny, charismatic and knowledgeable. Everything you could want from your tour guide.
We learned a lot about places we were visiting, he answered our every question (even those that have nothing to do with the tour). We had a good time and we saw Stonehenge, Windsor castle and Bath all in the same day! Be prepared, it's very windy around Stonehenge! Our driver Russell was really friendly and the ride went smoothly. Everything was well organized and on time. Keep up the good work!

Our guide Rhys Thomas was friendly, soft spoken and knowledgeable. He personally took care of each and every guest, even in a big group of about 50 people.
Driver Steve O was also nice.
The trip was very rushed and we could actually spend only about 1.5 hours at each stop which was okay for Stonehenge but not so much for Bath and definitely not enough for Windsor. I was looking forward to the guard changing ceremony at Windsor but you cannot cover that with this trip.
Tons of great information that made the bus rides seem short. A busy day, but totally worth the time and price!

Phil was a great tour guide. Very entertaining and we learned so much from him including beyond the topics of this trip. The venues are great. It was very well organized. I wish we had 30 minutes more at each venue - it felt a bit rushed each time.

This was by far the best tour that we have been on! Andy, our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable about all three destinations especially Windsor Castle having been a bodyguard for the Queen Mother! Laurie, our driver, knew all the ins and outs of getting us to our destinations on time despite traffic. The sites were all so interesting, we could have spent more time but that is not possible on a tour like this. Hopefully some day we can go back!
This is a very interesting trip. Our guide Katie has a charming voice and is very thoughtful. She told us lots of story, made our trip full of fun.

I really enjoyed this trip! There was no way we could have visited all 3 sites on our own. Our guide, James, was amazing at making sure we were running according to schedule (nothing is worse than having the whole bus waiting forever for 2 people who show up late.) James also made us go ahead of the other buses, so we only waited in line once at Windsor Castle (before it opened for the day), and after that we never had to wait in much of a line at all, which was so nice. Vinh was also a great driver. The only downside was we were expecting some time to grab lunch (even a fast lunch) and even with rushing through the Roman Baths, we barely had time to grab pre-made sandwiches before meeting the bus. If we would have known ahead of time that time would be so tight, we would have taken some snacks along with us.

Great tour, superbly guided by James who was both informative and entertaining. Highly recommend the tour. Made even more pleasant by the wonderful driving by Derek. Felt safe and in good hands at all times. Both gentlemen were friendly and receptive to any of our questions.

Hi everybody!
Today (08/16/2019) was me and my mom taking this golden tour trip to Windstor Castle, Bath and Stone Hedge for the first time, we didnt really know what to expect but we got really, really suprised.. We were suprised of how fun and a exceting a bus tour could be!
I have never imagined this should be the single must funniest part of our three day trip in England. We can thank alot of this to our tour guide, Cameron and bus driver, Kiran who made this trip to totally success. They made this trip to a really Golden Tour! 😃

Best Greetings from Alexander and Monika from Sweden.

My family insisted on this tour while I was more apt to stay in London proper. Good thing majority ruled! Our tour guide, Nick, was honestly sensational. He was a cross between a human Wikipedia and a quick-witted comedian. He knowledge was truly incredible. The Mercedes-Benz coach was quite luxurious and roomy, which allowed a nice period of relaxation in-between the stops and our driver, Derek, was outstanding as well. If you want to go back in time and see some of the most classic sights in history, I highly recommend this tour.

I understand this was a whirlwind tour but we needed another hour in Bath at least. We rushed through everything. Make sure you pack a lunch because there is no time to shop at ANY LOCATION. BUS WAS COMFORTABLE. Tour Guide Sacha was EXCELLENT. Great information on the bus. Overall it was good but fast.

My husband & I are from South Carolina & visiting England for the first time. We made the trip to Windsor Castle, Bath & Stonehenge today on an Evan Evans coach tour. The sights were wonderful. We were so impressed with our tour guide, James. He was extremely knowledgeable. He offered so much interesting information in an entertaining manner and with much good humor. Our driver, Kee, smoothly guided the enormous coach through the streets and roads of London & the other locations. We were impressed with his skill & always felt safe. These guys made a great team & we were grateful to have them both on our trip. The coach was very clean & comfortable. We definitely will be back to England & we’ll book trips with Evan Evans. We’ll also ask if there are any trips with Janes & Kee.

This tour was amazing - it's a lot to jam pack into one day, but if you want to do it this is the way to go! Our tour guide Mel and driver Lester were incredible and entertaining, providing just the right amount of information without overwhelming you. The only feedback I would give to Evans Evans Tours would be to give more time in Bath and less at Stonehenge. Bath is so beautiful and we felt a little rushed there whereas everyone seemed to have plenty of time and more at Stonehenge.

Thanks again Mel and Lester - you guys were amazing!
Each site was gorgeous and our guide, Rhys, and driver, Russell, both did a wonderful job! Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting London for only a few days.

Patty and the driver Allan were really nice and professional. However, I was not expecting a bilingual tour (Spanish and English), which turned out to be a little annoying at certain times.

Even though, the tour seems a little rushed for some people, I was really ok with the time provided at each site. I believe this tour is a great deal for someone who wants a glimpse of these historical locations.

If you are short on time in London, this is an excellent tour. You will learn the history of England from the ancients to present day. Windsor Castle is a must see with it’s pomp and circumstance that rivals Buckingham Palace. The city of Bath takes you further back in time and you can capture 2000 years of history in a single photo. Lastly, you will drive through the spectacular Cotswolds on the way to Stonehenge. There you’ll see the mysterious standing stones and surrounding burrows that still leaves experts and amateurs alike wondering about their purpose. A highly recommended trip. Our tour guide Catia and driver Tom were truly amazing. Catia managed to cover centuries of history in a very entertaining and easy to absorb way. On the way back, she worked with every family to provide them additional information relevant for their stay, including trip recommendations in Paris. Overall, great experience!

We were debating whether we should travel by ourselves or take the tour, mainly due to our worries on that touring 3 places in a day could be too rush. We are glad that we decided to go with the tour. The trip was smooth, it allows reasonable amount of time at each stop. Most of all, Phil is the best tour guide I have ever met. He himself is a fun book, he probably can tell you a story on every stone or building you bump into. We have learned so much from him even during the two hours bus ride each way. Highly recommend this tour.

Our tour guide, driver and bus were excellent. This is a good way to visit multiple sites in one day but this is also the downside. We were somewhat rushed at Windsor Castle and extremely rushed at Stonehenge so this visit was very disappointing. We did get to see the Changing of the Guards at Windsor which was an unexpected bonus!

Our family, which included two middle aged adults and three college age young adults had a great time. Besides the three great locations the trip's success depended greatly on the fantastic tour guide, Andy Jackson. This is because not only was Andy very informative and entertaining but also because of the long queues and bus travel. Which brings up the only downside to this type of all in one day tour--the times spent in queues (not the fault of the tour, just due to the nature of the crowds). Andy actually timed arrivals such that our time waiting at venues was shorter if we had arrived at other times. Due to trying to combine all three venues in one day and the queues there is not enough time to fully appreciate all that Windsor Castle and the town of Bath have to offer. There was enough time for all of Stonehenge and the bathes at Bath. One has to prioritize how to spend their time seeing the town of Bath and Windsor Castle. My advice when at Windsor is go directly to the chapel as it is a truly amazing work of art and architecture combined with history. The tour is ideal for those looking for a first visit introduction to these locations and desiring to see all in a limited time. All of our group said they loved it.

Went through via toe and booked this. It takes all day. Windsor castle could be difficult if you have issues walking or standing in que. get there when they open and pack water for the bus trip. You get time to buy lunch at Windsor. Go to one of the self serve places. Stonehenge was very nice easy walking. Bath is very interesting but wished we had time to explore the city

The tour was amazing, we did not wait anywhere longer than 25 minutes which is pretty good. Reece, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. He was asking us all the time if there’s something we would like to know more about which we really appreciated. All of these 3 locations were definitely worth to see. We spent about 90 minutes in each location, it was not enough to see everything but this was a highlight tour so be prepared that you won’t have a lot of time. Still worth going tho. Last but not least, we had an amazing driver Russel who got us everywhere on time and was extremely nice! We had a great time and we will never forget this tour!

We had a great time on this tour. It was fun and interesting. Stonehenge was amazing. Bus is very comfortable and clean. Toby James was our tour guide. He is not boring. He is very knowledgeable and patient with questions. He goes out of his way to take care of his people and is a nice guy. We were very happy with him. I totally recommend this tour.

We went on several guided tours on our recent trip to London and Paris. This particular tour was an all day event with lots of walking and lots to see. Our tour guide, Toby James, was hands down the most knowledgeable and the most fun! Great personality to boot! Highly recommend this tour! I’ll never use another tour guide company again. Thank you, Evan Evans and Toby James for an unforgettable tour!

This tour was good in terms of what you got to see in one day. However there was only approx 1hr20mins at each major location with made very rapid visits.
