Definitely not long enough to absorb the grandeur of Windsor castle, we walked through it quite rapidly. Roman baths were very busy (summertime) and it’s quite a cosy museum so very hard to manoeuvre between lots of people & not long enough to stop, read & understand everything.
Stonehenge was good because it was a lot more open and people could spread out, but again very quick stop & we didn’t have any time to explore the other exhibitions in visitor centre.
Still a good tour, but tiring.

Wife arranged a tour which provided transportation with snacks and a guide. Directions for meeting up with our guide were spot on and he was where he said he would be and at the time specified. Once we were all present he summoned the bus and off we went. On the drive out he provided insightful and humorous information about Stonehenge as well as the areas we were driving through.

There isn’t a lot to do once you get there as basically there is a small visitor center and great gift shop, a small example of how the builders of the henge are thought to live, and then there is THE HENGE. So simple, but oh so inspiring. Just walking around and imagining what possessed people 10,000 years ago to go to the lengths they needed to transport multi-ton stones from miles and arrange like they did for a reason we can only speculate about.

Something I’m glad I took the time to see.

Unless you want to just hangout in the shadow a contemplate life you don’t need to spend a lot of time there, a couple of hours is sufficient. Therefore our tour then continued on to Bath (which could be a whole day trip on its own).

My friend Val and I wanted to visit Stonehenge while in London, and we couldn’t have been more impressed with the Evans Evans tour we booked! Our tour guide Mel, lovingly referred to forever now as “Jazz Hands” made this whirlwind day of a tour an absolute pleasure. His knowledge of history, his professionalism, and his inner knowledge of the industry saved us massive time waiting in cues, and thus gave us a fantastic experience at Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. I highly recommend this tour for anyone wanting to pack a lot of magical sights into one crazy fun day.

Our family of adult children took this tour today and we efficiently visited the three sites: Windsor/Bath/Stonehenge. It truly is a highlights tour-providing just enough time in each location to see what you need to see. Note: this tour is NOT for those that like to linger at sites and observe every painting or listen to every audio guide track. If you move through everything at a medium speed you will have JUST enough time. Our tour guide Rhys was very clear with instructions & expectations, entertaining, & informative. I would recommend this to those that are only staying in London a few days and want to give up the reins of navigation and driving to someone else. My opinion, wouldn’t recommend it for children, though Rhys said he has had many children in the past come through.

We booked a day tour with Evan Evans to Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. Lots of walking but every step was worth it. Our tour guide Mel Adams was the bomb. Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. He is a living library. Make sure you wear comfortable shoes. The schedule is a bit tight, would have liked to spend a little more time at Windsor but overall an excellent tour.
We had an amazing day on this tour. Mel, our tour guide was very knowledgeable and approachable. George, our bus driver was excellent! I’d highly recommend this tour.
Our guide Rhys did a fantastic job. Very informative and kept the trip interesting. Recommend for people just wanting to hit the highlights as there is not enough time to get the details.
Mel, tour guide, made this tour memorable. 3 great tours in one day. Not a lot of time in each site, but probably enough. Given that the tickets were included, the price was very reasonable.
All day trip. Mel the guide was knowledgeable, entertaining, organized, exactly the person you would want to lead you on 12 hour tour.

Great way to spend a day outside of London. Our guide Rhys was very knowledgeable, engaging and truly funny and kept us informed between attractions as to how to best make use of our time when we get there. Could not have asked for a better guide than Rhys.

You’re on your own time during each stop so it’s important to listen to the guide. It was enough time at each attraction to allow us to get a good feel for Bath, Windsor Castle and Stonehenge to know if we’d want to head back to any of those again in the future. We even had enough time at Bath to squeeze in a little shopping and enough at Stonehenge to have a bite.

There is enough time on the very comfortable bus to catch some sleep between attractions and it helped us feel refreshed and not at all drained by the end of the day.

Wonderful memories

Our amazing tour guide, Rhys, was incredibly well informed and gave detailed explanations about everything we saw even before we entered, and continually asked us if we had any questions when we returned to the bus after our explorations. He was very well organized and the time on and off the bus was well balanced. My one wish would’ve been to have spent more time at Stonehenge because with the lines we only got about 5-10 minutes at the stones before we had to leave. Overall great planning! I highly recommend this trip as my sister and I had a great time!

Omar was the perfect guide for our day tour of Stonehenge, Bath, and Windsor. He was very informative, even keeled, and entertaining (with just the right amount of humor sprinkled in between narratives). The limited time we spent on each location actually helped us get more than adequate amounts of in depth information to enable us to appreciate each site. Omar gave wonderful background knowledge before and after each visit and with Lester's steady and capable driving skills,this made for a fascinating and extremely satisfying journey.

Great day trip from London. Angela and Michael were great tour guide and driver. Angela was an encyclopedia of knowledge about the history of England. Kept us entertained the whole trip.

Be prepared for long day. Time at each of the sites was perfect. Enough time to see what you wanted and still spend a little bit of time in the shops or get something to eat. Well worth the money.

Wonderful trip to see a little bit of everything. A great way to sample some sights to get a feel for what you might want to explore more of.
Great recommendations from guide Rhys Thomas about how to prioritize the time at each destination. Smooth driving from driver Jane. 10/10 would recommend!

I enjoyed this trip. Reece our tour guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. The driver was great - safe journey no issues. After visiting seeing Bath and the Roman baths, I would love to go there again for a long weekend. Windsor Castle state rooms were amazing and the town of Windsor was lovely. Stonehenge was good though we could have done with a bit more time here as there were delays getting on a feeder bus to the stones and I didn't get to spend time at the information centre. There was no official tour or guide talking you through it, but we got to listen to electric leaflets on the bus. Overall I really enjoyed the trip!

This was a 12-hour event, so be prepared for a long day, but it was great to cover so much in single day. Our guide was Richard Morrell who was a walking encyclopedia. He was working for Evan Evans Tours which is booked through Viator. He is extremely knowledgeable and with a sense of humor to boot. Bus leaves from Victoria Coach Station which is fairly convenient (not from the trains at Victoria Train Station.)

On a recent trip to the UK, three generations of our family took the full-day tour to Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge. What made the tour so fabulous was our guide Jennifer. She is incredibly knowledgeable about London as well as the three sights we visited. She also is personable and conveys the information in an entertaining way. Jennifer is kind and compassionate, and managed to deftly coordinate the trip for a group that included children, teens, adults and octogenarians — not an easy feat. She also spent time talking to the various participants on the bus, making sure that we knew how to get to our next stop and answering questions. Jennifer is one of the best tour guides I have ever had! We also appreciate our driver Vinnie who safely got us to our destinations.

In terms of the sights, Stonehenge does not require more time than what we had. If you can spend more time in Windsor and Bath, that would be terrific. That said, this 12-hour tour is a great way to see these three very different places in one day.

Thank you, Jennifer!

We can't recommend it enough. Our guide, Charlotte, and driver, Tom, were marvellous. Charlotte provided us with such great info about every location, including tips for London itself. It was such a nice experience. Definitely a must do!

Our tour guide Nicholas and the bus driver George were a perfect team! Nicholas is very knowledgeable and told us very interesting stories. It was the perfect tour for a Sunday and it gave us a very good overview of other things around London that one must see. We will definitely take part in another Evan Evans tour next time we are in London.

Overall the tour was great. Windsor Castle is always great and Bath was enjoyable as well. Our guide, Matt, was wonderful and did his best to manage our trip due to crowds and such.

My only complaint was we needed more time at Stonehenge. Eight years ago, we did this same tour and at the time it was very easy to get to the stones. The new process they use to get you to the stones (shuttle to the site) was problematic as we only had a little over an hour to visit the site and spent at least 45 min line for the shuttle, only to have to also wait on the shuttle for our return to the bus. Needless to say our time at the stones, was no more than 5 min to try and squeeze this in as a part of our allotted stop time. Beware if you chose this tour during the summer months.. the crowds were unbelievable!

This tour was very enjoyable, entertaining, and informative thanks to our tour guide Mel Adams and driver Ashton Martin. All 3 destinations were beautiful and full of culture and history. Mel was very knowledgeable and informative of all the facts on this trip, not to mention his upbeat and humorous nature made the day even more exciting. Our driver Ashton was able to bring us to the destinations quickly and safely, thus allowing us to beat the crowds. Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge are all breathtaking locations rich with history. I would highly recommend this tour (especially with Mel) if you would like to explore outside of London and experience what the UK has to offer! Exceptional job Evan Evans Tours!!

If you are looking for a great, easy way to see different sights around England, I highly recommend this tour. It is easy to navigate and you don't have to worry about the fuss of waiting in line and organizing the day (they do it all for you!). My husband and I took this tour with Mel, and he was amazing. He was great about giving detailed history lessons and as well as point out fun facts about the areas we were traveling. The only suggestion I would give about this tour (which Mel has no control over) is to extend the time at Windsor and maybe decrease the amount of time at Stonehenge and Bath by like 10 minutes each. We found ourselves having to rush through the state rooms at the Castle and really didn't get a good chance to get through the church which was a little disappointing. Plus it would have been nice to explore the cute shops by the train station a bit more. Overall, amazing experience and comes highly recommended!

First tour with Evan Evans, tour number was 21 and was not disappointed. Our guide Nigel and bus driver Dennis were fantastic. Nigel was very knowledgeable, friendly, and approachable. He also was very thorough in regards to what to do at our stops, where to meet and what time to be there. Dennis was a safe and cautious driver, sweet and friendly. The ride was so smooth my parents and most of the other passengers fell asleep. Fantastic tour, fantastic service, and a memorable experience. Will definitely return to London and take more tours with Evan Evans!!

There are many companies that offer similar day trips and some of them are slightly cheaper. But based on Evan Evans reviews, I decided to spend a little extra and am glad I did. It is a very professional operation from start to finish with excellent guides. The experience is relatively easy from start to finish - from booking online, to arrival and processing at the Victoria Coach Station, to the visits to each of the three sites. We went on a very busy day (several days after the summer solstice) and the bus was completely packed. Tall people will be uncomfortable in a window seat but such is life. You also need to know that there is no bathroom on the bus and the drives between the sites can be as long as two hours thus you need to plan accordingly. Our tour guide, Tom, did a good job of giving us some interesting history and background of the various sites while on the bus. You should also note that the tour guides aren't allowed to go in with you to the sites so they will brief you on the bus beforehand. You also need to know that you spend more time on the bus than you do at the sites because of the distances between them. You get on average an hour to an hour and a half at each site and there is no time for lunch (you need to grab something to go - cold food and drink only - that you can eat on the bus). This is not a criticism but a reality that you have to embrace or you will not have a good experience. In retrospect, I wish that we had picked a tour that only focused on two sites - probably Windsor and Stonehenge - so that we would have had more time at each. As it was, we got a good feel for each location but left feeling like it would have been nice to have had more time to explore. The Queen happened to be at Windsor while we were there which was neat (but, of course, we didn't see her). Evan Evans makes sure you get to Windsor ahead of most of the tour companies which means some waiting outside but also quick entry once the Castle opens to tours. The visit to the chapel and to the State Apartments, which are lavish, was nice. I would have liked to have more time to wander around Windsor town and to stay to watch the changing of the guards which was starting as we had to leave. Bath is a lovely town and the Roman Baths (definitely pay for your entry in your overall tour fee - there is no reason not too unless you really don't want to visit the Baths) are fascinating. The visit is a bit rushed as the museum exhibits are extensive but we decided to take a few minutes to walk through the nearby Bath Abbey. Stonehenge is impressive (although not quite the stunning moment that I thought it would be) but we didn't have time to visit the museum, just the site, itself. While you spend a long time on the road, the drive though the English countryside is pleasant and gives you a nice feel for what life outside of London is like. On the trip home, Tom helped people consider where to get off (the bus stopped in one other location before Victoria Station) to get back to their hotels most efficiently and helped people to figure out transit on the Tube which was nice. Overall, we had a great experience and I'm glad we did the tour.
Excellent! Our tour guild Sacha was funny, knowledgeable, and energetic! We loved her and the tour was awesome, even in the rain. Definitely would recommend it!!

I took a group of teenagers on a Girl Guide trip on this tour. We had a fantastic tour with our guide Peter (not Rachel :) ) and driver Michael. Peter was full of knowledge and kept us interested in what he had to say. We really enjoyed all the stops on our tour, but felt rushed at Windsor Castle. Not the fault of Evan Evans, just really long queues to get into the cathedral and state apartments. Would have loved to spend a bit more time there. The tour gave a nice taste of what Bath has to offer (it could be a full day tour in itself) and Stonehenge was very cool to experience.
Katie did a stellar job with our 48 person tour. Bubbly, articulate, and a fount of knowledge. While in Bath, we enjoyed a some quiet time in the Parade Gardens.

If your on the fence about booking-do it!!! It was pure loveliness! Peter was our tour guide. A hilarious gentleman that didn’t even scold us when we were a few minutes late to the bus in Bath. He patiently directed us to the bus (we we’re dummies waiting in the wrong spot) as we were the last to board the bus🤦🏽‍♀️He was lovely! Our driver was a sweet man named Michael. Seriously guys this was a delightful day. So much information and beautiful scenery to gaze upon. We learned a ton and want to sing their praises!

As stated, this is for those people with limited time. You only get 1-2hrs at each site so it is quite rushed. A lot of time is spent queuing and then 1-2 hrs drive between destinations. However, the sites are wonderful. I would’ve liked to have spent another hour wandering the towns of Windsor and Bath though. Both very quaint and steeped in history. It was great to see all three destinations in a day, but if you have more time I’d suggest spreading these destinations over 2-3 days.
Katie, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable and I enjoyed her history recounts. Valentine was an excellent and friendly driver. Thanks for a great day.
Katie was a great guide. Knowledgeable and passionate. Thanks Valentine for getting us safe to and from our destinations. Would recommend the tour.

Able to hit all these attractions in one day with efficiency! It’s certainly a long day (8am til about 7:30pm) but Mel made it fly by with his humor and interesting stories.

Mel kept all expectations and kept the group on task. We loved his hustle and was able to get us in front of many groups with his 25 plus years of experience navigating tours around these historical sites.

As he states, this is a taster tour which suited my family. About 1.5 hours at each location which we felt were plenty, though we would have loved another 30 minutes at Windsor Castle.

Mel is more of a historian than a tour guide with a wealth of information with a very objective view on history.

Would use Evans and Evans again.. especially if all their guides are as good as him.

Side note: James the driver was excellent too!

There is a ton of things to see and do in London, but I highly suggest enhancing your trip by taking this Evan Evans Tour to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. It is a full day tour and takes you well outside of the city, but the Guide (Eugene) the Driver (Laurie) and the experience were well worth it. The insights and friendly style that Eugene offered up throughout the day was the icing on the cake of these 3 historic locations. If you are in London, take a day to spend with Eugene and Laurie on this adventure!
Everyone needs to cross this one off their bucket list. Truly amazing and inspiring to behold. Makes you stop and think about how and why this was created, there are no definitive answers to date.

It was a early beginning to our day. The tour left at 7:30, but we had to be there 30 minutes early and we had a 36 minute walk. Our first stop was Windsor Castle. Awesome place and grounds. You could just feel the wealth of this place. What an impressive place. Our next door was the Roman Baths. Can't imagine what it was like back then. The Romans were very creative back then to create a water system that utilize the underground springs. By the time we were done with the Roman Baths it didn't leave us with much time to explore the town of Bath, which looked really interesting. Our last stop was Stonehenge. A very impressive structure and a big story behind the structure. Our tour guide James was unbelievable. So knowledgeable about the tour ,but knowledgeable about London history or history in general. He is an Oxford grad who actually worked for the queen.He was a funny man who was very smart. Love his approach on how he did the tour. Joe , the driver also had a great sense of humor and also knowledgeable. If you are interested in this all day tour ask for James and Joe from Evans and Evans Tour Company.

Mel was out tour guide and he was amazingly helpful and cheerful. Throughout the tour he gave lots of historical information that each landmark felt like a mini history lesson. He’s very personable and overall a wonderful guy. Fabulous!!!!

We took a day long trip to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge in early July of this year. It was a long trip but it was well worth it, particularly because of our tour guide James who did an excellent job. His knowledge was encyclopedic and it was laced with humor and pithy comments. His sidekick Dave was a great driver who managed to drive the bus through some very narrow spots. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wishes to see three important sites all in one day.

if you do NOT have time, this is a good tour, but if you have time to spend in London, definitely just take a tour and visit only 2 of these places!! its too much running to visit 3 places in one day!!
Stonehenge Windsor Castle and Bath are all MUST SEE places.

Great way to see outside of London. Picked up the bus at the Victoria Station which is in the city. Bus was clean, on time. Driver was professional. Tour guide Chris was knowledgeable and efficient. We made 3 stops and he gave info and tips that enhanced the experience.

I had an amazing experience on this tour and could not have picked a better guide or driver myself. Mel was chock full of information, but more importantly full of personality. He kept everyone on the tour engaged and interested. Key got us from location to location safely and efficiently. I highly recommend to anyone looking to see these bits of history.

The tour was a dream. Claudia and Derek were amazing as guide and driver. We had ample time to see all the attractions and even got a peek at the changing of the guards at Windsor. Claudia was more than happy to answer our questions and was super friendly. We did Windsor, Bath and then Stone henge which saved travelling time as well. the tour left at 8am and we got back to London at 7:30pm. Totally worth it!
Great guide, very informed and easy going. Just all around great tour! Very much recommend the company.

We enjoyed this tour so much. The weather was perfect. We arrived on time to each location and the tour was organized very well! A big thank you to our guide, Mel Adams for the insightful, amusing and knowledgeable comentary and for making this a very memorable day trip for us! Highly recommend this tour and our guide.

Our tour was throughEvan Evans and our guide was Mel, He did a great job, good knowledge, explain everything with details, well organize and so far knows very good his job.
I will recomend the tour through Evan Evans and Mel¡,

We toured with Eugene (tour guide) and Valentine (bus driver). Eugene was very knowledgeable and was able to get us into Windsor Castle quickly. Valentine is an exceptional bus driver and the bus was clean and comfortable. We toured Windsor Castle first and stayed through changing of the guard which was delayed by 30 minutes. This put our departure time to Bath back by 30 minutes and reduced our time in Bath. Stonehenge was at the end of the day. This is a long day! Make sure you fill up on water and grab snacks when you can. If possible, I would recommend visiting only two of the sites in a day.

James, our witty and knowledgeable tour guide ran our historical "tasting" tour so we could sit back and relax. James provided all key information so as we could squeeze the most out of our visits. We were first in line and prepared with the best routes. James used our drive and line waiting times in an entertaining and effective manner. Thank you to Joe, the bus driver, as well, for a smooth ride through history. A great tour, packaged perfectly by James and Joe.
Evans and Evans quality is not up to par with other tours. Would not recommend and would not use this service again

Our guide was Rhys and drive Valentine, and they we awesome! Rhys has incredible knowledge and added just the right amount of insight and conversation. His informative style and passion for what he does made the experience extra enjoyable. He was great with establishing expectations, managing our time and keeping a group of 50 or so going without issues. If the tour could be 2 hours longer it would be awesome...a small bit of extra te at each would have allowed us to avoid feeling a bit rushed but that being said, it was an excellent way to experience a lot!

Gave this experience to my dear sister as a gift for her 40th. birthday! could not be happier with the choice. Having the opportunity to visit 3 of the top 10 places to visit outside London when we only had 4 days in our trip, was just one that we could not miss.
According to Rhys, our amazing and knowledgeable tour guide, June 19, 2019 was the busiest tour day in Evans Evans Tour history and they did their best to beat the crowds and be timely. His recommendations in how to go around in our tour in the different locations were spot on! Appreciated all the knowledge and information shared, furthermore the recommendations for the rest of our stay in London, his openness to answer questions and witty English sense of humor made it so much fun! Two thumbs up!

I’d been to the sites, but was using the day trip as a way to show my mom several sites outside of London in one day. Katie was very engaged with each participant and enthusiastic about sharing her knowledge! The whole day she provided lots of historical information and personal knowledge. I learned new things and both of us thoroughly enjoyed the day. Laurie was a great driver as well! The whole tour ran smoothly and it was nice to be provided information between locations and be given time to explore the stops independently.

The tour was great Jennifer our guide and Nedia our Coach driver were brilliant.
Jennifer was great explaining everything about what we saw and visited.
Nedia our Coach driver was also great chatting and having a laugh with us when she wasn’t driving.
Had a great day with take a tour with them any time 😄👍

We did the Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge tour and it was absolutely brilliant. We did our tour on the 3rd of July and our tour guide was Jennifer and driver was Nadia. Jennifer did a wonderful job of guiding us and explaining the areas in a way that was interactive and fun. Nadia had such a welcoming and humorous personality. The day was amazing, we made friend and had so many laughs. We would do it again in a heartbeat.

We had a fantastic day with Toby (guide) and Steve (driver). It was a long day but so wonderful to be able to knock out 3 of the prime things we wanted to see in one day! Toby was energetic, knowledgeable, and funny and worked to keep everyone on board engaged, even my 9 yo. Because you are seeing 3 destinations all in the same day, the time is fairly quick at each without a ton of lingering around, but Toby was great to help us know what to hit first to be able to manage our time appropriately. I wish we had had a little more time at Windsor, but all in all, it was a fabulous day! Toby even took time at the end to make sure everyone knew the best way to get back to their “home” destination and give dinner recommendations. We don’t often do tours that are on a large tour bus, but even with the large size, Toby took the time to make it feel like it was one of the smaller 7-8 person tours! Highly recommend this trip and Toby.

We had an incredible time on our tour with Nigel. Seeing all of these sights within a day on our own would have been impossible, and Nigel had so much knowledge to share for each stop and at nearly every point along the way. We did Windsor Castle first, then Bath, then Stonehenge. Each was really interesting and definitely worth a visit! It's a long day, but it flies by. Bring snacks! Also, phone chargers (USB ports) on the bus were super helpful.

i would first like to praise our tour-guide, Manon, and the driver, Barry. Manon was quite a delight. she kept all the passengers engaged through the trip. was quite helpful, rather intuitive to the needs of the passengers. we were from time to time informed about the facilities and good options to eat at. so these two important things were taken care of. she was quite well- informed about the history of uk so she kept feeding us with that as well. barry was quite a sport. all of manon's jokes were addressed to him and he drove the shiny red bus quite well. a one day tour, however, is a short time to cover these three destinations. we had reached windsor before it opened to tourists. though there were still long queues to enter. we couldnt see all of it. the same happened at the stonehenge. we got time to explore bath as we hadnt bought tickets to the roman baths. otherwise we would have had to rush through all three. but if you are the sort of traveller who is quick and doesnt need to savour the sights, then this is the trip for you

Did this tour on 26 June. Three sites were excellent, but we had very little time to take in the grandeur of each site, especially Windsor Castle and Bath. We had most time at Stonehenge, which did gove enough time to take in he mystique of this place. Andy Jackson was an excellent tour guide, kept us on schedule and had lots to tell between locations. We had a 30 minute wait before entering Windsor and he gave a detailed account of Henry VIII life, which made the time in the queue pass by quickly - 5 stars for Andy!

We visited beautiful and interesting places, but our tour guide, James, and bus driver, Ben, were the best!!! The tour took the whole day. James kept it organized, informative and fun. By booking this tour, we were able to visit attractions without having to do long lines (another joy of this tour). We were the only ones with children and he found ways to keep them involved to enjoy the trip. My son says that James was AWESOME and enjoyed being James' deputy for the day.

A beautiful summer day with some rains spent on this tour. All the sites are great for a visit. Windsor castle and Stonehenge are beautiful. John was our guide- Witty, Funny and with abundant knowledge of the places we visited and all the British history we could know of. His dark humor made our tour more likeable. The coach was comfortable, on time and clean.
A must do for anyone who is short on time and would like to see 3 places in a day.
This was a wonderful day trip and the guide Toby James was excellent!!! The bus driver Kee kept us safe all day and helped with my mother in a wheelchair, very friendly. Highly recommend!

Evans and Evans was a great company, clean and very nice coaches. Well organized and very helpful people working at the station.
Our guide James was incredible! James is extremely knowledgeable, experienced, and took great care to make sure our Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge was perfect. His timing is impeccable, making sure we were first in line at each site. His commentary along the way was delightful and he has great wit. Evans and Evans has a great asset working for them.

The tour was fantastic, great to see 3 amazing landmarks in one day. The coach was very comfortable with plush seats. Our driver Bob and guide Rhys were fantastic. His comedic and interesting commentary on what we would see made the long drives seem shorter and the tour an excellent experience

Out tour guide Reese provided us with a great tour. Although the journey involved a lot of travelling on the coach, he provided us with a lot of useful knowledge on each places we visited. Both me and my uncle thoroughly enjoyed the trip. From visiting Windsor castle in the morning, to Stonehenge in the afternoon. Furthermore the Evan Evans staff were also very useful. As we nearly missed the coach at Bath, we called Evan Evans where Timi helped us by contacting the guide and reconfirming the pick up point.

Me and the Mrs have been wanting to do this tour for quite some time. We finally got round to it and must say I was not disappointed. The tour guide Reece was outstanding providing lots of useful information and entertainment throughout the day. The attractions were incredible the pictures do not do them justice. The booking process was easy I did like the website but preferred a phone call. I spoke with pavlin in the contact center and he provided all the necessary information. All in all a good day would definitely recommend.

Excellent trip overall. There's a lot of motor coach driving, but the locations are amazing (Bath, Windsor, Stonehenge) and the guide made it even better. Katie is a free-lance tour guide that works for Evan Evans. She was FANTASTIC... great insight & knowledge. Very professional. Very personable and helpful. I hope Evan Evans Tours books her as often as she's willing.

This was certainly one of the biggest highlights of our trip to the UK. We had 6 people (2 adults, 2 children, and 2 seniors), and everyone thought it was amazing. The tour of Windsor was great. I HIGHLY recommend booking the early tour, as otherwise the line into Windsor gets incredibly long very fast. Stonehenge was great, and Bath was also pretty good. I wish we had more time at each location, but to fit it all into one day, it was enough to see the things you want to see and get some great photos. The bus was comfortable and our guide (Simon) was kind and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone in the area.

I went on this tour with my husband, sister and nephew and we all loved it. Mel was our tour guide and he was so knowledgable and had a great sense of humor. He had everyone laughing throughout the tours. I wish we could have spent more time in Bath, but it was a great tour to see all three places in one day. The tour was organized and well planned. I would recommend it to all! Great experience

This is the first time my family and I have visited London. This tour was a great way to experience many locations in short time outside London. Rhys (@RhysThomasTours) explained things well so we knew what to expect as well as having amazing knowledge of London and all of England-the perfect tour guide! Lawrie efficiently drove us safely alll over the country. Awesome experience and would use Evan Evans again for other tours after this experience.

We had five of us go on this tour. We loved Windsor Castle and got some great pictures while we were all there When we got to Bath, it certainly wasn't what we expected. My wife and I are still puzzled at why this is an attraction worth seeing, but that's just two peoples opinions. We would not recommend this part of the trip. Stonehenge was very fun to see. We have all heard of it, but to actually see it in person was definitely special for us.

My wife and a few of our friends went on the Evan Evans tour to windsor castle stonehange and bath. Tour guide @RhysThomasTours and driver Lawrie were very pleasant. Rhys in particular was informative and engaging with a sense of humour. He made sure everything ran on time and took care of the group making sure we knew where to get lunch and where to go after the tour.

Overall a great time, highly recommended!

My wife, daughter, mother and I took this tour and had a great time, even though it was raining for part of the tour. They had clear instructions on where we would be picked up and showed up right on time. Our guide, Katie, really made it an excellent experience She spoke clearly and gave us all the background we needed on the bus before we got to each of the sites, so that we could spend our time looking at the highlights rather than trying to understand what we were seeing and having to read every plaque. She gave the history in an interesting way, through stories about key the key figures rather than just dry facts. The driver was excellent, and they were both very accommodating to my 87 year old mother.

Although it was a rainy day, also it' was freezing cold at Stonehenge, this tour is worth to add in your schedule. The tour guide - Omar is very helpful with clear & informative advice for each destination, and the driver - Barry is very friendly as well. I'd suggest to explore the area in Bath instead of going to Roman Baths which was a bit boring.

Simply using the audio machine to touch on the map provided by the tour guide, you could have all the information of Stonehenge, amazing.

The sights were all great and they managed to make everything despite the rain but Rhys Thomas made the tour more incredible. He was very accommodating, he told all the FUN facts, he even goes around every now and then to check if we have questions. Such an incredible tour guide! Made us feel royalty.

@rhysthomastours
Don’t get me wrong, the sights were beautiful, but Katie’s fun facts made the trip. Easily the best bus tour I’ve ever been on.

Andy Jackson was a wonderful guide. He has insider stories from working with the Royal family that are special. Stone Henge is phenomenal and worth the whole day. You cover lots of ground both in the bus and at the sites. The bus had USB outlets and wi-fi to keep your phone going.

We couldn’t be happier with our tour experience. Our guide, Mel, was obviously passionate about what he does and about the history of the places he took us. The tour does not allow for a lot of time at each place but we were able to see everything we wanted in a very well coordinated tour. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone. Fun fun fun! Informative! Friendly Staff! And try to get Mel as your guide, I would give him more stars if I could!

Great excursion out of London and easy way to see all three places in one day. There was plenty of time for a quick visit to each attraction. We didn't feel like we were rushed or missed anything. Had time for tea at Sally Lunn's in Bath which was great! Our driver Chris and tour guide, Anne Marie were awesome!!!!

It’s a lot to cram into one day because of the distances involved, but it’s a great way to be introduced to these venues. Be prepared to have very little time to get food over the course of the day: pack a lunch and bring snacks to consume on the bus to maximize your time at each location. Our guide Peter and driver Vin were great, Peter very knowledgeable with an excellent albeit sometimes corny sense of humor, Vin a marvel at getting that big bus safely through narrow streets and tight coach parking spots.

Our guide, James, was both hilarious and knowledgeable, and our driver, Mark, was great as well! My family and I had a lovely time touring the castle, walking around Bath and seeing Stonehenge on this tour. The whole experience was amazing.

I had the pleasure of traveling abroad. At first my friend and I were a bit skeptical about booking a tour as some of the reviews mentioned being ushered from one place to another without much time to explore. I have to say, our experience was amazing--why? Our tour guide, @tourwithphil was a game changer. Phil Bennett was a fountain of information. He was charming, entertaining, a real gem. He made sure we had enough time to view the sites and accounted for everyone and everything. He took the time to talk with each passenger and find out what was important for them to explore during the tour. He worked in excellence. I can count in one hand the number of people that I have seen work with such excellence. He made this tour the highlight of our trip. I definitely recommend this tour, and if you can get on the bus with @tourwithphil as your guide, it will be a game changer.

My partner and I wanted to see some of the historical sights while visiting London. This tour did not disappoint! Katie, our tour guide, was so warm and friendly! She made the trip feel like we were traveling with an old friend! Katie not only shared lots of information but she was also very funny. I really loved how Katie took time to get to know each of us (50 patrons in total). She asked where we were from, etc. We learned that we share a love for the Spice Girls!!! I have to acknowledge that Katie noticed another tour group push passed our group when getting in line at Windsor Castle and not only did she speak up but she did so in such a professional manner our tour group couldn’t help but clap to show our appreciation! I would definitely recommend going on this tour!!! Our driver Laurie was amazing! He ensured we were on time and drove very safely. Overall this was an amazing trip and definitely recommend it! You will not be disappointed!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed this day trip despite the cold rainy weather. Three major sites with all the travel and lines was difficult to cram in a single day and we felt like we didn’t get enough of Windsor or Bath. Having said that, the tour itself was great mainly because our guide Katie was amazing. She was very knowledgeable, engaging, interesting and considerate. The tour was always on time, the bus was clean and comfortable. Would definitely recommend this tour.
1.5 hrs at each is not enough time but it's a lot to cram in one day. If you are good with a very small glimpse of these sights with no expectations of anything more- this is for you.

My nephew and I vacationed in England for a week, and we packed our itinerary with excursions from London, traveling across the southern English countryside. Two of our tours were with Evan Evans (another 5-star review for that tour forthcoming!). The tour to Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge was stellar. It does pack a lot in for the day, but it's well worth it.

To our delight, when Chris our tour guide introduced himself, he told us he is an archeologist who spent time excavating the Stonehenge site. Yes, please! I love to hear first-hand experiences—and especially for something like this! Listening to Chris talk about all of the sites we visited, and Stonehenge in particular, was extremely informative and interesting. He is passionate about his work at Stonehenge, and it showed. I'm a published author and researcher who is passionate about my own subjects, and I enjoyed seeing that spark in our guide.

These sites are impressive, poignant, and moving. To stand on hallowed ground in places that are older than we are is difficult to fully comprehend, but we can appreciate. Long ago, people lived here. People worshiped here. People died here. The weight of visiting these formidable locations was staggering.

What bothered me about this tour had nothing to do with the locations themselves or our tour guide. Some individuals on our tour complained loudly and showed a lack of respect, and they have rated this tour poorly. Please disregard such reviews. They were more interested in shopping and food than learning about the locations.

Chris was never rude, at least not to us or from what we could see. Any rushing/hurrying from the coach to the entrance was to get us into the queue quickly so we could be ahead of the thousands of other tourists streaming in. These are some of the most popular, historically significant sites in all of England and the world. So waiting is inevitable. But we were at the front of the queue every time. And even though there were a few glitches on this particular day that were out of his control (hey, stuff happens!), Chris handled everything professionally.

When booking this trip, please make sure you understand that this is an overview of these locations. These tours are meant to awaken you to their significance and pique your curiosity to wanting to learn more and perhaps coming back for a more thorough visit. Indulge yourself in the history. Also understand you will walk a lot on this tour. It says so right in the "What to Expect" section that "travelers should be of moderate fitness level."

If you want to spend the day shopping, stay in London and go to Harrods. But if you are looking for a cultural and inspiring experience that transcends the here and now, this tour is for you.

James was clever, extremely knowledgeable and educated us while we were riding in the bus before each stop along the way. Consequently, Windsor, Stonehenge and Oxford University (not Bath) were even more interesting because of James' very detailed and fun commentary. Also, between each trip James took the time to go through the whole bus asking each of us if we had a question for him. There great participation in this and we all learned from each other as James answered the questions! I think what impressed me the most was how James was able to connect and inspire the children and teenagers on the tour. He made history come alive and I could feel the excitement of this kids. The future depends on more teachers and tour guides like James. I loved the tour with James and recommend him highly along with EvanEvans Tours. Great comfortable ride and the driver was exceptional too - I wish I could remember his name.
Thank you so much.
Pam G.

We had Andy Jackson as our guide. He was fantastic with tons of information and very knowledgeable. If someone is planning this trip they should take Evan Evan Tours. Everything was convenient for us from getting to the bust terminus in Victoria and the whole bus ride.

Our tour guide Rowan was overall the best tour guide we had in Europe. Her colorful commentary and spot on historical information was exactly what I was hoping to have on this trip. The time frame was a bit rushed but we did try to see three things in one day that usually you could spend a half a day visiting just one. If we had more time we would have gone back to Bath for sure. We were right in to many of our tours with only a short wait in the que. Rowan made the time go by quickly with great information. I highly recommend this tour or skip Stonehenge and just do Bath and Windsor if you love to shop and eat.

My Aunt and I took this tour as part of our vacation with hopes of experiencing 3 of the country's most prized locations outside of London- we were not disappointed. It is important to note that these attractions are some of the most popular tourist destinations in the country, so while crowds were understandably high during our visit, our tour guide Chris- along with Evan Evans in general, gets each tour to as close to the front of the lines as possible.

Do not pay attention to the bad reviews saying that there is not enough time at each location, or that the tour guides rush from the coach to the queues: this is only in attempt to beat the thousands (yes, thousands) of other visitors not on tours to the front of the line. While there is not hours-upon-hours to embark on a shopping spree or sit-down lunch at a pub at each location, those wishing this were the case are missing the point. This tour is about experiencing the essence of each historic location, with ample time to tour the landmark attractions (i.e the Roman baths, Stonehenge).

Chris was a wonderful and informative tour guide. He provided personal comments from his own research at each location (Stonehenge in particular- he has worked onsite as an archaeologist!) and I am so glad we stuck with him to hear his commentary instead of blowing through each location.

Overall it was a wonderful day, clouded only by the unsatisfied complaints of rude customers missing the point of this package deal day trip of England's finest locations. I highly recommend the tour, tour company, and tour guide Chris. You won't be disappointed!
I highly recommend this tour with Evan Evens. Our guide Mel was highly informative and funny. You will not be disappointed!

First tour while in London and had a great time. Rhys Thomas was our guide and he was extremely informative about our trip and all things British. He recommended a wonderful restaurant in Bath that was the perfect lunch spot.

Windsor castle was magnificent and Stonehenge was great. Free time in Bath was my favourite, with a small band that played in the middle of a park. Lovely architecture and definitely great food!

Felt like I was on a movie set the whole trip!

Kudos to tour guide Simon and our bus captain Kelvin! I now know why we have expressions like "It's raining cats and dogs".

First of all, the tour guide, Chris left us and walked very quickly to Windsor castle. When we caught up to him with my 69 year old grandmother he answer in a rude manner. After, my grandma had a cough attack. He told my grandma that he didn’t want to wait in the long lines and said that in a high tone.
Next, when we got to the places we had only an hour to look around and we couldn’t eat. The lines were long and the wait was taken off of our time at the sites.
Finally, he talked about random things at the site and talked way to much without end. Overall, Chris ran to fast and didn’t let the people sitting in the back to catch up, he didn’t give us enough time to view the sites, and didn’t explain well
-Nir from Miami

Visiting Stonehenge and Bath while we travelled through the UK was something we have wanted to do for a long time. Bath is an amazing place and the Roman architecture just sets the scene for a great visit. We also had the most amazing Cornish Pasty there. Stonehenge maybe for many may just seem like a lot of rocks in a field but our guide James explained about the history and when your looking at something that was there 4000 years ago it puts the visit into perspective. You just ask yourself so many questions about how it was built. Overall the day was great.

Was a great way to see 3 sites and not worry about driving. For me- there was plenty of time at each location to learn about and explore. Our guide Mel- was fabulous. Funny and entertaining. Would have liked a bus with a bathroom as some of the drives were quite far but overall a fantastic day.

We took this tour on 30 th may and loved it ... out tour guide Mel was friendly and informative and very entertaining! Would have liked more time in Bath and perhaps a little less time at Stonehenge... but would highly recommend . Great value for money!

We were basically told to hurry and don't bother trying to see everything or you will be left behind (which is common). Our guide was constantly telling us to hurry and don't bother trying to get a sit-down meal because you don't have time. Gulp your food down or bring it with you but nothing cooked so you don't stink up the bus. I felt like a 4 year old constantly being scolded. Doesn't make for a pleasant trip to "enjoy" the sites.
Wonderful tour by Evan Evans! Commentary and history by tour guide Mel made for an interesting bus trip!! Would definitely recommend!

Had the benefit of having Nigel as our tour guide and Derek as our driver. Amazing tour with loads of witty humour and behind the scenes history. Nigel really goes all out to provide the best experience and we even managed to get ahead on the queue due to his experience on tours. Overall would go again 10/10.

Thank you #evanevanstours for the amazing whole day trip. You made my dream come true to visit those 3 places. Special shout out to andy jackson & goerge for doing an excellent job. Andy i think you are the most intelligent, kind, compassionate, funny & humble tourist guide/historian i've ever met in my opinion. Thank you for all the great history & knowledge you impart on us during the trip. You really did your best to make our journey less boring especially whilst on the road. And to our driver george, thank you for keeping us safe with your excellent driving skills. Keep up the good work & may God bless you all..

Eden-living in Ipswich but originally from the Philippines
This was a great tour, covered a lot in just one day. Omar and Russell (the driver) helped to make this a day to remember, Packed with information and great sights we loved everything about ot.

Evan Evans was a good choice. Had a memorable day seeing parts of history.
Mel made an excellent guide, very informative with humor in between.
Thanks much, Mel!
Took the tour today. Whirl wind tour of all three sites. Experienced guide and great driver. A little rushed but it was a great introduction to the locations.

To be able to see all 3 of these things in one day without a tour would be more time consuming and difficult. The coach was comfortable, the tour guide Chris was fantastic and had so much information on especially Stonehenge as he actually did archeology work there in 2005. Chris was able to get the groups tickets, and since we were in a group we got to queue up early and in separate lines from the general public. I would definitely do a tour with the tour company again, this was well worth the money spent!
I was very impressed with the arrangements made including micro phone and very good and knowledgeable guide Chris and off course very cooperative driver Tom. Would highly recommend this tour agency.

We took the all-day Windsor Castle/Bath/Stonehenge tour out of London on Sunday, 5/12. The tour was great, but our guide, Kevin, was even better. He did a bi-lingual tour of English and Japanese, which was very impressive and informative. He did a great job keeping everyone together and on point throughout the roughly 12-hour experience. Windsor Castle and Stonehenge were everything we had imagined. Bath to us was a throw-in, but was actually a strong highlight of the trip. We plan to return there to spend a few days the next time we are in England. Be careful: at the end of the tour, the exit from the Roman Baths is on a different side of the building. Many buildings in the area look the same, so getting back to the bus on time can be problematic if you get turned around. We made it back on time, but 7 others from the group were late and we almost left without them. The bus driver left, but did a last loop back and we were able to pick everyone up. We highly recommend this tour, especially if you get Kevin as the guide! Jack and Amy Greene/May, 2019

Mel was a great tour guide. He was very knowledgeable and made the tour fun and exciting. It's a long day but it went by so quick. I would definitely use this your company again and go on another of Mel's tours. Thanks for a wonderful time I England.

This was an amazing full day tour and our tour guide Katia (spelling?) was super knowledgeable about everything and had us entertained throughout the long haul. From Stonehenge, Windsor Castle to the Roman Baths, you have plenty of time at each stop to explore and wander on your own and get plenty of pictures! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to check out these locations! :)
I can’t say enough about this perfectly timed day. It’s the perfect one day trip of essential sites outside of London.

James was an amazing tour guide. His royal history knowledge made the trip Fantastic. Great sense of humor and really spent time taking questions from everyone on the bus. Knew so much. I think he is a history and Royal expert. He really loves his job. Well worth the money spent.

This is a long day trip that starts 7:30am and finishes around 12 hours later. Our tour guide Alex and driver Tom were fantastic. Alex sense of humor and knowledge of history and tidbits was incredible and made the journey interesting and enjoyable. Windsor was nice and we spent 1.5 hours there before heading off to Bath. Bath was incredibly historic and worth visiting as a day trip alone. We spent 1.5 hours there as well. Finally we finished with Stonehenge which was amazing and timeless. We were there for 1.5 hours as well. The remaining hours were on the coach. Though the drive was long Alex made it entertaining with humor and knowledge. As a day trip it covers a lot of ground but worth it to see if you’ve never done it before.

James and his sidekick Mark(the tour driver), could not have been any better! James was organized and got the bus going on time so we were ahead of all the other tour buses, which meant less time in the queue. Mark was an awesome driver and the two made the tour fun. James was an encyclopedia of information and took the time to talk to you and answer questions. He also gave you tips on visiting each site since your time at each site is limited. I feel like I got the best tour possible even though it was a lot packed into one day.
We had a wonderful day. It was well organised and ran so smoothly. The guide Manon was very knowledgable and approachable. I couldnt fault the day in any way.

Visited on a lovely day and found a bit of peace and perspective.

Lots of info and interesting history at the visitor centre.

A little overpriced but unique experience.

We had a wonderful tour. Nigel was a great guide - lots of interesting history, but not too much. He explained what we were going to see and how to see it. It was a long day but very well worth it. Even still, I wish we had more time to explore, especially at Windsor Castle. There was a problem with the bus at the end of the day (thank goodness not at the beginning) and it was handled very professionally. Thank you!!
Mel was the best! He was extremely knowledgeable and could answer any question that was asked. Mel was quite a comedian! If you want a smart, fun & entertaining guide, Mel is who you should ask for.

Guide, not so much. Peter didn't warn us that not only is the castle closed during the changing of the guards, but they don't let you leave if the band and troops are leaving. Because they were practicing for the Queen's birthday celebration, dismissal didn't occur until after we were supposed to be back on the bus. He was extremely rude to a 72 year old grandmother who simply asked if it was too late to go to the restroom.

I wanted to comment about the knowledge base that James had when telling us about Windsor Castle, which was majestic! James not only is a scholar and used to work at the castle, but he has a terrific sense of humor to boot! He was engaging and knowledgeable about so many things! We appreciated how he encouraged our group to be on time as well. He did look after us and kept us ahead of the crowds. This tour covers a lot of ground and such a variety of Britains past and present. Such a great day at every venue! Mark was our driver and kept us safe and took us back roads that showed stunning profiles of the countryside. It was easy to locate in the bus station at Victoria. Do not go to the train station. Very well organized and we felt spoiled by James. He made sure every question was answered. Thank you James and Mark for a glorious day! Your Hawaiian gals!

1 day, 300 miles, 3 attractions. You only have about 90 minutes per stop, but this is perfect if you want to make the most of limited time. The coach was clean, our driver was fantastic, but I cannot say enough about our guide, Toby James. He was knowledgable, personable, funny, and did everything he could to maximize our experience at each stop. I cannot say enough good things about this day, and really do recommend this tour. If you are lucky enough to spend the day with Toby, enjoy it to the fullest!

Book this tour. Had a great time seeing the attractions, countryside and experiencing an enjoyable, knowledgeable and witty guide (James). Try to get James...get there a little early to get this advantage. Mark was an excellent driver. Glad I got to enjoy the day and leave the logistics to James and Mark. I was traveling solo and was totally comfortable.

WOW! What a tour!!! Our trip in London was made by this tour, all because of our spectacular tour guide Anthony Matthews... The man, the myth, the legend, really knows his history... He even has a book written titled, "In the Name of the Crown" its $13.99 on amazon! I just bought it and it is going to be my go-to travel book. I suggest if you go on this tour, request Tony Matthews. Yeah, the Rocks, Baths, and Castle were okay-- but this man's intelligence will blow you away. He is also very very respectable and hilarious. Not to mention, a decorated intelligence veteran. I am proud he fought for our freedom. Thanks Anthony!!! Best of luck educating more tours and good luck with Professorship in the States. Stay pip, my friend.

Pros:
>Entertaining and insightful guide.
>All destinations are awesome, but we loved Bath the most--a very cute and historic town.
>Pretty good bang for your money when you factor in the tour guide, transportation, admission, etc.

Cons:
>Long bus ride. It was a 12 hour trip which we didn't mind but might be too much for the less physically capable and those with small children.
>Windsor castle took 2 hours to get into due to long lines. Not much these guys can do about it so no points off. Also for some reason they don't let you take pictures indoors.

Worth the trip just for Bath alone--I think the tour should allocate more time to be spent in-town.

Great day trip, well organised, Coach was very comfortable. Our tour guide Philip was so knowledgeable and our driver did a terrific job on those narrow places. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone interested in English history and also in lovely scenery.

My sister and I visited the UK at the start of this May. Since the UK is driving on the left, we decided to take this tour. A small tip: the earlier you arrived at the bus terminal, the earlier your bus will depart which will save a lot of time for the tour. Our guide Andy is very informative, I remembered clearly about Henry 6 and beheading part; it was interesting and informative. The tour is packed so no lunchtime is given specifically. However, all those sights are amazing and it really worth it!

我和姐姐五月来美国玩。由于左侧行驶，我们决定预定这个bus tour。小提示：越早到巴士站，巴士越早离开，会为后面省去很多排队时间。我们的导游Andy讲解内容丰富有趣，我清楚地记得亨利六世和温莎城堡的故事。这次旅行非常赶，所以没有专门的午餐时间。然而，所有这些景点都是很漂亮的，我觉得很值！

Rhys Thomas was our Tour guide and Kee was our driver! We enjoyed the tour! Wish there was more time to spend in each place. Luckily we were the first to arrive at Windsor and only had to wait until the opened. Had we gotten there on a later tour we could have ended up waiting hours as the line formed behind us and went as far as we could see. Rhys was very informative and entertaining sharing all the pertinent points of interest. Bath was very crowded and when walking in such crowds it seemed to take more time trying to maneuver past all the people (or wait to get photographs) so be patient and you’ll see all you need to see. Stonehenge was awesome! Worth every penny - we even had commentary on things and places along the way! Rhys and Kee worked well to make sure there was no question about when to return to the coach. It would be great to have any tour with him!

We booked through Evans and Evan tour, our guide was Emily and driver Tom! Both were fantastic but Emily was the highlight. She kept us thoroughly entertained the entire time, talked about history and interesting facts. Such a delightful guide. Such a short time in Bath but we were still glad to have a seen it, next time I would skip the Roman Bath Tour and just wander the city more. Stonehenge was breathtaking as was Windsor Castle. I would recommend this tour to anyone

The tour itself was good, the bus was brand new and the driver Tony was safe. Our guide was named Reese, he was funny and knowledgeable and kept us engaged. My only regret was that a function was going on at Windsor and we could not go in. I realize that it is not EvanEvans fault that Windsor had a function, and I have heard that we can get our entrance fee back but it is still disappointing none the less. If we had gone into the castle, I wonder how much time we would have had, I felt rushed through Bath and Stonehenge, maybe they could do 2 of those locations and not 3 and allowing visitors a little more time.

Whilst we wished we were given more time for each destination, the trip was truly amazing! Our tour guide, Emily, is very entertaining. One thing that maybe can improve the trip would be if they can get the tickets in advance for the guests so that we would not have to waste time waiting in line. Those minutes could have been spent already wandering the place. But all in all, this is highly recommended!

Our guide Peter and driver Bob from Evan Evans tour were very friendly and cheerful. Peter is an excellent guide and the whole trip was very pleasant. Stonehenge is a different experience. Windsor castle is beautiful. We were able to see the change of guards. Roman bath was amazing. The whole day trip was tiring but enjoyable. A big thanks to Peter and Bob.

The tour starts from famous Victoria Bus Station. Recommend you get there before 7:30am start boarding time to give you some time to use the restroom and get quick breakfast bite. They had 6 coach buses doing the same tour, so just imagine other tours getting ready. Our driver was Jay and our guide was Allan, who give us none stop facts and history as we drove to our stops. Allan was very knowledgeable with history!!! Both help us save time and quick entrance to the attractions. We enjoyed 3 stops and just wish we had more time. Jay did excellent job in driving us around and was very safe driving too!
The coach bus ride was very comfortable, with wifi and USB charging ports below the seat. Oh NO HOT food or drinks on board. Recommend giving extra time at Windsor to pick up your lunch and eating on board to Bath. If you are taking Tube, its about 10 min walk to the Victoria bus station. Bathroom at station, you have to pay (10 or 50pc).

Mel was our guide and he was excellent. We visited the three places on a busy day in April with long queues everywhere waiting to get into the sightseeing spots. We all waited long but Mel kept entertaining us with his profound knowledge of the history of the places of interest. He’s done a great job and the trip was wonderful.

The day is action packed and long so timing is everything- something that Karen the tour manager/leader (not guide as she actually didn’t do any guiding or share share a lot of info that you wouldn’t find outside of a tabloid mag more just led us to where we needed to be) harped on about- I think she scared people into being back at the bus ahead of time - which although slightly irritating worked out ok in the end.

The 3 locations are all as amazing as the next but it really is just a taster so don’t expect to spend more than an hour and a half at east place and return to London by 7.30pm-7.45pm at the earliest.

A well spent day in the end!

Oh and Victoria coach station where you depart from is difficult to find so allow extra time in the morning to get there!

My husband and I really enjoyed our tour to these three historic sites. Our guide, Oliver, was very knowledgeable and kind. My only complaint is that I wish we had more time at Windsor Castle and Bath. I realize that packing all three sites into one day is difficult, and Oliver did the best he could. We were unfortunately behind schedule due to a few inconsiderate people in our group that were late getting back to the bus and using the toilet at inconvenient times for the group.
In summary, I’d recommend this tour to folks who and content with 1.5-2 hrs at each stop. If you prefer to spend more time at any one, choose another option. My favorite was Windsor Castle and could’ve spent 4 hours there alone.

We had very limited time in the UK so we decided to do this tour to make the most of it. We had such a blast. Our tour guide Kevin was amazing and so was Valentine our driver. I don’t know if I would have enjoyed the trip as much without those two. Kevin even helped us find a place to eat when we were done and his recommendation was delicious.

We thought it was such a great value as we saw Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and the Royal Baths at Bath. Every single stop was breathtaking and full of history and we even have decided to go back to Bath to spend a night soon, we loved it so much.

Do this tour! It was fun, informative, and honestly I’d do it all over again!

Our tour guide, Katia, was fantastic! She shared so much information about all the places we visited, and her instructions were very clear. I’ve read reviews that some people felt they didn’t get enough time at each location, but we felt it was just right. It was a great day trip to see a few highlights we might have otherwise missed on our visit to London.

Our guide, Peter, was amazing. The trip takes the full day, leaving at 8 AM and returning around 7 PM, but the trip was easy, no stress, and fun. The bus won’t let you take food on, but there are places to eat in Windsor and Bath. The bus has free WiFi (that’s pretty good, actually). Thank you Barry the Bus Driver and Peter the Tour Guide! Oh and dress warm!

Premium tours was really great. We went from Windsor castle, Stonehenge, Bath with delicious fish and chips at Locock. Leon our guide was really exceptional and knowledgeable. Highly recommended Leon and the trip.

This was a great tour. We had Rowan as our tour guide. She was amazing! Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. She told us about extra information going through London towards the tours as well as at the locations that we were heading to. I wish that we had more time at Stonehenge but other than that I was able to get explore each location in depth. At the end of the day she made sure we were dropped off at the most convenient locations to get home. It really was an amazing day. Loved this tour!

Family took this tour over our week long London vacation and it was really nice. Honestly, it was all great, but Stonehenge is really amazing and something to behold! Tour guide was knowledgeable and the whole day was put together really well!

This was by far the highlight of our trip to England, because our tour guide James and the driver Graham. James was so knowledgeable, with the best personality ever, the places were beautiful but the guide was the best part of it!

Our first visit to London. My wife and I are so impressed with the tour conducted by Debra and driver Lory. They're humorous, friendly and extremely knowledgeable. Debra shared with the group a lot of interesting British history and traditions. We are truly happy with this tour.
The tour was really funny and awesome to see all the many amazing places! Make sure to be on time for everything tho!!

James and Lorry were awesome! Very knowledgeable and funny to boot. Our destinations were beautiful! James made sure we were absolutely first to our tours to beat the crowds. I definitely recommend touring with him!

We had a wonderful day tour of Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. The tour was fast paced, and great to see so many sights in one day! Our tour guide Godfrey was amazing! And Thomas (our driver) did a fabulous job driving us safely through the busy London roads, and tiny countryside roads. Highly recommend this tour if you like to move at a fast pace!

We usually don't like tours, but we realized we wouldn't be able to see Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath in one day otherwise. This tour was great! Our tour guide was Patricia. She was very knowledgeable and helpful. She gave us lots of background information and pointed out all sorts of fun things. At each stop she gave us plenty of information about what to do and see and where to meet the bus afterwards. Each stop was fantastic and having someone else handling the tickets and transportation. I'm really glad we did the tour, and Bath was my favorite out of the three. I can't wait to visit Bath again someday, and have time to really explore. Several reviewers suggested bringing food with you - definitely do that! If you really want to see the sites, you don't have time to get food. There is plenty of time to eat on the bus (and nap) between sites. My only complaint is that I would have liked more time at each site. Another trip!

Andy Jackson was our tour guide for an all day excursion to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath. 12 hours sounded like a grind, but Andy's wit, charm and knowledge made the day almost pass too fast. It is hard to keep people's attention for 12 hours, but Andy knew to jump in with information and also when to allow people to rest. Evan Evans did a superior job with booking and arranging travel. The bus was clean and all the staff organized. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

I booked this tour while on a very quick three day trip visiting London. I wanted to maximize the things that I’d be able to see in that time frame, and this trip was perfect. The guide was very informative and helpful, but also gave plenty of opportunities for free time and self direction.

My mom & I just finished this tour & we both thought it was amazing. Our tour guide David was extremely knowledgeable, friendly & funny. He was very informative at each stop and during the drive & was very kind to each & every guest. I was amazed how he could go between English & Spanish all day without even having any notes. You could tell he does this a lot & takes his job seriously. Bravo David. Our driver Michael Angelo was also very good. He got us to each location on time & safely! I will definitely be taking more tours next time I’m in London. Thanks for the wonderful day! I can’t recommend this tour enough.

Seeing all three of these sites in a single day is tight. I could have spent a couple extra hours at Bath and Windsor even an extra 30 minutes at Stonehedge, but if you want to see all three and only have one day - Evan Evans did a super job of keeping the group on time and we may it out at 8am and back by 7:30pm.
Our guide Andrew was excellent...very informed and kept it very interesting....great tour...keep in mind it's an all day tour.....

I loved this tour! Was the highlight of my trip. Our tour guide Kevin and our driver Joe were amazing and got us there and back safely and enjoyable. It was a cold day in London but they still made sure we got the full experience. There is about 2 hours per stop, which can seem a bit rushed but hey you are seeing 3 famous places in 1 day so if you want to spend more time in some place you can always just stay there individually. I thought it was an awesome tour! Will do this exact tour again when I go with my family in March.

Great tour, get it all done at once, there is not a lot of time at any one stop, 1.5 hr ea, but except for the castle you were not really left wanting any more. Food does become a bit difficult, you need to pack cold food on the bus, nothing hot. We were on the bus for a total of 12 hours so u really do not want to streach these three spots out any more. We had an amazing driver, Steve who did a wonderful job keeping my car sick self from ever feeling ill. Thank you guys.

Our guide Oliver was both entertaining and knowledgeable and kept us laughing.
Nadia our driver was a great driver with a wonderful funny disposition. On the way back they dropped people off near where they were staying on the route back!!

We were on a trip to London for a Sweet Sixteen Birthday when we booked this tour. We were informed that Windsor Castle was closed so we had the added treat of going to Hampton Court Palace (King Henry VIII palace) as well as Stonehenge and Bath. It was truly beautiful to explore this beautiful palace and its expansive gardens that was nothing short of spectacular. Our tour guide Dominic was very shocked to find out we were stay at the Goring Hotel and that became the running joke on the tour which we loved. He was insightful and funny and we enjoyed the banter between him and the driver Paul. Stonehenge and Bath was awesome as well. Just a wonderful tour that all inclusive in every way.
Nice tour. Comfortable bus. Knowledgeable friendly guide. Bath was very interesting. Historical and quaint town. Interesting Roman artifacts.Nice local ambiance and nice pubs for lunch.

The tour went through Windsor (unfortunately the castle was closed due to maintance and deep cleaning), Stonehenge and Bath. Instead of entering the castle, we did a walking tour of the Windsor town, which was really nice. Both Stonehenge and Bath activities went like schedule.
David was our tour guide and Mark our driver, both of them really nice people. David made the tour both in English and Spanish, language he perfectly speaks. Mark drove in a very responsible way and I never felt insecure on the road.
This kind of tour is to someone who is looking to see the main highlights of the cities in a short period of time.
I would like to thank David and Mark again and to recommend this tour to anyone who hasn't been yet to this amazing three places!

We took this day trip just last week (January 2nd) & had a fantastic time! I think half the experience is the guide and we were fortunate to get to spend the day with Karen on the microphone.

She was organized & had that kind/take charge personality that had everyone back to the bus on time in order to keep our day moving.

Karen was also very knowledgeable for all three points of interest and shared facts & stories with us throughout.

I highly recommend this tour-we loved every stop & travelled in comfort the entire day. Well worth it & so glad we booked!

Great option if you are pressed for time in the country. We did feel a bit rushed at each place, especially Windsor castle, as there is much to see. If I were to choose again, I would do Windsor castle a different day however, I am glad we were able to experience all the activities. Overall, the tour was well organized and the tour guide was very interesting. Plan for a long day of sightseeing.

Brilliant arrangement, impeccable timings and an incredibly knowledgable guide. Phil's tourist-friendly inputs and historical anecdotes enhanced our experience of the amazing tour. Highly recommended!

We went on the day tour during the busy holiday season with Ryhs and Mark. Despite the fact that the schedule is tight as we have to go to 3 places within about 11-12 hours, we had a lot of fun and learnt so much during the tour. Ryhs our tour guide is fun, knowledgeable and very responsible as well. We highly recommend Evan Evans Tours!

Wow Reese and driver Mark were amazing. Three sites in one day with tons of information and facts. Reese knowledge was very impressive and he really tailored the trip for us on the bus. I would recommend spending more time at both Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath.
Took the tour on the 21st December with our tour guide name Leslie. Approachable and informative. Best way to visit three places within a day. Beautiful scenery.

If you can, get Deborah as your tour guide. She has the best sense of humor - I was laughing the whole time and she had great stories that made listening to the history interesting and not boring. Plus, her warmth demeanor reminds me of Mrs. Weasley a little bit haha. Loved Windsor Castle the most but all the stops were worthwhile! Definitely a must-do tour.

Kevin and Steve (driver) were excellent. Very personable, knowledgeable, and informative. It was a long day but we made the most of our time because of Kevin and Steve. Thanks for providing us a great experience and a safe one - great driving Steve!

Took this tour in late October with my wife and 5-year old daughter. Our guide Mel was funny and very knowledgeable about the history and culture of the places we visited. Also, Mel made sure that the tour was organized and that the schedule was followed, which was important since we didn't have much time to spend at each place. Luckily the queues weren't too bad so we were able to spend 1.5 to 2 hours per site. Definitely not enough time to fully explore each site but still very much worth the money and the time spent on the road. This tour is highly recommended.
