The trip is a good 1 day trip for southern England. Our guide godfrey (spelling might be wrong) kept us entertained and informed. The driver james (I think) gave us a smooth and timely ride. For the duo i give a 5/5. The only down side was the wifi on the bus didnt work. This was only a problem because my cell provider also didnt work the whole day. Bus 4/5

ALEXANDRIA AND WINSTON are great guides.Give them more tours they deserve it
So warm organized accomodating.They made the trip so wonderful🥰

Great day out covering THREE of London’s most beautiful attractions in one day. Our Tour Guide Godfrey and driver James were fantastic throughout and gave us a memorable journey from start to end. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! Covered whatever needs to be covered at Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath 👏💯

We were fortunate enough to find ourselves on this tour on a sunny day in December. The tour itself was very convenient, fitting a bunch of sightseeing gems into a short timeframe, without jeaporadising any of these experiences. James, our driver, was very friendly and easy to get along with, chatting away with the passengers whenever we were waiting around, whilst being very professional and excellent at navigating the busy streets. Gordon, our guide, was one of the most knowledgable tour guides I have had before, providing us with much more than the general stories surrounding each visit. He provided us with tonnes of little tidbits of information about all sorts of random things throughout the day, which was very amusing.

Guide : Godfrey
Driver : James

Beautifully planned tours. Great guides. Very fun. Very exciting.
And the driver is very careful and informative.

Best day tour I have ever experience.

Long day but Alex our tour guide made it a pleasure. She was very well organized, helpful, and very knowledgeable. She had a good sense of humor.
Great trip if you have limited time and want to see 3 beautiful sights.

I dont expect much from these tours anymore. But i was pleasantly surprised. The guide Kevin was very interesting and knowlegeable he made what could have been an uneventful tour a fun interactive experience. The bus was new and the driver a real proffesional. I would recomend.

My wonderful husband and I were fortunate to land Godfrey and Steve for our experience today. The tour in itself was great but a bit lengthy (several hundred miles round trip) but Godfrey was awesome and quite funny. Very knowledgeable of all the areas we traveled not to mention of many spots on the way to each destination. Too bad 5 is the highest rating one can provide as highly recommend the tour and these fine gents and I would give them a score of 100. Steve the driver was a smooth and safe driver and on time - we stayed on schedule. Godfrey provided different options of what to see and excellently navigated us through the historic sights—— this is a must do!

Absolutely recommend this tour. Very professional and use this tour company again in a heart beat.
This tour was fantastic and comfortably included bath Windsor and Stonehenge. Great amount of time at each location! Our guide Jennifer was very attentive and seemed to genuinely care about each one of us and how we found the tour.
I would recommend to bring snacks and water as it is a long day.
Would definitely use this tour company again!

Did the day tour to Stonehenge,
Windsor castle and Bath. Loved it. Stonehenge is a must-visit. Didn’t have much time to go around Windsor castle but just enough for a highlight

The tour of Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath was fantastic. Katie, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and engaging. She kept us entertained throughout the journey. The coach was clean and comfortable. Valentine, our driver, maneuvered the coach amazingly well through narrow London streets. Overall a great way to see these sites when limited on time.

I got an amazing tour guide, Godfrey was so funny and Even if i was the only for one in the tour with a different lenguage, he explained everything to me, it was a funny trío, Dave the driver was so reliable
Thanks a lot

Peter and Barry were great guide and driver. We did not realized that it was 12 hours and we would spend more than half the tour in the bus driving to and from places. When we arrived to the site it felt like a race to get back to the bus from an abbreviated visit to move to next location.

No hot drink we’re allowed on bus which also did not sit well.

The sites are worth the day. No question. Tour is efficient and well organized. Deb the tour guide, was confident and hilarious. I left the earbud in most of the time just to hear her side commentary.

We took a coach tour to all these historic sites and Stonehenge is,I believe.a World heritage site;Windsor Castle and the Royal Borough is always worth seeing and beautiful Georgian Bath with it's Roman bath house and exquisite crescents is as if preserved in aspic.
The countryside surrounding all 3 sites is beautiful to behold.

My daughter and I were in London for a long weekend and I wanted to show her as many uniquely British sites as possible. This tour was a great fit toward that end and our guide (Chris) and driver (Valentine) kept us informed and safe throughout. Our time at each site was limited and eating is pretty much on the go / on the bus, but if your goal is to see as much as possible in a short amount of time, this gets you there. If you have more time, then I would recommend different tours that give you more time at each site, particularly Windsor and Bath.

I had a day by myself when in London, and I booked this tour. Our guide, Claudia, and driver, Mustafa, were very knowledgeable and professional. Claudia made the day interesting and easy to navigate. She knows everything about these sites, as well as other fun facts about London and its culture.
Wonderful tour with Tom the guide and Paul the driver. Knowledgeable and helpful and would definitely book a different tour with them

Alexandra and Ben were good to take care of us. I also think that Alexandra has tried her best to sell us the three sights. So I have no complaints to them. The trip was also worth to go, especially that it might cost similar amount to go to the three sights but without the convenience of a coach.

On the other hand, although there was a guide, she did not really travel with us in the three main sights. We were given audio guide so that we could listen to the description ourselves and the guide was just waiting for us outside. What was worse was that the hardware provided by the tour company for the Stonehenge, supposedly an "interactive" audio guide, did not work at all. So there was no introduction during the visit for Stonehenge.

We spent around 40 minutes waiting for the opening of the Windsor Castle. There were few people when we entered, probably because we went there earlier than others.

Overall I think the trip is good value for money.
Peter was friendly and knowledgeable. The trip was well organized. It would be nearly impossible to see Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath in one day any other way.

This tour is about a 12 hour day all together, but completely worth it, as it would be impossible to see all of these beautiful sights in a day otherwise. Nicolas did an amazing job as our tour guide. He is astoundingly knowledgeable, passionate, and kind. I would highly recommend if you’re only in London for a short time!

Did this tour on a cold, wet British day, and yet it was one of the best tours ever! Rowan was a fantastic guide and made my day so much better! She knew literally everything and was funny, full of anecdotes and had a very bright and sunny personality. The driver Lester did a great job getting us around two bad traffic jams so we still had plenty of times at the venues. Can only highly recommend and will definitely book more tours with Evans. Would love to have Rowan as a guide again cause that promises lots of fun!

We had a very good day with Jennifer and our driver for the day Kee who was very helpful in explaining the history behind every site we visited. Our 5 year old boy felt special all through the tour as she kept checking on him if he was around. We strongly recommend her as a tour guide.

Thanks,
Riya

So my wife and I on our Honeymoon had Mel Adams and he was the perfect guide to have. He knows history which many tour guides do but he interweaves information with alternative views that scholars or historians have about many things that happened back before any of us were alive. He provided so much information that I would not have known from a simple point and talk tour. His personality was funny, amazing and he personally gave everyone on the bus tips on other tours to do and take advantage of. He never seemed pushy and he made the trip fly by with so much good info and exciting banter.
We had a great time with Chris and Valentine on the this tour a few weeks back. Chris is really knowledgable, I mean he's an archeologist!

This was well worth the time and money. The bus was very comfortable and Dave, the driver, was a terrific at getting us to all places safe and sound. Jennifer, our tour guide was fun and full of helpful information. She even helped us plan our time in Brussels (since she was from there). Take the trip - you won't regret it. BTW, dress warm for Stonehenge as it is on a hill with nothing around it to stop the wind.

I didn’t expect much, but the minute Richard started talking on the bus, I knew immediately that I was on the bus with a tour guide who was going to teach us something that would be meaningful and interesting. His lessons of England and the points that we visited were extremely meaningful and interesting. I highly recommend the tour, and if you can, ask to be on Richards tour. Your friend from Pennsylvania! God bless.

This excursion (September 9, 2019) was very well organized. The coach was comfortable. My wife and I enjoyed Stonehenge the most --- it was an overcast and dreary day, just as the day should be during a visit to Stonehenge. Bath was very worthwhile. We enjoyed the visit to the Bath Abbey as much as the visit to the Roman Baths. Windsor is incredible. We could have spent twice as much time there. The whole experience was made better by our guide, Saul, and our driver, Lester.

We loved our trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath! Our guide Mel filled it with historical facts in a way that was easy to understand and entertaining. The sights were all fantastic and very different which gave us a nice range of British history. We were concerned traveling with a child but the stops broke up the trip nicely and the coach was very comfortable. We would highly recommend this tour! George was a fantastic driver!

This tour makes sense if you’re short on time but wanted to visit these sites outside of London.
Our tour guide did the bare minimum (counting people on the bus, giving a few stories on the road, setting time frames for the trip).

For all 3 attractions, we got the audio tours from the sites directly and the tour guide for Evans didn’t join the group on site.

I’d recommend just use this tour as your combined Uber service and expect nothing more.

Wonderful experience on this long trip. Had some delays due to traffic going to Windsor-Stonehenge-Bath but was made much more worry-free with our very entertaining guide Claudia; and the superb driving of Mustafa. Highly recommended tour!
Great trip! The guide gave us lots of information, especially on the monarchy. 12 hour trip was long but it was expected.

Alex and Joe are the best team!
Alex really new the ley of the land - make sure you follow all the instructions she gives you, she is not “a guy in the diner” about what it takes to get to the attractions early, before all the other groups pile in and how to enjoy the areas with the amount of time you are allotted for your visit.
Joe is a really great driver, he really knew how to move the bus as to not create car sickness and was a total delight!
A few tips:
Be early for Checkin in the morning and you will have a chance to sleep on the bus on the way to Windsor Castle (first stop)
2.5 hours or so of travel back to London from the Roman Baths, so that will give you time to nap as well -
Pack lightly and bring your USB charger as there are plugs in each row.
Only cold foods are allowed on the bus - do not try to sneak it on! Finish your coffees and get on to avoid stalling the group.
Give yourself enough time to walk to the bus, allow about 15 min walk back to bus at all locations, no less time than that.
If you did not purchase the ticket with the Roman baths passage included, you will have an opportunity to purchase a ticket when the group arrives to Bath.
Enjoy!

First of all, let me introduce our guide - Simon and our driver - Wiston. They both made this tour wonderful. Winston contributed on taking us on a pleasant drive with caution and Simon gave us all information needed to hear and learn on what we were about to discover. The tour was exceptionally well planned and well carried through. Coaches very comfortable and clean. Definitely wear sneakers or comfortable shoes if you want to discover every corner on your tour. Time is efficient at every stop. Have a snack or two with you for the whole day as most of the time you will be on the road... Stonehedge was the star of the tour, its energy was majestic but Bath was a surprise for me. Especially the history behind it and of course the fact that Jane Austin visited often and had a house there. Maybe dedicate more time on Jane Austin for literature fans!!! Windsor Castle was medieval and beautiful. All in all, tour was amazing, guide and driver was excellent, congratulations Evan Evans Tours staff and management. Thank you Simon and Winston, hope to see you again.

Take this tour if you are looking for a full day of sight seeing! Jennifer was an amazing tour guide. She was super knowledgeable about all the culture & history surrounding us! She gave great advice on how to tackle Windsor Castle in an hour and half. And yes, you only have about an hour & a half at each spot. So like Jennifer suggested “it’s like a tapas kind of day- Look, admire, move on.” Dave was an awesome driver! I did put timely because this trip runs very on time so be courteous to others on the trip and come back when the tour guide asks!
Be ready for a full 12 hour day! Well worth the money. I paid for entry to each spot and have no regrets. One last thing, I went solo: so if you are on your own don’t fear this trip is great with or without buddy!

This tour was awesome. You can see three of the most iconic places of the UK within a single day and learn much of the history, while enjoying a comfortable ride. Our tour guide, Kevin, was informed, well spoken, and hilarious (seriously, he could be a stand-up comedian). The bus was very clean and modern (usb ports and free WiFi) and our driver Paul was also very kind.

Alex (our guide) was so friendly and knowledgeable about all the places we went on the trip and did everything she could to make sure everyone was having a great day. Was a fantastic day and really showed you some amazing places.
Fantastic tour and the guide was very good. I went alone but felt comfortable. No bathrooms on the bus, fyi.

Our guide Jennifer was brilliant! She managed the day very well and also gave great insight about the places we visited and general info about London. She has. Great sense of humour as well!
Our driver Dave was also great and took to places right on time.

As you need to cover 3 destinations, I would say it was very planned and we got decent time to see all the 3 places. Very happy with Evan Evans tour and would definitely recommend to people.
A great historical overview. We were a little disappointed that we weren't allowed to take pictures in Windsor Castle but a great memory none the less.

This was a great tour, but it definitely made for a long day. Our tour guide was Robert who we also had the day before for the changing of the guard tour and did a nice job on this tour as well. The worst part about this tour was the time on the bus, but that couldn't be helped. We started out at Queen Victoria bus station at 8 am. We left from there and visited Windsor castle, which is very interesting. They have their own changing of the guard and we got to see that. It was very cool. From there we went to Stonehenge, which was something to see, but really there's not really much to see. It's one of those things that you can say, I've been there, but that's about it. The best part of going to Stonehenge is the drive through the English countryside, which is beautiful. Our last stop was the city of Bath and the ancient ruins of the Roman baths. The city of Bath is beautiful, in my opinion, but unfortunately like most of this trip, you don't get to spend much time at anyone of these places. That is one compliant I would have about the tour is that it would be nicer if we could spend more time at each site, but that would be difficult to do considering the distance between sites. The trip was 12 hours and most of that time was spent on the road in the bus. Still I recommend this tour. It's worth it.

What a wonderful way to catch the highlights of these wonderfully rich areas. Though the forecast was poor, the rain held off and we were able to do everything we hoped to accomplish. Shiela (our guide) and Mustaffa (our driver) were warm, welcoming and enjoyable. The warm coach was wonderful to get in to after being chilled during our hikes. We opted to shop in Bath instead of seeing the Roman Baths, and were glad as there is so many wonderful boutiques in the area. Would recommend this tour!

Really the best way to get to all three places. Of course your very tired after. Only downside is you don’t get a ton of time at each site because you are on a schedule. Of course if you have the time you can always go back to the sites on your own a different day if you want to try and figure out transportation. Worth doing would recommend it.

Mel Adams our guide was one of the best guides we've ever had, information and humour flowed out all day. He was so friendly and very helpful. He even tried so hard to entertaining those passengers that couldn't speak english.We were first to arrive at each of the venues and when we had to wait he entertained us with British history. he should be a teacher. Our coach was clean and comfortable and driven with expertise by Mark. All three venues were great, my favourite was Bath. i cannot recommend enough Fantastic. Thank you Mel and Mark

Today, I checked off my bucket list item with a visit to Stonehenge. Our tour guide Nigel is excellent. His commentery on Stonehenge and Windsor Castle was very interesting and informative. And the bus driver Micky kept us all amazingly comfortable all along. Loved everything about the tour and how well it was managed. Highly recommend them.

The trip was arranged very well. We arrived at Windsor Castle even before it opens so were able to go in directly. Everything else flowed along well on the trip. We did have a problem though because we got lost on the way back to the bus in bath and missed the bus to Stonehenge. However the company was very helpful and arrange for another bus to pick us up We did not miss any part of the trip and we’re thankful that the company was so helpful.
This tour was fantastic. Our tour guide was knowledgeable, engaging and quite entertaining. There was never ‘dead space’. He filled in the parts when we were just driving with interesting dialog.

I don't normally write reviews as this is only my second review except when I encounter exceptional service. This is one of those instances where I received exceptional service. My wife and I booked this tour for November 9th through Evan Evans. Due to our own careless mistake, we booked the tour without entrance to the Roman Baths. We did not realize this until it was too late to change the tour. Our tour guide Deborah was very understanding and while she did not have the authority to upgrade us, she did tell us that instead of going off on our own at the Bath drop off point, to follow her and the rest of the group that bought the tour with the Roman Baths entrance. She took us right to the individual Roman Baths entrance where we paid and saw the magnificent centerpiece of the Roman Baths the Great Bath. We saw costumed characters which really brought it to life. As we were about to leave Bath, there were 2 tourists from our bus that were missing. Deborah was extremely concerned and went out to look for them. She found them eventually thank God. In Deborah's 25+ years as a tour guide, she has an amazing and unheard of track record of only one missing tourist. To this day, she still wonders what happened to that missing tourist. Deborah really cares about the people she guides and she went from person to person toward the end of the bus ride to make sure everyone knew how to get back to where they were staying. We were staying at the Holiday Inn in Kensington Forum and she let us off at Gloucester Road and Cromwell Road which was only a block away so we wouldn't have to take the underground from Victoria. She gave front seats on the bus to a tourist who walked with a cane. She gave a bathroom break to another tourist at Gloucester Road and Cromwell Road who desperately needed it. To top it all off, she has amazing knowledge of everything we saw. She even knew that the Queen, Prince Charles, Prince William and Princess Kate were going to be at the Clarence House on Remembrance Day and told us where to be. We got to see some of them and it was a thrill! Enough time was given at each of the attractions (Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Roman Baths) and multimedia guides were included. Valentine is a great driver, careful and smooth. Very important for people prone to motion sickness. I highly recommend this tour and hopefully you will end up with Deborah and Valentine!

Our tour guide, Kevin, was absolutely fantastic! Hilarious, knowledgeable, and super friendly. We enjoyed the tours and his hustle to get us in and out in the time allotted. It was perfect and thankfully we got good weather too

We booked with Premium Tours to Stonehenge. Took 2 and half hrs to reach there- if you don’t mind the long journey to see a pile of rocks, it’s fine. Personally we felt we could put our time to better use with other activities. It was pouring heavily & windy on our trip, so we quickly took a few photos & spent the rest of our time at the cafe for shelter.
On the positive side, our driver Michael was informative & entertaining with a great sense of humour. His Italian wife calls him ‘Michaela’ & he has 2 kids.

We did the day trip to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath. The coach buses were clean and comfortable and our driver Valentine squeezed in those tiny streets with such ease. Our guide Katie was extremely knowledgeable, friendly and funny. She told us enough information without overwhelming us. The city of Bath was my absolute favorite and I would go back in a heartbeat.

I did this tour with Eugene and George and had a great time! Eugene's impressive knowledge about each these destinations really set the tone for what we were about to experience. He kept us entertained while driving to each destination and even while waiting in line-ups. Eugene and George did a great job of keeping our group on schedule as well. Unfortunately the time spent in Bath felt quite short but that's just the nature of a quick one-day road trip. All three destinations were fantastic and I particularily look forward to another opportunity to explore more of Bath!

This tour was well worth the time and money! We only had a short few days in London and hoped to get as much sight seeing in as possible. This tour was a great way to visit some of England’s great sites. Our tour guide Deborah was incredible! She was extremely knowledgeable about all of the sites and provided lots of information on and off the bus. Her upbeat attitude, funny stories, knowledge, and overall kindness truly made the experience for us. She also helped to accommodate all of our needs, including going person by person and ensuring we all knew how to get back to our hotels and an impromptu bathroom break for me. The bus was clean and comfortable and our driver Valentine provided a smooth trip. I would highly recommend this tour rain or shine.

Would have really liked to have gone on this trip. We arrived 4 minutes late and the bus was gone. While this was disappointing I do really appreciate the timeliness. They did allow us to go on another excursion that did not include Windsor. Just from going to Stonehenge and Bath, including Windsor may have been a little rushed to get to all 3.

Very interesting, but quite a long drive from London. Definitely wear waterproof boots in the fall & winter, it's very soggy on the pathway. If you're short on time, there are more interesting sites IMO around & outside of London.

We did the full day tour of Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. Peter is a wealth of knowledge and very informative. Paul’s driving was very safe and the bus is very clean and includes conveniences such as WiFi and USB ports. Highly recommend Evan Evans and requesting this duo.

Great trip! Eugene was our guide and was very knowledgeable about the history of the places we visited. Keep us entertained on the bus with the stories of the places we were going. Dexter was driver and did a great job.

I visited this site in the early 70s & was blown away by the spectacle of it. In those days, you could actually walk over the stones which was incredible & a great memory. Of course now, you can only view it from a fenced off are which is understandable as the stones were graffitied. Nevertheless, it’s an aware inspiring site. If you just want to see it, you get a good view from the car park but entry to the visitor centre is expensive & off putting for us so can’t comment on that.
Phil and Paul were wonderful! Very knowledgeable and highly entertaining. I would absolutely recommend this trip, along with the guide and driver!

Our guide Manon was amazing!!!! So much knowledge of history and the place we went! Bath was very interesting, the roman ruins were fantastic. Windsor is stunning, what a beautiful castle.We could have spent more time, as there is so much to see and do. Stonehenge

Definitely recommend doing this tour! Robert, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and made this a fun day. The coach bus was very comfortable and clean. During each stop we were given some time to wander off and do our own discovering. Each place was beautiful! Oh and thank you to Ben, our driver, for driving is around London al day!

We took the day tour and this was the best part of our vacation so far! Katie was our tour guide and was so friendly, engaging, and knowledgeable. She told history in such an enthusiastic way that made it very understandable and interesting for all adults and our 2 kids (ages 9 and 10). This is a great tour and especially so because of Katie. We highly recommend this tour and her!

Tour guide Jennifer and driver Abbey did a fantastic job. They are both friendly and professional. Jennifer made sure everyone was taking care of, she also took the time to explain what to expect and filled in the dead time with facts, history etc.. She knows her stuff.
A good way to hit the major land marks outside of London without having to rent a car.
Trying to find the meeting point may be a little confusing. Go to gate 0 at the coach station, across of it you will find the door for Evans Evans your. They will get you checked in there.

It was a long day with a lot to see but worth every penny because of the tour guide. Request Alex to be your tour guide. She was simply amazing. Her knowledge was unbelievable and gave you the extra stories that you can’t get from your history books. Top notch and excellent at her job.
If I could give a higher rating I would.

I recently took the Premium Tours day excursion visiting Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, lunch in Lacock and a visit to the city of Bath.
Enjoyed every minute of my 12+ hr day.
Our tour guide Gavin, was absolutely brilliant. He was knowledgeable yet tremendously entertaining aided by his fabulous sense of humour.
All in all a super day.
Many thanks Gavin with a G!

Peter, our guide, was knowlegable, informative and entertaining. Andreas, our driver, provided excellent and safe transportation. A great way to see three well known sites when on a limited time frame in London.

Had a great time on this tour! With the price of the tour including travel and admission fees I found it already quite a good price, however our tour guide is what at the end of the day made the tour so enjoyable and well worth the money. My tour guide was Leila and our driver Michael. The day ran so smoothly and we remained on time. However the highlight of the day was definitely Leila’s commentary about each of the sites we visited and many places in between. The range and depth of knowledge she provided throughout the day as well as being provided with audio devices on the tour, left me feeling as though I really got the most out of the tour. This is a must do tour if you have time while visiting London!

This tour was a really great, yet packed, way to see three iconic sites. Everything went smoothly and Peter was a great guide - really enjoyed his (British) wry wit/humour. It covers a great distance so the time at each of the sites is tight. Highly recommended.

It was a well organized trip to Stonehenge, Windsor and Bath. Peter, our tour guide, was knowledgeable and also entertaining.
Our driver Jane was wonderful too. All in all, it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend this trip, especially if you're in UK on a short vacation and want to cover major tourist locations.

A wonderful experience with a great guide and punctual transportation. Too short time was given to explore each place. May be only two places should have been planned, but again going separately for one place may not be worth if u r spending only few days in London. Overall it is a great trip. Thanks to the team.
Godfrey was our tour guide and was fantastic in his commentary. Kept us on schedule and it was a great day. Our bus driver Kevin A was a good part of the team. Nice ride..nice tour A

Evan Evans are a very polished and professional company. Our tour guide, Nicholas was both knowledgeable and enthusiastic and our coach driver, James was an excellent driver; both men were friendly and approachable. Perhaps less time at Stonehenge and more time at Bath would be better suited.

I loved Bath and Stonehenge! Wish I could have stayed overnight at Bath as it's a really beautiful city. Stonehenge can be reached by a 45 min walk from the visitor center but we took a shuttle to it so we could save time during this day trip.

Note that you cannot take the iconic pictures of Windsor castle on this trip that are shown in the tour ads. Those pictures I think can be taken from the great walk garden which we didn't have time to see during this day trip.

Overall I think this was worth the money we spent.

Had a great day trip to Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. This is a long day left at 8 am back at 7:30 PM. Lots of walking which was welcome due to long travels in coach bus. They have done a nice job planning the route. WiFi did cut out about an hour into the way home. Don’t grab a coffee before boarding the bus as they don’t allow hot items on the bus. Everything ran on time but be prepared to wait at each stop in line as there are many other tour groups at each location. Bath is a great surprise and would be a fun weekend getaway.
Had a great time with Peter. He was fantastic. Would highly suggest doing this: This was a girlfriend trip Will be back with my husband for sure. Maybe even stay in Bath

Was a wonderful day out except the weather and I know it is out of our hand .. also the time in each city I felt wasn't enough to explore them I felt like I was in a hurry. But the lady tour and the driver were nice and lovely people .. thank you for the lovely day ..

Claudia and Valentine were great. The weather was horrible, I would suggest one way to make it better is for Evans to buy plastic rain panchos, they are cheap and the tour company can definitely afford them when needed. Otherwise great tour.

What an amazing tour with an amazing guide, Godfrey and driver Kevin A! The knowledge and experience from our guide was phenomenal and our ride to and from destinations was splendid. I couldn't recommend them enough!
Just finished a terrific day with Godfrey and Kevin A. They were both informative and entertaining. Wholeheartedly recommend this tour and this group in particular.
My father and I took this day trip with Godfrey and Kevin A. They were extremely organized and efficient. We got to see everything we wanted and had a fantastic time!
Excellent day with Evans Evans Tour Guide Jennifer & Driver Mo. Great way to see all three vital locations. Thoroughly recommended.

Our tour guide, John was wonderful. He was witty and knowledgeable. My friend and I enjoyed the the sites. The only thing that was disappointing, we were only at Stonehenge for about 45 minutes. We didn’t even have time to shop in the gift shop. I would definitely recommend this excursion.

This tour was an excellent way to see parts of London that are further away from the city! Oliver the tour guide was excellent!!!! He was entertaining, knowledgeable and was the perfect guide! Each location was a wonder to see with so much much history and would be a plus for any vacation for you and your family! Everyone was wonderful!!!

It’s the perfect tour of you have 1 day to know these places. You have about an hour and half to visit each place , plus the time of travel between each one. The tour guide gave us all the information we needed,

If you have the time , visit Windsor and Bath separately.

This was an extremely interesting and enjoyable day trip, and definitely worth the money! It was really incredible to see Stonehenge in person; even cooler than you might imagine. And the Roman Bath was such a unique and engaging trip back into the past, which is something that my family and I really enjoy. Nicholas (our guide) and Michael (our driver) were fantastic. I would recommend this for anybody who is interested in the authentic ancient history of the island of Great Britain.

We grabbed the green bus from Salisbury to see Stonehenge only. We were very short on time and barely squeezed it in before the last bus left at 4:00(?) The included audio tour while going there and back was very interesting. Stonehenge itself is pretty cool. The stones are bigger in real life. You follow a path that circles it which is great b/c it looks very different at certain angles. It one point you get very close and at another you're pretty far away.

The sites speak for themselves, and I can't add to what has already been written. As for the tour guides, Richard and driver Steve C were flawless: extremely knowledgable and well-spoken. Richard has inspired me to learn more about my own homeland. Impeccable and precise. They were true gentlemen, and maintained the proper balance between leisure and punctuality. This tour has been the best part of my 6 days in Europe thus far. I highly recommend this operator.

My husband and I took this tour just a few days ago. Our tour guide was Jennifer & we had a great experience with her. She provided lots of info, was very courteous and had a great sense of humor. She also did an amazing job wrangling our large group & keeping everyone on schedule. They locations we visited were beautiful. We never waited in line for long & had more than enough time to take everything in. We had an amazing experience overall.

Richard was aawesome! What a wonderful day. My 16 year old son even enjoyed himself
Will definitely use them for other trips!

A wonderful trip. Tour was organised by Evan Evans and the bus was really comfortable. The tour guide was very informative and a bit strict for timings but I think she had to be with the number of people in our group. The box boxes given were useful to keep hearing her when out of the bus and for audio guides at Stonehenge. All three places were breathtaking each offering something different. Windsor was beautiful, opulent and gives a beautiful historical perspective. The state apartments and the chapel are worth seeing. Stonehenge is amazing and I really wanted to immerse myself there and explore the mystery. Bath is beautiful. Just roaming around the town and marvel king at the picturesque postcard type sorroundings is good enough and in addition you can go to the Roman baths. Of the three this was just a primer for Windsor and Stonehenge as the tour itself does not give you that much time but it has definitely whetted my apetite for doing these two again separately. Within the time constraints of the tour it was excellent and worth it

My wife and I are visiting the London area for the first time from the US. We’re here for about 5 days and wanted to see some historic sites outside of the City but not travel extensively around the UK.

This tour was the perfect answer. Stonehenge is an amazing wonder, Windsor Castle was quite beautiful and the Roman Baths were a marvel. Best of all, our tour guide Nicholas was a wealth of knowledge with a great personality and sense of humor. Definitely worth the time and money.

I went to London for a work trip and only had 1 day to go sight seeing. Since my office is just a stone's throw away from the usual tourist spots, i.e. Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Tower Bridge, etc, I figured I'd visit those places after my work hours and opted to go on this guided tour on my free day instead. It is definitely one for the books! We covered a lot in a day and there was no dull moment! Our guide Godfrey, was great! He was very accommodating and shared everything he knew about the places we visited adding a bit of humor here and there. Tip for solo travelers: Bring a selfie stick as it very handy! Thank you so much for putting together this great tour! Will do it again next time with my husband when we go on holiday!

We took the Stonehenge, Windsor, and Bath tour out of London. The bus was very comfortable. It picked us up at Victoria Coach station and we had a wonderful day across all three sites. Getting into all three tours was quick and easy. Our tour guide Nicholas was wonderful and very knowledgeable. He shared so much information on our trip at the sites and in between. He even gave us suggestions for things to do during the rest of our trip in London. Would definitely recommend this to anyone.

We had the best time today touring Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. Simon and Jo were fantastic. Simon knew just what to do to get us ahead of the queues. He kept the tour right on track and had my husband and I laughing all day long with his dry sense of humor. Jo did a great job driving the coach and we felt safe the entire day. Windsor Castle was beautiful and Simon did an incredible job telling us about its history. We also enjoyed his interesting tidbits about how certain sayings originated from the region. Stonehenge was amazing and we had plenty of time there for pictures and exploring. Bath was a breathtaking town and we enjoyed touring the Roman baths. We had plenty of time after the baths to tour the town, grab a pint, and enjoy fish and chips in a local pub. We would highly recommend this tour!

We truly enjoyed this tour and would recommend for anyone. What an amazing day! Our coach was comfortable and the driver did a fantastic job. Aside from the incredible sites the day was truly made by our guide Phil, who shared so many cool insights and pointed out interesting landmarks along the way. His passion and knowledge made the bus rides between the locations fun and enjoyable. This day trip is worth the time and expense. This was the highlight of our trip to England.

Tom (guide) and Kee (driver) were great! Super knowledgeable about the sites and British history, kept us on schedule, and very professional. This tour was one of the highlights of my trip. I enjoyed that this tour takes care of all the logistics and allowed me to see these amazing sights all in one day.

It was on October, 9th that I was on this 12-hours-trip and it was really worth every second. The trip was very well-planned as there was enough time at all three attractions and at the end of it there was even enough time to offer an additional stop in London, so that guests who stayed at remote areas could go there easily and save time. The highlight was our guide named Catia, who did an amazing job. She gave a lot of valuable Information in an entertaining way, not only about the attractions of this trip, but on English and European History in general, so I learned a lot on this trip. She also created a very warm and happy atmosphere throughout the entire journey. That's why I call it a lovely day and can absolutely recommend this trip to others, who are interested in learning about History and enjoying a lovely day at stunning places.

The weather was horrible but the trip was a delight albeit an all day affair. Enough time given at all the sites. They speak for themselves. John our tour guide was excellent, engaging and kept us on schedule. I recommend to those who have the full day to spend.
It’s obviously a cool thing to see but now that I have I don’t need to do it again. I wouldn’t spend a ton of time as you see it take pics and that’s enough .....
Guide Richard did a great job of telling us about all 3 stops plus more along the way. And kept us on task and schedule.
Spent the day with Nicholas ....funny, quirky but very very knowledgeable....outstanding day.....Bath is beautiful.

We chose to go on this tour with Evans and Evans after doing an extensive research of the different tour Companies (and there are many). Our decision was the right one as this was hands down the highlight of our trip to the UK so far. The sites we visited were wonderful, and our guide,Godfrey, was sublime in entertaining us during the whole trip.

The trip is a must. NO REGRETS

Highly recommend this tour with Evans and Evans. Bus was comfortable and nice. The best was visiting Stonehenge. Unique and must see! Our driver and Nicolas, tour guide, were both professional, pleasant, and informative.
Very knowledgeable tour guide. Nicholas provided plenty of interesting background information. Well organized and comfortable.
Fantastic way to get 3 awesome attractions. We were lucky to have a incredibly knowledgeable guide. Richard has a wealth of stories and details about the sites and all the bits in between

Educational tour of London’ top sites: Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and The Roman Bath. Tour Director, Richard Morrell provides an exceptional experience. He is fluent in both English and French, knowledgeable and passionate about sharing his experiences

Our host Richard was amazing, informative, and funny! Seeing these beautiful historical sites was unforgettable, and so was he. Many thanks for an absolutely wonderful day trip through Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath.
Tom and Kee made this a very memorable trip for us. The sightseeing was worth our time and we would recommend this trip to family and friends.
Enjoyed the tour Godfrey was knowledgeable and organized. Kept the tour on time this tour was busy got through it on time.

We had Jennifer as our tour guide and she was lovely, knowledgeable and very professional. This was a great tour to get out of the hustle and bustle of London for the day. There was a good amount of time at each location too. 10/10 would recommend!

My sister and I had this tour on 9/25/19. It was a very well organized tour with knowledgeable and sweet tour guide Jennifer and fun driver Aston
It was one of the best tour I have joined, very organized, good time management and wonderful tour. I also had great experience with my tour booking and the staff were every helpful and professional. I highly recommend Evan evans tours!

My husband and I had a blast on this whirlwind trip. Our guide Crissy was amazing. She was so sweet and knowledgeable. And our driver Steven was marvelous as well! It was definitely a quick visit to each spot- once you get through the lines and security we probably had an hour to one and a half hours in each spot. I figured this would be the case because these are all very popular tourist destinations England and they are an hour to two hours apart from each other. I believe this was a great introductory visit to these spots for my husband and it definitely showed up what we would do in the future. The coach bus was easy to find and was right by the tube station. And it was super comfy, too!

I would definitely recommend this tour to everyone- but only if you accept that they are quick visits!

We had Chris for a tour guide and Aston for a driver. They were both beyond amazing. Chris had so many punny jokes as well as useful information. Even on the drives from place to place, he made sure to point out fun, interesting and historical facts along the way. Even on the highway! Chris gave us an adequate amount of quite time as well. It was a perfect balance. Aston was a fantastic driver. He got us safely from place to place. His energy was even higher than some of us ON the tour itself. They both always had smiles and were answering any and all question asked. Even in the terrible weather at Stonehenge, Chris guided us to the stones and gave us insider information from the time he actually worked there as an archeologist. It was a treat! We would HIGHLY recommend this tour. Hopefully you’ll have better weather than we did. 😉
Had a great time. Phil is an amazing tour guide. Very knowledgeable would totally do another tour with him.
Thom and Kii were wonderful. Quick and intense tour, but enjoyable. Recommended for short trip to the UK

Our guide Tom was fantastically brilliant!!! He’s incredibly knowledgeable, informative with great tour pacing. I was able to absorb so much while taking in the spirit of each stop. We had the perfect amount of time at each stopp and a smooth drive by Kee while getting back to London in time for dinner. Thank you Tom and Kee, I’ll definitely be back for future tours. Cheers!

This was an amazing trip from start to finish with our amusing guide Nicolas and our super safe driver, Michael! We started off at Windsor Castle, then Bath, and finally the trifecta of all Stonehenge. Stonehenge was on my bucket list of places to visit, and it was 💯 worth it! So much great commentary on the ride to and from each stop. I selected this tour based off the reviews, so I leave my own to vouch for an absolute wonderful time!

This trip was fantastic. The tour guide Phil is hilarious, informative and very knowledgeable. Shout out to the driver Vinh for a safe trip. It’s a great way to experience a taste of all 3 locations. The bus station was well organized. Highly recommend.

Our guide Chris and Aston were great. Chris, being an archeologist was incredibly insightful. Not only did he shed great knowledge at the sights but also along the way. Brilliant. If you book your trip ask for Chris and Aston. Great team.

Did the all day trip with Peter and Astin (I think that was the drivers name) Great experience, very informative, and the host was very knowledgeable. Definitely recommend doing. And I would try to stay in Bath. Seemed like a great place to sightsee.

We had a great time! The guide was awesome, the coach was comfortable and we the day trip was truly worth it. The only critique is that here are no bathrooms on bus so make sure you go before leave and at the stops.

Despite the rain and the cold weather my husband and I had a lovely day visiting Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. Our tour guide Alex is very professional and knowledgeable. Everything was done in a timely manner. Many thanks to our driver Eliza for our safe journey.
Visiting all three places in 12 hrs was a rush but worth every minute! Our guide, Nigel was a disappointment... he was doing it as a job that he was tired of doing.
The trip through Evan Evans was great. I recommend. The guide Richard was amazing. A very well planned tour. the staff were polite.

Our guide Peter and driver Aston were terrific! Very helpful and informative. The tour was great! We wished we could spend more time in Windsor and Bath. Both places had such great character and a lot of local shops to explore. Stonehenge is absolutely as majestic as it seems. Highly recommended!

You must do it at least once to discover some famous places of England.
Godfrey keeps the tour interesting with good facts and anecdotes.

punctual and fun

super knowledgeable

very informative

got us to the FRONT of the line

stories were great

Had a great time with Godfrey. Very entertaining and informative guide. The trip was very well organized, instructions were clear, and the time at each location was sufficient to be able to fit in each in one day. Definitely recommend this tour.
We went on the trip this month and had a fantastic day. The tour guide Omar and driver vinh was very helpful and professional, would recommend.
Our guide Armin was very knowledgeable about everything. I do wish we didn’t spend so much time trying to get into the events, so we could have more time. The bus was pleasant as was the driver

Signed up for a full day tour of Windsor castle bath and Stonehenge. Incredible experience! Very well organized. The staff was very professional and knowledgeable. Although the weather was rainy ( as expected in southern london) it did not effect the experience at all. Richard was our tour guide. Wish I could give him more than 5 stars. Excellent! Informative! Knowledgeable! Respectful! And extremely helpful!
I travel often to different parts of the world. This trip was by far one of the most enjoyable! Highly recommend this trip !
Fantastic tour, great service and Amazing guide Claudia. Time keep up and individual attention were the highlights.

We had a great time on this tour. Our guide was Rowan and our driver was Kevin. Both did a great job and were great hosts. Rowan in particular made the tour awesome. She was enthusiastic, provided great info and fun stories, and did a great job of keeping us entertained without going overboard and talking too much. I would highly recommend this tour. We would have liked a little more time at each stop but as it is already a 12 hour tour, it might make it too long and tiring. Hey

We really enjoyed the tour by Evan Evans! Our driver Jill was delightful and our guide Catia was absolutely spectacular! She painted a great picture over time about the history of the British Monarchs and events at each place. We loved it!

Our tour guide Robert, and bus driver Lester were wonderful! Robert was full of interesting information throughout each step in our journey, and it provided great background information for the places we traveled to. It was certainly a full day, and we were tired by the end, but we saw so many great things along the way.
Food is not provided on the trip, so I would recommend allowing time to stop and eat at Windsor and Bath just to make sure you're not starving by the time you end.

Had a lovely day with Nicholas the guide and Derek and driver.
Nick shows much knowledge on all of the sites, and tell stories in an entertaining way. The trip covers a lot of ground and in my opinion (though you can always stay longer in these historic locations) offers enough time in each spot.
highly recommended!

My husband and I went to London for our honeymoon and wanted a tour that was mixed with different kinds of fun and exciting things to see. We absolutely loved the locations. We had a really great tour guide named Peter who knew alot of information aside from the tour destinations. He answered a few questions I had when I saw something that peaked my interest and had no problem cracking jokes periodically. I was relieved that we had someone fun and entertaining for the day trip, rather than someone who rambled on about things that we didnt care for. I would 100% do this tour again. Thanks for the great memories!
Great tour. Angela, our guide, is top notch and Nadia, our driver, a real pro. Amazing places-important pieces of history that I've only seen in pictures-until now!

My friend and I went on this tour while vacationing in London for 5 days. It was the perfect break from the city!
Our guide, Peter, was knowledgeable and very likable. Our driver, Aston, got us where we needed to go and was really fun to talk with.
Each stop was of a good length, even Stonehenge, where we were able to walk around taking pictures from every conceivable angle and still have time to shop after.
Tour guide was great. Pushing 3 major destinations into one day makes things a bit hurried but still very enjoyable. Would definitely recommend any of the Evan & Evans tours.

I was so prepared for this Stonehenge trip! I read historical fiction as well as the actual history associated with the site.
I was a bit disappointed that I could not get closer so that I could actually further appreciate the history but I still felt elated to actually be in the vicinity.
Taking this trip to see for ourselves the magic on this place. Walking this path where long time a go have people the knowledge an the strength to pile up this magnificent monument .

We had a blast on this tour, we lovrd every bit of it - we would love to have more time on each place, but when you have so much to do on so little time this is how its done. The guide was fun and polite, and the buss drive was pleasant
Fantastic tour led by a tremendous guide who opened our eyes to the many interesting sights. Highly recommend the tour and Evans Evans Coach tours.

We toured with Evans Evans Coach Tours in early October 2019. It was a long day, but WELL worth it. Our guide, Peter, and our driver, Aston, were professional, helpful, and cheerful. At each stop Peter gave practical tips; what to expect, where to find toilets and food. There were apt opportunities to purchase lunch/snacks and use the facilities. This was not a good time to browse in shops.
The tour times at each venue were limited, but worked well for us. It would not for those wanting in-depth learning.
Peter and Aston were patient and even went searching for a client who was quite late to the coach/bus. I recommend this tour for those want to see much, yet have little time.

WOW!! What a great tour to these 3 historical locations. Our guide,Toby, made this trip come alive! He was so knowledgeable about the history of these 3 places. His commentary along the “road/ride” provided us with insight and background knowledge to these amazing sights. Toby’s personality was electric!!! He was so enthusiastic and cared about the people on his tour. Thank you Toby for being the best tour guide I’ve had in the past 12 years of traveling abroad.

This was our first trip to the UK and based in central London. Of course, opted not to rent a car. This left us with no realistic means of seeing Stonehenge. This tour was recommended to us by Marriott and definitely lived up to the expectations. We weren't anticipating a lot of time at each place, but just enough to know which ones we at which to spend a day in the future. This by far was the best way to get away from London to see the sights at a reasonable price. We had enough time to see a majority of the features of each site, but there definitely wasn't time to "doddle" so hence the plan of a return trip to Windsor to spend more time. We're exceedingly confident in our choice of this tour.

Our tour No was 21, on September 17th, with Nigel and Barry. I can't say enough about this team. They worked hard to get us into places ahead of crowds, especially Windsor. This meant we had a little more time, and the place wasn't near as crowded as even an hour later. They were clear and concise in the instructions, including departure times and locations. And handled a particularly negative situation by a passenger (seat hopping) with true professionalism. Nigel's commentary throughout the trip was greatly appreciated. Both he and Barry are true assets to Evan and Evans Tours and I would definitely go out of my way to try book specially with them again.

When reading the reviews, I was concerned that this feature packed tour wouldn’t offer sufficient time at each location, but I’m glad we decided to give it a try. I’d say we had just the right amount of time at each stop. Our guide Eugene, and driver Kee, were great. Eugene provided a nice balance of commentary, wit, and humor while Kee ensured a smooth ride both on and off the motorway!! :D Had a great time, and would recommend to others!!!

Really liked it. I now wish I could have spent more time in Bath as there was so much to do. I would recommend seeing everything at the locations but make sure your efficient with your time. You are going to want food at some point and there isn’t much time for it. There were restrooms at each location but it took a while to get to them as we had to wait to get into the locations. Go before you go and don’t drink too much! Our guide Eugene was wonderful and quite easy on the eyes and our driver Kee was real fast!! He made good time to make up for those useless stragglers that made us run late.
We had the pleasure of going on this tour. We were in Eugene and Kee’s group. They were amazing! Informative and friendly.
This was a great trip to see a lot of great spots. We had Kevin as out guide and Frank as our driver. Everyone was pleasant an a lot of information was provided

What a wonderful tour we experienced with Nick. Great informative tour that kept us entertained with his sense of humor. Many thanks for dropping us off close to our hotel and thanks to Lawie for your safe driving.

Rowan was amazing. She gave us exactly what we needed to know. All the important deets at each location and it’s a lot packed in a day - but Rowan made sure we knew the highlights of each location and we felt that we never missed out. This tour is amazing because it lets you explore each location as you like. Rowan even took time to make sure each of us had a good way to get home. She’s the best. Winston our driver was amazing as well.

The places we visited were high on our bucket list. The outing did not disappointed at all. Kevin the tour guy was extremely knowledgeable about the tour so it made the visit even better. We did not purchase the bath portion of the tour but enjoyed the walk around town a lot. All in all it was a very good day!
Really enjoyed tour. The tour guide Kevin was great, funny, and knew a lot. We saw a lot, but could have easily spent another hour or two in Windsor Castle

A great taste of each of the three locations with Richard. He laid out expectations perfectly and the tour went off without a hitch. Fantastic experience with a lot of extra information added by our tour guide along the way!

It has been an excellent trip covering all the 3 places which otherwise would not have been possible if you do it yourself. Our guide Manon Williams is extremely knowledgeable, polite and friendly. She has been there to always assist us and guide us whenever needed. Nikki ,s drive was absolutely smooth which enabled us to enjoy our views on the way. Me and my wife had a wonderful time thanks to the entire team of Evan Evans Tour.
Really enjoyed the tour. Tom was an excellent guide and our driver Lawrie kept us moving. Very informative and fun!
We had a fabulous day on the Windsor, Bath, Stonehenge your. Tom the tour guide was the best! Would do again in a heartbeat!

Four of us are in London for the first time from Las Vegas and this was SUCH A GOOD USE OF A DAY! Evan and Evan takes the stress out of touring three different sites in a day....the bus was comfortable and warm, they even had USB chargers on the bus so we were able to use them between sites. Oliver was our hilarious tour guide who was informative and fun but also gave us some quiet too! We loved Oliver and his driver Aston — thank you for an amazing day! I highly recommend this for other first timers!

The bus leave places on time and spent quite a big chunk of tour duration in Windsor castle. Tom is our tour guide and he is very diligent in carrying out his duty. Just a tip, make sure you check the weather to bring umbrella or wind breaker along.
Tom was a, fantastic host! Really funny, energetic and Informative!! It was a fun time all around!!!

This was my second time in England, and my husband’s first time. The trip to Windsor Castle, Baths and Stonehenge was a good introduction to our trip.

First, we were staying in Southwark, and with the help of Google Maps we found our meeting location (Victoria Coach Station) very easily. Method of transportation: the tube and walking.

The check-in process was quick and easy. There were stores in the building to purchase drinks or snacks prior to boarding the bus. You are allowed to take cold drinks or food into the bus (fruit, sandwiches, water, soda, etc). You cannot take hot food or hot drinks due to the smell (pizza, coffee, tea).

There are usb ports on the bus for you to charge phones or devices. The drive to each location was more than 1 hour, so there was time for snacking and napping. Each location we stopped at had a place to use the bathroom and also had food, snacks, and drinks for purchase (cash or credit)

Of course, like many have said before, there isn’t enough time to check out everything Windsor Castle and Baths has to offer. However, it is a good introduction to these locations in the event we ever want to come back. I felt that we were at Stonehenge a good amount of time.

Overall, Dave and Emily were great and provided us with a wonderful experience! Very communicative with clear instructions. I enjoyed our tour!

We had an excellent day with our tour guide Rowan! She definitely knew her stuff when it came to the history of the three sites, plus a ton of other interesting facts about the UK. She had a few jokes as well to keep the tour entertaining as well as informative. I would highly recommend her as a guide, and our driver Winston did a good job of getting us to our destinations safely and on time! I would 100% recommend this tour and this guide/driver duo as a “Must Do”, while in England. Make sure to enjoy your time in Bath, get some locally made ice cream, an ale, or some fudge! I got all three and it was worth every penny.

Though it was a rainy day, I totally enjoyed the whole trip with tour guide Richard and driver Tom!

Richard was not only knowledgeable and professional, he was caring too! Beside telling us the histories and interesting facts of each place, he would also check and make sure everyone in the group is doing ok. As for Tom, he was a smooth driver! They have made the trip worthy! =)

We absolutely loved our day trip to Windsor, Bath & Stonehenge this past Sunday. The itinerary is very well planned, as you have just enough time to see a little bit of everything. At Windsor, St. George’s chapel was closed but we took advantage and enjoyed the state apartments in more detail. We made it back to the bus right on time. We could’ve definitely been there a bit longer but there was some traffic and the walk to/from the bus is lengthy so we understand the length of the stay. Bath was absolutely perfect, the short walk around the streets and the tour within the Roman baths museum was well organized. Stonehenge was absolutely breathtaking, and the audiovisual guides were a really cool way of getting to understand the site before arriving. I’d highly suggest you listen to the guide before arriving at Stonehenge as the wind in that area is very strong and you might not be able to hear much.

Our guide Manon was an absolute delight, so knowledgeable and you could tell she absolutely loves what she does. Our driver James was great and he has great tips and a warm smile to make you feel right at home as well. Highly highly recommend this trip!
It was a lot crammed into one day but they did the best they could. I wish there was more time in Bath.

I cannot say enough about this tour!! Our AMAZING tour guide, Sacha, put it perfectly. It’s a tapas tour. A taste of three super historical, important places in England. My 12 and 13 year old boys had so much fun and didn’t even realize how much they were learning. A perfect day!!! Thank you Sacha and Lester (our driver) for being a part of one of our favorite memories from our UK trip!!!! I highly recommend this tour!!!!

Like the many other reviews that I read prior to purchasing my tickets, you cover a lot of ground in one day and it moves quick but you get to see THREE MAJOR SITES IN ONE DAY without having to do the driving yourself. Our guide Andy Jackson was wonderful and gave a lot of background and history while on the bus. The buses were very comfortable. Highly Recommend.

We traveled in a group of six, two couple and two 16 year old boys. Be prepared to walk fast, find bathrooms quickly and get a bite to eat FAST. You are on the tour to see the three sights not wander the towns, eat or shop. Get in and Get out. Choose wisely.

A fantastic way to tackle three top visited tourist sites. Eugene & George made the tour even more fantastic and were very friendly and accommodating. Would highly recommend this tour to everybody (solo/couples/families).
Good one day trip to see the must visits in Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge. Eugene and George were very friendly and helpful

If you go to London and you have one day free you should take this trip with Evan Evans Tours to see Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. The guide-Richard- was well prepared and give us a lot of information about english history and about the places we visited. The trip was just as we expected.

We spent 1.5 hours at each of the 3 sites, so 1.5 x 3 = 4.5 total stars. :)

Our guide warned us at the beginning that this tour is just an overview of these sites.

So if you're the type who likes to leisurely read every item of information displayed and to listen to everything on the audioguides, you will need a different tour (Perhaps 3-3.5 hours for Windsor Castle and Bath each, and 2 hours for Stonehenge).

No hot food or drink is allowed on the bus.
Catia and our driver Mark took good care of us and provided us a wonderful adventure. Stonehenge is an amazing place that should not be missed.

Our guide Oliver and driver Mo were wonderful. This was an all day adventure (12 hours tour) with our group of 4 getting up at 5:30 AM to arrive at the bus station at 7:30 for our tour at 8:00. On our journey first to Windsor Castle Oliver was very knowledgeable of telling us interesting facts as we drove through London and the countryside to get tour our destinations. I would highly recommend this tour and Oliver was very pleasant and went beyond on giving us history and facts of his country. Mo was an excellent driver and courteous. They made the long touring day very comfortable and enjoyable.

My friends and I went on the trip one of the days we visited London and we had such a good time. Our guide, Simon, was very knowledgeable and funny. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to see the beautiful sights outside the city.
I found this to be the cheapest most convenient way to hit these three major sites. My guide Oliver was awesome!

All stops were extremely interesting, very much worth to visit. Easy to find meeting place at Victoria coach station.
We were very lucky to have excellent guide Andy Jackson who presented a lot of relevant historical and cultural information in excellent style that made it easy to digest and remember. That compensated our disappointment with short amount of time allocated for visiting each of those remarkable places which made our trip a bit stressful (my reason to give 4 from 5)
Again, guide was very helpful to resolve our problems.
We traveled with a Trafalgar group tour. We were very fortunate to have had great weather in September. As this site and museum were very impressive
Our guide was amazing as were the sights visited. We had ample time (although there is never enough) to ship and explore on our own. The audio equipment worked very well.

My husband and I took a tour from Evan Evans to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge with our guide, Jennifer and driver, Astin. The info that we got was all useful and not a long boring list of names and dates like some tours. Jennifer funny and easy to listen to. She went out of her way to educate us on London transportation and other things to do. We'd never had a guide take a personal interest in us like that before and it was so refreshing. Astin was funny and so upbeat and his Jamaican laughter was contagious. I will definitely take another tour from them again.

Catia is an asset to Evans and Evans. Our trip was fantastic and enjoyable as she explained in detail of all the historical places we visited. I was very impressed with her multilingual ability. I will definitely recommend my relatives and friends should they visit London. Last but not least, she took the liberty to ask everyone personally if they had any questions and she also assisted in our drop off location. Oh yeah, we had a fantastic driver, Mark. The whole journey was smooth and safe. Bravo to both Catia and Mark.

From William Fong, Lisa Fong and Harry Fong.....Australia and Switzerland.

We had a great time, it is a full day and you will be speeding a good 6 hours in the bus but all and all was worth it. Our tour guide Jennifer was very patient and good a great job keeping everyone on time and not worded off, she was also very informative and knowledgeable. Our driver Ashton was awesome too and got us there on time even though we were not the first bus that left the station. :)
Very organized and fun day tour by our awesome, knowledgeable and caring tour guide Manon! Thank you for this memorable tour we will surely recommend to friends, colleagues and family.

This trip is a TON of driving, but for us it was definitely worth it. Our driver, George, was so friendly and entertaining. Our guide, Saul, was so incredibly friendly and knowledgeable as well! There’s not nearly enough time at Windsor and Bath (you could honestly spend a whole day at both!), but Saul did a great job keeping everyone moving so that we made it to the lines before other groups to make sure that we had as much time as possible. He gave great commentary and facts the whole day, which I loved! If you’re ok with a fast-paced and full day, I’d definitely recommend this!
Thank you Cartia and Valentine wonderful day! You packed a lot into a day for us. It was a great way to have a taste of each of the tour sites .
We enjoyed the whole trip. It was very well organized. The guide, Angela was great. She gave excellent commentary and kept us well informed.

I'd like to preface my review by explaining that the first part of our journey from Virginia to England was a chaotic mess of planes, trains, and automobiles. We were two days late arriving in Amsterdam and almost a day late arriving to London. It was after 11 PM when we finally arrived at the hotel in London, and our City Wonders Day Trip (an entire day of travel booked well in advance) was scheduled to meet no later than 7:45 the next morning. We were beyond tired, and I started to regret having made the commitment to be on a day tour all day. But thanks to our tour guide David, a genuinely nice driver whose name I have shamefully forgotten, and an extremely comfortable coach, our day tour was AMAZING! Honestly, it was one of the absolute highlights of our entire trip. David was informative and interesting, and the sites were beautiful. The day didn't feel long at all; it actually flew by. It was a wonderful tour. My husband and 11-year-old daughter loved every minute of it as well. If you are headed to England on vacation, I highly recommend taking a City Wonders Tour.

Tips for your trip:

Even in the summer, bring a light sweater or jacket you can curl up with on the coach. The temperature is fine, but it will maximize your comfort during the longer drives.

We did not have cup holders on the coach. We brought a bottle of water but stopped often enough not to really need it.

I wore comfortable shoes as advised, but the walking isn't too taxing. You might need sneakers (aka trainers), but you shouldn't need to buy special hiking shoes or anything. I spent more time walking around a museum one day than I did walking on this tour.

When you book the day trip, be sure to buy any required entry tickets in advance. We did this for Windsor, and it allowed us to avoid the long lines and be some of the first people on the grounds of the castle. The information about tickets is available on the City Wonders website when you book the tour.

Do your best to be on time to start the tour in the morning and for each check point throughout the day. It's simply good manners.

We had a fantastic time and will not hesitate to book another tour with City Wonders on our next trip!

Arrival and loading was a bit chaotic so allow extra time, but once aboard everything went smoothly. I do wish the company provided more details in advance about the itinerary so that we could have prepared better. For example, we had a half hour before Windsor opened, and since we couldn’t have coffee on the bus and left so early, this would have been a good time to grab one while we waited in line. It was just enough time to see the apartments and chapel, with none to spare. Also, we were told to expect to get lunch on our own in Bath but the stop only allowed 1 hour and 20 minutes, which is not enough to tour the ruins, see the town and sit down for a meal. Happily our guides extended our time an extra 20 minutes because we were early. I would recommend bringing some water and a snack, as there are a total of about 6 hours spent on the coach.

The tours themselves were nice but the time at each location was rushed. We didn't get to see all the areas at Windsor Castle. We didn't go on the Roman bath tour in Bath, but I heard people on our tour complaining that the queue was so long they never got in to see them. I got what I wanted out of Stonehenge but if you are into archeology and want to spend some serious time at the stones, this isn't the tour for you.
Little experience but a memorable experience. Tour starts at Windsor which is home to royal family. Then Salisbury which is home to Stonehenge rocks. Finally bath known for its architecture

I recently did a search for places to go in Berkshire, and the No1 was Stonehenge. For those who do not know, Stonehenge is in Wiltshire, some 60-70 miles from Berkshire and a much better reference would be Salisbury.
All that being said, Stonehenge is a magnificent stone age monument and well worth the visit. Forget modern building techniques with machinery and try to imagine how stones of such great size could be manhandled into place. Not only that but with such accuracy that they can predict precisely the equinoxes.
Nowadays it is a massive tourist attraction, and so expect large crowds, but in not so long ago, I took photographs of my children having a picnic on the stones and nobody else in sight !!

Our tour guide Jennifer explained this tour as a “tapas” tour and she was exactly right. She said you see a little bit of everything and then you know if you’d like to spend more time in a particular area when you return to the UK. We did see everything we wanted to and it was a very organized tour. For an all day trip the time did seem to fly by! Our driver Kee kept us safe and punctual.

We thought this tour was great. We left at 8 in the morning and got back around 8pm. Windsor castle and Stonehenge were spectacular. We decided to skip the Roman Baths and just walk around Bath. Unfortunately even then it wasn't enough time but we were able to grab a pint in a pub and then get a nice lunch. It was definitely worth it to have someone else driving so we could all sleep in between stops. Never even had we been on our own there wouldn’t have been enough time at each stop so that is not the tour’s fault. Our tour guide, Peter, was fantastic. Extremely knowledgeable with lots of fun stories to tell. We really had a great day and it has given us many ideas for our next trip to the UK. Thank you!

Eugene, our tour guide, was nice and energetic about his job. I would like to thank the driver (was it Thomas?) for a nice, smooth ride. Whatever you say, I will forever believe that the aliens built the Stonehenge. Remember me?

It's a great trip if you want to see a lot in one day. Just keep in mind you are going long distances and don't have a lot of time at each place. They warn you when you book but it truly is not a lot of time at each place.

We had such a great time with Evans, Evans tour. Our guide Rowan and Mark our driver were very accommodating. Rowan had great fun facts to share about each place and great recommendations. I would use them again.
Guide was hilarious and great at keeping the coach engaged. Learned a lot and glad to visit all the sites in one day.

Wonderful, informative, totally carefree experience. Our guide was amazing...full of historical insights. More than enough time to leisurely see all that was offered on each tour. Would fully recommend this tour for individuals or families.

In the 50's, my mother and her sister lived in England. There father was stationed at the Air Force Base in Burtonwood. Their family traveled to Stonehenge. There were excited about this tour. Their guide, Oliver and their driver, Vinh made the trip extremely enjoyable and very memorable. They really enjoyed the tour to all three locations. They would recommend this tour with both Oliver and Vinh.

This tour is too much to pack into one day because of the travel time. It’s fine if you just want to say you were there, but if you want time to absorb your surroundings, this is not for you.
Peter was an excellent guide. Lots of interesting tidbits that I will actually remember. Very personable and was always in good spirits.
This was the day:
We had to be at our meeting point by 7:30.
After we were in the castle grounds, we had 45 minutes to be back down the hill to the bus. No time to look in shops or have a snack.
In Bath we had about an hour. Could have done without the museum and explored the town more. Back on the bus by 3:00. No poking around in the gift shop. Still hadn’t had lunch.
At Stonehenge, the amount of time we had was reasonable (not as much to see), but we still needed to take the shuttle back to the parking lot. Which meant waiting in line as 3 buses ahead of us were filled before we could get on.
Had we gotten more information on the tour, we would have opted for doing only Bath and Stonehenge in one day and do Windsor separately.

Fantastic way to spend the day. Our tour guide Eugene and driver Valentine were excellent. Wish we had a little longer in each spot but going into the tour we knew it would be short and sweet. Eugene was amazing- we lucked out. He was funny and knowledgeable while making sure everyone was comfortable and taken care of. Would recommend to anyone traveling to London.

A whirlwind tour with our guide Peter and driver Tomas. Peter was excellent, kept us on schedule and was full of wonderful information and a nice dry sense of humour.

Don’t expect to do a leisurely full audio guide at any of the three stops. Enough time to get a visit and then move on. Well worth the money.

What great day we had, visited Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehedge.
Everything was perfectly arranged.
