Our tour guide Richard did a fantastic job.
Driver James aswell .
I highly recommend this daytrip , you see and learn so much .
Thx again 2 Richard .

The tour bus used might not be as new or spacious as their competitors but the knowledgeable guide, Oliver, and the helpful driver, Vinh, more than made up for it. It was a wonderful tour. There are guides who just go through the motions and get their jobs done but you can tell that Oliver is passionate about and loves his job. He goes above and beyond and really engages the group, providing insights and personal anedoctes which make the tour even more interesting. Vinh is a great driver and the both of them make a good team. Thanks so much for the wonderful experience.

This is one day tour that you can see Stonehenge while save the time of travel,seeing other 2 place along the way.Special thanks for Mr.James(tour guide)& Mr.driver for very good service mind and tons of knowledge.
Tour 21/From Thailand

We had a wonderful day visiting Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge. Nice clean bus. Great itinerary. Fabulous guide Rowan and driver Niki. Rowan is enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Her relevant stories kept my teenagers engaged. We covered a lot of ground for one day, but felt like we were able to see all.

I would highly recommend this tour and our guide Rowan.

We had a great day indeed. The traveling was very comfortable. It is obvious; if you have a professional guide you will get more historical knowledge than a normal citizane. But organizer should arrang raincoat and lunch for tourist with a additional payment (if needed).

Nevertheless, we will recommend this package to know the historical UK 🤠

I read reviews and chose Evan Evans tours, got Rhys and could not have been happier. He was an excellent informative guide, by far the best we had in our 17 days of travel. We had a windy rainy blustery day to see Windsor Castle, Stonehenge etc and loved it. Definitely recommend. We used lots of other services during our trip from Amsterdam, up the Rhine to Lucerne then London. Choose this one
Our tour guide was Andy Jackson and he really did a great job. We had an amazing day seeing the sights in Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge. Highly recommended!
Great trip with James and Derek (the driver). They were on time and on point. Got to each destination with plenty of background and plenty of time.

This is a great trip to see three sites in one day. James( from Evan Evans tours) the tour guide and his drive Vim did a great of getting us to the sites, explaining everything and providing a great deal of information as the tour went on. I would highly recommend it.

Mike, Brampton, Ontario Canada.
I felt rushed. James was very knowledgeable and Kee was an excellent driver, but there was hardly any time to eat, or go to the toilet

Truly brilliant historian and dynamic speaker who took the various stops from 'nice' to incredibly interesting. The bus could've used a bit more leg room and bathrooms on board for convenience considering the limited time at each stop. Otherwise all around great experience.
We had a full day tour and could not have asked for better guide and driver. Schedule was perfect for seeing all three sites.

We really enjoyed this trip. It was a short trip to London and this was the perfect way to get to see these 3 places in one day. Truth be told, each of these destinations requires more time than what this tour allows to really “see” them but if you are pressed for time like we were it fit the bill. Our your guide Richard and our driver Dennis were fantastic.

Hats off to Kevin, our EXCELLENT Tour Guide and George, our EXCELLENT driver for the Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge Tours ! We had a lot of ground to cover in 1 day, and Kevin made the journey Incredibly fun, informative and GOT US IN ASAP at each stop ! HIGHLY RECOMMEND this day of tours, you get to see 3 amazing sites.
Bless the air conditioned bus in the July 2019 rare heat wave !!!
Our entire family enjoyed this quick view of 3 iconic locations. Nice balance of structured and unstructured time to explore.

Our tour guide was Saul. He was very insightful and professional. Windsor castle was beautiful and we had plenty of time to explore. In Bath we skipped the tour and enjoyed a very nice lunch and walked around town. Stonehenge was breathtaking. Long day, but great opportunity to visit 3 good sites in one day. Perfect if you have limited time.

It was a Well organized, comfortable, entertaining and informative. Everything was communicated with good communication skill, air conditioned and comfortable bus, skilled driver and wonderful guide. Nigele was perfect. He was very informative and the details was useful plus interesting historical commentary. Andy also gave us quiet time to nap if needed. He clearly enjoys his job and we appreciated his efforts and knowledge. We really appreciate Nigele for his well verse information and jovial character. Denise was equally ver calm and experienced driver.we would highly recommend both of ghem to our family and friends. We had a pleasant and enjoyable trip.We definitely bringing back good memories to Perth,Australia.
Thanks Evans and evans.
Great tour! Highly recommended! We are a family of 3 with a 5th year old and we enjoyed the tour. Nagel and Denis were great! Coach bus with internet and great space. Super clean!

Well organized, comfortable, entertaining and informative. Everything was as advertised with good communication, air conditioned comfortable bus, skilled driver and wonderful guide. Andy Jackson was perfect. He gave us the details we needed, plus interesting historical commentary. Andy also gave us quiet time to nap if needed. He clearly enjoys his job and we appreciated his efforts and attitude. I would offer constructive criticism if I had any, but oddly I don’t. It was a memorable day!

Before even speaking about the trip itself, compliments to our magnificent tour guide Eugene and bus driver Thomas. Eugene was informative, respectful, and most of all, hilarious! Added much flavor to the experience. The trip was good fun, albeit short. That’s to be expected however, considering the amount of distance covered in one day. The destinations were beautiful and the ride was pleasant. Would recommend Evan Evans!

When planning my vacation to London, I also wanted to see some well-known attractions outside of the capital. Stonehenge, Bath, Windsor - all three were on my list and I was really torn over the decision of which one to choose. The Evan Evans's tour which covers all three in one day was a real godsend. Tom, our guide, was very knowledgeable yet not overwhelming so we were also able to just relax in peace while hopping between places. I also came to appreciate his dry English humor and manners.
True, given the tight agenda to visit all three significantly spaced attractions in one day, it is impossible to explore each attraction in great detail, however the tour was organized in a way to make the most of it.
I highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting England, especially to those with short stay and tight schedule.
Eugene had great knowledge and explained it with charisma--insightful and helpful. Kevin, the driver, provided smooth rides that all were lulled to sleep and refreshed for each site.

An excellent organization and a beautiful personal touch by our host Mr. Richard. Highly recommended for everybody. A new bus smoothly driven by captain Paul. Despite the partially rainy day, we had an excellent day. Well done Evan &Evans !

I went with my family and we had a great time. Our tour guide, Nicholas, was fantastic! He was very informative and engaging, which is difficult for an all day trip. We learned so much. Nicholas also made a point to talk to every person on the bus separately to see if they needed any tips for any other planned sights, dinners, etc.

Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath were great sites to see. We were in a bit of a rush due to the time constraints of seeing them all in one day. To do them true justice would require at least half a day at each location if not more, but this worked out for us and our schedule. I strongly recommend going through the Roman Baths quickly so that you can walk through the town for a bit and especially to grab something to eat at the local cafes.

Even though we need to rush through things, we had a great time and I strongly recommend.

This was a wonderful day trip during our vacation to London. Our guide, Frank and driver, Lester were both great. All the locations were well-worth the visit, and though a bit crowded being peak tourism season, were really enjoyable. Frank was very engaging, pleasant and knowledgeable regarding each stop and really helped us to make the most of them. I know some on our tour felt a bit rushed to stick with the day's schedule, but I personally thought the time allocated at the castle, Bath and Stonehenge were adequate. More time would have made a very long day near unpleasant, in my opinion. If you're wondering, the return time to London is approximately 6:30pm. Overall, I definitely recommend this trip. It's a great way to escape the hustle and bustle of London for a bit and check off some things that may be on your bucket list.

Richard Morrell was an amazing guide. He explained ya more that wahagvthe tour was about. He talked about the architecture of London and also for the other cities that we went to. This tour is highly recommended. Easy to follow and you get to see many things.

Good way to get out of London for a day. Quick walk through Windsor Castle, then quick to Bath and then a stroll to the Stonehenge site. Home by 8:30 pm. Tour director was very informative and she got to know each of us individually. She also spoke Japanese. Tom was a very good bus driver. Pick up something before you leave to eat and drink on the bus.

Our tour guide Jennifer was wonderful. Great personality, very organized and fun to travel with. She was knowledgeable about the sights and other things to do while on vacation. She made the entire day very special and one to remember for a long time. Would definitely try to take another one of her tours. The sights were great and very interesting to see.

James was a fantastic guide and super knowledgeable. Vin an amazing driver. So much stuffed in one day, but we don’t have a ton of time in England so it was perfect! Can’t wait til our next trip to go back to these places and explore them deeper over more time.
Great tour. Our guide Eugene was very pleasant and extremely knowledgeable. He and our driver Kevin made this tour our best one yet. Highly recommend.

A truly amazing tour with an awesome tour guide, Eugene! There is travel time between each location but it is filled with beautiful scenery and awesome commentary. Stonehenge and Windsor are sensational! Would recommend to anyone.

Excellent tour. We were with Phil, who was engaging and very knowledgeable. I had already visited these locations, but he made it interesting and I learned new things. Overall, we were very impressed!

It's a long day but it's worth it. So if you want a fun day with a good guide that knows everything about the three sites then take this tour.
Our guide was Nicolas Dave.
Great guy

We had a great day with a wonderful, funny, and extremely knowledgeable tour guide Jennifer E., as well as an awesome bus driver Andres. Our day was filled with information about the places we visited, and Jennifer took the time to personally visit with every member of the tour. She was organized and patient, and Andres was great in helping a tour member in a wheelchair. Overall, a marvelous day!

On our last full day in London with 3 kids, we decided to book the tour to see the Windsor castle, the City of Bath, and the Stonehenge. Three very different experiences in one tour was like hitting 3 birds with one stone! The time allotment for each place is just enough to have a glimpse of what it’s about and to enjoy a cup of ice cream! Our kids are always hungry (LOL!). Thankfully, there were food available for purchase in all 3 places. Bathrooms were clean, too. Evan Evans tour was pretty organized from the starting point at Victoria Coach Station to the destinations. Our tour guide, Oliver, was very knowledgeable and accommodating, but humorous, too! In addition to all the info about each place, he told a lot of side stories that were quite interesting. He also gave good recommendations for food, as well. Overall, it was a great experience. Our kids enjoyed the trip, too, and we didn’t hear any complaints.

Had a great time! Tour was well organized, hits the highlights. Oliver was our tour guide and he was awesome! Very bubbly personality, friendly and very knowledgeable- pointed out a lot of interesting facts along the way, not just at the attractions, he kept us entertained while we waited in line. James was our driver and was equally great. Very nice and got us to our destinations safely and on time. You do not get to spend a very long time at each location, but enough to get the general gist and a quick tour. After all, it’s a long day of travel to and in between each stop. Overall, would highly recommend!
The trip was well organised and I recommand it but I didnt like the way the guide dealt with me while asking him many times I found it an act of discrimination

Trip was great! Our guide, Andy Jackson was EXTREMELY knowledgeable and friendly. I think he is the most qualified person in all of London to provide commentary and historical context. His background is quite simply astonishing. The driver, Andres (not sure if I’m spelling it correctly) was also excellent. Smooth ride with comfortable cabin. I would definitely recommend!

The day trip was great! Easy way to see all the sites. Our trip guide, Andy was great. He was very informative and helpful to any question and recommendations. I would recommend this day trip. I felt it was worth the money. Happy travels!

Richard M gave us the most amazing trip to these three sites. The arrangements to find the coach was well laid out and the time allotted to each location was more than adequate. I highly recommend this tour company and guide!!

James, our tour guide was very knowledgeable about anything you could ever imagine. He has a Doctorate in history and it clearly shows. He is very professional and yet full of humor. If you are looking to book, definitely use Evan Evans tours, and if you're lucky enough, maybe you'll get James as your tour guide! Very memorable day and packed with lots of fun!

Although the tour was a little bit rush, it worths! All three places were really nice and could spend more time if time allowed! Besides, tour guide James is very good, sincere, helpful, funny and you never get bored during the trip. Besides, he did a very good explanation for all places that we visited! Good job and well done, James!
Will sure join Evans Evans Tour in the future!

Evans Evans Very good tour ! Tour guide Kevin and driver Mark , explain history , fun guy and manage good time to see the place . Highly recommend this tour .
The important is when meet at station , need find time to find the coach . Oh one point : staff at welcome area is not so nice this can be improve .

Our guide Andy was terrific - interesting background, informative and engaging style. We covered so much in one day while fully enjoyable!

First class experience thanks to Andy and Andres - our tour team.

Our family, which included two teenagers had a great time on this excursion. We highly recommend Nigel, our tour guide, and Kevin, our bus driver. Nigel is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about all three destinations. He runs a very tight ship so don't be late. When he tells you your return time, make sure you are there before that time. I wish we could have spent 10 minutes more in each place, but the day is so long as it is, that would make it even longer. We did feel a little rushed, that's my only complaint.

Tips: 1) The meeting location is a bit confusing, so give yourself time to find it.
2) Bring your own lunch. We bought sandwiches at our local 'Pret a Manger'.
3) Finally, they do accept tips, so bring some extra pounds.

We used Golden Tours for this guide and all in all it was excellent. Our guide Patrick was amazing. He made the history so fascinating and enjoyable, and he was quite funny! Windsor Castle was very crowded but beautiful, especially the cathedral (the highlight for me). Bath was quaint and charming, but we were there for way too short of a time. Next time I would want to spend the night in Bath. Stonehenge is worth seeing, although once you look at it, you don't need to hang around. Learning about the history and theories around Stonehenge was fascinating, and made the trip worthwhile. I hesitated about 5 stars due to the brevity of our visit in Bath, but Patrick, the tour guide, made this tour a must do on your visit.

The Stonehenge is of course just as awe inspiring as the pictures and feelings it inspires. Why would a Bronze Age civilisation move these stones for an unknown purpose. And the accuracy and precision with Stone Age implements reminds us why we are here.

Windsor castle captures the beauty, rapture and absolute decadence of the British Empire over the ages. Their procedures, protocols and customs. Evokes mixed feelings especially if you are from among the colonised countries which represents all the money that was taxed away to let this family lead this life. Definitely a must visit.

Bath is so typically Roman. But continues to be awe inspiring given the tools available to them.
A beautiful place that makes you feel insignificant, the tour guides are knowledgeable and friendly definitely worth a visit

Great trip to see all three in one day, Phil and James make an great team that you can learn so much about the history of the U.K. I recommend this trip for family. It's not very tiring but at the same time you could visit so many famous attraction. I also suggest to bring a raincoat for the Stonehenge part because it will probably rain and it's quite cold there. Overall it's a relaxing trip for family with childrens.

Jennifer E is an awesome guide and Kevin A a safe and dependable driver—they make an awesome team! This is a fast paced tour but perfect for those that want just the highlights. Jennifer is highly knowledgeable, wonderfully personal, and delightfully British. All in all a great day!

We had one day to travel outside of London on July 23 and this was a fabulous choice - thanks to our phenomenal tour guide Nicholas and our driver. Forgive me for not being able to remember our driver’s name. What I won’t forget is what an exceptional driver he was - as he manoeuvred the bus through narrow streets, busy traffic, and long stretches of highway always with great confidence and a friendly smile. Nicholas is the consummate story teller with a wealth of information who kept us intrigued and laughing all day long. He is witty, clever and engaging. And then of course there’s the reason we chose this tour - to see Windsor Castle, Bath and the stunning Stonehenge in one day. We were not disappointed! The Queen was in residence, Bath was beautiful and Stonehenge on this gorgeous sunny day was inspiring! On the trip home, Nicholas sat with each of the travellers to hear their stories and to make recommendations for where they could visit or restaurants they could try. What an exceptional individual! We’ll never forget his hat and umbrella and charm! From your front right passengers - Julia and Mark

The sights, knowledge, and overall experience provided was absolutely incredible! We had Richard as our tour guide, his wealth of knowledge, passion for the history of these locations, and humor was amazing! I have never felt this welcomed and engaged on a tour, thank you guys for the awesome experience!

Our tour guide, Godfrey, is very knowledgeable and has a great sense of humor. The comfort is not just having comfortable seats but also about having a responsible guide and driver so that you can enjoy the tour with the ease of mind. The tour sets off on time so be always early when meeting back at the bus.
Probably the most informative tour i have done. Well done gentleman I enjoyed myself immensely, and learned more than i can remember!!

We enjoyed the tour and the visit to Windsor Castle and Stonehenge were great! Chris is very knowledgeable about the places we visited, provided good tips to make sure we get to the key locations and he has a good sense of humour. James was professional and he made sure we have a comfortable and safe ride throughout the day!

First trip of this kind for me and absolutely loved it! Went with a couple of my girlfriends and we knew this was going to be a long day. It was a 12-hr day from start to finish. Our tour guide, James, and bus driver, Kee, were so much fun and extremely helpful.

Pros:
- Early schedule. We were the first ones to leave the station and to get in line for Windsor Castle, which made us ahead of all other groups for the day. This was my favorite part! **Tip: Get to the meeting spot at least 30 mins before departure. Seating is first come, first serve. The bus will leave on time!
- Clear timeline. James was clear about what time we should meet at the bus after each attraction. Thankfully nearly our whole group was respectful and made it back on time every time. **Tip: You may not have enough time to see everything but I think the timing was just right for Windsor Castle and Stonehenge. I will def be coming back to Bath.
- So much knowledge. James knew so much! He was a great resource and was happy to answer ANY questions. Honestly, ask him anything. He will know it with specifics!
- Bus route. James and Kee knew which routes would help traffic at a minimum. The ride is pretty smooth.
- WiFi is available.
- AC was great. Seats were comfortable.

Cons:
None. Do it!

Other Tips:
- Wear comfortable clothes. It will be a long day.
- Bring lots of snacks/meal prep & water. You won’t have time to grab an actual meal.
- See if you can get James/Kee on your trip. They are awesome!

We loved the all-day Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge tour. Our guide Robert was fabulous - kept us well entertained with lots of fun history bits whilst we were standing in lines awaiting admittance and throughout the drive.

The sites are each worth of a full day, but this was a great way to get a solid taste of each in short order.

A long day...but, oh, what a day!! All three sites were excellent. Wish we had more time to spend in Bath and Windsor, but that will have to wait fro another trip. This review, however, is mainly being written to compliment our driver, Aston, and tour guide, James. The two of them have a great sense of humour and feed off of each other. James, as a tour guide, is worth every penny you spend on this trip. A historian by training, and having worked alongside the Queen for a year, James has a wealth of information to share about all the sites and some great stories about the Queen and her life. Where James was especially different from other tour guides is that twice in our day he walked the length of the bus to give everyone a chance to ask him specific questions. My wife and I were travelling with another couple, and he stayed with the four of us for 20 minutes in conversation and answering questions. I have never seen another tour guide do this and I have to say that it was fantastic!! If you are able to arrange for James to be your guide, you will not be disappointed.
A great way to see all the sites. Our guide was knowledgeable and there was plenty of time to visit each attraction.

This trip is fast-paced and not for those who don't like to walk or have a hard time with stairs. Make sure to listen to your guide for details on getting back to the bus in time. This trip is designed to get you in and out and with very little time in between for much else. Don't bring aerosol cans to Windsor Castle. I had to throw away a brand new bottle of sunscreen as they are not allowed past bag inspection. You also can't take photos inside the Windsor Castle staterooms so make sure to get all your Windsor pictures outside while you're there. Huge shout out to our driver Ashton for getting us to our destinations quickly and safely. Both he and our guide Kevin were very attentive and personable.

Monica is the most genuine and personable tour guide I have ever had. Felt like she was talking personally with you (unlike some tour guides where you feel they are just repeating information by memory). When there were long lines to get into the Castle, Monica kept us entertained with interesting facts about what we were about to see so that we didn't even need the audio guide because she covered it all before we even went in. She also was so clear not only about where to meet but how to get back, looking backwards as we walked so we would recognize the meeting place because it looks different coming back.
Loved Windsor Castle, and checking Stonehenge off the bucket list and thought Bath was adorable. Wished Stonehenge was a little shorter and Bath and Windsor Castle was longer. Got there at 7:30am and most of the bus was already there!Got back around 7:30p. Great tour and so glad we did it.

3 great sites with plenty to do, just not enough time to do it all. Works enough to get a taste of each location but will need to return! Of course we wish we could have had more time at each location, but we knew what we had signed up for and it was a wonderful day. Our guide Alex was wonderful! She had great energy and kept us informed and organized and entertained. It was a highlight of our trip to London.

The tour was amazing. The only thing I was dissappointed with is that the time in Windsor Castle was too short. Due to the fact that the exit from the castle is closed during the change of the guards, you have to rush through the castle to get back to the bus in time. This problem could be solved if the bus would leave 1/2 hour later.
Other than that, the tour was perfect. Especially our tour guide Eugene was great! The amount of information he provided was fantastic! He was motivated and obviously was enjoying talking about the history of England!

Of course we wish we could have had more time at each location, but we knew what we had signed up for and it was a wonderful day. Our guide Rowan was wonderful! She had great energy and kept us informed and organized and entertained. It was a highlight of our trip to London.

My wife and I spent the day with some friends from the States on an Evans tour to Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge with Eugene (Guide) & George (Driver). All and all it was an excellent day on the tour. They provided the essentials of a good tour, both educational and entertainment, plus some good recommendations in Bath for food and drink. Money well spent.

We took the 8am tour on July 29th 2019. This is the best way to see 3 of the UK’s iconic sights. Our tour guide Nigel was excellent. We got more than expected with entertaining and educational commentary along the way. This tour was very well organized Our driver Kevin was outstanding. The ride was comfortable and safe. Nigel and Kevin kept us on time. There was just enough time at each place. I especially appreciated the extra drop off stops on the way back. We were able to walk back to our hotel instead of having to take the underground from Victoria. Thank you all.

This was the first time we visited these 3 places and ALL 3 were well worth it!excellent tour guide (Omar? Of African decent wears a cool hat) And Lester (driver) both very generous with their knowledge and patience. Windsor is beautiful, the city of Bath is small but well worth doing, please while there don't miss the abbey and go walk the shopping area and enjoy a quick lunch (very inexpensive) everywhere. Unfortunately your time is limited (maybe an extra 30 minutes?) And so use your time wisely in Bath.
Stone Henge is amazing and intriguing! Thank you Evan n Evans tour operators. Happy customers!
Leo and Patti

Our guide James prides himself on staying ahead of the throngs of other tour coaches on the same route. We were the first to enter Windsor only because we left Victoria coach station exactly at 8am. He also stressed the importance of being back on the bus on time. If you've been on tours were people have been even 5 minutes late you know how frustrating and rude this can be.

I've been on many Evans tours in the past and the guides have all be excellent. James is a cut above the rest. His knowledge, and sense of humor made the hours on the coach fly by.

My recommendation is to get to the coach station no later than 730 and you might be lucky enough to be on James coach as it seems his is the first to leave the station.
Covered all that was promised comfortably and confidently. Tour guides were great. Would recommend and do again.

Guide and bus driver were mindful of special needs for my father who has mobility restrictions. They made it so others were not inconvenienced also. Celia was great as a tour guide and gave great advice along the way! Bus was very comfortable, no problems with A/c. All sights were amazing. Time in Windsor castle was sufficient but limited. This was in part due to long lines at the castle. All in all, we were very happy with our day out!

The tour was a great chance to see three iconic places in one day, so is ideal if you are short on time. It is a long day but I was prepared for that, and knew from reading other reviews to make sure I brought lunch and water with me although there was a bit of time at each place to grab some food.
The Evan Evans staff were really helpful when I wasn't able to access my tour confirmation details due to an issue with my phone and made sure that I was in the right place for the tour. Guide Nigel and driver Barry were fantastic and made sure we got to each place promptly, and it was great being the first coach at Windsor Castle. I opted not to enter the Roman Baths and instead walked around Bath to see some sites that I really wanted to visit and had plenty of time to make my way around. Stonehenge was great and we had perfect weather for the visit.
All in all a really good tour that I would recommend.

My family and I went on this tour today and it was simply amazing! Our tour guide Andrew Jackson was so knowledgeable and helpful. I would recommend this tour to anyone (and just hope you get Andrew as your guide).

Another tick off my bucket list, was an awesome experience being at Stonehenge, guides were brilliant, all the staff very friendly, and there was so much to learn than just being a load of old bricks, we’ll worth the time to visit
Nigel and Kevin were wonderful! Both were informative, congenial and keen to our enjoyment! We would highly recommend this tour to anyone interested!

We went for a tour (booked under Viator and somehow is operated by Evan Evans tours) to these three amazing places and thoroughly enjoyed it. Tom (our guide) was very knowledgeable and funny, and was able to somehow manage a big group of Spanish/English speaking people smoothly. I just wish days were longer and could visit with more time Bath-
Nice day tour Karen was nice and we enjoyed Stonehenge up close. Bath is a great place to soak up the sunshine and visit quaint shoppes.

We did the tour with Chris as the guide and Valentine as our driver. It was very informative and enjoyable. Chris was very knowledgeable and funny and he directed us to the best places on the tour to try local foods like the Cornish Pasties in Bath. The Vox boxes were very useful in allowing the whole tour to hear what Chris was saying. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone spending time in the UK as these are such iconic landmarks.

Was visiting London for the first time and only had a few days there, so we decided to do the Windsor/Bath/Stonehenge tour and we LOVED it. Yes it is a lot of time on a bus and yes it is a long day, but man oh man are the sites worth it!
We loved visiting all three sites and our guide Katia (my apologies if I misspelled her name) was AMAZING! She was knowledgeable, funny, and I felt confident with her leading our group. She did everything in her power to give us the most time at each stop, but some things she just couldn't control (long lines, guests returning to the bus late, etc). We had some guests who were jerks (took their sweet time getting back to the bus at Windsor Castle and made everyone late) and once they got on she stressed the importance of everyone getting back on time. I guess these guests got their feelings hurt, and they asked to stop the bus and get off because they did not want to continue the tour. Absolutely ridiculous and wasted more of our time, but Katia handled it well like the professional that she is and we all enjoyed the rest of our day!

The only thing I suggest is getting to the pick up point early. There was a lot of confusion on checking in, if we needed wristbands, etc., and some of the workers didn't seem to know what they were doing. So that was a little frustrating. But once we were on the tour everything relaxed and we had a great time.

I highly recommend this tour!

This is a full day with a lot to see. My family enjoyed this trip and all 3 parts offered a very different part of GB history. Windsor is lovely. Could spend more time there than we did but we enjoyed both the chapel and the castle tours. Bath was also very interesting and we wished we had more time to explore both the city and it's many shops. Stonehenge was a nice way to wrap up the day. Our guide, James, was great and we enjoyed his dry sense of humor. The bus ride is long but totally worth it to see a lot outside the city.

Amazing day! A highlight of my trip and would recommend to anyone who wants to see the sites. James was extremely knowledgeable and his background information made it where you felt so well informed upon entering. Key, the driver, was also great. He brought us through small towns and would slow down at beautiful sites along the way. I would definitely go on a tour with them again!

We did the Tour with James(a historian) and Kee(the driver), and they were an excellent team. We got to Bath, Windsor Castle before everyone else and Jame's knowledge is well beyond all the audio guides and he put in extra effort to inform us of history of the attractions. If you go on this tour, ask for James/Kee team and you will get more value and insight. Awesome tour!! Well worth the money.

This day trip was nothing short of amazing! You’re taken on a very nice coach bus to each sight and are given commentary about the sites before you arrive. Our guide was very well educated on the history of the sites and was very pleasing to talk to. You’re only able to spend approx 1.5 hours at each site, but this trip is a great way to see the “highlights” of each site. Definitely recommend!

This tour brings you to these three popular spots without hassle. The guide, Jennifer, worked professionally introducing the spots nearby and the backgrounds, while communicating well with her visitors. Love her humour and courtesy! Also big thank to Tom, the driver, who takes us to all these places which take a total of nearly six hours! The only pity is that the time for each destination is limited for the day trip ends at 7:30.

I definitely recommend this trip to everyone who does not want to travel a long distance by yourself.

For anyone booking in your Stone Henge tour Evan & Evans is na awesome option and they provide a wonderful stress free service to these amazing destinations in London!

I had James as the Guide and Kee as the Coach driver and both are amazing and entertaining people so I do suggest to ask for them or hope to get these two ☑️

The locations were great! Great value but I felt like the tour was a bit rushed and the meeting locations were just stated quickly unlike other tours I have been on where the other tour guides really cared about their group. Some people got lost getting back to the meeting place and our tour guide got mad and gave us a lecture like we were children. Also, I wish we had more time at each location. I felt that if this is a prepaid tour, we should have the tickets to go in already. We shouldn't have to wait outside and still wait for our tickets before going in. I also felt it was hard to listen to our tour guide over the earphones because she had to switch between two languages. It might be best to keep the tours under one language. Overall, we did enjoy our tour.

I did this tour yesterday and Manon was our guide. She is a wealth of knowledge on all places and topics relevant to the tour. I appreciated that she reiterated instructions back to the bus and pointed out landmarks to help us remember as she led us from the bus to the site(s). She happily answered questions and it was fun to hear her passion for the mysteries of the history and how they’re unraveling to this day. It was a Friday in July and places were crowded, but that’s not due to the tour. I think that’s just the time of year. The bus is comfortable and has WiFi, which is a plus. Overall, this tour delivered! Special thanks to Manon for being a top notch guide with a good sense of humor!

My family and I went on the full day tour of Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge. We had an amazing time going to such historic and beautiful sites. It is a day we will never forget. A large part of what made it so wonderful was our great tour guide JENNIFER. She shared many interesting facts and stories of each site as well of keeping the group in a very cheery mood despite the rainy weather. I would highly recommend any tour of London with Jennifer. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

This trip is very fast paced but my husband and I enjoyed being able to see so much in a short amount of time. Our guide was wonderful and kept everyone very informed of important details along the way.

Eugene and Vinh were great tour guides . Wonderful
I would highly recommend it Windsor was great, wish I Had more time there, but everything else was great.

We really enjoyed this tour. It was a 12 hr adventure... our tour guide Alexandria did an amazing job educating us about all the country side history of London. I highly recommend taking this tour not only do you see amazing, untouched history but you also get very entertaining interaction with your tour guide.

We were amazed at the timeliness and our guide was very knowledgeable funny witty and he could talk non stop about London’s history!! We had a most lovely day and our driver was professional.
The tour was informative and a lot of fun was had by all!! We even took the suggestion of our guide to eat fish and chips at a lovely place for dinner afterwards!! Well done see you soon.

I did the Windsor, Baths and Stonehenge day tour from London. My tour guide was Andy and driver was Nikki. They were both really great! The tour was perfect, especially if you're short on time (I was only in London for two weeks so had to make the most of my time). It is a lot for one day though, so be prepared to walk briskly, but you still get to enjoy a good amount of time in each location.
Andy is extremely knowledgable and it was so cool that he had worked for the Queen Mother. It was like a cherry on top of the already delicious sundae to listen to his stories!! Learned so much from him!! Even got to see the changing of the guards at Windsor Castle, what an experience!! Definitely recommend Evan Evans Tours. Only thing is the bus didn't have wifi, but not really a big deal for me.

We had an amazing time on the Stonehenge/Windsor/Bath tour. The instructions were very clear as to the timing and the location of departure. Evan Evans tour company had many buses going on the tour that day... we went to the Victoria Coach station where we were checked in and asked to stand in a line. The buses were filled up... we got a great guide (Richard) and driver (Nicky) for our bus! Richard was very patient and enthusiastic in talking about the history and significance of different things not only at the points of interest but all through the journey as we rode along in the country side. Richard made special attempt to keep us on time so we could get the maximum out of the tour. In short we had a terrific time and would certainly recommend this company to anyone (and hope that you get Richard as your guide)!!!

We booked this tour because we had 6 days to do London and everything else we could. This is a great way to fit in all three. Our tour guide Godfrey was excellent. Full of knowledge and hilarious. Very helpful. Our bus did pop a tire and extended our trip by an hour, but things happen and it gave us an extra hour in Bath. No big deal. He was cool under pressure. Choosing to do all three destinations in a day comes at a cost. There is very limited time at each stop. I would have loved more time at Windsor. If you are thinking the same, just book the Windsor tour. However I will say, given the short time at each stop, there were plenty of shops to stop at to pick up a bite to eat before heading back to the bus. This was a plus, as the day is very long.

My family of 5 just returned from this trip and it was wonderful. Our guide (Nigel) and driver (Barry) were a great team. Nigel kept us continuously informed of all important sites, facts and trip milestones. We spent just enough time at each site to view the most important points and had plenty of time for great pictures. This is a full day trip from 0730 to 1930 and we were on the first bus out of Victoria Station. Nigel had a great sense of humor and great personality... You could tell he was a pro and had been doing this gig for a long time.
Best tour guide in the business, wealth of knowledge and great whit, great man and great tour! From your friends from down under

Awesome tour that lasted roughly 12 hours from boarding to drop off. Fascinating and varied history on these stops. Alexandria was an excellent guide. She was very informative and knew much about the history of each of these places. She was witty too and made the tour very enjoyable. Kevin provided excellent driving and plenty of opportunity for photos. Both were great. Highly recommend this tour with them.

James and Aston are a fantastic team.James has an incredible historical knowledge that makes it all come alive as well as very interesting and Aston is a great driver. You couldn’t get better on both counts. I highly recommend

This was a phenomenal tour. Our tour guide Nick was absolutely great! It was a bit of a whirlwind, and I would have liked to have stayed at each location a bit longer, but we had limited time as there is so much to see in London. I would recommend that you pack some food to munch on along the way, as there are opportunities to get food at Windsor and Bath, but not very much time. We had a great time, and Nick was very organized and educational. Of all the tours we did while in London, this was our favorite and was run the best. Highly recommended!

Valentine was a wonderful bus driver. Kevin was witty and informative. The trip was jam packed. We personally would have liked to spend more time at Windsor Castle. It was so rushed you didn’t really have time to enjoy it. I guess I should have looked for something different to spend more time. The lines to get in to all the places were crazy long. The castle is beautiful. Bath is interesting and a charming looking town. Stonehenge is magical.

To Evan Evans Tours: Please consider the safety of all your passengers. My husband is a big guy. The seatbelt did not fit. Please consider having an extension belt like the airlines.

I had this tour together with my friends who were visiting me over from the US. We had a really great time and our tour guide Richard is very knowledgeable and well spoken. We just wished we had more time in Windsor Castle but understood that we need to be on time for the 2 other places to visit. Good for me that I am based in UK so I definitely will go back to Windsor Castle!
What an amazing day thanks to Simon our tour guide. Well planned getting the most out of our day. Would highly reccomend to anyone except for small children.

Kevin and George were a hoot! It does seem a little rushed, however it is for your benefit... They are trying to get you there before ours, so you can spend more time enjoying and less time waiting! We weally enjoyed ourselves! #bookit #enjoy

My boyfriend and I (aged 22) were a bit hesitant to book thinking it would be for more of an older crowd but we’re so glad we did! We had more then enough time in each stop and our tour guide (her name was Karen) was so knowledgeable and entertaining that the trip did not feel like 11 hours at all. She was very organised with getting our tickets and entrance to the places which made the trip go extremely smooth! We could tell that Karen had a passion for the job and actually cared about getting us to the places, and into the places as quick as possible to give us maximum time in each place.

One thing I will say is to try and pack a lunch to take with you as it will help with having more time in each place as you can eat on the bus. We did this and we’re so glad we did!

Overall we were so glad we did this trip and would book it again in a heartbeat!

We really enjoyed this trip. Kevin the tour guide made it fun and enjoyable. He has a great sense of humor and was very knowledgeable.
Windsor Palace was beautiful, I loved Bath the town, the bath house museum was ok. Very busy. Stonehenge a must see of course!! I highly recommend this trip. Ask for Kevin, I think we had more fun then the other groups.

We decided to go with Evan Evans tours due to a prior positive experience and this one was no different.

Our tour guide, Kevin, was very knowledgeable and had a great sense of humour. His enthusiasm definitely made for an enjoyable experience. The bus driver, valentine, was also good and friendly.

The tour was extremely organized and followed to schedule very well.

As for timing, I believe sometime from both Stonehenge and Windsor could be sacrificed for Bath, maybe around a total of 20 minutes. Alot of the time from the 11.5h tour is spent travelling but that is understandably unavoidable.

Apart from that, only positive things to say and definitely would recommend.
Great overall tour with helpful guide Kevin and driver Valentine but be prepared for the short timeframes with a packed itinerary

Overall a good day with an excellent tour guide Jennifer
and driver Dave
The rainy weather and tight program over the long day
only spoilers.

We took this tour from London to really see and experience several sites without the hassle of driving. Jennifer referred to this as a tapas day and that was the best description...experience everything a little. Windsor castle was beautiful. Bath was a beautiful little town and our driver Steve C knew all the little routes to take to get us the best views. Stonehenge was impressive and left us all wondering whats its true purpose was.
Both Jennifer and Steve did a great job od explaining the sites and answering everyones questions along the way. Jennifer was bright and witty but was not pushy as other guides have been in the past. Wonderful tour!

Best guide around. Phil was knowledgeable and informative. Always friendly, answering any questions that were asked meeting everyone on the bus. It was the perfect tour of points in history and a great deal of that was because of Phil’s expertise on the subject.

Jennifer our tour guide was absolutely amazing, she didn’t miss a beat.
Only down fall was not enough time was allocated to each site no fault of her own. Just too much time is spent driving between sites. Maybe just reduce tour to two sites instead of the three.

Had a wonderful time on our trip to Bath, Windsor Castle, and Stonehenge. Our tour guide was so knowledgeable and funny. It was definitely a whirlwind of a tour. If we could have we would have done each trip on a different day so we could spend more time but we were limited on time. So it was perfect.

My wife and I booked the Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge tour #21. To be honest, I went into this expecting one of those experiences where you only get to see a site for a few minutes, fighting through crowds the entire time until you have to get back on the bus and drive for another couple of hours. Man, was I wrong! Our tour guide, Nigel and driver Dennis were absolutely amazing. Nigel is so knowledgeable about not just the sites we saw, but so much more. He has an excellent sense of humor & energy and clearly has a passion for what he does. He's been doing this for nearly 40 years, so he knows the in's and outs and doesn't waste time, which was much appreciated. Everything was on time and we were able to spend ample time at each location (each of which were breathtaking). I'd highly recommend Evan Evans Tours and I'd be sure to try and book it with Nigel and Dennis!
Jennifer was an outstanding tour guide and Dave was a great bus driver. You are definitely on the go with this tour but it’s well organized so that you get to see everything.

Jennifer of Evan Evans tours, set the tour's expectations right up front. Glad she did because I hadn't planned on so much driving time.
Great tour, Jennifer is extremely knowledgeable and very personable. Never had a better guide.
If I was king and could rearrange the tour time allotment, I'd take a half hour from Stonehenge and add it to Bath..Windsor was fine.
Thanks again for the high quality tour. We will recommend you.
Jim & Ana

Me and my friend went on this tour, our tour guide Peter was great and informative. We hit all three destinations and had enough time at each and managed to make it back at the end of the night early. Our driver Micheal was also friendly and a safe driver!

Peter was amazing, and a huge thanks to Michael our driver! He was funny and knowledgeable and it was a very nice trip over all. He knew just what to say and kept it entertaining for us all. He also encouraged timeliness and our tour group did pretty darn good!
Thanks so much for a great, great trip (and I really want to visit Bath again. You all made it happen ;) )
-the 2 girls that sat up front July 2019

We booked the Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge tour with Evan Evans. Our tour guide Jennifer was delightful, friendly and full of knowledge. She did a wonderful job orienting us to the tour, outlining the most practical and timely routes through our designated stops and provided clear and reasonable expectations for the day. Although she warned us that we would feel rushed, my friend and I felt we had a great amount of time (about 1.5 hrs) at each site. It was enough time to go through, see what we could see and move on. These tours do not go into depth and that was exactly what we hoped--to see as much as possible on a limited timeline. Additionally, our lovely driver James D. was wonderful, safely getting us to our destinations with a smile for the full 11 hours! All in all a great tour if you have a limited amount of time and have resonable expectations of how in depth you can get at each site.

It was everything we had expected and more. It was a wonderful overview of the region and our guide, Kat, was energetic and full of great information, and our driver, Mike, negotiated this coach with ease. It’s important to take snacks as there just isn’t enough time to squeeze in a proper lunch without sacrificing time at these cool sites.

I really enjoyed this day trip. It is a lot for one day, and a lot of time in the bus, but I am glad we did it. The bus was very nice and comfortable, with phone charging ports. I thought the time at each place was adequate, and all three places were awesome!

Windsor Castle was wonderful, the Roman Baths great and Stonehenge what a super way to end the day. Very convenient pick up at the bus station. Nigel our guide was very knowledgeable and Valentine our driver stayed a steady speed and was extremely safe.

I originally booked this tour and was excited to see Stonehenge. Ironically the first stop of the tour, Windsor exceeded my expectations. Our tour guide Robert was exceptionally well versed in the history of the location and the events preceding. Definitely the best tour I’ve ever experienced!!

Additionally the driver Derek works in perfect unison with tour guide Robert and always expedited our tour in a most efficient manner!!
Great tour better than expected. Rob our guide was well prepared, knowledgeable, and entertaining. Totally recommend!!!!
Stonehenge Over Rated Place. But u can visit since its on your way to Roman Bath which is a must visit place .

This is a lot to jam into one day. You will feel rushed. You will not get a ton of time to enjoy each site. You will get a nice highlight of each site and get to see the big stuff. Shout out to Manon for being a good tour guide. My wife and I really enjoyed her.

Its same what I saw since my childhood. Windows xp wallpaper.

A must visit place for everyone. Eva eva tour was what we took from victoria bus station and it was worth every penny

I recommend this Tour to anyone who has minimal knowledge of the attractions as James was an awesome tour guide. Not only his in-depth knowledge of the history and significance regarding the sites attended but his presentation and charisma kept you wanting more.

Our driver Aston was not only one of the funniest and kind individuals I have met but he would also give Lewis Hamilton a run for his money.

I have now great insights into these attractions and would love to have James be my guide with Aston behind the wheel for all future tours.

This was an excellent trip even though it was too rushed at Stonehenge. The organizers there need to improve their method of transport when there are large groups. We did not get enough time to properly see there even though we managed a few rushed photos.

Our guide, Angela, was fantastic! Extremely well spoken and knowledgeable and shared a tremendous amount of history with us.

The audio setup was also very good. And our coach was cool and comfortable with wifi for the trip. Tom, our driver was also very pleasant and did a great job getting us around.

All in all, well worth the money and a highlight of our trip to London. Hopefully access to Stonehenge will improve in the future. Thank you!

I was a solo traveler yet I never felt alone. Peter was a great guide with a wealth of information. He stuck to the subject and didn't chatter on. When the bus fell silent with napping passengers he didn't interrupt. He gave great suggestions for things to see and places to eat. Well done TripAdvisor!

Great trip. Our guide, Oliver, and driver, Bob, were great. Personable, informative and helpful. Realize this trip is meant to expose to multiple sites. Having gone on this tour we know which sites we will go back to and spend more time in.
Good way to see three landmark sites that are not particularly close to each other or London, all in one day. Peter kept it light and fun and had plenty of interesting factoids along the way.

We had a wonderful time with our teenage boys! Our tour guide, Phil, was amazing! It makes a nice full day and kept moving. Be sure to pack snacks and have your portable phone chargers, as there is a lot of time on the bus!

I highly recommend this tour and you defintely want to ask for the tour guide Phil Bennett. He was funny, informative and very patient. He took his time to ask questions and give answers when we needed it. Thanks again.

What a wonderful tour with the best tour guide and bus driver (Nicky) with Evan Evans tours. Andy is a bonefide expert, Having multiple degrees in history and archeology, along with first hand experiece with the Royal Family. This tour was informative and interesting and well worth the time and money. Thanks for a great day!

James was a great guide and shared many interesting facts on the ride to each location as well as at the sites. Easy access on and off the bus all day. Lots of great things to see and do at each location.

Richard was a professional, extremely knowledgeable, and considerate gentleman. Dennis, our bus driver, was a safe driver and friendly. The bus was clean & comfortable, and some food & drinks were allowed inside.

During transit we were provided with a plethora of information about the city and the attractions you visit. At the attractions, we got our ticket and were given a meeting place & time to move on to the next destination. We were left to use that time freely to explore the attractions, explore the town, do some shopping, etc.

These destinations are pivotal to English culture and are must-see destinations. Would highly recommend to anyone coming for a few days time or longer. The only thing the tour left me wanting was more time at each place!

This trip starts at 8 am and ends around 7pm. Richard Morell was our tour guide for the trip and had continuous good energy through the day. He was extremely knowledgeable and had many historical facts he shared with us throughout the trip. You get about an hour and a half to wander each attraction so you can really see the highlights at each spot. So if you want to spend a while to really see any of the 3 places this may not be the trip for you. Doing 2 spots instead of all 3 in one day may be a better way to sightsee, but the tour was very organized and had quite a bit of driving so being on a timetable was very important. We can’t recommend Richard Morell enough!!

Thanks to Robert and Darrell with Evans and Evans tours, this was an outstanding overview of these 3 sites. Darrell was a great driver, keeping us safe and on schedule!

I really can not say enough about Robert. He was knowledgeable and interesting for the entire day! He was descriptive on our way to the sites and just had an excellent knowledge about the sites and England. Overall, it was a busy day made perfect by these two professionals!!

My father and I are traveling for work but had a few extra days to sight see so we decided to take this tour today and see a few things outside of London. We had Peter as our guide and Michelangelo as our driver. It was a fantastic day visiting Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. As others have noted, because of the nature of the tour and the required driving, there was not a lot of time at each location but there was enough for us to enjoy it and see some great stuff.

Peter was very great and knowledgeable. He spoke in between drives but still gave us down time so you could rest or read or whatever. He was very clear on meet up times and locations. Michelangelo navigated the roads beautifully (and speaks Italian!).

A few things that may be helpful to know...

There was not a bathroom on the bus but there was always a bathroom closely located to where we stopped so it was never an issue. Food was also always located close by (no hot food or hot drinks allowed on the bus though). The bus was very comfortable.

It was about an hour drive to Windsor Castle, two hours from the Castle to Bath, another hour to Stonehenge, and then two hours back to London. The scenery along the way was beautiful.

At each stop, we had time to explore on our own so it wasn’t a tour where everyone had to stick all together the whole time.

All in all, it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend it to others.

We had a great time on this tour. It was a nice full day getaway from the hustle and bustle of London. Richard, our tour guide, was full of knowledge. He did a wonderful job sharing facts and the historical background of buildings and areas as we drove from one location to the next. He even speaks SIX languages. Stonehenge was the highlight for our whole family. We had ample amount of time at each location even though they are far apart from one another. The tour bus was comfy and clean with wifi.
We were lucky to have a fantastic tour guide; very knowledgeable and a historian. Katie was excellent!!!
The Tour was fantastic with an entertaining guide, who kept us entertained while talking about the history about the place. The Windsor castle was ok, not much to see, but liked stonehenge.
What an amazing day this was. Couldn't have asked for a better team than Mark the coach driver and James the tour guide. Wish I could rate higher than five stars.

One of the best tours we’ve ever done, maybe the best! Phil is incredibly knowledgeable and I’d highly recommend if you book, request him as your guide. It’s an education on English history that would be hard to replicate.

The coach was clean and very comfortable. It’s a long day and fast pace but good way to sample a taste of England. We did this with 4 children 4-14 in age and a grandma. There was something for everyone.

If you have just a few days to see everything you need to in London, this day trip to Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath is definitely for you. While it does feel a bit rushed, you get through 3 amazing attractions in a day that is somehow surprisingly chill. Godfrey was our guide and he was great, strategically getting us the most time possible at each location. The bus is nice and has WiFi—just make sure to note where to meet the bus at departure and that in the morning, loading starts at 7:30am.

If you are wanting a deeper dive into any of these attractions, I’d suggest doing a trip that has just two locations in a day. For us, Bath was the only location where we wished we’d had a little longer.

Excellent day-trip covering lots of ground with an engaging and knowledgeable tour guide named Toby. Visiting Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge in one day seemed ambitious. However, we enjoyed every minute and arrived back in London after 12 hours energized, not tired. I recommend packing a lunch. I highly recommend this tour.

Thanks to Jennifer and Tomas with Evans and Evans tours, this was an outstanding overview of these 3 sites. Tomas was a superior driver, keeping us safe and on schedule! He even located extra audio boxes!
I really can not say enough about Jennifer. She was knowledgeable and interesting for the entire day! She was descriptive on our way to the sites and just had an excellent knowledge about all the sites. Overall, it was a busy day made perfect by these 2 professionals!!

This was an excellent family day trip from London - a great way to see 3 Wonderful sights all in one day with everything taken care of and arranged for you! Our Guide and the Driver from Evan Evans Tours were excellent and added so much extra to the trip. Windsor Castle was wonderful to experience, the Roman Bath's and Stonehenge were also great excursions, so much to see and do. Highly recommend it!
Great day, very efficient and organised. We beat the crowds on Set locations.Our your guide -James/Mark were fantastic, well recommended.

The instructions could have be clearer on exactly where to board the buses as the bus terminal itself was confusing and you could tell many were not sure they were in the right place and so avoidable anxiety.

After that, we were in great hands with our guide, Rob, and driver, Steve.

Rob explained everything very clearly and in a fun way. He extended his expertise to help individuals with any questions — about the tour attractions and anything else regarding a visit to London.

Caveat: for those that struggle with mobility, this tour will be challenging — standing in queues, walking on uneven ground, etc.
Our guide Tom was great, very knowledgeable and funny. Overall an experience to never forget. Only wish more time at Windsor Castle and less time at Stonehenge.

This tour is very well done. Tour guide was extremely knowledgable and pleasant. Be sure to select the tour that adds time for lunch. We didn’t, and that mistake is on us. Adds 90 minutes to the day long tour, but grab and go opportunities for food were not plentiful, and if you miss the bus departure time at any stop, Evans shows no mercy.
Excellent tour. The tour guide James was delightful; very knowledgeable and entertaining throughout.

While we would have enjoyed a bit more time at each stop, we did see exactly what we expected. Our guide Simon did as good job providing background information ahead of each stop,. kept us informed as to the itinerary, and did well to set our expectations. One caveat - don't book this tour (or any tour to Windsor Castle) for a Sunday. On Sundays you can't get into St. George's Chapel (Sunday services) and the Changing of the Guard does not occur.

We went as a group of three on the Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge bus tour out of Victoria coach station and was lucky enough to have Andy and Steve as our guides. Andy Jackson was a wealth of amazing knowledge and wit and regaled us with historical lessons and anecdotes for the three sites.
Steve was an excellent bus driver who was on time and smooth in his handling of the bus.

The entire day was a joy and we had a great time.

This tour was incredible. Andy Jackson, the tour guide, was informative, insightful, knowledgeable, and funny. He shared as much knowledge as he had about all locations, which was a lot as he was in the army and served as queensguard, studied archeology and history and generally loved sharing what he knew. He made the trip so enjoyable and even the bus rides between places, we were tiring, he made easier with bouts of knowledge as we left locations and as we began to get close to the next.
100% would recommend to others!
Our tour guide Andy Jackson was very knowledgeable. He explained the history of each site very clearly. He also kept the tour schedule very well.

At first I was bit a skeptical about taking an 11 hour tour, but the time flashed by. James is a very unique person. He is quintessentially London.
He knows a lot, talks about what he knows from the perspective of someone who has been there done that, and has a definite point of view on everything.

The only reason I did not rate this tour excellent is, why don't the guides come into the places with you anymore? Did something change? James did give a good overview of what we were going to see and what the skip and when not to bother with the audio guides, and the best routes thru, but it would have been much better if he had just stayed with us as a group once we entered to guide us along.

I must have compared 3 similar tours before picking the Evan's one, and the reason was I got a USA discount, now I can say I picked it because of James, which I would have never know that before taking the tour.

I enjoyed touring the 3 locations and the tour guide (young male- can’t remember his name) was extraordinary! However, our time at our last two spots was extremely rushed. I really wish I could’ve been at the Roman Baths and Stonehenge for at least an hour longer. Unfortunately for our group, we left our first stop- Windsor Castle- a bit late due to the exchanging of the guards which ended a lot later then expected. I would still recommend this tour to anyone that is really wanting to make the most of one day in England.

Our tour was through Evan Evans. The coach was very comfortable. Our guide James was very knowledgeable. He made our trip very enjoyable. Our driver Mark was wonderful. We had an excellent time. My only complaint is that we didn't have enough time at Windsor Castle.

We have enjoyed our tour, with James our very knowledgeable and organised guide and Dave, excellent driver. Luckily, the weather was fantastic. We saw the changing of the guard, thanks to James who gave us good tips not to miss it.
It is great to get an overview of Windsor castle but far too short to appreciate all its grandeur and majesty. You have to go back!
Time at Stonehenge is adequate, I would have liked a little more time in Bath. Our guide, a great historian, able to keep our interest throughout the driving and very generous of his time to answer questions.
Thank you,
The 2 French Canadians!

It was really great, our guide Toby was really fun and shares a lot of story regarding the sites visited or London history and other trivial things. Our driver V was also very on time with the pickups. The sites are great, eventhough it was quite the distance between the sites and the tours were a bit hurried but it works fine and we get to see everything (including the changing guide ceremony playing Vader’s Imperial March in Windsor!)

Awesome tour! Simon was extremely knowledgeable and thorough. We enjoyed learning about each site from his expertise! Simon kept us entertained on the way between site with history and interesting facts about the areas we were passing through Nikki, our driver was super! The bus was clean and comfortable. Excellent trip! We’ll done Evans and Evans Tours.

Our tour guide Toby was very knowledgeable about the site history. He was very accommodating when we didn’t purchase the admission tickets to bath. Which by the way would recommend purchasing. It’s worth going into the bath, amazing history

Awesome tour! James was extremely knowledgeable and thorough. We enjoyed learning about each site from his expertise! James is also kind and efficient. Mark, our driver was super! The bus was clean and comfortable. Excellent trip! We’ll done Evans and Evans Tours.

The tour was fabulous! Big thanks to our tour guide James and coach driver Mark. They made the day fun, informative and well navigated. It’s a lot of ground to cover in a day, their expertise makes it possible and fun!

James was an amazing guide, who not only entertained with his witty humour, educated us with his EXCEPTIONAL knowledge, but he also really went out of his way to make this an amazing experience for US. He got us to the head of the line, knew the quickest routes to take and kept things running efficiently. Mark, our driver, drove wonderfully and worked as a team with our guide, James. This was a wonderful tour, with a fantastic tour guide. Thank you, Evan Evans Tours!

The trip was so well organized, I'm not sure what to say. Our guide, Simon, and driver Nikki were absolutely awesome. They made sure the trip kept at a steady pace to ensure we had sufficient time at every stop. As well, Simon's knowledge and history of each site were impeccable and his great sense of humour made for such a pleasant trip. I would not have any issue recommending this day trip to anyone.

Had the best tour guide in Phil and the best driver in Mike. Great combination! Windsor was amazing, could have stayed forever with Meghan Markle and Harry. Lovely summers day. Bath was quaint and Stonehenge for us and our two teenage boys was an eye opener into history. Great day...one to remember

Our tour guide Stephanie was outstanding. She was knowledgeable, personable, and very well organized. Her excellent directions for returning to the bus after each stoop kept the tour on schedule. Stephanie's knowledge of London's history made the bus ride interesting and engaging. We enjoyed our visit to each attraction and felt we had enough time to see what we wanted to see. Stephanie worked well with our bus driver, Bob, which made the tour a pleasure.

excellent tour and nice bus. You will see 3 critical spots on this tour....do NOT be late getting there, get to the meeting spot EARLY. They will leave you & they should leave on time so you are not in line behind 5-8 other tour buses. Our driver was Aston & the tour guide was Godfrey, if you can get on their bus, you should. Very informative tour, witty British humor and Aston is a great driver. (Getting home safe is really the baseline goal of any trip). You don't have as much time to see all of these things vs. driving yourself. However, when you drive yourself you don't have time to look out the window and enjoy the sites and you cannot take a nap between stops. I'm not much of a total tour group type of person, so we travel to a city on our own, book our own hotels & then take these day tours. You should always budget some money for gratuity for the driver & tour guide. We donated 10 pounds, the amount is up to you, but that seemed to be what most were giving.

We went to Stonehenge, Bath and Windsor Castle today. Our tour guide, Jennifer, was very informative and funny. Nadia was a great driver giving us the opportunity to take pics of the English countryside. This dynamic duo are without a doubt the best team.

Under Richard’s expert guidance and Thomas’ skillful driving, we arrived at Windsor ahead of the crowds and enjoyed a leisurely tour of the castle. We visited St George’s chapel and the changing of the guard.

Then off on an hours drive to Bath. Again we had sufficient time to tour the Roman Baths and pick up sandwiches and drinks for the ride on to Stonehenge.

During the bus portions of our tour, Richard provided wonderful context information. After leisurely touring Stonehenge we returned to London. It was impressive that Richard gave individual advice to each passenger on how to most easily reach their lodging.

A twelve hour day but extremely worthwhile.

We had a great day on our tour. Nigel was wonderful and got us into Windsor Castle very quickly given the lines and number of people there. Valentine was an awesome driver and he negotiated traffic beautifully. We had enough time to see all three attractions! It was a wonderful experience!

This was a great way to end the trip! Tom was an amazing guide and gave us lots of knowledge about each place we went! Paul was so nice and got us to each stop quickly and without incident! It is a great way to spend a day especially if you are at the end of your trip and exhausted like we were! 10/10 would do again!

We went to Stonehenge as part of our tour of England. It was a beautiful day a little crowded but that didn’t matter because you couldn’t get close to the stones anyway. You can walk to the circle or take a bus,people did both. If you ar3 short on time, you should take the bus. They have a stone age village next to the visitor center, just the huts and no re-enactors. They have a lot of stuff to buy in the visitor center. It was a good morning visit. Loved it.

Thoroughly enjoyed our day sightseeing around Windsor Castle, And The beautiful town of Bath and then on to the amazing historic site at Stonehenge . Very impressed with our knowledgeable tour guide James !!! He is an extremely intelligent man who made our day a wonderful unforgettable experience !! Huge thank you to James for all his help and for making our day so memorable.

Peter (guide) and Bob (driver) kept us entertained during the long drives between locations. We learned a lot, saw a lot, and drove a lot. Overall, a great experience. The bus was comfortable, the drive beautiful. Peter was a well informed and pleasant guide.

The only observation I have is that we felt pretty rushed at each location; hard to see all there is to see. That is not the tour's fault. I only mention it to say that, if you are someone who wants to really scrutinize the details of these amazing historical locations, you may want to look for a more focused tour.

Thanks Peter and Bob!

Mark was our driver and James was our tour guide. James was both knowledgeable and witty.

I appreciate that they both knew the time to start and leave to minimize the lines. Considering that I had a young adult and a 10yr old, this minimizes some of the meltdowns that could happen from delays waiting in the sun.

This was a perfect time at each location for me. I would love to come back and visit bath for a single day trip in the future.
James was an amazingly knowledgeable (and witty) guide. All three stops were absolutely worth every second. Don’t miss this tour!

This was a day well spent! Absolutely delightful. The right pace and the right places. Our guide was Celia and V drove the bus. Thank you both for making the trip so wonderful.
Celia's narration laced with typical British humour made the trip all the more enjoyable. Her precise instructions on departure times helped the entire group.
I would strongly recommend taking this trip to three iconic places in UK.

Incredible day spent touring some of the highlights in London. Manon was our tour guide for the day. We started our day at Windsor Castle, then off to Bath. We concluded our day at Stonehenge.Manon was a delightful guide who had a wealth of information to share with us. Would recommend Manon as your tour guide for the day.

James of Evan Evans tours was our guide for the day. He and our driver Valentine did a wonderful job taking care of us. Our tour left a half hour earlier than most others. That’s because James wanted “his people” to be first in line at Windsor Castle...and we were! The cue ended up to be farther than I could see. We had the longest wait to get in but also the least crowded venues. James used to work in the castle so he knew all of the best places to go for the best views. Stonehenge was amazing! And the drive to Bath through picturesque hillsides dotted with sheep and cottages made me want to stay for a weekend. In Bath one of the couples on our tour got lost. Our bus had to leave them but James was right on top of the situation. He arranged for another Evan Evans tour bus to transport the couple to our next destination. Problem solved! As we traveled James got to know us and we learned valuable interesting information about these historical, not-to-be-missed English experiences.

Guide Godfrey and Driver Aston were awesome! Had a great day at Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath with my niece and a friend. Another big check on my bucket list. Weather was beautiful and all went smoothly. Highly recommend!

Our tour guide was Oliver. He was very informative from the start to the end. His information went deeper than just a google search. They have audio-boxes so at locations you can hear the tour guide without straining. I did see some tours where the tour guide had to yell for people to hear them.

The bus had ac and wifi. The seats were a typical tourbus seating- so pretty comfy.

This is about a 12 hour tour of three different parts. While it sounds like enough time, it is just a short time at each stop (a little less than 2 hours each stop). It was just enough for what was needed. Some parts would have been nice to be a little longer but still just enough.

I would really think hard about bringing children between 5-10. It is a long day for them. Our trip had one kid who was 5 years old who was just miserable and a couple people on the bus had made comments. I personally thought of him as a kid being a kid when bored.
Would highly recommend! Peter was our guide and he was fantastic. Lots to see and do, and gave you a great taste of smaller towns outside of London.

I want to start off by saying how fun and sweet both Simon (our tour guide) and Nikki (our driver) were. Those two kept me laughing and smiling with their banter.

Windsor Castle was beautiful, and I loved that Simon was able to talk to us about facts regarding the area. The same goes for Bath and for Stonehenge.

Simon also had very good facts about how different figures of speech got their meaning. I loved listening to him, and would take the tour with him and Nikki again anytime!!

Our Evan Evans tours arrived early at Windsor Castle so we have to wait in que under the rain. The time is not enough to visit chapel and the rest of the buildings around. Bath is disappointing. Stonehenge is ok since we only need photos of it. But the most enjoyable is listening to our tour guide Rhys Thomas. He has not stop imparting information all the way for each destination. He had treated everyone in the coach special as he approached the seat to ask if there is any question we would like to ask not only about the tour but in general. I did asked about the royals. He was so good guide.
