This activity is perfect to see many things in a short amount of time. Our guide Simon was amazing. He kept us entertained while also providing lots of facts about the country and the places we were visiting. Thanks to our driver Thomas who got us everywhere quickly and safely. You do get very limited time at each place, especially when at Windsor, so be prepared to move quickly at each stop to ensure that you can see the most you can possibly see while there. This tour is perfect when you are short on time and would like to see these amazing places in one day trip.

It was a great tour! Keep in mind that you’re visiting 3 places in one day so it’s a quick place throughout the day. Oliver kept us entertained with English history while we waited. The thing that separates this tour from the others is that they give everyone individual headsets so the tour guide doesn’t have to shout everything. Overall, I’d recommend this trip

My family and I went on the Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge tour yesterday June 28th and it was a very enjoyable experience thanks to our tour guide Jennifer. She was very friendly, knowledgeable, and humorous as she took us to all our destinations. Our driver Ben was also excellent because he would slow down whenever passing something worth seeing. I would highly recommend Evan Evans tours with Jennifer and Ben as guides.

Our guide, Oliver was so welcoming,cheerful and informative. Great historical information delivered well. Our driver, Andrew, was amazing! His driving was so capable and his knowledge of roads/ways to avoid traffic hence not make us late was outstanding. Perhaps just not enough time especially in the "season" as there are huge lines at all three places. My advice would be ...don't try to fit all three in one day. However could not fault the guide and the driver. Excellent work gentlemen.

We had a fabulous day visiting Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. Catia was a knowledgeable, helpful guide that used good organizational skills to be sure we had the maximum time possible at each site. She gave helpful hints about using the time to our best advantage. She shared so much interesting information and responded to the questions of the group so it had an element of being interactive. What really struck us was how she even helped other tourists to find the right line to stand in and give directions all without slighting our group at all. The driver, Russell, was skillful and we felt safe and comfortable at all times. We recommend this tour and any tour lead by Catia at Evan Evans Tours.
Chris was the guide. Mark was the driver. A very good team. It is a long journey with no restroom on the "luxury coach" so empty your bladders! Very informative and comfortable. We enjoyed it!

Have a great day with a nice weather. The guide, Katie, is friendly and gave us tons of knowledge about these attractions. The driver, Steve, is very good at driving and gave us a comfortable journey.

We did this tour with an amazing guide, Katie, and driver, Steve. They were outstanding. Katie was engaging, knowledgeable and gave us great history before getting to the sites. She also pointed the highlights not to be missed. Steve drove safely and kept the coach very comfortable. Definitely highly recommended! 😁👍🏼
at the first we thought about the price , but in the end it deserve every cent , this place i used to watch it just at the movies , it was great to see it in realy , i still don't believe it

The tour guide (James) was VERY knowledgeable, however, when he addressed the group, I felt he was treating us like children. Wifi did not work. Bus seats were cramped and uncomfortable. There is simply not enough time allotted to enjoy the stops. Due to circumstances, we were promised refunds on Stonehedge Admission fees, which I have sent 2 emails and received no response.

Had a great experience on the tour to Bath, Stonehenge and Windsor Castle today! The tour guide, Alexandria, was friendly, energetic and extremely knowledgeable. She and our driver Tom kept things moving without making us feel too rushed. I would definitely recommend this tour and if you can find a way onto their bus you won’t be sorry!

Andy Jackson #ajaxldn was our tour guide for this trip on 26-Jun-2019. I give him 5 stars. He was very knowledgeable of the attractions and history behind each attraction. He even injected humor during our journey. I recommend doing this tour with Evans Evans tour and ask for Andy Jackson.

Jennifer El Gammal (Guide) and David Bell (Driver) were exceptional. Jennifer kept us all on time and David got us to each destination in a comfortable and brisk manner. Our time at each site was maximized giving us a wonderful day in the historic English countryside. Jennifer is extremely knowledgeable and took every opportunity to share her love of British history, as well as timely advice on how to get the most out of day.

I highly recommend this excursion knowing other tourists would enjoy the same depth of experience.

Guide Angela / Drive George
Well organized, details explanation & friendly reception. It's worth to join this trip through Evan Evans while staying in London.

we were in London and wanted to see Stonehenge and without a car we decided to book this tour and hit a couple more “must sees” as well. Our guide Peter was very knowledgeable and had a good sense of humor and our driver Bob was a very safe operator. Our coach was clean and comfortable. We started off at Windsor Castle followed by a quick stop at Bath ending with a stop at Stonehenge. These were quick stops but was enough time for us to see everything we wanted. The guide, Peter did an outstanding job and I would recommend this excursion to anyone who wants to make the most of a day.

Our tour guide Jennifer E, and driver David B were amazing. Jennifer provided lots of interesting and entertaining information. While David gave us a smooth and safe ride throughout the day. We were very happy with our day.

Had “the best” day on June 25 with driver David Bell and guide Jennifer El Gammel. Jennifer was wonderful. Very informative and helpful. Her suggestions to help us get the most at Windsor castle were great. The day ran so smoothly. Thank you Jennifer and David.

We had a fantastic tour today! The guide, Jennifer E, was knowledgeable and entertaining with some interesting facts and tips, and the driver, David B, was organized and fast. We were one of the first in the queue for Windsor and didn't have to wait long. For Windsor you have enough time to follow the crowds and get a good view of each room, not much time to linger but enough time for us. Bath was great, we saw the Roman Baths and still had time for shops. Stonehenge was great to see, plenty of time to see that. All in all an efficient, well-organized day tour.

Had a wonderful day touring with Jennifer El Grammal and David Bell (driver). Both were pleasant and accommodating.
Jennifer was superb and extremely informative as well as very pleasant to chat with. The day went without a hitch and would recommend this tour for anyone that wants to quickly see these sites.
Well done!

Peter was funny, knowledgeable and entertaining throughout the day. Would highly recommend him and this tour. We really enjoyed Bath. Found a wonderful pizza place and ice cream next door,
would have liked to spent more time in
Bath.
Our tour guide was excellent. He gave us so much information and delivered it with a smile and jokester the whole time. It was a great tour that took us to three incredible places.

Well organized, very efficient, and incredible sights. Such a great experience. What made the trip even better was our guide, Andy. Was literally an expert in all the history surrounding each site, and made you craving more after each story. Loved every moment of this adventure.

We enjoyed this tour very much, Tom was very informative and gave us tips for getting food on this activity packed day! Valentine did a great job keeping us safe on the narrow roads. I highly recommend this tour!
We had a great time doing Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath. Our tour guide was absolutely amazing and gave us so much history about each different place we were going to.
Andy Jackson was our guide and did a wonderful job. It’s a long day, but well worth it. Andy was very entertaining, full of knowledge and genuinely knew his history.

I thought it would be too much in one day, but it was great! Nigel & Bosco were wonderful! Nigel had great stories & the ride was smooth, which definitely was a plus for me since I am prone to car sickness. Would want this duo again for other tours if they were available! Definite 5 stars!!
It was a great trip and the guide Toby was fantastic, very knowledgeable and extremely helpful. Quite hectic and not enough time to eat, but within 12 hours that’s the best can be done.

We were very impressed with Andy’s wealth of knowledge. He improvised story after story and left us with valuable historical information that actually stuck in our brains! He speaks from personal experience and an extensive resume of serving for the country of England. Definitely seek him out and you will not be disappointed!

Great tour. A little bit of everything. Good for my teens who didn’t want to spend hours in each place. It’s a great way to get acquainted with each spot. Our guide, Nigel and driver Bosco ran a very efficient tour which helped us navigate the crowds.

Our experience was undoubtedly great. While the views were amazing, the commentary given by our guide, Simon, made it all the better. His jokes were witty and informative, and hilarious at times. We would've wanted to spend more time at some sites, like Bath and Windsor Castle. However, you can expect such from a tour like this. Overall, very fun. I recommend.

We used Evans Tour bus line for our trip to Sonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath from London. If you don't have car then this really worked well. Just sit back and enjoy the ride. our guide (Sidi) and our driver (Lawrie) were great.

This trip is long but worth it. Please read other reviews. Most everyone is accurate with the description of how the tour works. The trip starts early and there is a bunch of bus travel. While on the bus our guide Andy Jackson did an excellent job telling us about UK history, he is very knowledgeable, and he got us in and out of the attractions as efficiently as possible. His commentary on UK history makes the bus trip go by quicker. There is about 1.5 hours for each stop, so if you want to spend a long time at any of these attractions you may want to book another tour for a specific attaction. Someone could spend a long time at Windsor, but about an hour at Stonehenge and Bath is good. You may want to take something to drink and eat since you will be rushed to get back to the bus. The guide will suggest places to get a sandwhich or quick snack which are good suggestions. Not time for a sit down lunch. Try to scheudle your trip on a day the changing of the guard takes place at Windsor. The buses are clean and comfortable. Windsor and Stonehenge have nice gift shops if you are looking for souvenirs.

We had Phil as our guide and Dennis as our driver, and our trip was excellent. Definitely a long day, and we were exhausted at the end, but we could not have asked for a better guide than Phil. He is truly passionate about history, and he seemed to know everything we could possibly want to understand. The Roman Baths were really cool. Highly recommend!

I really enjoyed this trip, and doubly so because of our tour guide, Toby James, who was gregarious, attentive to detail, and very caring about each of the 52 people on the tour. All in all, a great experience.

SHOUT OUT TO GUIDE RHYS AND DRIVER BOB! Really nice way to efficiently spend you time on south greater Britain. It's great to see so much and travel so far from the city. Really enjoy the trip, tour guide was knowledgeable, bubbly and talkative, driver was courteous and helps you out of the bus. Unlike what other reviews said about too much telling from the tour guide, I managed to catch some nice naps throughout the journey, and while I was awake I could hear some history about Britain, it's a nice mix! So if you want to make the most of a short time and don't want to worry about sorting out tickets and getting there get a booking. These tours (Rhys and Bob) are also nice in the sense that they are professionally organized, they know where to get good photos and how to get in early to avoid the long queues. I'm sure it'll be a nice experience (unless you bump into noisy (American) neighbors on the bus next to your group)

Had a fantastic day. Our guide Jennifer and driver Aston did great job keeping us on schedule and informed. You get a good taste of each of the 3 destinations. It’s a busy, long day but our 3 children (ages 12, 10, 8) handled it well. There is plenty of time on the bus to sleep/rest and we found enough time at Windsor and Bath to get food.
Our tour guide, Nigel, and bus driver, Valentin, on Tour 21 were stellar. Nigel was informative and entertaining.

My husband, 18yo son and I took this tour in June. We wanted to see as many sites as we could because we only have 6 days in London. This is a perfect tour to see three fabulous areas in one day and you don’t have t worry about driving. Our tour guide Nigel and bus driver Valentine were outstanding! Nigel is so knowledgeable and gave us interesting facts from the time we boarded the bus. Nigel has a vast knowledge of Britain’s history and he provides fascinating details that definitely make this tour worthwhile. We were all given a head set that allowed us to hear Nigel as he guided us to Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge. His instructions on what to see, where to grab a take out lunch and where the bus would meet us were extremely helpful. We recommend booking this tour and we highly recommend asking for Nigel and Valentine.
Awesome tour guide and driver! Had a hasslefree tour and little queuing with the well planning from the team.. Thanks Nigel and Valentine! Recommend all to take this tour..
Our tour guide was smart, succinct, and kept all of us interested. My two teens liked it, too. It was just enough for them. Great job to introduce us to two UNESCO sites!

The beauty and history of these place was only surpassed by the amazing and wonderful knowledge that we received from out tour guide Andy Jackson. He was smart, witty and entertaining. I would highly recommend this tour to everyone. I hope you are lucky enough to have Andy as your guide!
Chris was a wonderful tour guide. Very knowledgeable and was very courteous. We had a wonderful time

Our tour guide, Nigel, was incredible! He was very informative. It is an entire day trip but worth it. We beat the lines everywhere and although the drives were a little long the bus was comfortable and had great WiFi. Be aware that we only got an hour at each place- I thought this was enough for each site, so with that said, it’s a great introduction particularly to Windsor and the Baths.

Would highly recommend these tours. The guide were knowledgeable and helpful to share what they know about each places and gave us more information about the places of interest that we passed through during our journey.

Recommended for those who like to visit the 3 attractions. Due to the distance and the time, it is more of a touch-and-go tour so if you like to take your time to enjoy to attractions, this might not be for you.

Shout-out to Nigel and Valentin, who were excellent throughout the tour!

We absolutely loved the day trip to Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge! It was very convenient going with a group, we got in faster lines and had all tickets included. Andy was a great driver and Eugene was the BEST guide! He was super professional, very funny, and incredibly knowledgeable about the history of all the locations and other facts about the area. He made the day fun despite a traffic accident taking away some of our time in Bath. Overall would highly recommend for anyone looking to see multiple sites in a short time.

Absolutely fabulous tour- made better by the commentary, expertise, and knowledge of our tour guide, James. I can't believe we crammed all of these things into one day, and still felt like we had enough time in each place. I would absolutely recommend this tour

Nigel (whose last name is Fitzgerald, I think) speaks at least five languages, runs a tight ship, and knows his job extremely well.

He also knows the history of the sights we visited like I know the back of my own hand, and he has a very sonorous manner of speaking that makes me wonder if perhaps he missed out on a career in voice-over work.

My only gripe is that we felt rushed — but that is simply the nature of group tours. If you want to take your time, stroll around, and read every placard, then this is not the tour for you — but if you want to cram in a lot of activity in a relatively short time, go with Nigel.

If you do choose to take this tour, I urge you to keep your eye on the time, because what I said about Nigel running a tight ship was absolutely true. If you are late (and it’s easy to be late) the bus WILL leave you behind, and I hate to even contemplate what it might cost you to get back to London on your own.

If Nigel says, “Be back here at 1:15,” GET YOUR ASS BACK TO THE BUS BY 1:05, SHARP!!!

Things WILL take longer than you anticipate, so plan for that. Don’t aim to be on time; aim to be early.

Aside from that, it’s a great tour and a good value. I recommend it highly.
Would like to commend James our tour guide and Michael Angelo the coach driver. James is very knowledgeable and has a good sense of humour.
James and Michaelangelo were the best. Jame’s extreme knowledge was great. We could not have learned as much or done as much on a day doing it ourselves. Saved money too .

I attended this tour with a friend, and it gave us a chance to see three amazing sites in one day. Windsor Castle and Bath are quite hectic, and I think going in the group made it more enjoyable. We started off our day with a lovely guide (whose name I can’t recall), but lost track of time at Windsor Castle and missed our coach! Fortunately, Evan Evans Tours had another tour visiting the same locations (led by Peter), and we were able to see everything we wanted. So grateful for Peter’s graciousness! We enjoyed his tour immensely!
Only complaint is long line and security check at Windsor it was like going through the airport. Other than that tour was great

This activity was amazing, Windsor Castle was spectacular, the little towns were quaint a lot shops and restaurants, Stonehenge was beautiful. Our tour guide Andrew was the best so funny and charismatic. I definitely recommend this trip 👍🏼👍🏼

This was my first time in London and Tobi did a fantastic job! He was super informative, down to earth, honest and super funny! The wait for the attractions wasn’t long and you got to see so much! It is a little face paced for someone who likes to take there time however I would highly recommend this tour and tour guide as both were fantastic. Only advice I have is to make sure you bring proper rain gear! Safe Travels!

The tour guide Katie and our driver Laurie were absolutely fantastic. The knowledge they had and friendliness were above and beyond what I’ve ever experienced! Would definitely be back to join those two again!
Katie was our guide and Laurie was the driver. We had such a great time and the trip was so informative! The information given was so much more than just the basic stuff!

A great tour with a great professional guide name James he was outstanding!! Super knowledgeable gave us so much history and information would we really enjoyed the tour!! Even with a rainy day James was great that we were able to enjoy the entire tour!! Also our gratitude goes to Mark the driver under all the weather conditions with rain he made our trip safe and enjoyable!! We thank you Evan Evans for a great tour and staff!! Thank you James and Mark we hope we can enjoy another Tour with you both!

I booked this tour really only wanting to go and see Stonehenge. But was pleasantly surprised with Windsor castle and bath. The tour leader James was very knowledgeable, approachable and comedic at times. Even the driver Mark was a nice guy. Well worth the money, I recommend this tour.

Excellent day with the family. Our tour guide Eugene was fantastic. It is a long day, but goes by quickly. There is enough time at each stop to truly get an appreciation. You could spend days in Windsor alone. I highly recommend the tour.

The combo of Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath would not be easy to accomplish with out this tour... and tour guide Alexandria made it a memorable experience! You can look at it as "not enough time in each place" or "wow, what a day it was seeing three fantastic sites". It is a push, and you will probably wish you had a little more time at each... but you will probably not feel like you did not have enough time to see a good bit of each site. Lunch is a quick grab and eat on the bus, but again that's the only way to accomplish three trips/great sites in one day
Eugene was a great host and very knowledgeable. He incorporated humour and was a delight! Mo was a great driver as well. Would highly recommend the tour with him.

We are very lucky to be assigned to James of Evans Evans as our guide. He is very knowledgeable, experience and charismatic. He has a great sense of humour. He always emphasises on safety throughout the trip. The coach driver , Ben, is a safe, experience and careful driver. Tips : grab your sandwich on the go. We bought ours at the Windsor and Eton station. No time for a sit down lunch. Time is crucial so please be punctual so that the group can cover all 3 places on time. Skip the audio guides for all 3 places as there is really no time for that. Approx 2 hrs ride to Windsor. 1hr 45mins at Windsor. Then 1hr + coach ride to Bath. We are given 1hr 25mins at Bath. another 1hr+ coach ride to Stonehenge. we returned back to London Gloucester station at 7.45pm. Very rush itinerary but I personally feels that James and Ben have done their best to maximise the time. I will certainly recommend anyone to join Evans Evans for the day trip to Windsor, bath and Stonehenge. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

My daughter and I traveled to London recently and decided to take an Evan Evans tour. What a great experience! Our tour guide, Andy Jackson, was so informative about every aspect of the historical significance of each destination and was so welcoming! I highly recommend joining his tour whenever possible! He made the tour exciting and was able to move the group swiftly to each place that we were able to be in front of the line for The Roman Bath tour, and Windsor Castle! Great at being prompt with time in order for the group to receive the best experience! Thank you Evan Evans and Andy!!

Tour guide Kevin and driver Mike were friendly and knowledgeable. Kevin shared historical information about each stop and he engaged both the English and non-English speaking groups with ease. The bus was clean and comfortable (thanks for rule about no hot, smelly food on the bus). There isn't a bathroom on the bus but the schedule allows for breaks at each stop.

Best part of the tour was Stonehenge. Highly recommend seeing it in person.

Tour company instructions for meet up location need to be improved, including signage where possible. People were waiting outside the station instead of entering it and we were on the wrong line for 15 minutes. Recommend tour company include tipping guidelines to avoid confusion.

Important for everyone to return back to the bus at the time mandated - 10 min late leaving the first stop added about 30 minutes overall to an already long day as we were forced to wait behind for 3 other tour companies who were behind us initially. Be respectful of others and return on time.

We have such a lovely evening with Evans tours (Pieter).
Thank you for bringing us and back safely and we have such good experiences and will recommend to other friends and families about this tour.
Thank You

I was fortunate to be in London and booked an Evan Evans Tour to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath. It was a long but amazing day. Our tour guide was Nicholas and bus driver Andy. Nicholas was extremely informative regarding London and the sights that we saw and had a great sense of humor. At the end of the tour on the way home, he went to each person on the bus and told them which stop to get off based on where they were staying and provided tips on what to see in the area. I actually took his advice and saw some other fascinating stuff in the city! He went well above and beyond. Excellent tour overall and highly recommended.

Our tour guide Phil and our bus driver Steve really made the whole experience wonderful. I learned a lot not just the history of our destination, but also UK history in general. Our tour guide really know the history like the back of his hand. The whole trip was really enjoyable, even my non english speaking parents were able to enjoy it too. I would recommend for everyone to join the tour. Thank you so much!

From the moment we got on the tour bus our guide Eugene had a smile on his face. Dare I say he may be the best tour guide I've ever had. So well informed, so well organized as we arrived at all the sites, to the moment we left the bus and he made sure everyone had directions to their next plans. Now the actual sites - Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge - all incredible and exceeding expectations! Would we have liked more time at each, sure, but there are only so many hours in the day. We feel is was just the right amount of time at each site i.e. we toured the rooms at Windsor, the museum at the baths in Bath and the exhibits at Stonehenge. Even had time for an ice cream.
We had a great time and left feeling very well informed! Highly recommend this tour with Eugene and excellent driver Valentine!

This was a wonderful day trip! I would highly recommend it to anyone who is going to London! We booked through Evans Evans tour and it was simple and easy to do! We had a great and very knowlegable tour guide, Rowan, and the bus driver Kee was very friendly!

I took my two kids on this day tour and we loved it. This is a great way to get out of London and see some other sites and experience a different part of England. Claudia was a great guide - great voice, very funny and very informative. Dave was a great driver. Highly recommend!
Our guide, James, was excellent. He’s extremely knowledgeable, entertaining & fun. He’s very enthusiastic and high-energy! We highly recommend him & @evanevanstours

Our tour guide was Armyn Hennessy. He was great. Very knowledgeable. The bus was very comfortable. The tour starts with Windsor Castle then Bath and ends with Stonehenge. All great sites. Definitely worth a day trip.

Trip was great, made even better by our guide (whose name escapes me), but he was fantastic. History teacher by day, so he had the knowledge plus a sense of humor to go with it. Really a great day....!

This tour was wonderful. Our tour guide Rowan was absolutely superb. It was clear that she cared about the history of each site and it was great getting to hear all of her knowledge. It made each stop much more meaningful!

We went on this day trip because we wanted to see the English countryside and we sure did! The views were beautiful and we got to see Windsor castle, the Roman baths, and Stonehenge! Our guide was toby who was kind, knowledgable, and went to each individual person to help them get home and provide dinner recommendations. Thanks Toby (and bob our trustworthy bus driver!)

Andrew was an amazing tour guide. He let us go where we wanted and look at what was special to us. He didn't take all our free time talking. He knew how to explain things with interest and let us go. He was also so entertaining for a long bus ride. Please do this tour and ask for Andrew as your guide.

This is a lot to do in one day, but they do a great job of making it all happen. These are three really amazing destinations. You really could spend much more time in both Windsor and Bath. Such beautiful quaint towns. If you have limited time and really want to see all three I highly recommend this tour. It is a long day, but well worth it.
Nigel our tour guide was great. We were on tour #21.
I enjoyed it so much, I look forward to coming back to London in the future and spending more time in both Windsor and Bath.
Well done Evans and Evans!
This trip was amazing and our guide Andy Jackson's was exceptional. He is so informative and he always goes above and beyond what needs to, to help you.
We joined group tour 21 led by Nigel & Tom to Windsor, Bath & Stonehenge. It was a lovely day! Nigel is a very knowledgeable guide.

Our guide, Nigel, and driver, Tom, provided such a wonderful experience on this day trip. They were extremely knowledgeable and friendly. The tour takes you to three wonderful sites with admittance fees included in the price. The coach was comfortable and the service was great. Would highly recommend for a day out of busy London!
This was a very professionally run tour. The tour guide was interesting, funny, and helpful when we got into the town of Bath. Everything was on-time and we really enjoyed it.

I traveled with a group of 5 on May 25, 2019. Our tour guide was Steven Maynard. When researching this tour, I was under the impression we would travel by "small" motor coach. I was very surprised that not only was our transport not a small coach, it was the largest in the bus depot! A double decker bus! The bus did get us to where we needed to go but because of the amount of people on the tour, it took a long time loading and unloading, especially unloading, which translates into a smaller amount of time at the attraction. With such a large group, it was impossible for most of everyone to hear any commentary that was offered while we were standing in line, waiting for tickets or waiting for a venue to open. Most other tours I have been on offer headsets where we could hear anything our guide was saying to the group, very frustrating to hear bits and pieces but not the full story, some in my group couldn't hear anything being said. Windsor was our first stop and I felt we could have used maybe 30 additional minutes here but did not feel the visit was inadequate. The next stop was Bath and we did get to visit the Roman Baths with adequate time but there was only a very little time for a rushed lunch, no other time for exploration of the town or even a quick peek into the Abbey. I would recommend to anyone taking this tour, to bring a sack lunch with you! Once aboard the bus again, we were told we had to hurry to Stonehenge and our guide hoped that they wouldn't close before we go there! Not something a paying customer wants to hear, that we may not get where we paid to go! Steven really should have kept that worry to himself...we did make it in time, but only because the summer time hours had just started that week. As we were getting off the bus at Stonehenge, audio guides and tickets were handed out as passengers stepped off the bus. There weren't enough audio guides for about 12 of us who were last off the bus but that didn't seem to bother Steven. We were told to go to the visitors office to find one ourselves (which they hadn't collected and cleaned from previous visitors yet). If I were the guide, I would have gone myself to find the remaining headsets and brought them to my people, even if it meant finding them by the stones. I was extremely disappointed in his nonchalance in the group not having the audio. It is a nice idea to visit 3 major attractions in one day but in retrospect, it was too much for one day, especially with a very large group.

Excellent outing to Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge! Rowan was an excellent guide! She gave us so much information about each site, and additional little tidbits of interesting information about so much more along the way. The whole day was great - so interesting and informative! I highly recommend this tour and this tour guide Rowan. AAA+++
Such amazing moment with Katia our tourist guide which borught us such amazing moments. Every time in which attraction was very good planned. Thanks Katia and Mark driver.

The day is long, the stops are short. If you're someone who likes to take their time and mosey around, this tour is not for you. As a solo traveler, this tour was perfect and my tour guide was wonderful. The bus was nice and clean.

It was nice to leave all the planning to someone else. I enjoyed this tour, but as tours often go you don’t have enough time. First stop is Windsor Castle; arrived early & had to wait in line for castle to open. Didn’t have too much time, but enough to visit staterooms, snap some photos, & visit the gift shop. Second stop Bath; here we had more time to explore. If you choose to visit the Roman Baths you have less time to explore. (I personally was disappointed in Bath; wouldn’t visit there again.) Third stop Stonehenge. This was my favorite stop of the day. There was plenty of time to take in the monuments. I do remember rushing around gift shop though. Guide was very educated & well versed in history. Bus was comfortable. It was just a lot to see in one day, but I would recommend it; especially if you’re limited on time.

Booking out tour with Day Tours London was the best! It was a small van that took us there and back, no frills or extra add-ons, we booked the morning half day trip. We wanted to experience seeing Stonehenge and nothing else. Our driver was great and was a great tour guide explaining to us all about the sights we seen on the way. Best Value for sure.

Took this tour for a bucket list trip to England! Our tour guide was Claudia and our driver was Dave. 5 stars!!! Highly recommend both. Their banter was brilliant and both seem to really care about the customers. Had such a great time. Highly recommend the tour also!! It was bloody Brilliant!

For travelers who are focused on historical and cultural theme tours as we are, this tour will probably resonate with you. To see these landmarks and learn more about each was certainly worth the time spent traveling from one site to the other. This tour satisfied our long-term desires to visit Stonehenge and the mysteries surrounding its construction, and Windsor Castle in light of the Royal Weddings that have taken place there recently. As for the visit to City of Bath, we consider it to be a plus. But for this destination being included in the tour, we probably would not have visited the city on our own. It is a picturesque idyllic town and it’s always a memorable experience to stand among Roman ruins. Though our group was large, our guide, Ildi, did a great job shepherding us through all the lines in a timely manner, as well as highlighting information about each landmark, top attractions and points of interests along the way. We also appreciate her added insight about the Royal Family and its many traditions. She is the consummate guide, knowledgeable, professional, articulate, courteous, punctual, and possesses a bit of British humor, which brought us laughter along the way. The bus was clean, comfortable, and air conditioned. We welcomed the relaxation it provided after each walking tour. Viator Tours is our preferred go-to-tour provider when traveling. We look forward to our next tour with them.

This was the one tour outside the city we took during our week in London. Be aware that this is a LONG day. You will spend about 12hours on the tour. Be prepared with snacks and such.

Our tour started at the Victoria Coach Station. There were uniformed folks form Evan Evans tours there to point us to the proper boarding area. The bus was new and clean and comfortable. There was no bathroom, though. Surprisingly, the bus had phone chargers and even WIFI!

Our tour guide was Nicholas. He was amusing and informative. He was easy to understand. They provided us with a VOX audio box and headphone (tip, bring your own earphones the ones they give you are not the best) so everyone could hear him.

The first stop was Windsor Castle. It was an hour ride. They planned it so we were there early and thus didn’t have to wait in a huge line. We ended up waiting about half an hour before the castle opened. There was a security check then we were free to explore the castle at our own pace. The castle provided an audio guide which was very helpful. Windsor castle was very impressive and beautiful. we had about 90 minutes there.

Then we took a slightly longer ride to Bath. The Baths were very cool to see, but extremely crowded the day we were there which was a Sunday. We had to wait a bit longer for our turn to enter the Roman Bath area. Even with the prepaid entry, it was very crowded inside the bath areas. Like Windsor, they had an audio guide which we could key in to areas along the tour. The museum section was especially crowded, but was worth seeing.

Stonehenge was another hour or so away. The stones are about a mile away from the visitor center and you can either walk or take a shuttle bus. We were told we would really not have time to walk there and back. The tour provided us a map with numbers which would play on our VOX and provide more information about different areas at the site. It actually worked pretty well. You cannot actually touch the stones, but you can walk around the perimeter and see them pretty well. There is also a visitor center which is worth seeing.

I would suggest purchasing the entry for all 3 areas. There are other things to do at Windsor and Bath because there are towns with shopping, etc, but not so much at Stonehenge.

Overall the tour seemed well organized and it was a good way to see a lot in one day. We seemed to get some preferential access to the areas since we were part of a tour group.

There are some places to get food on the tour, but not a lot of time. I would suggest bringing a sandwich and some snacks. however, note that there is not hot food allowed on the bus.

We were able to leave backpacks and purses on the bus.

It is a great way to see a lot, but be prepared for a long day.
It was great, bus was big but very accommodating, the guide was very informative and pleasant to listen to. And we were able to do own thing, unstructured at the sites.

Evan was a great guide and Dennis phenomenal
Driver!! Thank you
Bath Windsor and Stonehenge where must sees
This trip was the best. The driver and guide knew everything you would need to know. It was rushed with 3 tours. We should have done only two to see everything but would use Evan's and Evan's again.

My mother and I had the best time on this tour. I usually hate tours like this but found this one to be well organized and entertaining. Our tour guide, Manon, was absolutely lovely and quite funny. She made sure we were the first in at Windsor and kept the tour very organized throughout the day. She provided interesting historical background along the way and also gave helpful suggestions such as where to get the best ice cream or find the best bathrooms. This tour gets you from place to place but lets you do as you please at each site, so there is a nice bit of freedom there. I went into this day expecting to be annoyed at being herded around but was so pleasantly surprised. I cannot recommend this tour enough if you’re in England for a short stay!

Had a great fun with Cardia and Nicky. It was well planned and the trip had all the time for leisure and photo ops..Recommended for every visitor to UK to have any of their tours.. They organised systematic and very empathetic.. Thanks Evan and Evans

Roweyn is an excellent guide! She made a long day very enjoyable. Each stop is quick but it’s a great way to see the most in one day. Each place is absolutely stunning! Recommend grabbing a sandwich in Windsor on the way back to the bus and bring snacks and water.

I live in London and have visited Windsor before, but had some friends in town who also wanted to see Bath and Stonehenge. We kind of knew it would be a long day, and it was, but really it's probably the only way to see all three sites so quickly. I was a bit disappointed that St. George's Chapel was closed at Windsor Castle, as Lady Gabriella Windsor's wedding was being held the day after our visit, although that of course isn't the fault of the tour company. Maybe check in advance, if possible, and book accordingly. In general, it's A LOT of time on a bus, and you don't get super long at each place, so it ends up feeling quite rushed. If it were just me, I'd probably prefer to do just two of the sites in a single day, and have longer at each. There's no built-in time to eat, so you're basically just grabbing something quickly on your own time. So bring (cold, non-liquid or else they'll not let you have them on the bus) snacks! Godfrey was our tour guide, and he was informative, energetic and quite funny. Steve was the driver, and he was excellent too. They even went around to everyone on the bus near the end of the day, figured out where people needed to go after the tour, and made three stops, taking people to their preferred destination. I was pretty pleased with that, as the Victoria bus terminal is a mess and not all that close to where we live. Getting dropped off five mins from home was much better!

Took the trip today with my spouse and the trip was amazing. Thank you to Nicky and Godfrey for making the trip worthwhile. The commentary on the coach was exemplary and refreshing. I would have liked for Godfrey to accompany us during the tour itself however I understand the regulations and protocols. We will definitely use this company in the future as it is the best one we have used throughout our European travels.
Celia (guide) and Steve (driver) were very professional. The tour was a great value - would definitely recommend.

We absolutely loved our Guide James he had us thoroughly informed all day long even about things that werent apart the tour but he had his own abundant personal knowledge about! He was so well spoken and had us in fits of laughter in the back seat with his English humour. It was an honour to be shown such beautiful places by a man who was clearly so passionate about each place and the history behind it I am so happy I got on James and Thomas' bus for this tour. Thomas was also very funny polite and friendly. Thank you Evans Evans Tours for choosing such fabulous people to guide us through our day!!

The trip was well organized and informative. Our guide was knowledgable and funny. It is not enough free time to walk around the streets or to eat. Hovewer,keep in mind, you will see three places in one day. My husband and I had a good experience! I personally recommend this trip with this company!
Completely worth it!! Peter was a fantastic guide, and made the tour very fun and informative. It was incredible getting to see 3 amazing destinations - this tour gave us a great taste of each.

Really enjoyed it, Peter was a really funny and knowledgeable guide and Tom was a great driver. This experience was a great taste of west England. Especially liked the rolling hills and countryside views in all three locations!

It has been a fantastic 12 hour episode for us (party of 4) taking this tour, our first time to Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. Guide Eugene acted more like a friend showing the sights and sharing "behind the scenes" information while Jane was behind the wheels provided us the safe and smooth ride. Eugene's great and valuable orientation and insights on the places we were about to enter made us feel we did not need the audio guides provided at Windsor and The Roman Baths and truly we had more time to explore and take pictures. More enjoyable! "Easy easy lemon squeezy".. At the end of the day, Eugene personally attended to each of us on what we would want to know like getting back to our hotels and places to eat. Nice of him to suggest to us that we can take the 1st drop off at Gloucester Road to take the Tube back to Paddington instead of getting off at Victoria Station. The friendliness of Eugene and the smooth driving of Jane reflects on the management of Evan Evans. We'll book Evan Evans again in our future visits to Great Britain. Lovely as they say.

The tour is good as long as you know what to expect. It is RUSHED, but you are doing three major attractions in a day. There is NO time for food, and hot food is not allowed on the bus. You will either subsist on snacks or go hungry. Finally, it is not a guided tour in the sense that your guide takes you through the sites. Your guide will provide commentary during parts of the drive and get you into the attractions; that’s it. You will have audio guides, but with as rushed as your visits are, you will only partially get to listen. The buses are clean and nice, though, and the guides are friendly and available for questions.

in 12 hours you will be touring three historic places: 900 years old Windsor Castle, 2000+ years old Roman Bath and 5000+ years old Stonehenge, so much history in one day! amazing tour and unforgettable time spent. strongly recommended for those having very limited time in UK.

We're usually not into the tourist trap sort of tour, but with a short time frame in London this was perfect. James was ever so humorous and informative and our driver Michael Angelo was competent and prompt to arrive at designated times.thoroughly enjoyed our day.

James was an excellent and very comical tour guide with a wealth of information; we really enjoyed how efficient he was with getting us everywhere and early to beat the crowds. Mark (I hope that was his name) was a very good driver and made sure we were safe. Thank you!
Mel was a very experienced guide. Well worth the long day touring. We had picture perfect weather to tour all of these sites too.

It was a wholesome tour as we got to visit all three attractions at once. Our bus broke down at Stonehenge but our tour guide, Nigel( funny and humorous) swifly found a replacement bus while making more stops at different places during the return journey to allow us to go back to our hotels faster.

Will definitely recommend to others.

We had a wonderful day trip with James as our guide and Valentine as our driver. Both were great! James was the best most informative tour guide I’ve ever encountered. He was so knowledgeable on many subjects & really seemed to enjoy the day with us & was super efficient at getting us to each destination quickly. The sights were great as well! I would highly recommend this as a London day trip!

Sacha Armando as a coach and guide for the tour was awesome, full of energetic and sharing good information.

Definitely worth your.
James and Mark were absolutely wonderful! I’m so glad I booked this trip, tons of good information and priceless sights!
If you want to see the 3 places in a day, this is your trip. James was very knowledgeable and didn’t come off dry. He made sure we made the most of the time we had at each place!

Our tour guide Allen was amazing! He was so knowledgable and witty! He was very engaging and his humor kept us all laughing! The trip may seem long, but it went by so fast. Evans and Evans was an excellent tour company and again can't say enough great things about Allen our guide. Our guide knew all the tricks to beat the crowds and we saw so much because of it. The Roman Baths, Stonehenge and Windor were amazing. Do yourself a favor and book this tour!

We took the Windsor, Bath tour and Stonehenge tour. The coach was clean and new. The trip was perfect. We most enjoyed the tour guy, Peter. He was so knowledgeable about area. He mixed it up with information about the history of the area but also information about things I never knew. He was so kind and patient with the guests. He also made sure we knew where we were going after the tour ended. Peter made the trip wonderful. If you get the opportunity to take this tour try to get with Peter.

I just completed the Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge tour and it was a blast! James is very knowledgeable about the locations and history and conveyed the information with the right mix of humor and sass. Valentine was the driver and got us to our destinations safely.

Went on the coach tour (Evans and Evans) to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. Our tour guide was Manon. She was exceptional. Our bus driver Nadia was also excellent. We enjoyed it immensely. A wonderful day. Highly recommend.

This one day tour was great to see outside the London city limits. It’s a full day trip that covers a lot so be prepared with snacks to munch on the bus because sometimes there’s not enough time to eat at the locations. It’s a good tour if you’re in London for a short period of time.

First of all, we were quite fortunate with no rain. The day started off early and we made it to Windsor Castle in record time since it was a bank holiday. Yes, we had to stand in line for 45 minutes at Windsor but we were the first group there! That made so much difference! As it turned out, we were there the same morning as the birth of Harry and Megan's baby. From Windsor we went to Bath and ended the day at Stonehenge. I loved it all. What made the day even better was the knowledge our guide, Rhys, shared! He was exceptional! The Evan Evans tour was well organized. I can't say enough about Rhys' skills and communication abilities.

The weather is not on our side. Regardless our tour guide Andy Jackson is the star and he could be my British history teacher if he happens to teach. I just wish I did a separate tour for Stonehenge and Bath only to spend more time there.

***You need to pay attention for the meet up point and timing after visiting each attraction especially if you are traveling alone! Better to pack some food with you as there is no lunch break. Oh wait bring umbrellas too

It was an absolute whirlwind, but a great way to see some of the major sites in the UK in a single day. I greatly enjoyed the tour guide, who was formally employed by the crown, and knew a lot about historic England. I

We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Rowan and Dave. Rowan was informative, friendly, and full of personality. She knew many facts on local history and presented them in a fun and engaging way. A real pleasure! Dave kept the big bus rolling safely along the many windy roads throughout the day!
The time allotted at each stop seemed about right for us. Perhaps if you are someone who likes to thoroughly investigate things you may feel a bit rushed. I didn't hear of anyone being disappointed with the time we had. Being at the front of the line when we visited Windsor Castle was especially nice!
We opted to take the tour while in Bath. If you choose not to, you can easily busy yourself around the town. We thought the tour was interesting.
Stonehenge was good to see. You are not allowed to go near or touch the stones, that is only permitted on the two solstices. Still such a wonder to see.
Bring a lunch or buy something along the way to eat during the drive. Remember cold food only! Would recommend!

There is a lot to see in a short amount of time, so you will need to move fast on this tour. It’s a little rushed, but that’s expected when seeing so much in one day. I would highly recommend this tour, and Evan Evans. Our tour guide Godfrey was so informative and friendly. He was always very clear on the pickup locations and when we needed to be back. The drive wasn’t bad, it was just a long time stuck in a bus. Our driver Nicki handled the roads with ease though. If you have a spare day and want to see some of the sights outside of London, this trip would be a great choice for you!

Our tour guide Godfrey was excellent. Very informative and helpful. It was a very busy day with lots of walking but being able to see so much in one trip was amazing. I never could have done it without the tour.

Although we got to see all 3 places in one day, you really need more time in both Windsor and Bath. Our bus departed at 8 and we arrived at Windsor at 9. The doors to Windsor do not open until 9:30 and we were sent to the back of a VERY long queue. Then, we had to go through security so we really only had about 80 minutes to explore the castle.. I felt rushed and I really would have liked to spend more time, especially the town itself. Just an FYI, no photography, whatsoever, inside the castle.
We only had about 90 minutes in Bath and again, I would have liked to explore the town more.
That being said, our tour guide Godfrey and our driver Mark were very good, funny and informative.

Long day but Toby and Lisa our driver kept us informed and safe, Toby was excellent with his knowledge of history and the places we saw and interacted well with all the passengers, and with Lisa at the wheel we felt completely safe, recommend these very highly.

James our tour guide was fantastic; our first trip in London, It is the most memorable trip in London. James an English gentleman, knows what he is talking about. My family and I really appreciate your professionalism, my son 14 years of age still talk about you today 100% Recommended ask for James and Valentine very good driver!

James our tour guide and our driver Steve teamed up to give us a fantastic day out. Number one we were ahead of queues all day. James clearly knew his stuff - and not just about the tour sights but about London living and history and made it funny, relatable and thoroughly enjoyable. Steve negotiated our bus through small streets with ease for a very comfortable ride. Options were given for alternatives if stairs were an issue for anyone. Meeting points and departure times were clearly advised.
On a very personal note, James went above and beyond to locate our daughters missing ipad (left behind along the tour) and organise the return to us for which we cannot thank him enough. Will absolutely recommend this tour to anyone who asks.

Honestly the tour is full of knowledge an of course the tour guide Tobby was great and happy to answer all kinda questions . The french lady bus driver "E" is the most cheerful and friendly person ever.. u will have enough time to see all the 3 places with enough time. My personal fav place is bath cuz its kinda an old village with a lot of history. Its a must to go :).
the highlight was Lacock, such a cute village. the guide was funny and the driver was a good one ( I d suffer from motion sickness, and IF I felt great ... )

The other reviewers will tell you how wonderful the tour sites are, so I will tell you about our experience with the tour operator. Evan Evans Tours were excellent! They were very efficient and allowed sufficient time to tour each site. It should be noted that the Victoria Coach Station (pick up location) is about a block up from the Victoria Train Station so allow an extra 10 minutes or more for the walk if riding the Tube to the pick up location. Wear good walking shoes, and dress in layers. We left on time for each tour stop. The tour guide (Jldi) was very good and gave a lot of detail for each site. The order of the tour was Windsor Castle, Bath, then Stonehenge. We arrived at Windsor Castle around 9:00 AM; gates open at 9:30. Each visitor goes through airport style security but it goes quickly. We had about 2 hours to tour the castle. Individual audio tours are included and recommended. We were there on a day scheduled for a changing of the guards. We skipped the ceremony and had a late breakfast in the village. It's important to know that food is available at each of the stops, but no toilets on the coaches. Water and cold foods are allowed on the coach. The next stop was Bath which was a couple of hours away. The coaches are very comfortable and many on the bus napped. At Bath we toured the Roman Baths.Its an indoor museum. Again, the individual audio tour is recommended. At the end of the tour you can taste the mineral water if you like. It's filtered but served warm and has a heavy mineral/copper taste. After the tour we had a chance to get some ice cream in town near the bus pick up spot. The last stop was Stonehenge. A shuttle takes visitors out to the site. The pillars are roped off but you can walk completely around the site. The self-guided audio tour allows you to punch in a code and listen at each stop at your own pace. Traffic wasn't bad heading back into the city, but we didn't arrive at the drop off location until 19:00. The coach dropped us off on the other side of the Victoria Train Station, right in front of a wonderful Italian restaurant called Il Posto Ristorante. It was the perfect way to end a wonderful day.

Golden Tours was an ok choice but if I could repeat might go with Evans and Evans or Vivitar. It was a little cheaper so we choose it. However, that was reflected in the guide and the information shared and how it was shared. Evans and Evans uses headsets making it so easy to hear the guide and they shared info when you were waiting to get into Windsor and Bath. The lunch was awful and the bus had no wifi which may it hard to my teens/tweens to enjoy the long ride. Golden tours did do a good job on time and it was wonderful to see these sites with out having to drive in England.
Team Oliver and Bob were great! I was amazed by Oliver's knowledge of London and he had a great sense of humor.

Our trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath was great. The Jack-the-Ripper portion of our other tour was cancelled. We agreed to continue with the other aspects of that tour but that turned out to be a bad idea. They wouldn’t refund us for the canceled trip in advance, so I had to call once we returned state-side. After two international calls, I was told to forward them the email they sent to me, as it wasn’t saved in their server, for a refund. I think we were eventually refunded about $100 less than was fair, and every time I called, I had to start all over with my problems, as it didn’t seem their system tracked issues over time. So - if your tour actually leaves, it’s fine. Otherwise, be careful. Also - they don’t fully explain all the tours online.

My wife and i really enjoyed this day trip.windsor castle is real nice with the little town that surrounds it.we wished that we could have stayed in bath longer.real nice old town.stonehenge was cool.out in the middle of the country.overall nice trip.

This was a great day with a great Guide.

First was traveled to Windsor to visit the castle & then onto Bath to see the Roman Baths.

It would have been nice to be able to spend more time at both places as both town & city are very picturesque. However keeping in mind we were traveling a long distance to fit the day in.

Bath was gorgeous & you truly felt as you had stepped into a story book.
The baths were quite crowded & I would have been happier exploring the village.

Heading out to Stonehenge & passing through the small villages & rolling paddock covered in bright yellow canola was very pretty.

All in all a great day trip.

Getting the right guide on these things is always the trick. We had Mel this day who was a freelancer with a great History background who really made the trip for us. Stories...advice...and of course jokes! The timing of everything was spot on! It’s a 12+ hour tour so be warned up front but outside of Bath (could have spent the entire day there...and will next time) you had more than enough time to enjoy the sites without being rushed! Highly recommend

We very much enjoyed the day trip to Windsor Castle, City of Bath, and Stonehenge. So much exposure to English history and culture! Oliver the guide was brilliant: good humored, urbane, friendly, courteous, concerned about our safety and enjoyment, and very knowledgeable about the sights and environs. Bob the driver demonstrated serious driving skills, allowing us to enjoy the trip without any worries. It was a day well spent and one which no one in my party will ever forget. We already wish to come back to London for more touring. Thank you again, Oliver and Bob.

Really enjoyable tour. Great guide "Eugene" and driver. Actually left someone behind who was delaying the tour, which i think is great. Fun commentary, good lunch, generally highly recommend for countryside tour.

A very busy, yet fun day! Took the tour with my 16-year old son. Our guide provided excellent information and local 'color'. Unlike other bus tour guides I've experienced, she spoke is a tone that was easy to listen to - not in a robotic manner.She would also switch to fluent Japanese periodically, for the Japanese tour members - very impressive! The audio headsets worked well and enhanced the trip.
This is definitely a 'highlights' tour, so you don't have time to fully experience each site. There is enough time however to enjoy each site. Comfortable shoes are a must.
Would recommend without hesitation!
Great tour! James was an awesome, highly entertaining guide, and the driver Nadia was excellent, too.
The tour itself was kept on schedule; the tour guide Nicholas was very informative & enthusiastic. The driver Dave was professional & safe. Overall; highly recommended.

Our tour guide Oliver did a great job and we had a great time even though our particular group was almost unmanageable. There must have been something in the water that day.

Many people seemed let down by Stonehenge but we were not. It’s impressive what people were able to do 5,000 years ago moving these enormous rocks. We enjoyed Bath, but it was the least interesting site of the three probably because we’ve spent time in Italy before this visit. Our favorite site was Windsor castle and wish we could have spent more time there.

Thanks again to Oliver for an interesting and humorous trip.

This was a great way to see 3 separate venues in one day. The entire trip was 12 hours but well worth it to see these different places. My family of 4, including 2 teenagers, really enjoyed the experience. Our tour guide Alex was great—very nice, knowledgeable and helpful! I highly recommend this trip.

This is a long day, but well worth it for the remarkable visits and information. James, our guide, is an encyclopedia of knowledge and kept us on schedule to get everything fit into the day which includes about 350 miles of bus travel.
Wow!

Mel Adams, our tour guide who led us throughout the day's visits, was simply excellent. He represented himself and Evan Evans Tours well. The day is a long one, starting at 8am, but for a first-time visitor these tours are a great way to get a taste of Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. There is a lot of traveling by bus; kudos to our driver Malcolm for the mammoth task of driving all those miles and deftly maneuvering a massive bus through traffic. Stops at the sites are limited, so move with a purpose and see what you want to see. Lines at some sites can take a while, so be prepared. Mel kept us entertained with tales of history to pass the time, and it was greatly appreciated. We were very pleased with the experience, and would heartily recommend Evan Evans Tours, Mel, and Malcolm!

Family of 5 traveled with Godfrey and Mark, a very patient team. Our driver Mark was efficient and safe. Our guide Godfrey was knowledgeable and shared stories along the way. We remarked how this would have been a laborious trip if we had to drive it ourselves and most certainly would have been more expensive. The day trip gives you a flavor for these 3 areas - just right for teens!

Recommend packing snacks and water for the bus. There’s not a lot of time to eat during the stops especially if you’re trying to soak in as much as you can on the tours. The ride is comfortable, there are USB chargers and the WiFi is pretty good.

All in all, a great day trip!

The tour guide, Rowan, was fantastic! She was so bubbly and accommodating. Her knowledge of England ‘s history behind the places we visited is admirable. She was courteous, and was also very entertaining. The tour became fun with her as our guide!
We just returned from the day tour of Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. Loved everything. James was amazingly informative and entertaining - a real encyclopedia of history and other information.

This was a brilliant tour, despite the weather. Our wonderful guide James(also our comedian), our brilliant driver Kee, ensured we were taken care of the whole day! James is very knowledgeable and helpful with the areas we visited and made sure we knew everything we needed to know prior to experiencing the location. I highly recommend Evan Evans Tours, and pop in a request for James and Kee, (or was that Rebecca and Pixie? Another of James’ jokes) 😂 You will remain entertained the whole day! Thanks guys, I’ll be back 😁

James the tour guide and Valentine the driver were absolutely wonderful. James was hysterical, I had a lot of laughs. James took good care of us and got us to each stop before all the other tour buses, getting us in first. Really informative tour and perfect amount of time at each stop. Would highly recommend.

It was very well organized, our guide Hildi provided useful and practical information. We did not have to queue long to get tickets at Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and the Roman Baths in Bath.

It is a “taster” as Hildi said, because you need more than 2 hours at each venue. The time was restricted because Stonehenge and Bath are quite far away.

Laurie drove expertly back from Bath to avoid the traffic and we only encountered traffic back in London. We were asked where we were staying and for those staying at places before Victoria we were dropped off at the nearest underground station or bus.

I would highly recommend the tour and the guide Hildi and driver Laurie.

We took the tour on Friday, 29th March.

We had a great day touring the 3 sites with Phil. He has an amazing knowledge of British history and very interesting commentary throughout the day. This is a very long tour - about 13 hours - and I wish Evan Evans would limit the age to those over 5 years old. It is simply not enjoyable for the young ones and causes delays and disruptions to the rest of us. Otherwise, I highly recommend.

I’ve been on many, many tours and the quality of the guide and driver on this tour were exceptional. Phil had a high level of knowledge of the sites and local (British) culture in general that is rare in tour guides, and kept it interesting as well as informative. His enthusiasm and clarity was also top notch. Malcolm did an excellent and safe job of driving the coach, and managed to avoid the traffic jams from two major accidents to get us back to London efficiently. Bravo!

A wonderful experience and a highlight of our first trip to London! The day was packed full of historic locations and magnificent scenery. The absolute best part of the tour was our guide, James. He was delightful, entertaining, and literally a walking encyclopedia. He was efficient and made sure we made the most out of time. In addition to his humor and anecdotes, he was very informative and shared historical information about each destination. We highly recommend this tour group, and be sure to ask for James. You will not be disappointed!

Of course, if you have time you should do all those attractions separately, so I'm not even gonna mention "not enough time". If you book three major attractions for one trip there won't be enough time!:)

The tour itself though was extremely well organized! Katya, our guide was very informative, helpful, funny, and had everything running smoothly. We were very happy with everything. Thank you for a great trip!

We quiet enjoyed the trip. Well honestly we primary booked it to finally see Stonehenge even if it was quiet windy. So take care! The Tour was well organized and equipped. And yes Alex was awesome and informed us very well during the Tour. :)

Well organized, convenient trip, a good way to see the sites without the hassle of planning your own trek! I loved the whole experience! My family (2 kids aged 1 and 4) did the day trip and it was great, a long day but well worth it! The sites were amazing, as expected, but I was extremely impressed with the guide, Catya, and our driver, Tom. Catya has an extensive knowledge of the history and ties it all in with the sites as well as fun facts. She also was great at allowing as much time as possible to see the sites and was great with our kids. We would do this again!

I really enjoyed the trip to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. The bus was comfortable and left the station on time. James is an amazing tour guide! He's funny, interesting and knowledgable. He really does know a lot of the history and is always eager to answer questions and give us special tips regarding the points of interest.
The cities visited are rich on culture and the sightseeing is amazing.

If you're a curious tourist who likes history but is too lazy to look it up and would much prefer someone tell you directly, I HIGHLY recommend this tour for you for some obvious reasons:

1. Its ONE day (less actually!) So if you happen to NOT enjoy it, you have plenty of time anyway to do whatever you like. No sunk investment.

2. Frequent stops and great spots. All three were very fun, particularly enjoyed Bath. If you'd like to stay longer, you can opt to go back to London by yourself instead of with a coach. Bath is only an hour away from London.

3. PEOPLE! Phil and Bob (the tour guide and coach driver) are amazing. Basically walking wikipedias. Phil knows everything so go and enrich yourself. Also, it was nice socialising with other travellers.
The tour is really worthwhile although it is more expansive than many other tours from other companies that they charge less for not getting into scenic spots with admission fee.
Excellent tour! Andy Jackson was more than amazing! Best tour guide, very knowledgeable and friendly

The Stonehenge, Windsor, and Bath was an excellent tour. Through Alexandria's expertise and seemingly unending knowledge of the sites I was truelly able to appreciate each sites beauty and history. I would recommend this tour to everyone.you truelly get a taste test of each of the sites magnificence.

We found the Evan Evans Tour to be well organized and easily accessed. Our guide and driver, Claudia and Malcolm, were great. Claudia was interesting and had lots of information for us. My friend that I was traveling with was using a walking stick and she and I were immediately granted a front row making the on and off process much easier for her. So glad we did this tour!

We really enjoyed our trip to Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. It was a very busy day. We decided to try to hit 3 sites in one day, but in hindsight we should have only attempted 1 because we were on a tight timeline. Our guide Chris was amazingly knowledgeable about Stonehenge! He was great!! Our bus driver Mark P was phenomenal, especially on those narrow roads and busy tourist sites. We added going into the Roman Baths in Bath which were very interesting. Our bus did have a very annoying, loud, chatty customer sitting directly behind us. Wish we had taken our noise canceling headphones. We would totally book with Evan Evans again . Very professional, very organized and well worth the money. Just wish we had tried to do less and enjoy fewer places more.

You spend alot of time on the bus with limited time at each sight. Windsor was literally a half hour, after the 40 minute que and rushing back to the bus, which was the part I was looking most forward to.

That being said, you don't get to spend a whole lot of time at each place. I would have loved to have spent more time at Windsor and Bath (there was plenty of time at Stonehenge, in my opinion). However, I knew this was just a highlight tour and I chose it to be introduced to each of these places.

I took my 5 year old daughter with me and we both had a nice time. Our tour guide, Rowan, loved the history of the UK and it showed. She had tons of interesting tidbits that made the whole day just incredible. George was our driver and he was fantastic!
Our trip was fantastic. It was a great way to spend the day on Christmas Day. With everything closed in London it was a great time to spend a time outside the city.

Great way to see 3 phenomenal stars if traveling to London, Windsor was spectacular, Stonehedge was magical and the trip finished In Bathes which was also an amazing surprise of a great town and fascinating history. Barry was a great driver, should be recognized for his F1 grace and style, Kebin (Kevin) was knowledgeable and gracious- great use of time & dollars.

This was a great tour. I have done several tours around England and this was the best. I also had a 13 year old daughter with me. We had an educational and relaxing day.
Our guide told us enough about each stop but not too much. He was funny and interesting but didn’t spend every second of the day talking.
Between stops we were able to rest and even sleep undisturbed so we were fresh for the next stop.
We went through each attraction on our own and either took the headsets or not.
At Stonehenge we took the bus up, walked around calmly and then walked back. It was amazing.
At Bath we took the headsets and really enjoyed learning more about this historical period. Then we had time to grab a gift and have tea. Such a treat.
We were also free to eat our own food on the bus or in the towns. I liked that they did t give us food in a box. This was much better.
The day was 99%
This was one suggestion.
I wish the tour guide had suggested that people turn their ringers and alarms off their phones and be considerate of those on the bus that were resting.
The woman in front of us on the bus had a beep on her texts that went off about 50 times. So annoying.
Other than that it was a perfect tour and perfect day.

Timely departure, comfortable seats, friendly and knowledgeable guide, decent technology (wifi, VOX boxes) No USB plugs, however.

Awesome experience.

This is such a great tour. What makes it so great is the organization, staff, and entertaining education. Our tour guide was the best. Mel (tour guide) and Joe (driver) were wonderful.

If you want to see a lot in one day, this is the tour for you.

The tour was great, our tour guide very knowledgeable although at times I felt very rushed. The tour is 12 hours but I think they need to build in time for one real meal. I mean the tour is 12 hours and other than cold drinks and cold food you couldn’t bring things on the bus. We tried at every stop to get something quick but was more difficult than anticipated and there was little time to have a proper sit down. The one thing I was very disappointed in was that we were not notified that Windsor Castle was closed for maintenance until we boarded the bus. This should have been very clear when booking and it was not. We would have chosen a different day had we known as this was a big thing on my list that I wanted to see. The guide did his best and toured ya around the castle but it wasn’t the same. Stonehenge was amazing given it was a very cold and blustery day so very few tourists. This meant we had prime picture taking opportunities and we took advantage. Overall I would recommend this tour company, just make sure you know all the attractions are open. Apparently in January that’s a variable as several things were closed while we were there.

Andy Jackson was my tour guide and he did not disappoint on a fantastic tour. Andy has an immense amount of experience working for the royal family. He knows so much history and shared it in the right way at the right time. The sights were amazing. what you would have expected and more. Even though the weather was dismal - Andy and Evan Evans can't control that, the tour was worth it. It's a long day but well worth it. Andy paced his knowledge breaking up the tour and saving some of his best tidbits for the end. I definitely recommend this tour and try to get Andy if you can.

This was truly the best 1-day tour I've ever taken. Mel and Andy were a great team and helped make this a great day for all of us!

If you want a tour that covers a variety of areas in a single day, this tour is for you. I was only in the London area for a couple full days and wanted to experience as much as possible in my short time. The drive towards Stonehenge and then onto Bath is absolutely beautiful. I enjoyed looking at the countryside so much - almost a 4th area of interest on the tour.

Mel (our guide) was absolutely incredible. Obviously very knowledgeable about each area and passionate about history. He provided so much interesting information throughout our visits and during the rides. He had a fantastic sense of humor and kept people laughing with his commentary throughout the trip. Andy was an incredible driver. Driving that big coach through London and onto the other destinations is not easy, but he made it seem like a piece of cake and got us there in comfort.

Given the number of venues on this tour and their proximity to each other, be realistic about how much time you'll have at each event. We probably had about 1.5 hours on average at each site. I felt this was ample time to get a sense of things, and you can always go back for another tour at a later time if you want more time at a particular one.

I am so excited I chose this tour and will never forget it. I would definitely take a tour with Evan Evans again - especially if conducted by Mel and Andy. They were superb!

The set up of the tour was excellent.

Mel was very personable and knowledgeable. Gave great running commentary with a different perspectives on history to ponder. Very vibrant, interactive and funny.

Thanks to Adam for driving the bus. Pleasant and smooth journey.

Wow! I am blown away by this tour. Mel (our tour guide) was a hoot, absolutely hilarious. He was extremely informative and told us lots of interesting facts. I honestly didn’t want him to stop talking because I enjoyed everything he was saying so much.
We felt very safe on the bus, thanks to Andrew (I think that was his name!)
I didn’t think it was possible to fit three major locations in one day, but we accomplished it!
Mel was the greatest tour guide I’ve ever had. He made the entire experience enjoyable, despite us being tired. I would recommend this to anyone!

Our tour guide was Mel, known for his extravagant jazz Hands, and our driver was Mark, who was known for his safe driving and very friendly personality. Mel has been doing this job for over 35 years and it shows! His stories and knowledge were superb. Windsor castle is a very quick whirlwind, but worth it. Stonehenge is nice to see one time, but overall underwhelming. Bath is a beautiful city but also only there for a short time. The trip overall is worth it.

The tour was very well planned. Carol was so nice and informative. She paid attention to every detail to help giving us the most convenient way to travel. Tom was also a great coach driver. Even though we had to travel all day long since some places are quite for from others, but I found this tour very enjoyable and safe. Great value indeed.

I was nervous about scheduling a bus tour because I assumed it would be crowded and rushed but I was pleasantly surprised. Phil and George were exceptional. Phil gave an excellent history of all the stops and sites along the way and was fun and engaging. Definitely glad I booked this trip for my mom and I.

This trip is a very long day - 12 hours from beginning to end, however it is absolutely worth it to see these great sites and the towns adjoining. Godfrey was our Tour guide, he was very knowledgeable & Michaelangelo an excellent driver.
