We really enjoyed our day trip out of the city. My husband and I did a London vacation for 5 days and wanted one day out of the city. This was a great option. Between our tour guide, Deborah, and our driver, Elise, we didn’t get stuck in traffic and we beat many other tour groups to Windsor and Stonehenge, so we didn’t have to deal with crowds! Ending at the Roman baths was nice too. Deborah made it so we didn’t have to fret. She got our tickets for us at all the places and as a group we got to go around those visiting on their own in line. The Vox boxes were incredibly handy and made sure we didn’t miss a word of our tour even if we fell a bit behind or others were (rudely) talking. Now I don’t know if I can do another tour without a Vox on hand! Deborah also made sure we knew how to get home and was genuinely interested in talking to us all. I wish I could have her for every tour!

The meeting point of Victoria Coach station was easy to find and it's best to arrive 30 minutes early to check in and get your wrist band. Kevin (our guide) and Michael (our driver) were both wonderful! Kevin has a great sense of humor and kept things light during travel between sites but also very informative. Kevin clearly has extensive knowledge of British history and presented the information in a fun and easy-to-understand way. He also made sure we had access to food and restrooms throughout the day. Windsor was exciting as Meghan and Harry's wedding garments were on display. Stonehenge is fascinating and worth seeing up close and worth seeing. The Roman Baths were incredible - to walk where the Romans walked was very exciting!
Michael was a skilled driver and added a little commentary every now and then to keep us entertained. At the end, they provided several drop-off points to accommodate everyone on the tour. Go on this excursion, you will enjoy it!

It's a good way to see & learn a lot about London's history, especially with our guide, James. He knows everything about London! I liked that it's a guided tour but you have opportunities to wonder off on your own. Take snacks, there's no lunch time but you can grab a bite at any of the places you visit.

Loved our trip to Stonehenge, Windsor castle and Bath. The crew Chris and Elisa were really helpful and were highly knowledgeable. They did not rush the trip at all and we covered all the places and we were on time. I would definitely recommend this trip to everyone.
James was an excellent guide and gave us all the information we needed. He was kind friendly and very helpful. The bus driver Steve was very good driver and got us where we were going without problem

3 destinations in one day... of course you have to be fast and punctual. Our guide was very informative and nice. We had more than enough time in Windsor and Stonehenge, but you need more than a day for Bath. In my opinion, the Roman baths take too much of your time, so I do not recommend buying your entrance and, instead, explore the beautiful city of Bath. I loved this tour, Evan Evans is highly recommended.

We really enjoyed the tour. Unfortunately it was a little too quick. It really did enable us to see many sites in one day, but unfortunately we were unable to spend a lot of time at each site. That was OK for Stonehenge, which didn’t require a lot of time. I would like to have spent more time at Windsor Castle, and bath,.

We went on this tour a couple of weeks ago during our short stay in London. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who is short on time. The tour runs on a tight schedule, as you can expect with travelling a distance out of London and seeing so many great sites all in one day. Our guide was Katya, she is so knowledgeable, the history lessons she gave us were very impressive. Very nice and friendly too. The sites we visited were all great to see, Stonehenge was probably my favourite but the other sites were all equally impressive. Try to get your lunch at the Stonehenge cafe, great food and service.

My husband and I booked this tour, and we enjoyed it immensely. Our driver, Joe, and tour guide, Claudia, did an excellent job of making sure we got the most our of our tour. Claudia, additionally, did the tour in both English and Spanish with great ease.

Its a very good tour esp its our first time to visit UK. It gave us 3 "glympse" of great historical sights. Glympse because we spent at an average of 1.5hrs per site but in reality you might need at least 3 hours per site to learn more. Here are the points that we like about the tour.
1. 5 Star Tour Guide - he is highly engaged with us. Ask us questions and also encourage us to ask if we have things that we dont know. Gives us great details about the sites and even the road that we are passing through. Very nice sense of humor too that made the tour very interesting as well. He also extends his service by asking each of us wheres the best place to get off the bus after the tour which will be near our hotel. Great job Oliver!
2. All the historical sites that we visited are all A+ for us. Its clean, very tourist friendly and the portable audio tour guide is very nice.
3. We enjoyed the suburbs road drive that gave us some idea how the outskirts of London looks like

In general, we highly recommend you take this tour company and this tour package. Im sure you will enjoy it

Took this tour with anticipation of seeing places I've read about. The guide was VERY knowledgeable and interesting to listen to. She shared facts that we wouldn't have learned about had we traveled on our own.I would liked to have had more time in Windsor. I would recommend this tour.
Much better than I expected. A lot packed into one day but it all worked out smoothly. Our tour guide Kevin regaled us with history and great stories. Very highly recommend this tour!
Great trip with plenty of time to view the sights and have a box lunch. Be courteous enough to be on time though for departures. It's a long day of fun. Windsor Castle was great.

A beautiful day exploring 3 iconic spots and driving thru the countryside. We loved Windsor Castle, especially the royal wedding exhibit. Stonehenge was quite moving. The city of Bath was a hidden gem. Thank you Oliver for entertaining and educating our group. We can’t wait to travel with you again✌️
Oliver was an excellent and informative tour guide. We enjoyed ourselves and would definitely do another tour. Cheers!!🇬🇧🇬🇧🍺🍺

Fabulous day with Mel & Moe. Mel was incredibly knowledgeable, witty & humorous. Moe always made us feel safe behind the wheel. It is however, a VERY long day with not much time at each location. Windsor & Bath you need much more time. Bath in particular is a quaint town begging to be explored. No fault of our guides though, I’ll just have to come back another time.

What an awesome day trip! We had limited time in London and the U.K., and a lot that we wanted to see, so this tour was just what we needed! Our guide Katya and our driver Michelangelo were terrific. Katya knows her stuff, provided us with a lot of useful history and was friendly, welcoming and had a great sense of humor. Plus it was wonderful to see the beautiful rolling countryside on the way to all of our stops, Windsor Castle was great, and Stonehenge and Bath were both spectacular. I was really pleased that I chose this tour over other available choices, especially because Katya was so knowledgeable and helpful! I highly recommend this tour!

Efficient n organized service from booking to delivery. Trip was great n Rhys (guide) was witty and informative on most topics. Tom (coach) did a great job in careful driving n delivered us back safe n sound. Thank you guys and hv enjoyed the trip despite being a short trip.

We took this tour on 10/9/18 and our driver was Steve and tour guide was Rob (we are hoping we got his name right bc he was wonderful). Those two guys were experts at their crafts. They kept things interesting and fun and safe while being polished and professional the entire time. We loved our experience and hope everyone can get these two.

Booking that trip was a great decision.
Our tourguide Oliver (also known as Tom ;-) )was really entertaining, funny and friendly. I had such a wonderful time. I can definitely recommend it!

Nigel is a fantastic tour guide, clever, funny and well informed. Kept us entertained and informed. Gill was great driving the bus.

Windsor was in the morning mist, then the sun broke through like cinema. Lovely visit with electronic audio guide to let you know what you’re looking at.

Stonehenge was impressive, especially with a good guide.

Bath was a bit fast, but well preserved and exhibited.

Good recommendations were provided for ice cream and ale — separate places!

As a nice touch, Nigel walked down the bus and made suggestions on how to get back to our hotels.

This Tour Starts Early in the Morning, and time is considered Really Important, because the sites visited are not that close from london and traffic is a real problem in UK. The first place you Visit is Windsor Castle, and it is a Must, very nice experience but you get an hour for the visit but it takes 10 minutes to get back to the Bus so you really get a little time and the castle takes like 2 hours for a good visit. Next you Go to stonhenge a really nice place, you also get an hour there that it is just enough to circle it around and take pictures. And last you Go to te City of Bath, really nice city, with The Roman Baths Museum, The museum its great, very explicative and very well maintained. All the visits are in a really fast pace, and in a very uncomfortable bus, your knees are always in contact with the front seat and it is very uncomfortable for a 3 hour trip back.

A taste of London...and that’s what you get. Andy the tour guide was informative, knowledgeable, engaging and witty. A well organised day tour where you get to explore the beautiful Windsor Castle, historical Bath and amazing Stonehenge. Comfortable coach with wifi. Good amount of time to spend at each attraction. Long day but well worth being chauffeured around to see these spectacular sights.

My husband and I enjoyed every minute of this lovely tour. We had the best tour guide - Mel and driver - Ben (Oct 9, 2018 - few days before the second royal wedding). Mel was very enthusiastic, entertaining, knowledgeable, and we had a wonderful day. The tour is long, so it is recommended to have a positive attitude and follow all time/schedule details provided by tour guide to avoid delays or issues. Also get food as recommended by your tour guide. The highlight in my opinion is Stonehenge - which was awesome. For us it was a dream come true as this was part of our bucket list. The weather was perfect. We have beautiful pictures to remember this day forever. Bath is interesting and Windsor is enchanting. Thanks to Mel for providing such wonderful guidance during this tour.

Took the Windsor Castle, Bath, Stonehenge Tour with Chris as our guide and George as our driver October 7th. Excellent, couldn't ask for more. Chris was a great guide and George was an excellent driver. Highly recommend the tour, guide and driver.

We had a good time and enjoyed seeing everything, no complaints about the sights. Our tour guide had some great stories about each location, although I could have done without him explaining getting drinks with his ex-wife while we were in Bath. I did not appreciate that we were told no hot drinks were allowed due to "health and safety reasons" but both the driver and the tour guide both had hot drinks throughout the day. At one point our tour guide even held us up for 10+ minutes while using the bathroom and getting himself a hot drink, despite having said repeatedly how it important it was to be on time.

The day tour to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath is a wonderful way to get out of London and get a little taste of the rich history of the UK. Our tour guide Andy was the best as was the beautiful blonde coach driver. Andy kept us informed as we approached the different sites and educated us on all sort of little known facts. A must see when in the UK.
We had a wonderful day with our knowledgeable tour guide Mel and driver Ben! The timing of the tour worked well for us, and overall it was a well-run and fun day. Thanks!

I was in London for a short business trip and only had 1 free day for sightseeing. Rhys (our guide) managed expectations (compared this tour to tapas - or a sampling of the sights). We were able to pack in a lot in a short amount of time and Rhys used the time in between stops to give a lot of historical information about the area and tips on how to make the most of each destination. It was a wonderful, memorable day!

Chris was our guide and George our driver....they were both excellent and highly recommended. The tour itself was amazing, easy and full of wonder and discovery. Our coach was comfortable and enjoyable. We departed London and headed for Windsor Castle with advice to visit the state rooms (which we did). The only regret was not enough time. Next was Bath and The Roman Baths. Along the way Chris gave us some history and interesting facts. Seeing the Cotswolds on the way was stunning. As a great fan of Jane Austen, this Bath trip was an important visit for me and I was not disappointed. Next was the fabulously mysterious Stonehenge. Chris was very informative on this site and had some inside information as a rare tour treat. Having visited Stonehenge many years ago, I was glad to have this second visit to learn even more. the Evan Evans interactive map was really cool! On the way back to London, Chris played a DVD of some Stonehenge new theories..what an unexpected surprise to pass the drive time. George gave us a smooth ride and was friendly and made our trip a joy. I would recommend this day trip if you're short on time and want to see a few of England's best treasures.

Great day out! Thoroughly enjoyed this tour the pace was just right and it was all bought together by our wonderful tour guide James. James ensured that we were on time and made the absolute most of our day, his wit and historical knowledge made it a day we will never forget!

All three places are amazing. Our tour guide, Andy Jackson (Evan Evans Tours) is very knowledgable about the history and tells very good stories during the bus ride. The bus is very comfortable for a full day tour.

We visited mid-September 2018 and seeing Stonehenge was at the top of our list and the primary reason we booked this tour. When we arrived at the bus station, it was pretty confusing trying to find our terminal, because nothing was clearly marked. But we found other tourists carrying the same tickets as us and we were able to locate the queue.
We ended up on a bus with Alex as our guide, and she did such a great job! She was informative and easy to understand and she gave clear instruction at each stop. She also spoke French for several people in our group. I found her funny and very endearing and I just wanna be her friend!
Our first stop was Windsor Castle, where we also saw St. George's Chapel. Alex gave us some background and history while we waited in line to enter, and we got there right at the beginning of the day, so we didn't have to wait long. We had a limited time period for our visit, so we definitely didn't get to see everything, but I thought we had enough time to see most of the castle. Unfortunately, you are not able to take pictures inside either, but that's pretty typical of most museums.
Second stop was the Roman Baths. Alex provided a lot of history on our drive to the Baths, and again while we waited for entry. Entry to the Baths was optional, but I would recommend it. Might as well see it while you're right there! Pretty interesting site, which I knew nothing about prior to our trip. We had just the right amount of time to see the site, without feeling rushed.
Final stop was Stonehenge, where we were able to take a shuttle bus right up to the site. It was incredible and made the whole day worth it. We were given a magic map that gave a guided tour through your personal headset, but I didn't listen to much of it. There is a small museum at the site, which is worth checking out, and doesn't take very long to walk through.
Overall, the whole day took about 12 hours. It was a lot packed into one day, but considering the ground we covered I think it was organized and well scheduled in order to make the most of the day. Highly recommend!

This tour was very good , we wanted to have more time min windsor where you got so much to see , but we got little time in windsor just 45 min and had to rush back , where as you don't need lng break in stonehenge where they gave us 90 min stop, this is in fact due to they rush in the first stop and second stop windsor and bath to keep some time reserve in hand for rainy day or traffic jam.Any way this was a nice way to cover three highlight of UK.
The tour was incredibly amazing, and with just enough time for you to check out the 3 locations completely. Our guide Mel was very informative and knowledgeable about everything!

This tour offered a fascinating view of Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge, the breadth of the country, and 5 millenia, in a day. You might think it to be exhausting, but our tour guide, James, made it fascinating (all while smiling along with his brilliant wit). By the end of the tour he felt like English family, taking time to get to know us and answer all questions with great insight. James was considerate to even drop off my elderly mother at her doorstep at the end. As for our driver, he managed the narrow streets with impressive skill. Most importantly, my teenage children acquired a wonderful perspective of England's rich history that they would have never fully appreciated in a textbook. We all would highly recommend an Evans & Evand tour led by James.

Pick up stop is at 7:30am at Victoria Station, arrive early if possible. We got there 5 minutes early and there was a huge line.
First stop was Windsor Castle, you get about 1 hr 30 min there. Recommend going straight to State rooms or St George Chapel. We didn’t get to explore the town but the Castle was incredible.
Second stop was Bath, you get about 1hr 20 min we had about a 15 minute wait to go into bath but we walked thru it pretty quickly so we still had time to walk around the town.
Last stop, was Stonehenge and you get about 1 hr 20 min which is plenty of time. I was pleasantly surprised that we weren’t too far from the circle.
Our tour guide, Nicholas, was beyond phenomenal. He was extremely informative about every location, architecture, important people, eras and everything you can think of. He was so fun, witty and had a great sense of humor. Aston was our driver and he was great got us where we needed efficiently and safely.

Our first stop was at Windsor Castle, it rained heavily; one must always carry an umbrella and rain coat. Also be sure not to get the audio guides wet since it causes the device to glitch.

We had enough time to visit and take good pictures at all 3 locations (Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge). Although we did arrive at tour bus 10 minutes later than we should have at our last stop at Stonehenge since there was a huge/long que for the small shuttle buses returning back to the tour buses meeting point. Thankfully our friendly driver, guide and other passengers were kind enough to wait and not complain.

Our favourite attractions in order:
1. Stonehenge
2. Windsor Castle
3. Bath (least favourite)

Be sure to always return to the tour bus at the given time in order to avoid delays and advisable to carry snacks (no hot meals)/water to have more time to tour the attractions.

Overall review: the buses were clean, we had a very good driver who drove safely. Our guide Oliver Simmons was entertaining and very informative. A great way to explore all 3 sites in one day. Great value for money. Definitely worth it and a must to book with Evan Evans.

This was such a great day! We covered a lot of ground in England and saw some key tourist things! Nicholas was our guide and did a fantastic job telling stories, relating history, knowing the secrets, etc. He kept us well entertained on the bus and in line at Windsor. We actually only wanted to see Stonehenge but booked the tour because Bath sounded neat as well. So glad we did and were able to visit all three locations! Such a great time! All three stops were great! Highly recommend it!

My only suggestion would be to allocate enough time for lunch. We were really pressed for time in Bath. Just a few more minutes would have ensured that we were able to eat properly. This is an all day tour and time spent very well, but if it's an all day tour (even having brought snacks with) we needed time for lunch. For us and most tourists, the way to our hearts is through our bellies. Just a suggestion! But on that note, if you book this tour bring snacks! There are places you can grab nibbly-bits along the way, but having them with you helps a lot!

Also of note, more instructions regarding the bus terminal/pick-up location would be great! There are many buses going to many of the same places (I think the final stop was the difference). It was a bit chaotic without further instructions such as "check in at line #1, or #2, or #3, etc" or "ask someone in such and such colored shirt". We ended up asking another tour guide where we needed to be and were treated rather poorly. With no additional instructions and time-sensitive departures, guides should expect tourists to ask questions (and probably the same questions day after day) especially if no further direction is given other than "go to the bus terminal" or similar wording. Just allocate a few extra minutes to ensure you get to where you need to be for an on-time departure.

But overall a great tour and highly recommended!
We had the best tour guide in James. So sweet and knowledgeable!! The day was so memorable and I would tell everyone to do this Evan and Evan tour!! The driver Tom was a great driver as well.

This was a really long day seeing amazing things. The start at Windsor was well done as we were one of the first groups in. Bath is such a lovely town and the Abbey is beautiful. And words can’t really describe Stonehenge. The problem with this trip is you don’t have time to do more than run through any of the three. Additionally, our guide Saul was doing both English and Spanish commentary which meant he rushed through all of it.

This trip is, I think, the best way to check a couple of things on your bucket list, as Karen, our guide said. Both Karen and our driver Jane were prety amazing! Money well spent! We laughed almost all the way and the things we saw...were breath taking! Be sure you won’t regret a thing! Thank you Karen and Jane! 🤗🤗🤗

Had a lovely day with Rhys and driver Malcolm visiting these three sites. Rhys was very knowledgeable and Malcolm got us there and back safely.
Just remember time is a bit limited but still very much worth the visit at all three stops.

Beautifully day. Very enjoyable tour. Very organized. The driver and our tour guide, Mel A. was very efficient. Mel was very informative, knowledgeable, and entertaining. Will definitely recommend to friends !!!

My family and I took this trip to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle and Bath from London Victoria Coach Station. The bus was very confy as promised and had AC. All the sightseeings were amazing even though I felt that we could have spent a little more time in each location. However, what was far beyond our expectation was the tour guide (Phil). He did not only talk about all the places that we visited, but he also taught us about UK's history. We did not even feel that he was a tour guide, but more as a friend who did his job out of passion. His food and pub recommendations were amazing at the end of the trip and I would highly recommend jotting them down. Overall, he was an extraordinary guide that I would encourage asking for before going on this amazing trip!

We packed a lot into this tour but felt we had enough time to explore all we needed from these three extraordinary sites. We were well prepared to capitalise on each location with informative, entertaining commentary and observations provided by Andy Jackson. Ricky drove us safely and confidently through London city and busy roadways ensuring we arrived at each location with plenty of time to explore. Great job guys. You made sure we had a fantastic tour!

I usually hate tours, especially bus tours. They typically cram you into a bus with a bunch of strangers and treat you like a fifth grader on a school trip. However, I do not regret my decision to take the Golden Tour day trip to Windsor, Stonehenge, and Bath. Considering the distance between the sites and the entry fees, the cost of the tour was reasonable. The tour guide, Graham, was extremely knowledgeable, not only of the sites but the landscape we passed along the way. He actually addressed many lingering questions I had regarding architecture and geography in rural England. The driver, Kiran, was timely but safe. I highly recommend this tour.

Outstanding tour made better with our guide, James. His depth of knowledge of the history of England made the travel time between destinations tolerable. He’s very engaging and so helpful especially at the end of the tour. His partner and driver, Barry, handles the bus with aplomb, navigating the narrow streets and getting us to the destinations safely. We were very lucky to have James and Barry as our guides. Very professional. Too bad you cannot request them as you’re guides.

I took this tour on a Monday with my 11 year old daughter. We met the tour group at 7:45 am at the Victoria Coach Station, boarded a coach and went on our way. First stop, Windsor Castle. We felt a little rushed to go through the State Rooms in order to have time to tour St. George’s Cathedral but we got it done. Next stop, the quaint little town of Bath. Again, we felt a little rushed to go through but it’s a long day and to cover 3 places it’s a busy day. Last but not least, Stonehenge.

These three places are must see places when visiting London. To be able to do them in one day is remarkable. This tour gives you a nice taste of each one and you may leave wanting to come back and spend more time at one or more of them.

What I liked about this tour was:
-I didn’t have to drive
-a knowledgeable tour guide (more about that later)
-I could nap on the way back
-being able to look out the window and enjoy the scenery
-learned a lot about the history of London and the Royal Family

So our tour guide was Andy Jackson and I have to say he was great at what he does. He really sets the bar high for all the tour guides out there. Andy was extremely knowledgeable about the history of the Royal Family and about each stop on the tour. To help pass the time while on the bus or in line waiting to enter the location, Andy spoke to the group through a VOX device that each of us had. It allowed him to speak into a microphone and would broadcast to each VOX device and we listened through an earpiece. For example, while waiting for Windsor Castle to open, Andy spoke to us while we waited, telling us history about the castle and about the Kings and Queens that have lived there and the Royal Family. The tour guide in front of us wasn’t as talkative and didn’t have nearly the information Andy had. This was the case throughout the day. Andy really was an amazing guide. I’m not sure there is a way to request Andy but if there is, I would tell you without hesitation to request Andy Jackson as your tour guide. And Andy, if you read this, I just want to say THANK YOU again for the memorable experience you gave me and my daughter. A+ or 👍🏻👍🏻

One last thing... don’t make the same mistake I made, bring some paper money to tip your tour guide.

We had a great trip. Guide Rhys and driver Bob were excellent! Rhys was very knowledgeable with excellent insights and history along the drive and provided valuable information to guide us at the different locations.

Each site was beautiful and historic. We didn't have as much time at each location as we would have liked but given the distance traveled and places seen in just one day, the time was adequate to give us a fun highlights type tour. We had an excellent time and our guide and bus driver made the tour very enjoyable.

Did this tour whilst in England and was very impressed with the organisation of the tour and the enthusiasm and energy of our guide Rhyees. All 3 sites were fabulous and all went to schedule. Only thing is at Stonehenge you need to catch a shuttle bus from the coach drop off point and it is not well organised (not a fault with Evan Evans it’s with the Stonehenge centre). This meant we had to rush Stonehenge as we didn’t want to miss our bus home!

All in all a great tour and a great company. Bob our driver was also a champion.

Our Tour Guide Rhys and our Driver Bob, were professional, gracious, and quite a team. Yes the day is long, but right at the beginning, Rhys advised us of the travel distances and the need to be punctual to make sure all three stops were available to us in the best possible way. He took great care to guide us to the State rooms first. We got there first and we were in the building in about 20 minutes. This gave us time to walk about the area and even get a small snack to carry on the bus. Bob (the driver) always helped us on and off the bus. He was very kind. During the long ride, Rhys took the time to tell us about the things we were driving by. Quite often on the bus he walked up and down the bus and spoke to us all individually asking if we had any questions or concerns. Also while walking on our tour, the vox digital box was very nice in that we could hear what he was saying even though we were in the back of the group.

I agree that three sites in one tour is a lot, but my husband and I cruise often and one could say the same thing about visiting several countries or cities in 10 days. These tours are a "taste" of what is available. If given the chance, I would visit these three sites again, but plan a day around each one and go on my own to enjoy all these places can give you. If you cannot do that, this tour is the perfect option to see as much as you can while visiting Great Britain.

This whirlwind tour is a great way to pack in 3 fantastic sites in one convenient day trip. As the other reviewers note, it is a fast-paced trip that doesn't give you much time at each site, but for us, it was the perfect balance of getting to see these sites while not spending too much of our 1-week visit. There's no way we could have accomplished this on our own.

Evan Evans really knows what they're doing and fun a very efficient system, from the comfortable bus ride to the audio gadget that connected us to our tour guide as well as recorded information.

Our tour guide, Oliver, was WONDERFUL--knowledgeable, personable, thoughtful, and sincere. At one point, an uncomfortable passenger was trying to get another passenger to switch seats with him and it was an awkward situation... Oliver resolved the situation right away by offering his own seat to the unhappy customer. It really showed class, professionalism, and kindness.

Our family of four from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada did a full day guided coach trip to Windsor Castle, Roman Baths and Stonehenge from London's Victoria coach terminal and had to chose Evan Evans tour operator as all others were booked out. Not a bad choice as our tour guide Emily was very knowledgeable of England's history and kept it interesting. The driver of this coach bus, Joe was professional but spoke nothing except disallowing any food on board that was not a cold sandwich or a bottled drink. No hot coffee or hot food or even ice cream in a cup!
Starting from London at 8 am, we did Windsor castle in under 50 minutes, which needs to be given a proper 3 hours to justify the cost of the entry ticket Then on to Bath, which is a Roman era natural hot water spring that the ancient Romans capitalized on in about 60 BC, when London was actually Londinium, a far away Roman colony of Julius Caesar and his Generals. Total of 45 minutes here, and with all the crowds, its barely enough. As the weather turned wet and cold, we reached Stonehenge, a prehistoric stone formation and again with the thousands of tourists, had to rush back to reach the coach in time. We were dropped off at 3 points in London, culminating back at the coach terminal.
Three very historic and beautiful parts of England, and excellent guide, Emily, a clean and comfortable Mercedes bus (no toilet on board) but this trip felt rushed.

We went on this tour on a Sunday morning. We were accompanied by our guide, Toby, and driver, Aston. It was great! We were one of the first groups to arrive at Windsor and we had a sufficient amount of time to roam around the castle. Be warned though that St. George's Chapel is closed on Sundays.

Our next stop was Bath, and the queue for the Roman Baths was extremely long. This was something beyond the control of Evan Evans, though. We appreciated Toby's effort to keep guests entertained by sharing history and trivia about the area.

Finally, we arrived at Stonehenge at around 1600. We had 1.5 hours to see the attraction, which we felt was sufficient.

Note though, that there is barely any time for lunch, so it would be best to pack snacks to eat during the bus rides instead.

I would definitely recommend this tour!

Bus was very nice. Tour guide was excellent and very informative. We had no wait to enter any of the sights so were able to use all the available time touring. Lots to see in such a short amount of time. Tour company very experienced in conducting the tour. Very enjoyable and nice to have someone else do all the worrying about driving and paying for entrance fees. Would have definitely spent more time at Bath and Windsor Castle if I had more time, but Stonehenge time was fine. Definitely recommend doing it.
Our trip was terrific based upon the sites visited and mostly because of our wonderful tour guide, Gavin, who was entertaining, knowledgeable, insightful and amusing!!

This review is for the tour we took with Evan Evans that took us to Stonehenge, Bath, and Windsor Castle. As with most tours, it’s usually dependent on the quality of the tour guide. We got pretty lucky ending up with Chris who happens to be a trained archeologist. This tour starts off at the Victoria Coach station. One tip… there is an Evan Evans counter directly in front of gate 1. We booked this tour off Viator and it didn’t tell us which gate to look out for. We followed the signs to another tour company that took us to the other side of the terminal. Look out for the counter if you book any of their tours so you know exactly which gate to use for your tour coach. If I could do this tour again, I would probably not include Windsor Castle. That could be a trip all on its own. Having a highly qualified tour guide taking us to Stonehenge and Bath was incredibly valuable. Thanks Chris! And thanks to our great driver Kelvin! Cheers!

I was weighing between choosing this trip and the other one which was a trip to Stonehenge inner circle and the Roman Baths. I am grateful I chose this trip. Why? Although Stonehenge was beautiful but to pay extra for the inner circle experience is not worth the money. I enjoyed Windsor Castle but not as much with the Roman Baths and Stonehenge. That is personal opinion so some may disagree.

I enjoyed the commentaries and the directions Andrew Jackson (yes, my guide's name is the same as the American President Andrew Jackson) gave. He was witty, humorous, and a great tour guide. The driver, Aston Martin (yes, his name is really after the famous car brand), was a good driver. So hopefully, some of you who read this review may find themselves with Andy and Aston as their guide and driver.

I had Toby and Charlie as my guide and driver, respectively. They were both great and I really liked the fact that Toby gave us these Vox boxes so he can communicate with us through individual headsets. It made the tour a much more pleasant experience. He was also a pretty comical guy and was extremely knowledgeable and that made him a great storyteller...clearly someone who knew his stuff.

I also liked the fact that on our way back the bus made 4 stops (3 around London and then one at the original Victoria Coach Station).Toby went around individually to everyone and gave them the best stop to get off at, which is above and beyond. I meant he talked to EVERYONE. I gave him and the driver a 10 quid gratuity...which is around $13 US...usually I give around $5 to my tour guides and what not. He personally showed me a map of where to get off based on where I wanted to go (I wanted to go back to my hotel to shower and then later enjoy the night around town).

I hope that if I ever go to London again Toby would be my tour guide.

We started the day in anticipation 11 hours was a long time how would we go on the bus. Well to put surprise the day just breezed by and it was made some much more enjoyable by the informed wit and knowledge of our guide Toby.

We started at Windsor castle and spent around 90 minutes exploring the grounds and the staterooms. Such opulence we mere mortals can only dream of such wealth. As we moved out the changing of the guards had begun and to our surprise they were playing stuck with the man in the middle by Michael Jackson who would have thought

My only advise is get ready for the queues they are long even early in the morning

Ok back to the bus for some more informative repartee from Toby as we travelled to our next destination of bath. Luckily the rain did not start until we hit the bus well organised Toby

Bath is a unique town one of the few to be heritage listed we decided not to go to the Roman baths rather we just walked around town for the 90 minute stay and found a nice hotel for a quick bite Nd drink. Luckily Toby organised for the rain to stop as we got off the coach. It was a pleasant experience we won’t forget

Back in the bus and just as we drove out the rain started again. Well done Toby. Getting to stone henge took about another 80 minutes and on queue the rain stopped as we drove in. This is a unique experience well worth experiencing it’s a piece of history that does not exist in Australia. My only concern about stone henge was it blew a gale so for the new Traveller make sure you bring a jacket. You can leave on the coach if not needed during the day

So we leave stone henge for the 90 minute ride back to London and on queue the rain starts again as we board the bus. The trip home was a unique experience as Toby came and spoke with every person on the bus

Asking how he can help recommend somewhere to eat or what to do. I don’t know if it’s company pricing Livy but it was a nice touch. Thanks toby

If anyone has a day to spare and wants to experience some uk sites in a day this is a great trip. And if you get the chance ask for Toby. He was great

I would not recommend it to anyone. It cost too much for what it is. We spent 85% of the time in the bus and didn't get enough time at each location. I had about 35-40min in Bath (because I didn't go to the roman bath). Once I went to the bathroom and bought a sandwich I was almost out of time. The guide was new and unfortunately he had nothing to say most of the time. There was mostly silence on the bus. No anecdotes or good stories from him. He never told us anything about the locations and seems to only count on the fact that we would get an audio guide on site. Very boring. I really feel like I threw my money out the window on that one. Stonehenge felt too touristic. A real circus. We coudln't take any pictures in Windsor Castle. I wanted to see the change of the guards, but I was pressed by time and I had to run back to the bus. The whole day was a desapointement. I'm never gonna book a tour with them again that's for sure!

My tour got off to an awkward start. I bought it on Expedia about a week before my trip and then a few days ahead we got an email that the tour was full, but the email was a tad vague as to whether I was cancelled or not and they didn't respond to my request for clarification. So I called and Ms. Boyd guaranteed our seats. So we knew we'd be on a pretty full trip. We went on Mon July 23 with the driver Vin and the guide Inge or Inde I think. Vin was very skilled and Inge was very practiced and clearly knows her route quite well and the times you have to be back by. It is not easy to herd so many people. There is a lot of time spent on the bus but Inge explains a lot of the things you are seeing and what it is. I definitely learned a lot. There was sufficient time at all the sites to see them, but something, go to the bathroom, and in some cases buy something to eat, but it is rushed and slightly stressful because you have to be back by that bus on time, but that's the deal. I don't think there's a ton better way to see great things in a shorter time. Or a longer time for that matter. In the summer I think you need sun screen. I wish Inge had spoken up a little more but there is a VOX system that can help at times, but then you have to carry it around too. You can mostly leave stuff on the bus at times. There is no bathroom on the bus. It leaves from Victoria Cross. Not Victoria Underground. Be careful you are in the right place. Victoria Cross. It is about a two minute walk down and across the street from Victoria Underground. You will not have time to see the changing of the guard at Windsor. It was a long day but I sure as heck wasn't going to be driving around all day on the wrong side of the road. All three places are definitely pretty amazing and well worth it. Stonehenge is sorta trickiest because there are these shuttle buses that take you from the visitor center out to the site about a 4 minute drive and the line to get back on those buses to go back can be pretty long. At least 12 minutes.

This was a pleasant tour. They were efficient in checking us in on the bus and the ride on the motor coach was smooth. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and very informative. There were a few lines to go through, but that is what happens at popular attractions. I would have preferred a little more time at the castle though. I did not go to see St. George's Chapel because I wanted to see the changing of the guard. Overall, enjoyed my experience.

I took this tour with my twelve year old daughter and we had a brilliant day with our guide Claudia and driver Steve. We were able to pack so much into one day and discovered a great deal about British history on the trip. Claudia was excellent at organising everything and providing the historical background to the places we visited and Steve's driving was first rate. I wouldn't hesitate in recommending this tour to anyone looking to see a lot of the UK in a one day tour. Hopefully you will get the same tour guide and driver.

If you really have no time to see the UK then maybe this is OK - but be warned you spend most of the day either sitting on the bus or in a queue. Queuing starts getting onto the bus in Victoria Coach station (20 mins) then at Windsor Castle 40 mins, then waiting for people coming back to the coach late (20 mins) then again at the Roman Baths (20 mins) then queuing for the shuttle bus to Stonehenge (30 mins). Actual visiting time was 90 mins in Windsor Castle, 1 hour in Bath and 30 mins at Stonehenge. That was only enough time to get a brief impression of each place. On the other hand the places we visited were great and we agreed that we needed to go back and see them properly. The driver and guide did a good a job as possible given the circumstances and they were appreciated. Next time though I would book a tour with less to get more out of it.

The tour takes a whole day, for me and my friend we started at 10am and we were supposed to be back around 7 or 8pm. But there had been än accident so we were not back in London until 9pm. We got very tired but that was great day out.

My wife and two children (14,11) took this tour today. We all enjoyed it. Andy Jackson was our guide, and he was great. He told us about stories about Kings and Queens, and related some stories from his personal experiences. What a wealth of knowledge. All of his stories were entertaining and informative. It was a long day but we knew that going in. The time allotment at each stop was just enough to get a feel for the place. We realize now that we could spend a whole day at Windsor Castle and several days in Bath, but we only had this one day left on our trip and feel that our time was spent wisely. Also, Mark, our driver was a skilled coachman. It was impressive watching him navigate that large coach up and down those narrow streets. He was also quick with a joke or one-liner. Overall, we had a great day. We would do another Evan Evans tour if we had the time. Thank you Andy and Mark (and Evan Evans Tours

I loved this tour, it was well timed and very well organised. I can't remember our guides name sorry (maybe Abbey) but she was fantastic. Her knowledge was great.
Windsor castle is huge and has so much to see, if you want to see the whole thing best you pick a day just to spend there, as our guide said "you only get a taster in this time here". it was simply just a taste, but a wonderful taste.
Plenty of time Bath to see the Roman baths, grab a gelato and a beer the pub.
Stonehenge - this was also a lovely experience, I enjoyed this also, and you hav plenty of time to have a look around, grab pictures and check out the shop.
Wonderful tour.

We had James as a tour guide and he was a great one - lots of jokes, informative, and friendly. I would recommend taking the earliest tour to get a head start on the lines so that you will end up with more time at Windsor. In general, I thought we could have spent more time at each location. If you went inside the roman baths at Bath, then you won't have any time to spend looking around Bath.

We did our research prior to the trip, so we were aware that we were getting into a 12 hour day. We brought snacks with us, and are glad we did, as time can get away from you quickly. Windsor was really great-arrived first thing well before it became packed. Bath is a great example of what we would have been completely unaware of had we not enjoyed this trip-beautiful landscapes, informative history and lovely views. We finished the day at Stonehenge. Though there is not much to do here, we are still thankful to have experienced a 4,500 year old wonder. The highlight of our day was our amazing tour guide, James. He was witty, informative, and seemed to genuinely care about our personal experiences at the sights. If you get the chance, this tour is well worth it. If you happen to get James as your guide, well then consider yourself one lucky tourist!

This is a tour of all 3 of the sights but don’t expect to spend hours at each sight exploring and wandering around... you spend more time in the queues waiting for entry... and driving between the sights... you get enough of a sense of the sight to decide if you want to come back and explore further...

Our guide (James) was conscientious enough to wait until our actual entry before telling us what time to be back at the bus... still, we only got about an hour at each sight...

James was an entertaining sort and seemed to have lots of stories to tell and might (or might not) be related to someone in every story...

A good time was had by all...

If there is one thing I didn’t really like was James’s repeated veiled reminders for tips...

The locations were great. Loved seeing the history of each site. The downside of the trip was that we left late about a half hour late which ended up cutting time off of each stop. Our tour guide was knowledgeable, but a bit dry and was hung up on corralling a family that did not speak English and would not let the rest of the group go ahead which held the other 45 people of the group back.

The trip covers three places, for Bath and Stonehenge, the time was sufficient, while at Windsor, it feels rushed. We had to skip the doll house to make it back on time. Maybe another 30 minutes at Windsor would have made the whole trip much better. Our guide Armyn Hennesy has extensive knowledge about history, it was a very informational and educational trip. Thank you

Katia was our guide and she was great, very knowledgeable and interesting. This was definitely not her first rodeo and her experience helped us maximize our fun. The day was very full but we knew that going in. We were able to decide how to spend our time at Windsor and in Bath which worked out well. Our group was great too, everyone got back to the bus on time so we didn't waste time waiting for someone. It was fun to see St. George's Chapel just two months after the royal wedding. Make sure to save time to get an ice cream at Windsor...Royal Strawberry was delicious! The coach was very well air conditioned and comfortable. The mic system worked well too. I highly recommend this tour with Katia.

About 30 years ago I watched an informercial for Time Life that talked about Stonehenge and since then have always wanted to visit. I finally got my chance on a trip to London this year with my dad and both of us agree that it was the highlight of our trip. James was our tour guide and was stellar. He really kept us happy and went the extra mile. If you get him, you'll see what I mean. The Windsor castle grounds were also amazing as was Bath. I would actually do this tour again especially if James was the guide.

Had a great day with Andy and Mick to Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge. Andy was very knowledgeable and entertaining. I would have given this a 5 but I feel that the time spent in each location was so short, especially at Windsor. We have 2 young boys and it feels like we're constantly running to go back to our coach so they don't leave us behind. Other than that, it was a very memorable experience!
My husband and myself enjoyed the day trip a lot. Our guide Kevin did a very good job in explaining and also looking out for us. He was very efficient and hence things went so smoothly in the trip.

Great day visiting Windsor Castle, Bath, and Stonehenge. Rhys, tour guide, was awesome. He guided us through each place and provided excellent tips. I think he was a professional voice actor in the past. I booked this trip for Stonehenge but loved Bath the best.

My wife, sons and I had a good time. The ride was long but our guide Chris made it fun. He did a great job entertaining us along the way. He was also an archaeologist. To us, Stonehenge was the best even though most people might think it is just a bunch of very old rocks.

Most importantly - if you are traveling in a group or even as a couple get in early unless you are perfectly happy to sit next to a stranger. These tours are booked so that there is not a single seat free and frankly, my dear, Evan Evans don’t give a damn if they split you up.
Coaches are clean but there is no bathroom on board, the windows are stained and the seats are uncomfortably close to each other and leg space? There is none! this is cattle class London style.
Your guide gets you in and you go see what rocks your boat.

We looked forward to these tours and booked them well in advance the ensure our honeymoon was stress free. However this tour company is completely disorganized. We were given incorrect gate numbers, or no gate number at all at a station with 30 departure gates. We literally had to walk from one gate to another asking which was correct, only to find out that there was an Evan Evans booth at the station. Why wasn't that have been mentioned on the itinerary?. Horrible customer service.

After we finally departed, about 45 minutes late, we arrived at Windsor castle. You would think that for the purchase price of a group tour, you would receive preferred entry, not so much. We stood in line as long as single admissions, and spent more time in line than in the castle and on the grounds. After we rushed through the castle and tried to exit the grounds through Henry VIII gate, where we were told, the gate was closed for a guard procession, and we narrowly made our bus. Since these changings close everything down, the tour should allow extra time, as it is not possible to move past guards with guns. Poor customer service

Next stop was Stonehenge. Our tour guide Patti, gave us her private number at the beginning of the day in case we got held up. So upon returning with plenty of time, we were again held up by the Stonehenge shuttle bus from the venue to the welcome center, near the meeting point, which was about a mile or more, and took too long to walk. At that point we tried to call patti to let her know we were held up, but got her voice mail both times we called. Sadly, the reason we were held up was because there was a group of special needs tourists in front of us, and we waited through three busses that accommodated them, making us three minutes late. Apparently calling Pattis number was not to let her know that we were held up an on our way, but to let her know we were simply held up, and she left without us. We were stranded with no other contact information on how to return to London and had to rely on visitor center staff to make calls to other busses to get us back to London. The staff there was kind, and sympathetic to our situation, as they encounter it often. Poor customer service.

Buyer beware! Tour guides for evan Evans are independent contractors, not employed by the company. Depending on you guide, you may have a great experience with either Claudia or James Morgan who were both instrumental in our return to London. We were grateful to these two tour guides, as the only other option we had was to travel at our own expense. These tours overbook venues and do not have a contingency plan for people paying for their tours.

Not only is there not adequate time to visit a venue, but because we were left behind for the sake of three minutes, we missed seeing the remainder of our tour. Buyer beware, the bylines say they will not reimburse you if you are left behind. Had many other wonderful days in London and Paris without Evan Evans.

These tours are advertised as seeing many venues in a day, but instead are money traps for tourists which are paid upfront with no regard for customer service. This tour company did not even follow up with us, our hotel, or our travel agent to see if we were safe. We've taken many tours in our lifetime, never left behind, never treated with such disregard.

Go on this tour! It was so organized from the beginning. Our tour guide James and bus driver Mark were so so so knowledgeable and made a personal connection with every single person on the bus. I can’t say enough great things about this tour!

A long day but we were totally satisfied. Tired with Evens Tours departing by bus from Victoria Coach Station. Our guide Andrew, with a degree in history (I believe) was extremely well versed in the background of each site. He kept us entertained throughout and made sure we had absolutely minimal waits at each location. With the distances to travel between sites we only had time fo just over an hour and a half at each and one. But as planned this was to be only an introduction to the sites. We we very happy with the trip and will do some more homework in preparation for our next visit. Thank you Evens an Andrew, we will look for you again.

My husband and I enjoyed the destinations on this tour, but felt it was trying to do too much in one day. We had perhaps an hour and a half at each location, which was barely enough time to get oriented and see what we most wanted to see. If we were to do it again, we would choose a tour with two destinations only. And if you are especially interested in one, just go there!
It's a long day with many hours of driving as well. The guide was helpful in providing lots of information and part of the mini van time was well used in this way. You can purchase food, but if you stop to sit down to eat it, you will be using precious time at a destination!

I would not recommend this tour if you have more days to roam around London. Our trip to Windsor was so hurriedly done that our group of 9 was not able to even go inside. The guide was also a bit rude in the beginning and told my parents that they were “too slow for his pace” when my dad said that he was too fast. To be fair, he was in a hurry to get in line to get tickets to windsor.

Had I known this, i would have just taken a day trip in windsor and really explored it. There are shops around it.

But if you want to just get a glimpse of all these three places, then this trip should be fine.

We booked this tour specifically for Windsor Castle. As we’re lining up to board the bus, they notify us that Windsor is closed for an annual festivity. Something they knew about ahead of time. If they had told us, we would have booked a different day. Not happy about that! Our first stop was Bath, 3 hours away. Although the bus was large and comfortable, it did not have a toilet as many of the large buses do. There was also no water available, not even for purchase. The process at Bath was very disorganized; the guide was handing out the tickets randomly and gave some to people that hadn’t prepaid. Why didn’t he do that when people were disembarking the bus? The tour at Bath was rushed, we didn’t get to see everything on the audio tour. We left to meet the bus after a quick restroom stop. We arrived 5 minutes late and the bus was gone. We had been left. Fortunately for us, another Evans bus was there. Andy, the guide welcomed us aboard, as he had two extra seats. First thing I noticed was this bus had water. When we caught up with our original bus at Stonehenge, neither the driver nor the guide was aware that they had left us behind!! We even had items on the seat. Granted we were 5 minutes late but at Stonehenge we waited 15 minutes for other stragglers. In addition, our guide Joe didn’t seem very well informed about the sites we visited. He often ended his explanations with, “or something like that “. If you choose this bus line, ask for Andy and check the schedule before paying.

What an amazing experience. Oliver was very knowledgeable and quite charming..
The buses were easily accessible from Victoria bus station and the coaches clean and comfortable.

Our guide, Rhys, and driver, Mark S., provided us with an excellent tour. Everything was on time and we were very comfortable. Rhys was very knowledgeable and a great communicator. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

Our tour guide was Rhys and our driver was Lawrie and together they were a great team! As Rhys explained each of these attractions could easily take up a day in itself, so to do all tree in a single day is really more or a highlight reel touring approach. The coach was comfortable, the narration was top notch and equally entertaining, and the attractions were excellent albeit crowded. We took this tour on 6/13/2018.

Great tour to tick off a lot of bucket list items in one big go! Super easy to get to the Victoria Coach Station to get started. You're given a headset that connects to the guide for commentary, which is great in a big group as you don't have to be within ear shot to hear all the information. Although you don't get all the time in the world at each destination (after all it is 3 main places all within 11 hours!) our guide Chris gave us lots of options before letting us close at each destination. At Windsor I chose St George's Chapel and watched Changing the Guard - NOT to be missed. At Bath I did as much as possible with wonderful suggestions from Chris; the Roman Baths with a quick speedy walk through the 'museum' part of the baths, lots of photos, drank actually Bath water, had the most amazing bacon and leek pastie from The Cornish Bakery, choc mint icecream from Marsfield Farm (a local dairy!), and fudge on the suggestion of a friend. Last but not least was Stonehenge. An interesting site not to be missed! It was perfect weather to give you enough time to have a few thoughts about how and why it was erected, a walk all the way around the henge and back to the coach. Of course there was enough time at each destination to grab a souvenir! Our driver Kee did a wonderful job of driving comfortably between the destinations.

Fantastic tour guided by Chris. We were very fortunate to have a guide with first hand knowledge of Stonehenge. He is an archaeologist and brought a unique perspective to the tour. Much better than the pre-recorded tapes you often listen to. Very interesting, very entertaining. I highly recommend this tour and hopefully your lucky enough to get Chris as your guide and Bosko as your driver.

I completed this tour with Graham and Peter, our guide and driver. Both were very friendly and great hosts. Graham was quite the character and had plenty of dry jokes. He was very knowledgeable and provided us with lots of facts and information. Peter was an excellent and careful driver. This tour was good... it was great to see three different spots in 12 hours, however, it was a bit rushed and not enough time at each spot - but that is what I expected... the lunch was filling for a couple of hours. If I had my time back, I would have done the attractions on separate days to give plenty of time to be able to soak it all in (Windsor and Stonehenge on one day, Bath on another). Overall a great day though. I think Bath was my favourite! I would definitely visit there again! The only thing that I did not like about this tour (the reason why I did not give it 5 stars) is that we had VERY limited wifi on the bus and were NOT DROPPED OFF at the SAME destination we departed from and were only informed about that at the very start of the tour. I wish they would have told me that at the time of booking as I had to pay for a taxi back to my Airbnb which I did not plan for. There was an accident on the highway on the way back so we were stopped and waited for nearly an hour or two hours but that was out of our control. The seats are not very comfortable so bring a pillow to put in between the seat and your back. Would recommend this tour to anyone who has limited time in London!

If you have a day to spare while in the UK, this tour is just what you need. A longish day for sure but quite worth your time and money. Our great guide Oliver -a veritable source of information- and friendly driver Steve took us for a trip down history lane. First, a visit to Windsor Castle (memorable for fans of royalty) then to the wonderful city of Bath. We could have stayed in Bath forever, honestly. The friendly vibe and artsy atmosphere were fantastic. Last but not least, a tour of Stonehenge. A sunny day in the British countryside, friends, a cheese and onion pastry to die for at the visitor center in Stonehenge, and a pint of cold cider in Bath: all you need in life.

Was so impressed with this tour!!! Was easy to book and get to. The sites where amazing and we had just enough time to see what we wanted to at each place. Our driver Bosco was great and our tour guide for the day Chris was the best guide i have ever experienced he was full of amazing facts and pointed out sites through the whole drive. He was very funny and got us all excited for each stop. He mentioned studied archeology too which was awesome at Stonehedge because he was able to tell us all these really cool facts most won't know. I would book another tour simply for his knowledge!

We went on a tour on 3rd may and we had a beautiful day. The driver and the tour guide were very kind and helpfull with us. The tour guide told us a lot of informations, it was a great experience.
Thank you very much
I had a great time and would highly recommend it

Our tour guide Nigel, and driver Michelangelo were wonderful nice gentlemen. Nigel was very knowledgeable about our travels, the locations we were visiting and how to make the most of our time at each spot. We enjoyed our day very much.

This was the perfect tour for an introduction to these sights. There is not nearly enough time to see everything in one day and you do feel a bit rushed but this tour is great for getting a taste of the three sights. Our tour guide Rowan was so sweet, talkative and very informative. She has some great stories.

Our tour guide Godfrey and bus driver Paul were excellent! I really wish that there was even more time to explore Windsor Castle.(Hence the 4 rating) It was our incredible experience. Godfrey was so funny with entertaining us on the ride. We really enjoyed ourselves! Thank you England for making these three American girls feel so welcome! We will never forget it! Tammie, Elaine and Alesia
Had a excellent experience Mark the guide was very knowledgeable well arranged just sit back and relax

My partner and I took this tuor and it was definitely worht it. Our guide, Kathy was so knowlegeable and almost know everything about the Stonehenge, Windsor and Roman Bath. She made sure that everyone is well looked after from the beginning of the trip until the end, she even asked us for drop off location which would be convenient to us going back to London. Recommended many pubs and restu. Our driver also made sure that our stuff is secure inside the bus.

Tour guide: Phil
Driver: Nikki

Phil really made this experience.

I don’t think I need to sell the destinations to anyone considering this tour. Each one is fantastic and highly recommended.

My biggest concern was the downtime between destinations while riding on the coach.

It’s about a 12 hour trip with 50% of that time being transit time. The transit time, however was just as interesting as the time at the destinations because I learned so many interesting pieces of information from Phil and had such interesting conversation. I never felt bored once, which was a pleasant surprise.

The driver, Nikki, also did a great job giving us all a smooth ride from start to finish!

Overall, a fantastic tour and a great value! Highly recommended! Get Phil if you can!!!!

Excellent tours of Stonehenge, Bath and Windsor with fantastic tour guide Oliver and bus
driver Tom. Both were very professional and so much appreciated for providing us an enjoyable day! Thank you

We so enjoyed our tour! It is a long day but Phil our tour guide was fabulous! He started talking and pointing out all the interesting sites on our way to each destination and sharing interesting facts about them from the moment we left the bus station and didn't stop until we returned. He was committed to insuring everyone on his bus had a wonderful visit at each of these facinating venues as well as our entire visit to the UK. Definitely worth the time and cost.

Oliver was a great tour guide that provided wonderful insight into all three venues, and also a bit more about the city of London and some country side villages. Tom drove us safely through some snow covered country roads. We had a wonderful trip and highly recommend Evan Evans Tours. It was an agressive schedule for three venues but Oliver and Tom made it more pleasurable.

I'm sure any of their tours are great. We had Oliver and Mark as our guides and it was great. Mark was funny and their banter was great. Oliver was very knowledgeable, he could answer all our questions and had a great attitude. I wish we had done this tour earlier on our trip so we could have taken more with this company. The tours on our trip where my highlights, they can be pricey but it really is worth it. Takes the time and energy of planning off you and with great guides that know the history you can relax and learn the ends and outs of the city you're in.

Very well organized. Very comfortable buses. I appreciate the WiFi. Our guide was very welcoming and knowledgeable Would never done all that any other way. I personally liked the fact that you do the tours at your own pace and don’t push you to shop like in other places.
Few tips: know your tour number ( it’s on your voucher), that will alleviate the anxiety at the coach station since many other buses and tours depart around the same time.
Also, remember your bus number. That way you won’t be running from bus to bus trying to figure out which one was the one you were on.
And last but most importantly, be punctual.

We loved our Evan Evans tour to Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath! Our bus driver Mark was fantastic! He drive safely and smartly. Oliver was the very best tour guide ever! Witty, charming, informative, and so pleasant!! Would definitely recommend this tour but most specifically Mark and Oliver!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

It was a time and cost efficient way to see 3 world UNESCO heritage sites in one day. I am not the type of person who lingers at museum displays for hours so I had no problem with the time allotted at each site. It was perfect for me...just enough time for each site. Maybe I would have preferred less time at Stonehenge and more at Bath, its such a pretty town! I enjoyed looking at all those beautiful english countryside vistas as we drove along. All in all money well spent, a perfect day.

I was on this tour with 51 other visitors and it went very smoothly, our guide is Sheila and she was very good, she speaks very good Japanese. the time allotted for each attractions was enough to fully enjoy each attractions, plenty of time to take pictures and shop around, I truly enjoyed it.

If you have visited London and not visited Stonehenge, then your trip is not completed. Beauty cannot be expressed by word, request you to visit this place and compulsory take the audio guide to explain the architecture and build of Stonehenge

The tour is very good, and takes you around to all of the spots that it says it does. The tour guide was knowledgeable and nice. The bus is big and comfortable and has wifi. Our only complaint was that it feels a bit rushed because of all of the places you are trying to see. We felt a bit rushed at Windsor Castle which was our first stop and probably was the place we wanted to spend the most time in. Next time we will book a tour with less stops along the way. Other than that the tour is very good and we were glad that we booked it.

This was a busy day trip on 12/30. We started out at Windsor castle. Just beautiful. As other reviewers have mentioned there is not enough time here. It does make us want to return. Off to Stonehenge next. Very interesting but maybe too much time spent here. Our last stop was in Bath. Again not enough time but a very charming town and would like to return. Our guide was Debbie. She was knowledgeable, helpful, and funny. I would recommend d this trip if you do not have a lot of time in London (we had only 5 days).

And Phil was quite literally our favorite tour guide of all time!

My wife and I travel a lot... including all 50 states and approximately 45 countries, so believe me when I say we absolutely loved our day trip with Phil, the most interesting and knowledgeable tour guide we've ever had!

We can't recommend this tour enough. Call and ask for Phil if possible!

I loved each of these locations. It was a great way to spend the day and explore more out of London. However, the time was so limiting, we barely got to take in what we were looking at. There was almost no time for bathroom breaks or food. It is at least an 8 hour tour and we had to choose between buying cold food (because hot is not permitted on the coach) or seeing what we can at each site. I understand the time constraints of travelling, but the fact that we didn't have time for food was a bit upsetting. We also did not have time to see most of Windsor Castle because the line to enter was so long even though we arrived before it opened. I even wanted more time at Stonehenge because we had to rely on busses to take us to the site from the Visitor's Center and it was really crowded.
Great sites to wiew and the excellent duo of driver Jim and guide Bruce, made this tour easy to recommend!
Overall pleasant experience other than the terrible weather. Would have appreciated more time at each spot other than Stone henge.

Wonderful day trip to three beautiful sites, very busy day but worth every minute, I recommend Jim the best bus driver you can get and I enjoyed specially the interesting and extensive explanations of our guide, Bruce!

Throughly enjoyed this trip but unfortunately it was quite a busy day at all 3 locations which left us with a short time at each location. Maria our guide did a great job with filling our time in line with a lot of stories and details about each location while we waited. She even did her best with trying to give us more time at each location. Overall loved the tour!
Saul was a great guide. Took good care of us. Saw the Queens final resting spot and really enjoyed Stonehenge. Long day but worth it.

richard and earl are the best!! richard is so knowledgeable and earl was so charming (but don’t tell richard i said that)! this is a lot to do in one day & they will swim you through it. just don’t be like me & spend all your cash so you can give them a tip at the end 😅

Robert and Mareck were fantastic! This was my first time doing a day-long tour and Robert has set the bar high for any future tours for me! Very friendly, knowledgeable, and organized. Thanks for the great day!!
Robert, the tour guide, and Marek, the driver, provided an excellent tour of Windsor castle, stone henge, and Bath. The drive was smooth and the stories entertaining and informative.
Our guide, Chrissy, was great! Overall the tour was very enjoyable. It did feel a bit rushed and I wished we had more time to explore the sights.
Such a fun tour with the best duo, Peter and Behar. Definitely worth the time and money. I hope you get Peter as your guide when you book it.
Brilliant place will be back really enjoyed thanks staff lovely, lovely surrounding brilliant place 23
Peter and Behar were wonderful ambassadors for these amazing sites Peter provided thoughtful insight for each place that we visited. A beautiful taste of Britain!
This was a great day trip out guide Robert was great and very informative. We had a great driver Luna, would definitely take another tour with them.

Our guide (Robert) was extremely well educated and provided a tremendous amount of knowledge and fun stories throughout the day. Our driver for the day was safe and efficient! Thank you for the great day!!

What a great day trip from London!! We were a little rushed at each location, but the day was wonderful nonetheless! Our wonderful guide Deborah and driver “Ward” made the experience educational and a lot of fun!

We enjoyed the tour but we did feel rushed all the way through! Our first stop was Windsor Castle and we were able to see St. George's Chapel and the resting place of the Queen (you file through the chapel single file without stopping) and then on to the State Rooms. We barely had time to walk through the State Rooms because we had to walk quickly back to the bus - needing to find a place to pick up lunch to eat back on board. We weren't given any recommendations of lunch places that provided take away food. We ended up eating chips and an apple for lunch. At Stonehenge, we boarded the shuttle that takes you to the site and then it's hurry up and get back on the bus. It was the same in Bath - you get in line for the Roman Baths - walk quickly through and back to the bus. (We did find a place that could serve us a quick meal before we had to get back on the bus!) It's a long day, but I thought there might be a little more time for a sit-down meal.
Bath was amazing part of trip ,tour guid named ,Peter and driver Judi were so freindly and made our trip so lovely and enjoyable journey ..always smiling and joking ☺.thanks to both specially Peter 😀
Katia was a great guide and Jeoff was a excellent driver. This tour was very informative and would definitely recommend.

I booked the trip to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge from London on 27th October 2022 with all entry frees Inc. I went to pick up point on time at the first. However, I missed the coach at the first place (Windsor castle) according to the emergency cause. The guide had an appointment at the coach parking at 11.20 AM. At 11 Am I try to exited from the castle but there were an soldiers exhibitions, the only one exit was temporally closed until 11.20 AM. I tied to came out and bake to the officer inside the castle, unfortunately he said that “no permit” until the exhibition would finished. Then, I could come out at 11.20 AM and try to ran to the coach as fast as I can. I arrived the coach parking around 11.30 AM, but no our bus waiting, it’s gone. I have no phone number of the guide or driver and my belonging was in the coach. I'm very suffer to finger out went back to London and my house's key on the coach. I had to ask each other for help.

I know coming on time is very important but for me It's an emergency event that I didn't need it occur. I’m tourist and go alone. It’s my bad and fear experience in UK.

This tour was one of my favorite things in London. Our tour guide, Phil, was lovely. His knowledge was unparalleled plus he was a nice guy. I considering the distance to Bath and Stonehenge, I was happy to have our bus driver, Michele, navigate for us. The tour was convenient, fun and informative. Glad I did it!

Robert (Guide) and Jerry (Driver) were absolutely amazing! What a tour. Of course it was a long day but they truly made quite an experience to remember. Robert is so knowledgeable and quite funny. Jerry made sure we made it to our destinations safely and in time. Great couple of guys- highly recommend ❤️
Our guide Robert and driver Jerry were awesome! Always made sure we had fun and stayed safe! Will definitely book again ONLY WITH THEM!
Robert was an amazing guide and Jerry was the best driver. Also, the sites were breathtaking. Highly recommend this tour!

I have a really nice time!!!!! Robert is amazing,full of knowledge and very humour,make the trip very comfortable and enjoyable!
Definitely will recommend it!
This was a very nice trip and very informative, unfortunately my mum couldn’t understand everything as it’s English only.

Guide was very informative and helpful.
Had an overall good experience.
Scenery is outstanding..

Would recommend to take this.
Select the days where Windsor castle is open. I think it is closed on Tuesdays and Thursdays.. Robert (tour guide) and Sam(driver) were great!

I would like to thank Richard and Sam for being and amazing guide throughout the journey.
Evan Evans: the ride was very comfortable.

I have taken this tour 2nd time and the experience is exponentially good.
Thank you Godfrey and Greg for a wonderful tour! A great way to see the 3 sights in a day. Entry into all the sights was seamless and Godfrey gave us some excellent recommendations in each location.
Robert and Rav were both great. The day went smoothly. We enjoyed seeing all the sights and hearing Roberts commentary
Robert our guide and Rav our driver were amazing, best combo of people to have on this 10/10 tour! Would definitely recommend!
