3 amazing must-see sights on a trip to London. The convenience of visiting by bus in a group tour was nice, and the tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable. There was also wifi on the bus and it was clean. Windsor Castle is absolutely beautiful, Stonehenge is fascinating, and the Roman Baths are really neat to tour around.

However, not a lot of time was given at each stop. It took an hour drive to get to Windsor Castle, and we had just over an hour of time to sight-see after waiting in line for 20-30 mins (also no lunch included, which took up precious time at this castle to have to grab a sandwich. Pack a lunch if you can). Then another hour drive to Stonehenge, and 45 mins- 1 hour to visit here depending on the length of lines to take the shuttle back to the bus. Another hour drive to Bath, and again only an hour visit for the Roman Baths / the whole city. Then a 3 hour drive back to London. So 3.5 hours of sight-seeing, 1 hour of waiting in lines at the 3 places combined, and 6.5 hours of bus, plus waiting time for the stragglers to get back. You also definitely need to buy access in advance to the castle, and Stonehenge (Roman Baths more optional since you could walk around the city) otherwise there's not really a point in going on the tour, so factor that into costs.

Overall, it was convenient to visit these 3 sights in one day with a knowledgeable guide but we felt we did not get nearly enough time to visit the sights.

Okay let me start with the pros:
Our guide Robert, and our bus driver were both great! Robert is funny, friendly, calm, and knowledgable. He did a great job with a day that took a bit of a rotten turn toward the end(not his fault). The bus driver did a good job navigating some very narrow passages and was patient when a problem popped up with the bus. The locations that the tour visits are all awesome and worth seeing. Robert made sure we understood where to go, walked us in as far as he could and ensured we had entrance(if you had purchased). If not, he directed you how to buy your entrance tickets on site. His bus commentary was great and made the ride go more quickly. Super great guy.

Okay, soooooo we had some issues. None of these were anyone's fault, but still made the second half of the tour a lot less fun than it could have been. First of all, we ran into traffic backup caused by an accident on the way to Stonehenge which cost us about half an hour and put us behind schedule. When it was time to leave Stonehenge one of the guests did not show up for the bus and couldn't be found anywhere. Turns out she was shopping and that cost the entire bus another half hour waiting on her to show up. The return times were clear ahead of time so this was quite annoying for the rest of us. Between Bath and Stonehenge we had a brake fluid problem of some kind and had to pull over to try to figure that out which took another half hour. Thankfully got moving again but by the time we got to Bath there wasn't even time to tour the actual Baths and barely time to eat. At this point we were over 2 hours outside of London. When it was time to return to the bus....no bus in sight. Turns out the bus driver had taken it somewhere to be looked at which is fine and better than being stranded but the communication at this point wasn't great. Pulled out of Bath almost an hour late. Soooooo by the time we returned to London we were about 2.5 hours past our expected return time. It was now 9:30 pm . We were supposed to return at 7pm. We had set up a car to take us to an airport hotel at 9 pm thinking we had a 2 hour buffer. Nope. So the car canceled and we had to try to get an Uber which was a pain bc of the strikes going on. Also, the last leg of the trip was miserable because most of us spent the extra time in Bath at the pub with a pint and then found out the bathroom on the bus did not work and could not be used. At any rate, they did the best they could but it ended up pretty miserable towards the end. Robert was apologetic and we all felt terrible for him and the bus driver as it sucked as much for them as it did for us. I feel the company could have reached out to us at least to apologize and maybe a partial refund or discount for another time would be in order at the very least. I would not hesitate to recommend this tour as I feel like on a regular day without all these random problems it would be a great time. Also, as others have mentioned the check in at the bus depot is a complete mess. Hopefully we get back to London someday and can try again.

We had an absolute blast on our trip today. We saw it all in one day. Saul was our guide and he was awesome. He gave us little tidbits of trivia and information all while keeping us on our schedule. The schedule is tight in order to see it all in a day. Luckily we had James the coach driver who got us everywhere we needed to be on time. James and Saul were the dynamic duo. Getting us there before the other tours London has to offer, getting us to the head of the queues and the vouchers we needed to see the attractions. Windsor Castle was first. As I said We we’re the second group to arrive and we were inside in less than 20 minutes. We walked the grounds and then toured inside. Inside opened at 10am. We had to be back by 11am to move out. We had plenty of time to see the historical artifacts that lined the inside of Windsor Castle and to see the changing of the guard on the way out. There is a McDonald’s in the village so you can get food and drink for the next part of your trip. After that it was off to Stonehenge. We were there in a little more than an hour. This was my favorite stop. Saul made it easy to get out, get a mini bus and get the the stones. After an hour we were back on the bus. Plenty of time for Stonehenge and some time for the gift shop. They also have a little cafe but if you can wait till your next stop for some food and drink. Bath was next. We were there in about an hour thanks to James’ incredible driving. Saul was great showing us the sites and giving more history and other fun facts about the village. Saul got us all set for the Ancient Roman Bath tour and then we were off. We had about an hour and a half till we had to be back on the bus to head home to London. We had just enough time on this one because of all the shops in town. Plenty of places for food and drink here though so tuck in because it is about a 2.5 hour drive back. This was an super good time though. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone who is London for a short time and would like to see it all in a day. So put on your walking shoes and make sure you have enough space on your phone for pictures because Saul and James are taking you on adventure.

We booked a Sunday tour because many shops and venues are closed or close early in London and it was a great decision.
Guides- Rowan and Kevin are a great team. Kevin is extremely capable as driver, smooth road skills with no pitching and bouncing you around in the seats and Rowan is the most delightfully sweet, competent and informative guide you could ask for. Directions, expectations, and suggestions are clear and reasonable. I highly recommend a break from the city and this tour is perfect!

This was an amazing tour! Our guide Pete was knowledgeable and concerned with all the passengers; the driver Bob was also extremely attentive and gentle. I couldn’t say which was the best part: the royal palace in Windsor; the Roman baths in Bath or the wonderful and mysterious Stonehenge. I really loved it all!
Thanks to super knowledgable guide Ildi and very smooth driver Michaelangelo!! I had a totally enjoyable day.

It is a full packed and busy day. However getting to see all the sites was totally worth it. Andy Jackman the tour guide previously worked for the royal family and his knowledge was second to known. Great tour

Perfect day with a great guide (Mel)... Interesting✅ Fun✅ Worth it✅

The trip was pleasant, although we were on the road a bit I was keep well entertained by our guide, he has a good sense of humour and provided information about each location as well other historical facts.

Thanks Evan Evans 😎
Oliver was a great tour guide, very informative and funny. He truly made the tour! I recommend bringing an umbrella and warm jacket if you go in April!

A big day with a visit to these three wonderful locations. Would definitely recommend including the tour of the baths while in Bath in the package. Oliver our tour guide was very knowledgeable and entertaining. He was friendly and engaging which made the day even better. Felt very safe with Bob our bus driver in the driving seat. Even though the time was limited at each place and felt a bit rushed, I would still highly recommend this tour.

bus was comfortable and we got a taste of all three sites in one day. Nicholas was so knowledgeable about the sights and everything we were seeing along the way. He honestly enjoyed sharing his knowledge and seemed to enjoy the trip as much as we did. He had a rich knowledge of history, science, pop culture, other countries and the royals. knew when to move us along to beat the crowds and made the journey easy and fun A tour guide can make or break trips like these, and he pushed it over the top. thank you for a great day.
What a fantastic day trip. Our guide Nicholas and driver Nikki were awesome. Nicholas was very entertaining and knowledgeable not just about our detinations but of England in general.
Went on a Viator tour which included Bath and Windsor. Cold and windblown in November but a must do site.
What a great day !!!! I loved this tour, great service, and the staff members they were excellent!!! Claudia the tour guide did a really great job !!!! I’ll be back soon

Fantastic tour! James, our tour guide, was super. His knowledge of the sites was superb. Having worked for the Royal Family combined with his background as a historian, he was full of insights, and poor jokes!

I went on this trip with a friend and it was early, but you had time to sleep on the bus. We had a great tour guide and bus driver; Rowan and Lawrie. They made sure we got to each of the places on time and in same cases early enough to get a head of the line! Rowan was very energetic about history and made it fun to learn about. They even dropped us off close to our hotels at the end of the trip. You had about an hour at each stop. It wasn't enough in some places but a great eye opener to more places in London.
Kevin was a great and helpful. Did the Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge was very enjoyable.Would recommend the trip. Ask for Kevin.
Beautiful! The whole trip was excellent. The cherry on top of it all -Godfrey and Aston our tour guide and driver. Super Knowledgeable and caring. Thank you!

This tour packs a lot in during one day but if you want to see all 3 sites and are short on time it is worth it. If you have the time I would suggest doing this in 2 days instead because Bath is such a beautiful place and we had no time to explore and enjoy it because we were stuck in traffic on the way there. The bath house is worth seeing but that is all we had time to do. The town is so beautiful i would have like to spend the whole afternoon there. Our tour guide Mel was fantastic. He is extremely knowledgeable about all London history and sightseeing and he is very animated so he is very entertaining and fun. So if you want to see all 3 sites, which are all worth visiting, and only have one day this tour is great, but if you have an extra day break it up and do it in two days instead.

We have gone on various tours in different parts of the world but this one was one of the best. Our guide and driver, James and Kevin were amazing. James was humorous and extremely knowledgeable. His tips and tricks helped us make the best of the limited time we had at each site. James was able to keep the group on time and you could see that everyone had a wonderful time. Despite the long lines at all 3 attractions, the tour was timed so well that in most cases we were able to beat the crowd and make the most of our time. Although the bus had no WiFi my teens did not miss it because James kept its going with all his anecdotes and jokes. This was definitely a must do especially if you have limited time in London and want to get in a lot of sightseeing

This tour is great if you want to visit all three sites in one day. This tour is not so great if you want to spend a lot of time at any of the three sites that you get to visit (I would say that you get about an hour tops at each site). Please note, this is not because the tour "rushes" you. This is because the sites aren't close to each other, so in order to get you to where you need to be, there needs to be strict time constraints. I say all that to say, choose this tour if you don't have a lot of time, but want to visit all three sites in one shot, but go with another tour if you want to have a more intimate experience at each site.

As for the sites themselves, absolutely beautiful! All three of them. In fact, my wife and I would love to visit/stay in Bath for a few days sometime in the near future. It looks like such a great place!

p.s. Great tour guide! (Rodney?) and I'd recommend / I would book through Evan Evans Tours again.

This was an amazing tour. Packed with three major activities but really worth it. Rob (tour guide) and Malcolm (coach driver) were the best. Even though we hit some traffic on the highway, Rob kept us entertained and well informed.

We really enjoyed seeing these three wonderful sites in one day. The downside is that you spend 5 of the 11 hours driving between the sites. Our tour guide helped to pass the time by telling us interesting stories. I am not sure I would try to pack so much into one day if I had to do it over again.

A very enjoyable tour with excellent guidance from guide Oliver. Though we hit some major traffic, he was able to take us through all the sites with enough time to see them. Kept us entertained with this stories about London & neighborhood
Alex was an excellent tour guide. She was very informative. Definitely needed more time at Windsor Castle.

The tour we took through Evan Evans was terrific.
Our tour guide Phil was amazing & made the trip worth every cent.
The amount of information that Phil had about Windsor Castle, Bath & Stone Hedge was amazing

Our guide Omar and driver Jane were fantastic. The whole day was well timed and the information that Omar provided about the areas bought more enrichment to the whole day. #evanevanstours tours_with_omar

The trip was so so amazing. We went to all the 3 places today and really enjoyed thoroughly. The guide Karen and Jane by Evan Evans were so good in terms of guiding us through and taking care of all the small small things. The trip was long but if you have small window to explore the 3 places this tour works perfectly. Thanks to the Tour company and tour guide for making this a memorable trip for us.

Chris and Kevin were awesome! We all received ear phones and an apparatus to listen to our guide as we made our way to each site on foot from the bus. Also, Our guide kept us entertained with his knowledge of the areas we drove through on our way to Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge-(he also was a former acheologist at Stonehenge). We had nice quiet time on the bus as well and ample Time at each site although just given the overall timeframes things felt a bit rushed - but don’t let that stop you from booking this tour - all day tours are this way. We loved it and would book again with Evan Evans tours!

Claudia was EXCELLENT! Full of info and fun. Kevin was the best driver. We had to detour from Bath to Stonehenge, due to an auto accident. Kevin took us on the most scenic detour. Breathtaking scenery! Trip was well organized and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this trip to anyone.

This tour was great from the start! Easy to book, pickup point was effortless to find. Bus was clean, tidy and very comfortable! Our guide Rowan was so fantastic. She was knowledgeable, super friendly, easy to understand and nothing was too much trouble. Our bus driver Lawrie was very professional. Enjoyed the day and would definitely recommend to anyone. Thanks again Rowan and Lawrie.
What a great day! A highlights tour that delivered. Rowan our guide was brilliant, great knowledge and great fun.

Today we went on the Evans and Evans Tour to Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, and Bath and it was well run. The tour gives you enough time at each stop and the stops are brilliant themselves. I highly recommend this tour company.

Everything about the tour was perfect. Everything was as per schedule, and the tour bus was very comfortable. The guide was super cool and very knowledgeable. We speak time in 3 great tourist places and we loved it. Amazing experience!

James is an awesome and funny tour guide, and Valentine makes our ride safe and smooth.
James has explained to us the History of Windsor castle so well, and great tips from him on where to get the best view to watch the change of guards.
My tour guide Andy Jackson was fantastic! Highly recommend this tour. I never felt rushed, perfect amount of time at each stop.

First I would like to say that this company was amazing. The night before our tour we realized we made a mistake in booking, called at 8 o'clock at night and they fixed it for us. This was a mistake that was all our fault and something they really did not have to fix (and I assume many other companies would not fix at all) but they did. As for the tour we had plenty of time at each place considering it was a busy Saturday. We really got to just explore and see the sights since the guide on the way there gave us plenty of info on what we were going to. We did not go into the Roman Baths but our guide gave us great places to go see while we were there. I would highly suggest that if you have just s day and want to see these places to go on this tour because it is not only informative but extremely convenient and the company is great.

My guide was James, who was wonderful. He was very knowledgeable and made the tour exciting and fun. You will definitely do a lot on this trip and it is so worth it. Bath was absolutely amazing and Windsor Castle was unforgettable. I am so happy that I decided to book this tour. Our driver Tom as also amazing. These guys did a great job!

This was by far the best organized tour I have ever taken.
James, our tour guide, was one of the reasons this tour was so good. Yes, the sites we visited were notable on their own. James took that experience to an entirely different level with his vast knowledge of basically "everything"! He made the entire day interesting with historical facts. He is also quite witty. He always made sure were first in line, ahead of the many additional tours/tourists.
The second reason this tour was remarkable was our experienced bus driver Tom. The day we took our tour it was quite rainy and windy. Tom drove the luxury bus like nobody’s business! He had control of the vehicle at all times and we not only made it to each destination safely but quickly- even in the inclement weather.
Each visit along the tour was like walking in a history book. Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath were all beautiful sites. You experience enough of each to leave you wanting to come back and thoroughly visit each more.
I highly recommend you take this tour and if you can get James and Tom- even better!

This tour is highly recommended - it was one of the highlights from my trip. It was well organized and our guide, Kattia, was very knowledgeable. She kept us engaged for the entire trip and had lots of information to share, whether it was about the region we were passing, or the places we were visiting. She made sure we all stuck to the schedule, but yet was very considerate at the same time. Many of the other reviews will touch on the fact that "there wasn't enough time" at each location; however, I found it was a good amount of time as long as your group meets back on the bus in a timely fashion and you're moving through each place semi-quickly. Each location is atleast 1 hr apart from the other and there is an approximately 3 hr drive back to London at the end of the day. I loved how each location included an audio-guide so you could move through the locations at your own pace. Would definitely recommend!

This is the perfect trip for someone who isn't in the UK for long but wants to see some of the major highlights the country has to offer. You will meet the bus at Victoria Coach Station (not to be confused with the Victoria Station a few blocks away :) ) and will go to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and then Bath. This is a full day tour! We left at 8am and got back to Victoria Station at 7pm.

Both the driver and the guide were excellent. Both very knowledgeable of the sites and were good at what they did. All of the places were fantastic to visit!

I am giving this a rating of 4/5 for three reasons: 1. When I arrived at Victoria coach station, the gentlemen who were checking us in was rather rude and short towards me. I didn't have my ticket already out when I approached him and he spoke to me like I was an idiot. 2. Windsor castle was closed the day we were there so we didn't have a chance to go in. 3. The amount of time at each location was a bit short. This may be unavoidable because of how far away each site is from each other, but I would have liked more time at each one!

If you have the time, I would recommend traveling to these locations on your own. They all seemed pretty easy to get to by train/bus. I recommend staying overnight in Bath if you can!
James gave us a great history lesson interspersed with plenty of humor. Would definitely travel with him again anytime.

This tour is extremely packed with things to do, and you have to be prepared to stick to a strict time schedule, but if you do, the sights are amazing. Our guide was very helpful although I admit I've forgotten his name, and our driver was excellent.

After seeing the high score at tripadvisor I booked this tour and didnt become disappointed. Whats important is that the guide is good, this one (Katja) was very good! And I will not forget the Coach driver Tom! Excellent driver.
Best was Stonehenge and I will defently recommend this tour to others. 5/5!!

Everything went smoothly for us from waiting for the bus, went on the tour, explored the places and reached back to London safely. Our tour guide, Andy Jackson was very informative and the bus driver was friendly.

It took around 12 hours to complete this tour and it's worth it especially if you are visiting England for the first time.

The Evan Evans tour was very well organised. Chris is a super guide and gave us a lot of detail about the countryside we passed as well as the sites. Maybe worth mentioning is that he does accompany you on the Stonehenge tour, but not in Windsor Castle or the Roman baths. The latter two provide audio guides. Thank you Malcolm for driving us safely in the stormy weather! It would have been nice to spend the hour+ waiting in line to enter Windsor Castle actually visiting the property. Definitely take a (cold) lunch because there is no time to eat at any of the sites. It is a fast moving tour that packs in a whole lot!

This tour took about 11 hours, but what a great way to travel and see everything. We were first in line to get into Windsor Castle (fees included), straight to Stonehenge with interesting commentary along the way (fees included), and then off through Bath, Box, and Lacock. Because it was a Sunday, they closed the Lacock pub and served just the bus tours, which was great. Food and drinks were ready upon arrival, and was a perfect ending to the day. I would highly recommend this tour.

It was a lot to see in one day trip but worth to go. Steven M is our tour guide and provided us information all along. Tony is our driver who keep us on track and we had a safe trip. The Windsor Castle is a must visit place as this is one of the largest castle that’s still in full function. Unfortunately we only had a short period of time there and we don’t have enough time to see the change of guard and we have to leave to keep on track.

Although the weather is not the best as we had pouring rain in Stonehenge, me and my son tried our best to get close to the site but the wind was too strong. The rain coat/ poncho can only save our top, we still got wet.

We had a great lunch at Lacock and this was our first fish and chip experience in England. It was a nice and cosy restaurant full of history. If the bus could just go around a couple street to show us the historical houses it would be great.

Bath - a nice town and the weather finally get better there. We browse around the center and the church and visited a couple stores. I had the scotch tasting as Steven introduces they sell local melt here. I tried a single melt scotch whiskey and the first experience is full of aroma and the alcohol. This was a 12 year old whiskey with limited bottled produced. However with the same price range I could get a brand name single melt with better taste, I didn’t choose to buy local. I also saw a store selling British wool scarf which I was quite interested in but they were closed. Since most of the store in London had already updated with new season clothing, it is not easy to find it in London.

This tour was great -- in fact, more than I hoped it to be. Our tour guide, Emily, was extremely knowledgeable, gracious, funny, and explained each of our stops in with detail and accuracy. Bosco was our driver and kept us on time to each stop and very comfortable in the coach while we were driving. We were able to take a short tour of Windsor Castle and, because we toured on a Sunday, we sadly had to miss the tour of St. George's because the church was closed for Sunday services but made up for that with shopping in the shops around Windsor. Stonehenge was breathtaking and larger than life. Again, because of the travel distances for the day, we only had a short amount of time to tour the stones before we had to be back in the coach to go to Bath. The tour of the Roman Baths was one of the most interesting offerings on the tour and there was ample time to go through the Baths and then take a picture or two in front of Bath Abbey. Plenty of time was left for shopping. Bath is a most picturesque town and we loved the ride to and from with all the green fields and caramel colored houses. This was a well run, informative, eye-opening tour that I would happily go on again.......but only if we had Emily and Bosco guiding us along the way!

My Wife, daughter, and I really enjoyed our tour experience. Our Guide Catia was great. She not only shared the information in an interesting way, but also interacted well with the group. Barry also did a great job driving and helping out with the Vox equipment.

This trip was well organized and an absolute pleasure to experience. Our guide James was knowledgeable, experienced, and hysterically funny. Our driver Nadia managed a large bus full of tourists through some tight roads and heavy traffic quite well. I highly recommend this tour for anyone seeking a fun day trip.

We had Mel as our tour guide and he was excellent and very knowledgeable about everything along the way. He made the history pop out of buildings that I wouldn't have thought twice about otherwise. This was my first time to London and the UK in general and it was a great decision to come on this tour. I came with my girlfriend and we both had an amazing time!
Great tour! Enjoyed all the stops and the tour guide Godfrey & driver Thomas were amazing. Very informative and great use of time to see attractions outside of London!

Great tour through and through. We were the only people at Stonehenge, which of course was a real treat. Oxford really, really great as well.
Mr. Andy Jackson was an absolute treat as a guide, full of equal parts fact and humor. Thanks for helping it make such a great day!
You gotta see this masterpiece in person to truly appreciate the size, beauty and ingenuity. Well worth the short drive. If you are in the UK, I highly recommend this to everyone!!!
Our guide was Katya. She was great. We traveled to Windsor Castle, then to Stonehenge and finally to Bath. We had a great time.

Andy Jackson was absolutely charming and proved to be very knowledgeable.... and quite the storyteller. He ensured that we were informed of all aspects of our trip and kept everyone organized. I most enjoyed his vast knowledge from years of personal experience. Given the opportunity I would absolutely seek out Mr. Jackson again.

It was a great tour made even better by our guide Andy Jackson! Four thumbs up! We had the best view partnered with the best stories and commentaries from our guide. Fun indeed! Everything was well timed, we made it early to Windsor Castle, escaping really long lines. We were always on time. Definitely enjoyed it! Book with Evan Evans Tours and pray that you'd have Andy Jackson as your guide! :) All the best!

Whether you are a solo traveler or you are opting in with partners,friends etc you will enjoy it! If you're short on time, with no transportation and are looking to squeeze seeing Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath into one day this is the PERFECT tour for you.

The only downside of this tour is that if you opt to see the Roman Baths, you don't have time to see many things outside in Bath. However you have plenty of time at the other stops.

Our guide Phill was a phenomenon!!! Just amazing! I am a trip/tour leader myself and I have seen very few EXCELLENT trip leaders around the world.. HE IS ONE OF THEM :) He is very informative and entertaining. His knowledge goes far beyond what is required.. He informed us about the local customs, local and world history and much more..! You can tell that he simply loves what he does! What a gentleman! The tour was well timed and we got to Windsor Castle early so we could go in as soon as the gates opened. The fact that they provide headphones and an audio so we could hear everything he said was very useful.

Although we were not allowed to take pictures inside the Chapel, we saw where Meghan Markle married Price Harry and her wedding dress and the military uniform he wore at the wedding. The tour of the Roman city of Bath was also beautiful and the town itself is charming. Stonehenge was very interesting and 1 hour and 15 minutes was plenty of time. Well done Evans Tours, and especially Phil! I give him the highest rating!!!

Be sure to take out some cash for a tip which the guide and driver share.
Thank you Phil!
Had a blast! Godfrey and Nicola were awesome. He knew just what to do to help us maximize our time! Could use some usb drives for charging on the bus though.
Saw all three fantastic venues in one day was just right. The day was long yet so much was seen. Thanks to Katia for her expert knowledge of sights and James for driving. Well done!

This was a very good trip for a reasonable price. We went to three places, received a box and had an excellent tour guide and driver. The tour guide genuinely cared for us and you can tell he actually enjoyed his job and was proud of being from England. I recommend this tour for any one going to London. All the places visited were outstanding.

If you're short on time and are looking to fit seeing Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath into one day this is the perfect tour. Our guide Kevin was really informative. The only downside of this tour is that if you opt to see the Roman Baths, you don't have time to see anything else in Bath. However you have plenty of time at the other stops.

This was a day trip from Central London, the bus tour was very good, the site has an extremely interesting history, but some of the tourists are less than respectful of the location, a couple times guards had to chase tourists away from the site. It is worth a visit, but I would plan it as a stop from one location to another, vice the focus of a day.

My mom and I took this day trip in July 2018 during our mother-daughter trip-- we had a blast! It was definitely a fast paced day, bopping around from location to location, but so thankful we got to do and see all that we did. Left us wanting to dedicate a day each to each place. Thank you for the memories!

My family of 5 took this day trip last week. Our tour guide was Phil and he was so informative and very knowledgeable. He could not have been more helpful. The day went smoothly and we all had a great time.

Oliver our guide and Moe our driver were absolutely great in this intense 1 day tour from London on a day when the weather was at its extreme in Stonehenge! Highly engaging and thoroughly professional, we had a fantastic time in Windsor, Stonehenge and Bath. We only wish we had more time as there was so much to do! Oliver was an expert at guiding us during the actual tours and engaged us with a lively commentary during the bus ride. He even made sure to really try and find a missing tourist in our group who had wandered off in Bath. Recommended! The guys and the company are pros!

This day trip begins at 7:30am, and ends around 8:00pm, so it is a very long day. That said, it was a great way to see three places in one day and not have to drive. The bus is very comfortable, the driver, Laurie was great, and our tour guide, Rowan, was the best! She is very knowledgeable on English history, and kept us informed and entertained all day! We saw Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath and really enjoyed are (loooong) day!

We just recently returned home from our two week stay abroad and we all agree that this was our favorite day. We took the tour on Jan 2, 2019 with Mel and Andy. Mel was charming, funny, and witty. Andy kept us safe on the roads, as you can tell he is a very skilled driver. It was a great way to see a few sights. I will definitely choose a tour through Evan Evans again, if we ever have the chance.

Thank you Alex and James for a wonderful tour. It was a long day but you were great! Alex is very informative.She made the trip more exciting with her extensive knowledge and love for sharing information. Looking forward to another day trip with you guys! Massive thanks and Happy New Year!

We loved our guide Mel and our whole day trip experience. Mel was very informative and offered some great tidbits and topics for conversation! It is a long day- but everything we saw was beautiful and totally worth the long trip. Totally recommend and ask for Mel, if you can!! He’s great!!

They do a great job on this busy tour to get all the attractions in for a single day, seemed to have ample and not rushed time at each location. Guide Karen and driver Denise were both insightful, courteous and helpful. Definitely recommend this tour for those that want to take extensive time at a single location.

We have been on several tours before, and never have we had a guide with more knowledge than James. You can tell he really loves his job, and enjoys sharing everything he knows about the history of England. He is what is known as an academic historian, so he literally knows everything about everything. Well worth the time and expense,, a terrific highlights tour.

Stonehenge - a bit disappointed ... not really what we expected
Windsor Castle - Good walkabout and history about the royal families.. heritage
We had a fantastic day with Claudia and Mou. There was a lot of people due to the Holidays but Claudia managed the times perfectly.

James, a professor of history at Oxford with deep insight into the royal family, made the day fascinating. He kept us on time, which ended up saving us an hour what would have been wasted queue time. I rate the day summa cum laude.

The tour was a quick sampling of the highlights of each of the three sites. The tour guide Rowan was delightfully witty and regaled us with stories and history of the areas. Laurie was a splendid driver. (MUCH better than the driver we had on a tour the day before with a different company!)

At first, the early start time seemed... too early, but we ended up being the second group in the queue for Windsor Castle. Not having to wait in a long queue was well worth the early start time. Also, the winter days are short, and we were able to visit all of the sites before the sun set.
Oliver our tour guide was great! Kept us informed along the way. One downside to the tour way to quick to enjoy exploring each location. Only 2 hours at the most at each stop, not enough time.

I took my family of 5 on the Stonehenge tour on our first family trip to London. We had a great time. It was a whole day bus tour, so we were a little concerned. Our guide, Oliver, and our driver were fantastic. Oliver was very knowledgeable about all things London way beyond just the sites we visited. He knew his history as well as current events and stories. He gave us some great recommendations for restaurants and afternoon tea. It was a challenge as it was Christmas eve and most places were closing by the time we returned.
The 3 sites were all really interesting and too far out of town to be seen on our own.
I highly recommend this tour and hopefully, you can get Oliver as your tour guide.

Sandra was amazing, very friendly and personable! Coach was comfortable and clean. Arrived early at Windsor castle but bet all the queue! Bath is a beautiful town wish we had a little bit longer there but impossible to fit in more time!

Norma was an amazing tour guide, witty and full of information and very nice

(Thanks for not leaving me at Stonehenge even though i was tardy back to the bus!!!!)

A great way to see a lot of the U.K. in a day. Our Guide was great always offering tips and ways to maximize our time. Plan on a long day as you are doing a significant amount of travel. We wish we could spend more time at Windsor Castle but got to see some amazing sites.

A very good tour.. Phil, our guide, was awesome - friendly, knowledgeable and funny, the bus was comfortable and our new memories - priceless. We were not tired upon return, but the trip takes all day (started at 8am and were back at Victoria around 8pm).I liked the Windsor Castle the best, but Stonehedge and Bath were definetely worth visiting. Go on this tour if you have a day for new experiences, and you will not regret it.

Had a great tour led by Kevin. Kevin was excellent - knowledgeable, courteous and very customer oriented. We greatly enjoyed the day. A little less time at Stonehenge for more time at Windsor would be excellent. All in all was a fantastic time. My senior citizen parents also loved it. Great option for fitting a lot of things into one day outside of London.

One of my favorite portions of my trip to the UK was this tour to Windsor Castle, Stonehenge, and Bath. This tour provided the opportunity to see some of the gems England has to offer outside of London In addition, our tour guide Kevin brought history to life through his lively storytelling and humor. Kevin did a fantastic job of making sure everyone had their needs attended to while providing the tour in English and Japanese and having to manage unexpected delays. Overall I would highly recommend this tour, especially having Kevin as the tour guide.

This tour blew me away because of the amount of things we were able to see and experience. Kevin was our tour guide and he was a great dude all around. He was funny, knowledgeable and reasonable. I asked him to stop for a bathroom break on the way back to London and he was able to accommodate my request (even though we were late). Paul did a great job keeping us safe driving the coach bus around. My only complaint was that the WiFi sucked on the bus. Arigato gozaimasu Kevin!

3 sites in one day was kind of rush but our tour guide, Kevin, make it work very well. Kevin was great, speaking English and Japanese all the way and introducing the history. Well managed time and in the end, he even drove all of us to the individual stops. I will highly recommend for Evan Evans Tours. Super professional service. One thing to remember, be on time.

Deborah was the perfect tour guide. She has wit, humor and a ton of knowledge. She also made sure we had the full amount of time to see each site even if that meant she got home a bit later. The tour was so enjoyable and I need to come back and spend more time in bath!

The trip was great! Our tour guide James was so knowledgeable, helpful and funny, he made the trip so much more fun. Our driver Steve was great too. Overall an awesome experience for my husband and I. I highly recommend this tour.

My husband and I generally like to explore on our own when we travel, but with only one week in London, we wanted to squeeze in as many sites as possible outside the city in one day. I am happy to say that we could not have picked a better one. Our driver, Valentine, got us to all of our destinations safely and efficiently. Our guide, James, was a rock star. He was highly knowledgeable, friendly, and witty. Not only did he have all of the information we could want on the three sites, but he also had plenty of tips and tidbits about where to go and what to do in London. Throughout the day, it was evident how much he loves his job and really cares about enhancing and maximizing theexperience. I would highly recommend this tour!

They did everything they promised. And then some - they gave us James, the best guide I could ever wish for. He was not only very knowledgeable, he gave all those interesting historical bits in an engaging, funny way, which make for better learning. He didn't waste a moment of our long day.

Everything about this tour was great: the sights, schedule/tour organization, guide, bus, and driver. Our tour guide, Anthony Matthews, was fantastic. His passion and delivery often made us feel like we were actually taking part in a documentary. He kept the group entertained even during the lower parts of the trip (bus rides, lines, etc.) with interesting facts, lessons, and stories. A special thanks to our bus driver Kelvin for getting us to each location safely and on time.

This tour was an excellent way to spend the day!

Big day out today but well worth it. Started at 7.30am and a full day. Visited Windsor castle which was amazing and I really loved the town of Windsor. Stonehenge was fantastic to see and lastly Bath. I recommend this trip to get a taste of these places. If I get the chance to come back I most definitely want more time in Windsor and Bath. You need to stay a few days.

We were very fortunate to have James as a guide for this tour. He is well versed in history and every other aspect of the sites we visited. Very friendly and great fun to be with.
If possible, when booking this trip, insist on James being your guide.

You will definately enjoy yourself.

Great trip. The guide, Monica, was the very best tour guide. She was friendly and very knowledgable. She took interest in what the people on the tour had to say. She gave precise information and made it a truly fun and informative experience. Our coach driver, Bill, did an excellent job getting us to our destinations - a wonderful coach driver. I would highly recommend this team for a tour anytime.
This trip was great in being able to see three of England's most famous landmarks. I wish that we would have had more time in Bath, it was such a cute little town.

wow, what a great day . Roan is a great tour guide and James the bus driver made you feel safe and comfortable. Driving that big bus in London is a real challenge. The weather was great and Roan knows her history and facts. Roan provided all types of assistance and information. She is the right person for this job. Note as this is a long day and parking for the bus is time sensitive at some locations, they will leave you if you do not return to the bus timely. the sites were great but your time at each location is limited.

I had heard about Jody on a review I read. I thought it would be nice to have him. Well we get on the bus and he introduced himself as Jody. It didn’t sink in right away that this was the same guy. He was very knowledgeable, kind, funny and interesting.I enjoyed him very much, almost as much as the tour itself. He spent time with everyone on the way home asking if we had questions. I would highly recommend Jody as a must to have as your tour guide. You will not be disappointed. :):)

This was a great day trip from London. Nice to have someone doing the driving and purchasing all the tickets in advance. Windsor Castle is wonderful, just wish we had a bit more time at Castle and in Bath.

Chris was a great guide and it was a smooth trip. Although we were threatened with being 'left behind' if we weren't back to bus on time, no one was.

Went with my adult son, both enjoyed the trip immensely.

It's difficult to spend the perfect amount of time at Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Roman Bath in 1 day. But if you're going to do it all, then the Evans Evans Tour is the way to go. Our tour guide gave clear instructions for departure time from each location. And because everyone was punctual, we didn't wait on long lines. (The most we waited probably was for 30 min BEFORE Windsor Castle opened, and honestly that was better, because the line only grew longer.) Our tour guide was also great - she was knowledgeable and funny.

This was a great trip and we thoroughly enjoyed this excursion. We would highly recommend it! Our guide Nigel was an expert on all the places we went and added humor to make the day fun. Gill was a great driver and kept us safe and comfortable.
The time allotted for each stop was appropriate to get a high level experience of each. We enjoyed how smooth the day was planned out so that we could sit back and enjoy! Thanks Nigel and Gill for making our day unforgettable! Just a hint, the front seat of the bus is the best!!

Did the day tour of Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath with Evan Evans Tours - professional, comfortable bus, good audio. Godfrey was our guide and Marc was our driver, both were excellent. Godfrey was knowledgeable, engaging and so funny. Marc navigated us safely through the long day of driving. Having said that, we spent a lot of time traveling, which was a great way of seeing places outside of London. The downside was we had limited time exploring, enjoying and reading facts and history of the sites. Godfrey though was upfront that there will be a lot of traveling and limited time on the sites, between 1-1.5 hours per site. In all sites, we spent substantial time waiting in line, especially in Stonehenge waiting for the bus. There was also no time for eating and souvenir shopping. I felt rushed. Fortunately, all guests (around 44 pax) in the big bus were conscious of time and back on the designated return time. Moreover, I signed up for English tour and was surprised about a last minute addition of a handful of Spanish guests. Translating took time which could have been used on further information. The audio guide (radio and earphone) was great since Godfrey was able to share information to us when we're off the bus without shouting. Unfortunately, Godfrey did not join us in the Castle and Roman Bath, and to the Stonehenge - could be their standard practice. He could have helped us optimize our time by directing us on what must be seen and visited in the sites.

I would still recommend this tour but would suggest the following: (1) do two sites instead of three; (2) don't mix groups; (3) guide to join the actual tour of sites to optimize time; (4) advisory during booking (about the tour) about the tight schedule and to bring snacks; (5) toilet in the bus or toilet break along the way.

Carol is the absolute best guide. Ask for Carol. She thoroughly explained every phase from what we would do, precautions about minding the time, history along the way, checking on us once back on board. One can read details about each site, but the guides can make or break a trip. She made it very worthwhile.

This tour was a great high level overview of all three experiences. You get enough time to look around maybe grab a snack but not quite enough time to stop and really get in depth with each place. Which is fine- seeing all three in a day is great for people who don't have a ton of time.

By far the best part of the entire tour was our tour guide- Rowan. She was informative, enthusiastic, kind, funny, and a wealth of information. She had a story or two about each place we visited. Our driver James was also amazing, getting the large bus in and out of tight spaces as if it was absolutely no problem.

As far as the stops itself- Windsor Castle was interesting. We got there early enough to beat the large line. Once we got in there was enough time to walk through the chambers and the chapel. But then it was off again. Rowan pointed out some places to get snacks for the ride on. We sadly missed the queen by mere minutes- she was coming down the street as we had to go to catch the bus.

Stonehenge was a little backed up when we got there. There was a wait for the bus but we made it up with time to walk around and admire the stones. It was a rare sunny day and a really beautiful. Had we more time I would have loved to walk through the glen and cow pasture that was offered half way up from the parking lot. However we headed back down and stopped in briefly to the gift shop. Really good swag- not the standard touristy stuff. I got a pair of earrings made from the same sort of stone as the henge itself. Reasonable prices too.

Bath is a beautiful city. Rowan gave us some great history on the way in. My group had opted not to go into the baths themselves but to wander around the city. The honey colored stones they used to make the city provide a beautiful backdrop. Bath is all about the sweets- Local icecream, fudge, and chocolates were 'tested' by my group. I'm sure the Bath was amazing but after a long day of touristy things it was nice to get a bit of free time to look around and go at our own pace.

The drive home was smooth and they were kind enough to drop people at areas where they can get a tube back to various hotels. It was a great tour- a bit rushed sometimes, but that's the nature of the beast. As a note- at Stonehenge we did end up leaving three people who were very late for the bus. Rowan and James waited far longer than than they said they would- she did her best to find them, even leaving the parking lot to go look for the stragglers. If you get left by this tour it is 100% your fault. If you are on time (it's not hard) you're in for a great day!

While I enjoyed Windsor it was surprising no pictures? Our guide Nicholas was extremely knowledgeable with a ggo$ sense of humor. Overall a very good experience

Mike C
Philly
Time available to spend at each place was too limited due to travel time and queues. I would recommend dropping one of the sites to allow more time to see them. Guide was excellent.

Oliver is knowledgeable, charming and kind.
We had a wonderful time. The sights are beautiful, but the description, explanation and all the interesting information he provides open your mind to much more than what you see.
Thank you Oliver for looking out for us until the last second. The Vegas girls.

Lots of time on coach/bus. As expected. To see these three sights in one day is a lot. But if your short on days for London and you want to see them do the tour. Oyr guide Leslie was very informative and used some of the driving time to give information and answer individual questions. We felt we had enough time to see the interior of Windsor but no time to wander the quaint town. Ditto for Bath. Time at stonehedge was sufficient

We visited Stonehedge with our friends from Bristol it took us around 11/2 hour to reach.
They have ample car parking, the main building has the ticket counters, the museum to learn more about Stonehedge, cafeteria.
Post this you can sit in Bus that takes you to site half a kilometer away. From there you walk. The site can be visited from a distance as you are not allowed to go very close to the stones.

My wife and I took part in the tour for the first time and thourghly enjoed the whole experience. James was our guide was very knowledgable with a keen sense of humour and was very engaging with every person on the tour. James found a way to connect with everyone. James' depth of information about each leg of our tour made me curious to explore further. Very well done. Our driver "Kee" was as skilled and professional anyone could ask for. Overall James and Kee made for a memorable experience. I highly recommend them to anyone.

We booked these through klook. It was easy to locate the gathering point and the tour guide is a nice guy that give so many useful information for our next trip. The full day tour introduce Windsor Castle, Baths and Stonehenge intensively and we think it is good enough for the first visit. The bus drop us close to Harrods that we want to shop before it closes. Thank you!

Rob was our tour guide and Steve was our driver. Rob made these amazing sites even more interesting with his constant stream of fun facts and trivia and his humor. Steve got us everywhere safely and efficiently. Nice comfy bus. Overall a wonderful day, topped off by Rob's helping new visitors to London with advice for our evening plans. A great time was had by all!
We enjoyed our tour of Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge very much. James and Kee provided expert knowledge and driving across the countryside. Its a long day but we saw a lot of English history.

This tour was an awesome day out and we got to see so much in such a short amount of time! Our tour guide James knew a lot of history, as well as some (awful) jokes so there was never a dull moment on our trip.

We took trip 13 on Saturday 6th October and had Alex as our guide and Dennis as our Driver. Alex was amazing and gave us some really good insights on all 3 attractions all through the journey. However.....No wi-fi on the bus as had been promised was very disappointing. Further there was a problem with the Air Conditioning in the bus where the people at the back were freezing and the front was sweating. Repeated attempts at fixing this did not work and finally the front driver window was lowered to get some cool air in ! After paying full value for the tripe we felt that we didn't get a fair deal! Mind you the sights were astounding and worth the visit !

All three sites on the tour were beautiful, interesting, and majestic as expected but there was definitely not enough time to sufficiently enjoy everything. There was only about an hour and 20 minutes at each stop, which had to include waiting in lines, bathroom breaks, and finding food on your own. We definitely felt rushed, so maybe limiting the stops to 2 would be a better idea. Our guide, Rob, and our driver, Steve, were fantastic and very forgiving when some passengers were late back to the bus, but that couldn't make up for feeling rushed at all our destinations.

I had the best time on this day-long tour. Every part was very timely and organized and I felt like I got the most for the money, but this trip was definitely worth every penny! I was also very pleased with our tour-guide, Andy Jackson, who did a superb job at explaining as much as he could with a lot of enthusiasm and excitement. I would recommend this tour to anyone.

Driver: Steve
Tour guide: Mel
Company: Evan Evans

Time line: meet at 0745 and leave 0800. 45 min ride to Windsor Castle. Castle opens at 0930 and head back to bus at 1130. 2 hour drive to Baths. Arrive 1330 and head back to bus 1530. Arrive to Stonehenge 1630 and head home at 1720. Finished at 1900

Pros:
- excellent way to be able to get to all 3 locations in a timely manner and had small bits of information during the ride (if you can stay awake)
- love the views and pictures
- great tour guide because he gave great advice to where to eat and shop

Con:
- tour guide didn’t even walk into the tours to explain anything cause of the time restraints
- VoxBox didn’t work at Stonehenge so I didn’t even have the chance to listen to a single thing at the site (notified Mel about it)
- VoxBox was useless cause the tour guide wasn’t even there with us so really the speaker on the bus was enough

Rated 4/5 because VoxBox didn’t work properly even though we all did a trail run before getting to Stonehenge and that the tour guide really wasn’t around us for much of the day, it was really the audio tour guides provided at all the other locations that did the explanations.

I understand the time restraints at all the locations and that didn’t affect my opinion of this rating.

We started early at Victoria Cross Bus Station and we had Monica for a guide. She was awesome and we went to Windsor Castle (we were the second tour to reach and hence less crowded) and then we went to bath an amazing town and finally ended in Stonehenge which was a surreal experience hoping we could stay longer. Would recommend this tour. You get to see a lot of stuff and we had an amazing guide Monica who had all details of what to do including Vox boxes which we could listen to her when on the tour
Awesome tour to see 3 amazing sites! Comfortable buses and good lunches. Our guide was very helpful and informative!
Marvelous places, will indeed repeat it! Actually i went already twice, once with my husband and another time with my son. I am thinking on going once more. It is indeed magical!
Make this a definite stop on your tour. All aspects are covered, from visitors center, bus ride to and from site, gift shop. Just show up and absorb the vision before you.
Great day! James was a terrific guide. He really knows his history and made it fun with his good humor.

How amazing to drive past this amazing spiritual place.
Honoured to have driven by and see the flocks of all people of all nations coming together to see this wonder.

He was our tour guide on the bus. He's very knowledgeable. Please, please tip him and the bus driver at the end. They're with you all day, so it has to be a lot of work for them. We went to Windsor Castle first. This was my least favorite since all the castles/palaces start to look the same, so I can't remember if anything stood out. From what I remember they don't let you take photos inside just like Buckingham Palace. Lots of paintings inside. Then we went to Bath. It was raining when we got there, but it was interesting. The warm water you can sample at the end is disgusting lol but it's worth trying. You have very little time to spare on your own for each place since you're visiting three places, so keep that in mind. Stonehenge was last and it was cold and gloomy, but I was excited to finally see it in person. They give you an audiopen/sheet to listen to when you're there. There's a café/gift shop too.

We went on a day tour to Windsor castle, Stonehenge and Bath with Graham and Lally. They were both great. The thing I wish we had done differently would have been to go on the tour at the beginning of our trip to London rather then then end. Then we would have known we would like to go back and spend more time at Bath before our vacation was over.

In London for a week with a friend who'd never been to the UK. Thought this might be a good tour to see 3 sites in 1 day without taking too much time from our days in London. Evan Evans is a very good tour company. Our tour guide was very good BUT the tour was way too rushed. I've been to Bath on a day trip from London and was able to see quite a bit. Not this time. Only had time to visit the Roman Baths and then find a restaurant for takeout. No time to visit the Abbey or walk around Bath. Likewise at Windsor Castle. By the time we completed our tour we were running to the bus. Problem may have been with the delay in getting to Windsor which was our 1st stop. There was an accident and traffic was really backed up (no fault of the tour bus). I assume the delay cut into our time at the sites. Next time I'll do each of these site by rail/bus from London. I've also done a day trip to Cambridge from London and that too was relaxed compared to this bus tour.
Wonderful tour on Monday Oman our guide very knowledgeable and helpful and Michael our driver friendly thank you

There were 11 of us on this tour, a mix of ages. James our guide was very knowledgeable, witty , and patient...an excellent "host "for all of us. Lorry was a skillful driver. They are a great team!! We loved seeing these places outside of London proper! The day was an interesting melange of locales and time.

We had booked Bath & Stonehenge only tour but when we rang to confirm tour had been cancelled & we had not been notified. No apology or explanation. We were offered WindsorCastle, Bath & Stonehenge tour instead (We had not originally booked this as it seemed too much in one day) and it definitely was. On a positive note the tour was very informative and we did get to visit the three amazing places.

The tour was led by Nigel and Jane. Lots of commentary from Nigel who often lighten up the coach. They also provided good service and tips for the group. It was a memorable trip except that the weather dampen the mood.

James, our tour guide was awesome. My 11 year old loved him.He was very funny and very knowledgeable on all aspects of English history. He teamed very well with Laurie the driver and our trip ran very smoothly. He was very precise with times for pick ups which made it really easy for us to get on and off the bus. That way the tour runs really smoothly.We had enough time to see everything at the sites and had time to grab some lunch on the run. We chose to spend our time on what interested us and just quickly walk through the things that didn’t. That way we got to see everything.Take a hat to Stonehenge because it can be very windy there. Thanks for a great day!

My husband and I booked this trip with Golden Tours and it was a great trip but a long day. Our tour guide, Andrew was knowledgeable and Chris was our bus driver and he was quite nice. The bagged lunch they provide is nothing to write home about though.

Catia was our tour guide and Paul was our driver. Both were fantastic. Catia (unsure of the spelling) speaks many languages and gave a very informed history lesson of early London and the surrounding area along the way. All 3 sites we full of culture and we learned quite a bit. The bus is a standard coach bus so if you're taller like me (6'3") you already know the slightly uncomfortable feeling of traveling in general. Other than that, the 2 hour ride to Bath went surprisingly quick and so did the 2 hour drive back to London from Stonehenge. It is definitely worth the cost and time if you like history and want to make the most of once in a lifetime experiences

Really nice tour to Windsor Castle, thanks to our guide Rouen the waiting in line was fun with little royals stories. Bath was incredible but it was so rushed I only got to see the roman bath but missed the city that is stunning. Definetely the highlight was Stonehenge!!!

I chose this tour as it stopped at all three locations. Despite what other reviews have mentioned, I felt that we had ample time at each location and never once felt rushed.

Katya was an excellent guide. She mixed in humour with her history and definitely brought some life into what otherwise could have been a very dry lesson.

Would definitely recommend this tour, especially for other solo travellers as it's the perfect way to tick off some major landmarks without having to hire a car.

First off, our guide Nicholas and our driver Aston were amazing, incredibly funny both of them, which made the trip so much fun for us, and surely for everyone else too. Since the moment we left Victoria, to the moment we got back, he would tell us stories and give us information and tips. Five points to them!

We loved the tour! And would recommend it to anyone.

Apologies if I misspell her name but our tour with Katiya was excellent. She was extremely knowledgeable and very skilled at her job. I loved hearing the history of England while taking the three stops of the day. My favorite part by far was Stonehenge and I was happy we made good time and there weren't a lot of people there the day we went so I got a ton of photos.

I recommend this tour to anyone who is looking to see these three stops and want to learn and see a lot. If you're someone who likes to take a lot of time reading plaques and listening to the full audio guide at your tour locations I would not recommend this tour. Because of how long it takes to drive to everything there is limited time at each location. For me it was the right amount of time to see things and to get refreshments and take bathroom breaks but I know this wouldn't be right for everyone.

Tom did a wonderful job as our tour guide. He knows a lot about everywhere in the world. His explanation of the tour are interesting and humorous. He is so kind to everybody and knowledgeable. The trip is well organized and the driver made the day so comfortable. We had reasonable time at three point of interest, it is a bit tight but we could’nt ask more about this arrangement. It meets what we need.

We had a fantastic trip. It was great being able to get outside of the city and see some of these famous attractions. Andy Jackson was our tour guide and he made the whole trip worth it. He had so many facts and tips that really brought the entire trip together. He even was helpful as we departed and pointed us to a great restaurant. You get a little taste of each spot which was just enough. Highly recommended tour.

Our tour guide Andy Jackson was very knowledgeable and entertaining. The stops we made were very fast paced and only gave you time to scratch the surface of each attraction. If you want to deep dive into these attractions this is not the tour for you. But was just perfect for my sister and I.

Booked through TripAdvisor of which organised by Evans & Evans tour.
Must take train to Victoria station for the tour bus suppose to start at 8am. We arrived around 7.10am as unsure around the area. Need to walk for about 10—15mins from Victoria underground to the bus station. Its situated near a big clock tower.
Have to approached Evans counter to claim a wristband. Remember bring along a print out of your booking as the guide will keep it.
Driver, Thomas do sell water bottle for GBP1 which is so much cheaper than outside.
Our tour guide namely Andy of Evans & evans tour is excellent as he is knowledgeable and humorous at times. We had an enjoyable time with him. He does told us a lot of history before we arrived our destinations. Will tips us on more times at certain place eg St George Chapel at the Windsor Castle which was remarkable.
We were being given ample time for touring and food. Even though we were queueing up for enterance to the Windsor Castle, Andy feeding us non stop history & information.
Roman bath tour is a little bit boring but the way to Bath city is magnificent as the countryside has absolutely beautiful scenery.
Stonehenge is an excellent and unique place. You will feel awesome abd the sight of Stonehenge. The bus will drop us near the gift shop & cafe. Andy will give a shuttle bus ticket which will take us to the nearer area of Stonehenge. We walked around and took lots of pictures. Its was a spectacular sight. Lots of souvenirs at gift shop. Bought 2 special key chains which stones similar as the stonehenge which cost GBP35. As its a special place therefore the gifts were worth it.
We were being drop at the underground station by around 7.30pm...
Thorougly enjoyed the trip.
Thank you to Andy and Thomas for their excellent services.
We joined their tour on 14th September 2018@ 8am tour.
Evans tour... You are fortunate to have such good staffs..
.

We had James as our guide and Tom as driver. It was an excellent tour. They kept everyone on schedule and the narrative was fun and very well done. James is like an English walking history wikipedia. Thanks for the great day.

Although there is more than a few hours of travel overall, it’s a relaxing ride with great commentary. Once we got to each place there was plenty of additional narrative and instructions on what to do and what to expect. Personally, I thought it was just enough time at each stop. It was nice to get a taste of three significant destinations in one day. You can always go back for more.

Our tour of Windsor Castle, Bath (Roman Bath), Stonehenge was an amazing experience. Our tour guide Debbie (Bee) was knowledgeable of the sites, gave a lot of
interesting tidbits. Once on the bus it was organized. At each site Debbie handled everything from giving us our audio tour guides, headphones and getting into each site hassle-free. We covered a lot of ground in one day. My only suggestion would be to give a little more time at Windsor Castle (my audio tour guide given at Windsor didn't work properly and took awhile to get it to work (not anything to do Evans Tour) and Stonehenge. Possibly a half hour more at each so there would have been more time for the gift shop (at Stonehenge had to wait for second bus coming and going to and from site and gift shop very crowded.) Had to run for the bus both times. In your explanation of the tour and where to meet could have been explained better. We met at Victoria Station but there wasn't much guidance once we got there and where to go. Once we found our way to a person it was handled fine. Kudos to Debbie and Steve the bus driver - we felt like we were in good hands. This was my first experience with any kind of bus tour and it was a good experience.

We visited each location at a very timely manner, though it was a bit rushed. I wish we had more time at Windsor Castle and maybe a bit less in Bath (even though Bath was very lovely and quaint. Be sure to visit their local ice cream shops!).

Kevin was guide and he was lovely and our driver.. Elise (I believe) was an excellent driver. I usually get car sick but I felt fine the whole day thanks to get great driving. Kevin was very knowledgable and funny, making the long day very enjoyable.

We booked a couple of months in advance for the Bath and Stonehenge tour. Less than 48 hours from departure, while flying from the States, they sent a notice of cancellation. Talk about last minute and very inconsiderate. They then said to call to get onto the Bath, Stonehenge and Windsor Castle trip for that day, so I did. The lady handling the call had an attitude like she was doing me a big favor. So we showed up and the day was redeemed by our guide Andy Jackson. He was great, 5 stars out of 5. Very welcoming, friendly, and amazingly knowledgeable. Provided a lot of background and history to help make the stops more relevant.
PLEASE NOTE, this is only a highlights tour. You could easily spend a day at Windsor and the same at Bath, and 1/2 day at the Stones is plenty. On our trip, you get about 90 minutes in each place with 90-120 minute drives in-between. It is a long-long day, but Andy knew just the right balance of quiet time and then would start building the excitement for the stop. If you only have a day, and can’t afford something more personalized, this will do, especially if you get Andy. I can’t say the same is true for all guides based on other reviews.

My husband and I had one day to visit these three sites and traveled comfortably by Evan Evans Coach. I think it was 300 miles round trip, so there is a lot of time on the coach, but seeing the English countryside was fun and relaxing, too. Our guide was pleasant and knowledgeable and and gave us lots of background information before arriving at each site. Listening sets were included with each tour. We were there in August, so there were lots of crowds everywhere, but we still saw the magnificent State Apartments at Windsor and the beautiful grounds. Because it was a Sunday, St. George's Chapel was not open to the public. Stonehenge was absolutely amazing although we were there in pouring rain, and the Roman baths were awesome and worth the drive across southern England. I recommend that you arrive 30-45 minutes early at Victoria Coach Station to be among the first in line for the tour. That morning I believe that there were five coaches going on this tour. Also, buy tickets for this tour online before you get there, so you don't have to wait in line. A small negative was that due to the length of the trip, there was no time for a sit-down lunch, and people had to bring food aboard the buses.

Ask for Graham! He is the best!! The tour was fantastic. Bath deserves a weekend stay. Thanks to Graham and Z we made it to Windsor Castle early enough to catch the changing of the guards. Stonehenge is a must see at least once. Oh and the already beautiful ride out to the tour sites was made even better as Graham was always at the ready to point out many other jewels along the way.

Great day trip from London our tour guide Mark was fantastic he kept the long bus rides from stop to stop entertaining! First stop Windsor castle little interesting artifacts but a little stuffy but enjoyed the changing of the guard. Bath is a beautiful place Roman baths was quite informative watch your step though. Stonehenge was a site to see its truly a mystical place makes you wonder how those big stones were brought there so long ago enjoyed the tour

We went on the Windsor, Bath, and Stonehenge with James as the guide and Kee as the driver today (9/4/2018). Evan Evans Tours is very fortunate to have a history scholar with great management skills who provided one of the best tours I’ve ever been on. I highly recommend this tour and especially if you get the opportunity to have James and Kee.

Great Tour. Our guide Andy Jackson was amazing. He was a wealth of information. I have never had a guide that was so well informed. Ricky our bus driver was also excellent, maneuvering all the small roads. You only have a limited amount of time at each location. Next time I would only do two locations a day, three was too rushed. Lots to see at Windsor and Bath, and time was too short. Well organized, left on time. Take snacks and go to the washroom when you can. Great tour.

From checking in to timely arrival the whole tour was enjoyable. Our guide Andy Jackson kept us entertained throughout the tour with his knowledge of not only the tour sites but many places he pointed out along the way. The driver was prompt and kept us on time. I especially liked that I had my own time to move through the tours and see those things important to me and spend time where I wanted. I highly recommend this tour.
Andy was an excellent tour guide, and Malcolm a excellent driver, took us to our destination on time, and we were back into the city of London on time. They both did an excellent job.

This is about the maximum you can fit in a day trip from London. Excellent guide and driver - all three locations were beautiful and could have spent more time but we were able to experience all three locations. Kudos to Evans and Evans for the best location first (Windsor Castle), got here before the crowds and the guide's excellent advice got us to the best part first - royal apartments are some of the best of the Buckingham Palace and the Tower of London. St. George's Chapel also gives much of what Westminster Abbey offers with Knight's stalls and all the history. Guide was again excellent with advice at each stop on what to see first -- never enough time but ideas for future trips if lucky enough to make it back (day trip was August 14 - top of the high season).
Our tour guide Phil and the driver, Parkie, were amazing! Phil seems to be a fountain of knowledge and eager to help in any way. Highly recommended!

My family took this day tour for Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge on Aug 14. The guide was James with bus driver Rolly. We visited Windsor castle, Bath and Stonehenge. The schedule was well arranged such that our tour group in the same bus entered Windsor as the first or second group in the morning (while the bus was able to collect all people and departed ~10 minutes earlier). James greeted every family and answered questions in the middle of trip, and to every family on return offering help regarding next destination. We got much context info from the guide’s comments. Overall the tour came with well worthy sight seeing and comfort riding.

My husband and I were itching to take a trip out of London and Tour No 13 Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge didn’t disappoint.
James our tour guide was impressive with his knowledge,. He was professional, took time to chat to the passengers to make sure we were okay and provided a wealth of information. We found James witty with a dry sense of humour.
Kee was an exceptional driver and the journey was very smooth.
The tour gave us a very good overview and a further visit to Bath is certainly on the cards. Enjoy, it’s a long day but worth it.

Yesterday we took a full day tour of Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge. Our tour guide, James, was entertaining and informative. Our driver, Kee, was excellent, too! We especially enjoyed the opportunity to chat with James personally during the lengthy bus rides between attractions. The Windsor Castle stop was a bit rushed but it is difficult to cover the three locations in one day (11 hours).
Greatest trip i ever had since i usually get bored easily. But with the interesting places and our great guide James and driver Barry i will highly recommend it to anyone visiting london.

I got to say that by far James is the coolest tour guid I’ve ever come across :D
The whole tour was great , fun organized and very interesting
Highly recommended 👍🏻👍🏻

First off our guide Rowan was excellent. Best guide we have ever had! Bus was good and all 3 of the sites we visited were definitely worth the trip. Only negative thing would be that when you do so many sites you have limited time at each of them. But you did get a good overview of them and now I'll have to come back and see them all again.

Had a really good time with Katya and Dennis the bus driver. Although the trip included a lot of driving it didn't hurt as there were a lot of fun facts and historical background shared with us. We spent a lovely day, thanks!

You hear about these wonders, but never think you’ll see them. If you make the time to see these, you will not be disappointed. ANDY JACKSON was our guide, and his stories were wonderful. His collegiate study of history, as well as his personal life experiences make his narrations first rate! JILL was the driver, and the ease with which she moved that huge bus through ancient streets and passages that were never meant for use by tour busses she was nothing short of miraculous!
Windsor Castle is elegant and very historical. Loved seeing where Harry and Meghan got married. Sitting in the St. George Chapel, you can understand why they Chose that venue.
I hope that BATH doesn’t loose its historical look after the renovations currently in progress. The beautiful sights and historical village feel made our time there quite memorable, despite our having declined the tour of the Roman Baths.
Stonehenge was magically awe inspiring, and the provided audio tour really helped.
We used Evan Evans Tours.

I went with my two boys and had m amazing time. From the moment we got on the bus till the end of our tour. Simon our tour guy was very informative and extremely funny which made the trip even better. Simon gave us great tips as how and exactly what should we focus. Highly recommended. Our bus left right on time, had plenty of time to explore and take pictures.
Una actividad sumamente recomendada, todo se hizo a tiempo y nuestro guia nos dio información para cada lugar visitado. Los sitios son hermosos y logramos ver la marcha de los soldados.
