Both the tour guide and driver have done a great job. Well-paced 12-hour tour. Driving itself would take at least 6 hours and the tour guide has given us about 1.5 to 2 hours at each site. There is much to see in Windsor and Bath, so one has to make trade-offs as there were lines everywhere. Bath is very beautiful. During tourist season it would take a while to enter and visit the Roman Bath, so after Roman Bath, one may only have about 30 minutes left to see the City of Bath. Overall it's a great tour, we wouldn't have done better had we driven to 3 sites in one day by ourselves. One tip I have learned from the tour is to take pictures of the tour bus and the returning point for each stop so that it would be easier for us to get back to our bus.

We had a great trip. Guide Oliver Simmons and driver Austin were excellent! Oliver was very knowledgeable with running commentary all the way providing valuable information as well as anecdotes.
Loved Austins Jamaican Bus dance!
The places were historic and beautiful, specially Bath city and Windsor Castle ! The scenic drive to Bath is excellent. Only issue is time allowed at castle and Stonehenge is slightly short and one has to rush through them.

Great trip. Andrew Jackson was simply the best. So knowledgeable and made the tour. If it wasn’t for him, the trip would only be three stars but with Andrew it was a ten!!! Lots to see and I wish we had more time at Windsor Castle. Entering the Baths was worth it. My teenager enjoyed it.
This was a perfect trip to get three iconic locations in one day, but that said, it was a bit too much to get a full picture of each destination. They required more time to really explore

We have done three tours with Evans Evans this trip and all were wonderful experiences. Today we did the Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge tour with Andy Jackson, who was very knowledgeable, friendly and thoughtful to not only our tour members but also other people we met along the way. Keep our driver was also amazing- driving expertly and very smoothly. We would definitely recommend taking these tours!

My son & I did this tour yesterday. Amazing sights, & our tour guide (James) was fantastic. His broad historical knowledge, & wonderfully English sense of humour, made for a fun & fascinating day. Paul, our driver, was also excellent. Would highly recommend this tour.
Good trip. Would recommend it. Just read the description cause it is not slow paced, almost rushed, and no WiFi on our bus. Was worth it

Great tour Windsor castle and changing of guard simply great, Bath an amazing town and Stonehenge awesome even in pouring rain and standing in queues to get to stones and back another one of those special experiences in life like Pompeii. A definite must do no matter what the weather. Thank you James, Steve and Bertie for a memorable day

We loved the trip. So well organized. We wish we had more time at Windsor, got cut short because of changing of the guards and we couldn’t get stuck inside. Recommend checking the guard schedule and not going on those days. Gave 4 bubbles because we could have skipped Bath - the water is so toxic that you can’t touch it. It really is just how it looks in pics. Stonehenge was amazing. Surprisingly windy! You can’t get close. Would have rather done Oxford than Bath!

We just spent the day touring Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge with Oliver Simmons as our guide and Aston at the helm of our coach. Oliver was fun and very informative making this whole day excursion special. Aston was amazing guiding our coach through the narrow streets of Bath. Thank You!

Although you won't have much time at these sites, Evan Evans has this process down pat. We were one of the first buses to arrive at Windsor and our guide had us book it to get in line, and I'm glad he did because within about 10 minutes the line was massive. You're certainly going to feel a bit rushed at each of the sites, but if you only have a day to spare for a trip to the countryside, this is the way to go. I don't like big tour groups, but there's no way you'd be able to rent a car or take public transportation and see all of this in one day. Plus, once you're at each site, they let you go off on your own, so apart from being on the bus with a bunch of people, you don't really get that large tour group feel. Can't recommend this company enough.

We took the day trip from London to see Windsor castle, Bath and Stonehenge. The bus was a large coach, we had a group of around 50 people.
Initially this made me think we wouldn't have a good day however our guide (Catja) made it fun and very interesting.
It was a big day so I would recommend to all who go on the tour to take a day pack with a drink and possibly a snack. There are plenty of shops along the way though to get lunch but you are on the bus for a while at times so this is when a drink or snack comes in handy.

We saw some great sights, Catja told us many interesting and funny stories about the places we visited as well as interesting things about the history of the UK. She also gave us tips and advice on anything we wanted to know as tourists in London. We came home very tired but happy.

We had a great day touring the three locations with Evans Evans tour company. Our tour guide, James, was amazing. He was very knowledgeable about the history of the attractions and shared interesting obscure facts as well. He mentioned at the beginning of the day it was a highlights tour and it was a good mindset to have for the day. We definitely will be going back to visit the sites again. I just also mention Barry, our driver. He was amazing navigating through narrow streets and crowds all the while keeping us on schedule. One of the highlights of our trip to London!

I LOVED this trip. While it was more of an "appetizer" to encourage us to stay longer at Windsor Castle and Bath, it was well worth it (and the mission was accomplished - I want to come back and stay longer at both locations). I doubt the trip would have been as fun if James (our tour guide) and Kee (our driver) weren't there leading the way.

James was amazing. His dry wit and superior knowledge of our destinations (and so much more) kept us engaged and interested in hearing more. He also took good care of our entire group. Our happiness and comfort were his #1 priority.

Kee was a great driver and the interplay between him and James was a lot of fun.

We lucked out. I doubt we would have had as much fun if these two gents weren't teaching us and looking out for us.

As for the trip itself? Well worth the price and time investment.

Excellent tour. While our driver Kee navigated the big bus smoothly, James entertained us with his dry wit and knowledgeable details especially about inside stories of life among the Royals. Well organized.

While I was on a seven day visit of London, I took a bus tour trip with Evan Evans to visit Windsor Castle, Bath and Stonehenge, in that order. If you are excepting an in-depth dive into these locations in one day, this trip is not for you. Fact is, this trip is designed to give the visitor a taste but not a meal. It was sweet. Starting with the tour guide, Nigel and the driver, Steve. Both were gentlemen and pleaseant company. They were a pleasure to spend the day with. The bus was comfortable. The journey took us thru beautiful country outside of London. Because the three destinations were far apart, we were only allowed about 90-120 minutes at each location. Nigel herdered us into the three different locations so that we didn't have to wait on long lines. He moved us along so that we could get the most out of our short visit at each site. So, I give this operation a thumbs up. It provided a short visit to each location, just enough to leave lasting memories. Thank you Nigel & Steve. (My trip was on July 25, 2018)

This tour packs in a lot of attractions in just a 12 hour day. Our guide, Andy Jackson, was highly informative, making our tour a fantastic day with his insights, history and knowledge of the royal family.

This was a lot to put into one day.
Our tour guide Godfrey explained all the ins and outs well and was a fountain of knowledge.
Mo our driver got is safely around and to and from our destination.
Great working pair for sure.

Whilst visiting the UK, we decided to do the above tour. The only chaos was lining up at Victoria coach station whilst trying to know which queue or bus to take. Once we were aboard, our guide, whose name I cannot remember, was efficient and informative. THe tour was well organised and we enjoyed the tour, despite the length. On the boring stretches, she allowed us to have a short nap instead of rambling on.
All in all a good tour. Will use again when in the UK

I was very satisfied with this tour. Toby was knowledgeable and interesting. The day is quite rushed but it's the only way to see all three sites. You just need to manage your time carefully. All the sites were interesting in their own way. Toby thankfully told us lots of historical stories while in line at Windsor. Worth the wait, though. My only complaint is that they really should notify you that you can't have coffee or tea on the bus well in advance. I had to toss a completely full coffee!

Guide Oliver was excellent and kept us entertained during the drive. He has a lot of knowledge of the areas. He kept us on schedule as well. Thanks to Joe, the driver, for keeping us safe during our travels. I highly recommend this tour but be ready with your running shoes on as it’s a tight schedule.

I took the trip on 21st July. The trip was awesome but having taken it alone I felt that this was a very much rushed trip. If you want to savour the place, this is not for you. But if like me, you have limited time in London then go for it.
But remember to abide by the time at all times. We were given 2 hours at Windsor, 1 hour at Roman Bath and 1 hour at Stonehenge. On all three occasions I could barely complete the trip and return. For Stonehenge especially this was crucial as they left behind 4 people. And at stonehenge because there were inhouse buses to take from and to the site, you could be waiting in a queue for over 20 minutes and still not reach the gates. At least I had to run after a 20min queue for bus and was the last man in. Even though I confirmed the other 3 were in same queue and would be reaching by next bus, the trip didnt wait.
Earlier there was no time given for lunch. So if you are coming for this trip, pack your lunch.
Overall the trip was informative and light hearted. The guide Mr Nigel shared a lot of information.

Went on this tour with Vicki and we both thoroughly enjoyed it. The tour guide James was extremely knowledgeable and had plenty of funny anecdotes. The bus driver Qi was excellent at navigating through the narrow streets and we always felt in safe hands. Bus depot was easy to find and we were dropped back at Victoria Station on return. It is a long day so be sure you are rested up.

We had a really good tour the whole day. Everything was great but I would like to mention Phil our tour guide who really was fantastic. He has a really good knowledge in history and even answered questions related with history which have nothing to do with this tour. I highly recommend this tour and again a big well done to Phil.

We had James as our tour guide and he was absolutely phenomenal. He was incredibly knowledgeable about any and every topic, funny and entertaining, and very caring about making sure we all got the best experience possible. We had Kee as our driver, who was also phenomenal at his job, as he took us on the most lovely and scenic routes to our destinations, especially on our way into Windsor. I would definitely recommend bringing cold food on the bus. There are places to grab a quick meal in each of the stops, but there is very limited time at each and it was nice to get to spend all of it seeing the sights and not having to worry about finding food since we did it ahead of time. I would strongly recommend this tour as we had an amazing day!

Booked with Evan Evans because of their high ratings and they didn’t disappoint. Our guide Jamie and driver Kee were great. We were one of the first buses out of the station with the thought of beating the queue to Windsor Castle. When you get there and there’s a line you think - wow, we left so early and there are all these people already here - but that feeling goes away when you get inside within about 15 minutes. Then after you take your tour and come out to see the queue afterwards you will realize just how lucky you were to be on this tour. Plenty of time in Windsor unless you want to see the whole changing of the guard. If that’s your goal you will need to book another tour. So there’s your warning don’t be disappointed. On to Bath. If you’ve been to Rome and seen the baths consider skipping and checking out the town. The Baths are okay but more of a check in the “I’ve seen it” box. Then finally off to Stonehenge. Plenty of time to stand in awe and take pics of the amazing site.

Overall five star. Some reviews said they feel rushed and yes, if you don’t know how to prioritize your time I could see that. But you are visiting 3 sites that aren’t close together in one day. If you want a highlight tour this is the tour for you. If you want time to wander and hang out at each stop you should choose to book individual tours.

Thanks again to Jamie and Kee for a great tour.

Our family of 4 (2 adults, 2 adult children) took this day-long tour to Windsor, Bath and Stonehenge. The sites were so incredibly interesting and we were ferried safely and comfortably from place to place. We knew that travelling with 50 people and staying briefly in each place with long bus rides in between was what we signed up for. What we didn't enjoy was the minimal guiding at each place. We felt that the guide was mostly there to herd us to and from each site, on and off the bus. Perhaps it is due to the style of our specific guide, but we would have liked much more interpretation and context for the visits to these sites. We wanted to learn much more, and if I had to choose again, I would pick a different tour company with better, more expert guides.

My friend and I decided to do this day trip to fit a lot in to a short trip. It was a long day, but it was worth it. It was a nice way to see a lot of things and get a taste of everything. As our tour guide said, this was a "highlights trip" so that you hopefully get a sense of what each place is like and hopefully it inspires you to go back in the future, which it certainly did for us! Our tour guide, James, and our driver, Laurie, were both fabulous and made the trip super enjoyable.

The trip was well organised, morning visit to Windsor, almost no queue and the guard change at the final of the visit as a bonus, enough time in Bath if you skip the visit to the Roman Baths, too much time at Stonehenge, nice small lunch in Lacock. Frank was the perfect guide.

Great tour. Both our guide James Morgan and driver Laurie were extremely professional and helpful, making this tour as comfortable as could be. James is highly knowledgeable and entertaining, giving great commentary and organising the tour extremely well so as to beat the crowds. Also to note is driver Laurie's admirable driving skills. Only downside is, because the tour covers 3 very large attractions, it will feel a bit rushed, so it's only recommended to those with little time who wish to see the highlights. 5 stars!

This was a long day (almost 12 hours) but very worth it. James, our historian guide, made our trip enjoyable with his wealth of knowledge and sense of humor. Steve was an excellent driver-not once did we feel unsafe on the bus even during London rush hour traffic. We spent about 1.5 hours at each site. For Bath and Stonehenge, this seemed sufficient, but wish we had a bit more time at Windsor. There wasn't much time for a leisurely lunch, so would suggest bringing snacks to supplement a quick lunch. All in all, highly recommend this tour with James and Steve.

My wife and I went on this tour and from the moment our guide opened his mouth I knew it was going to be a fun trip. The man in the brown hat, Simon, was very informative, had a great sense of humour and along with driver Thomas, made the trip very enjoyable. There is quite a bit of time spent travelling in the coach but after a couple of busy days walking it was nice to just sit and relax and be driven around. The sights are very interesting - Stonehenge is one you do to say you have seen it. Windsor Castle, St. George’s Chapel and Bath are well worth seeing and we had plenty of time at each place to explore and grab a bite to eat.

This tour is a great way to see sites that are not easily accessible from those staying in London. Our tour guide, Andy, was extremely knowledgeable and was able to give us unique pieces of information about the sites. He was a nice bloke and went beyond what was expected from an average tour guide. The bus was clean, had free wifi and the bus driver, Barry, got us to our destinations quick and safely to allow the maximum time possible at the sites. There was plenty of time to explore the sites, however you could easily spend a whole day at Windsor Castle and Bath. If you are staying in London for a few days and want to see famous landmarks, I highly recommend!

I did this tour through Golden Tours and had a lovely day.
The bus was very clean and on time. We had a great driver and very help and insightful tour guide.
Time is limited at each attraction but still overall a worthwhile tour.
Windsor Castle is stunning, the town of Bath is so romantic and beautiful and Stonehenge is a must see.
James’ knowledge and humor made this trip memorable. Aside from being exhausted by the day jam-packed day of excursions - it was fantastic!

Our guide Andy and driver Mick were wonderful!! Andy is a wealth of information and was so helpful to everyone. Mick is an expert driver - the streets of Bath are so narrow, but he guided the bus expertly through. Highly recommend this tour, Andy and Mick!!

Had a fantastic time with our guide, Oliver, and our driver Tom. The tour was quite enjoyable with so much to see. Oliver was very funny and knowledgeable. My only complaint is that our day flew from all the fun. We would gladly go on another tour with Evan Evans. Thank you for a wonderful time.

This is a great way to hit some must see spots near London with efficiency. Evan Evans tour with tour guide Phil and driver Bob, outstanding job! Phil shared his knowledge and interest even beyond the points of interest of tour sites and at the conclusion assisted with evening plans including great recommendations. You spend about 1.5 hours in each spot, time to tour and in Bath to see some of town. Quick ride to Windsor for this tour, then 2 hours to Bath, 50 minutes over to Stonehenge and finish with 2 hour (a little less, depending on traffic) trip back to London. Bus will stop at convenient spot for you if along route back to Victoria Station. Thank you Phil for recommendation of Seafresh for authentic fish and chips, was really good.

We booked the day trip on golden tours to visit bath , Stonehenge and Windsor . Our guide Bruce was very knowledgeable and funny-he made the trip very enjoyable. Our driver Romeo took us to places in time and quite comfortably. The queue to Windsor was quite Long but bath and Stonehenge were amazing . Overall very enjoyable day and lots of great photos .

We had James as our guide and Mark as our driver and they were both great! James is incredibly knowledgeable and shared so much! It was just the right amount without being annoying. Mark gave us a timely and smooth ride. Highly recommend this tour!

Off to a rocky start because we were given a Buckingham Palace Street address by the Victoria Coach Station when the meeting place was actually in Victoria Coach Station. Oliver our tour guide was phenomenal! He was quite charming and knowledgeable about all of our destinations. Parky our driver did a fantastic job navigating the curvy, narrow streets. Oliver kept us entertained and the long drives didn't seem so bad. Windsor Castle was extremely crowded which limited our ability to see much beyond the courtyard and building. We did not have time to see the State Apartments and St. George's Chapel was closed due to a rehearsal for a ceremony on Monday (we were there Saturday). WIndsor was quite disappointing, not Oliver's fault.

Bath was charming, although we had a shorter amount of time there due to having to wait for stragglers to return to the bus in Windsor. Oliver was too nice to leave them behind even though they were warned they would be left behind. Roman Baths were crowded and beyond that we did not get to see much of Bath. We would love to go back for at least a full day, this trip is a taste of Bath, not enough time to explore.

Stonehenge was unexpectedly fantastic. It was cold and dreary but that did not matter. We had plenty of time to explore and listen to the wonderful audio tour provided on the bus. It was quite interesting and very enjoyable.

Overall the day trip was just a sample of the three destinations, as advertised. I would recommend this trip if you just want a glimpse at the sites. I do think a full day at Windsor and Bath would be preferable. As we did not know what we were doing we did appreciate the commentary from Oliver and the good transportation. As you can see, our group absolutely loved Oliver.

My wife and I chose to do this day trip to Bath, Stonehenge, and Windsor Castle. Although the Windsor Castle was closed for our tour, that didn’t matter at all as we were taken to the Hampton Court Palace which was absolutely beautiful.

Andy (tour guide) and Mark (driver) were excellent. Andy was knowledgeable, funny, and helpful without inundating you with info. Mark navigated tight streets deftly. The day was packed with experiences and it was tremendous to not have to worry about any details as they were all taken care of.

I’d do this tour again for sure. Highly recommended!!!

Oliver and Parky rendered a wonderful tour. Frought with ligistical difficulties and some very slow clients Oliver managed to apply all his skill, knowledge and human resoources to get us to all sites, have enougth time to enjoy them and get us all back in time and safely. Parky is a very careful driver and managed all the stops and pick up points with great control. The tour is intense and thanks to Oliver we had a wondeful day.

The tour info said 12 hours, but the day flew by, despite long lines at Windsor castle, not enough time to see bog Island in Bath and the piercing cold winds at Stonehenge..

All three sites definitely left an impression..

The coach ride in between, which can be mundane, was anything but.... thanks to the humour and expert skills on the mic by our guide Oliver and the smooth driving by Parky..

All in all, a fun, informative day with some breathtaking views and photographs to cherish..

Gaurav Gala

It's a good tour and they have arranged it pretty good. Only I wouldn't recommend this tour. There was not enough time by far. In Windsor Castle we had 1.5 hour and 1 hour we were standing in line to get in. So we only had 30 min left to see the castle. It's very stressful to walk through the castle with the idea that you have to be quick.
At Bath we had 1 hour I think. I wasn't too interested in the Roman Baths so I went through it pretty quickly to see the town itself. But if you are interested in the Roman Baths, then you don't have time to see the town at all.
Stonehenge we had 1-1.5hour. This was fine. Only if you listen to all the information on the digital guide you are still in a bit of trouble.

My advice to everyone is to go to 2 of the 3 places. I hope you will have more time and enjoy it better. The day was stressful.

"fun james" was a great tour guide. he knew a lot of history and much about London and the UK. in addition, he was quite helpful in getting us set up and in the right place, answering questions and I felt he genuinely cared that we had a good experience. all three places are great and you get a nice overview of each area. we had seven in our family and they really enjoyed it. if I did it again, I would probably just do two of them on a more in-depth basis. however, it was still a great day!

Don't get me wrong 2 of these 3 attractions totally worth it (Windsor & Bath) but when you put all together in one day trip is a waste of time, if I have to do it all over again I'll go each one separate and enjoy more. With this tour you only have a couple of hours and actually you have to run in order to try see everything.

Regarding Stonehenge I know is a must to... but take a lot of effort to go there and that's it... just stones and you can even get closer, a lot of people and nothing more

Have a great town circling the Stonehenge. Amazing stone arrangement. However, there’s a fence surrounding the stones and people or tourists could no longer touch them. Still worthwhile to go there. We went to Salisbury and went around the closed cathedral but still could go in the Magna Carta, the shop and the restaurant. Did not have time to go to Windsor castle though have been there long time ago. Also did not visit the Bath from London.

Recently returned from a wonderful 8 day trip to London from the US (Illinois). We are a family of five - me, hubby, and our 3 teenagers One of our planned excursions was this trip to Windsor/Bath/Stonehenge with Evan Evans. This was a great day. While it was a little difficult to find the coach station in the morning, we left plenty of time to find it. Once we got on the bus, we were good to go. They gave us little audio guides and ear buds to use throughout the day. We had Andy as our guide, and Lorry as our driver. Andy is very knowledgeable about London and his passion for the city shows. In terms of the trip logistics, he explained everything in detail, and was open to any questions or clarification as needed. This was a very relaxing day, and the sites were wonderful. I do not have any regrets at all taking this trip. WiFi did not work well on the bus, but that's ok, Andy kept us entertained, or used the time to relax/read/nap. We did the Roman Bath tour in Bath so that did not leave us much time for exploring Bath, but Bath is a really beautiful town. Would like to come back. Andy always emphasized the importance of the meeting time regroup, so do heed that. We planned extra time to get back earlier, just to be safe. Especially in Bath, it's very important to regroup on time, earlier is better. And I'm very impressed with Lorry's driving maneuvering in Bath! I highly recommend this excursion, and we had a very good experience with Evan Evans. We brought a backpack with a few snacks and light jackets/unbrellas, books, etc, which you can leave on the bus, or at least we were able to. We didn't have any issues. Of course keep your valuables with you. My 3 teens (14, 17, 19) also enjoyed this trip and found Andy to be entertaining.

Loved all 3 places. I always had the dream of going to Stonehenge ! And it was the most beautiful and peaceful place ever! I felt like I was in another planet!
Windsor castle was beautiful and sooo big and wig so many things to see! The queen was there actually of course we didn’t see her but just knowing she was there was everything!
Bath is a beautiful little town with a lot of shops to see and explore! The Roman baths were so interesting and I learned a lot about them! I recommend this tour a lot! If you want to do 3 things in one day! But keep in mind you are going to get really tired by the end of the day! And you won’t see everything it’s impossible!

Our day on the Evans Evans tour bus was a very good experience, the bus was very comfortable and you can see so much from there. The drive was a bit long to each place but very doable. Our tour guide Mark was very pleasant and helpful always and the driver was great! The only thing I'd say could be better was a bit more time at Windsor Castle. Due to the long wait to get in, takes away the time inside, a little less time in Bath and more at Windsor would have been perfect! But, we enjoyed all of it... Highly recommend.

Our guide Oliver and driver Malcom were great. Oliver knew his stuff! Malcom was a very skilled and safe driver. We enjoyed Malcolm’s sense of humor and the vast array of knowledge he shared with us, including his own personal connections which gave us a better feeling and understanding of everywhere we went. Thanks for a great, full day Oliver and Malcolm!

Highly recommend this tour if you’re short on time (visiting my son in London) whilst on vacation and looking to visit the 3 destinations.

Nigel was very knowledgeable and knew his stuff. Enjoyed all 3 tours. Tom the driver was efficient - always there ready to drive onto our next destination. 3 great places to see. Thanks Guys.

- Margaret

So we thought that Graham did a splendid job of driving us all day! And Oliver made the long drive VERY enjoyable! He gave us great info in a light and entertaining manner. A few criticisms; 1. the WIFI was spotty at best; don’t rely on it 2. It’s a bit ambitious to do these three sites in one day. We would have preferred more time at each site 3. Skip Bath all together! The town is quite nice and it would be wonderful to spend a night or two there on our own; the Roman Baths were unimpressive and actually felt claustrophobic to us.

This tour was a full day experience. We had a wonderful time. Our tour guide was Phil, who did a great job keeping us entertained in some of the long drives between locations. He also gave us some great insights before we arrived at some of the locations on how to get the best experience. The three stops were incredible historical sites.
We wanted to see Stonehenge, it truly is a beautiful place and an amazing experience! we booked it on tourscanner and we were not disappointed

We had a wonderful tour with Armand. He was a wealth of knowledge!! We learned so much about England and specifically about the three attractions we were visiting that day! He was very considerate of the passengers as well

The tour was too quick of an introduction to the 3 sites visited. I highly recommend narrowing your visit to one or two stops depending on your interest. Our guide Oliver did an excellent job of presenting the history of where we were traveling to with wit and charm!

My partner and I had a great time on the trip. Our tour guide, Rohan, was enthuastic and fun while providing a wealth of information! All three locations were beautiful. This is a great tour if you're pressed for time.

We booked our tour through Klook for 2 May 18. Our tour guide, Rowan (Tour 21) was great. She is extremely good with history story telling. We (3 of us) really enjoyed listening to her historic stories with a hint of humour. She cared for each passenger on board and even talked to each passenger on their accommodation location and had a few drop off points along the way for us to alight. She is a very cheerful lady and we felt no restrictions at all to voice our concerns and questions. She deserve a 5 star rating.

This was an amazing tour that is atypical from the main spots of London, but you won't regret it. Definitely make time for this day trip to see the country side of England, Windsor Castle, The Roman Baths and Stonehenge! All of the sights here are incredible. My tour guide Emily was great - she really knows her stuff well and kept us informed and entertained throughout the day. I'd highly recommend this Evan Evans tour.

My parents, my Aunt and Uncle, and myself took this tour. I have previously been on a similar tour years ago, but decided to tag along with my family since it was their first time. Our tour guide was Oliver and he made the tour feel like I hadn’t don’t it before! He was friendly and full of knowledge, interesting facts, and jokes. We had a very lovely, well organized day and would whole heartily recommend a day with Oliver as your guide!

Half of Windsor Castle was closed. Tickets to the 3 locations is inexpensive. Majority of the cost here goes towards transportation. Bus/coach is convenient, but if anyone is touring in a group, it’s more cost efficient to rent a car.

Our tour with Oliver was great, the best guide we have ever had. We enjoyed all the sights we went to, Oliver was very knowledgable and thorough, at the end of the tour we appreciated his recommendations on places to eat once we arrived back in London, we had awesome fish and chips!

It's beautiful to see at least once but I was surprised to see that it's not as mysterious/ ominous in real life. Some people say they feel moved by being in its presence or that their photos have strange phenomenon appear on them. I like it.

Claudia and Vin were our guides and were teriffic. We left on time and Claudia gave us useful information about how to use your time wisely at each site. We had at least an hour to see everything. Plenty of time to see a lot and grab a meal at each site. Highly recommended.
Tour guide Phil was outstanding. We received a wonderful history lesson from Phil, which enhanced the quality of our tour.

Went on the Windsor Castle, Stonehenge and Bath tour with the wonderfully informative Carol and great driver Paul. It was a jammed pack day with limited time at each stop but Carol pointed out the highlights and best way to use our time each stop. She told us many interesting stories and facts along the way too. Paul kept us safe on the roads too. Fantastic day trip if you have limited time in London to see the highlights!
Rodney, the tour guide was exceptional and provided excellent information throughout the tour day. Mark, the driver, was also very good.It was a long day but well worth it.

Oliver Simmons was our tour guide. I believe the bus driver's name was Tom. They were both the most professional and friendly people! Oliver had some great background stories and Tom got us to each stop safely and effortlessly. I would absolutely recommend Evan Evans tours to anyone traveling in England.

This tour was awesome. Our tour guide, Graham, was the best! We could easily spot him in crowds because he was wearing a hat and a neon vest. He was able to share so much knowledge with us about each stop, which was very helpful. All three stops were interesting and well worth seeing, and it was nice to get out of the city for a day. I highly recommend this tour!

We recently took this trip with our 2 teenage sons and had an excellent day. The tour was well organized and provided a good taste of all 3 locations. The best part of the day was our tour guide = Oliver who took us on a fascinating trip through British History. We all ended the day smarter and having had tons of fun. Hats off to Tom our fearless driver.
An unbelievable experience that pictures cannot do justice. This really puts in perspective our place in the world.
One of y favorite tourist location from United Kingdom. The tour leader was the best and his narrations are very exciting.

We booked Stonehenge, Windsor Castle, Bath including pub lunch in medieval village of Lacock one day tour. 2 adults and 1 child 414,19$ included transport, admission to Stonehenge and Windsor Castle, lunch, some free time at Bath. Not included hotel drop off or pick-up.
A long day but we saw so many beautiful places! We had enough time for Windsor and Stonehenge visit, we had a nice british lunch and time to walk about in Lacock. We could have spent more time in Bath but we have arrived a little bit late because of some asiatic tourists (they forget to come back in time after visiting Windsor -not so nice but our guide managed to resolve it)
Unfortunately, because of delay, only Christmas market was still opened in Bath and everything else closed or almost. We had an hour to walk around and I chose to see Jane Austen places.
Our guide was very good, passionate, organized and friendly. The driver did and excellent job.
We took a lot of beautiful and spectacular pictures and my son was very impressed by every sight.
We highly recommend this tour if you want to see many interesting things and places in one special day.
It is worth it!

Our guide and driver were just great. It started as a wet windy day, but turned sunny by the time we reached Windsor. Just enough information with quirky trivia along the way. Our group was good about timing to get back on board and no smelly foods. Good suggestions for side sights to visit and eating joints, also places that didn't object to bathroom visits. Would definitely suggest the operation for someone else to use.

Highly recommend this day trip from Evan Evans Tours and our guide Mark Watterston and driver Michelangelo. The guide had interesting anecdotes, was fluently bilingual and kept the group timing on track. Windsor Castle was beautiful and the town looked quite interesting as well. Could easily have spent a full day there alone but quite excited to see Stonehenge for the first time. The museum in Bath was interesting and our guide hustled us in quickly to maximize free time for the Christmas Market. The Bath Christmas Market had a wide variety of locally made goods, food and drink. Wonderful day. A word of caution for summer travelers, entry lines during peak season are much longer so it may be better to break the outings into more than one day during summer to have enough time to experience each place.

We did a private tour for 6 people. Our guide Linton was terrific. Very knowledgeable, pleasant, and was able to get us to the destinations in spite of some traffic headaches. He knew how to maneuver. As others have mentioned, however, it is a long day and you don't necessarily have as much time as you'd like in each spot. We got to Windsor as it was opening and its lovely. Very glad we had the chance to see it; caught the Changing of the Guard there at 11 am. Would have loved to have more time in the village there. Next we were on to Stonehenge. Interesting but remote. Finally we went to Bath where we grabbed a quick bite in a local pub and toured the Roman baths. Very busy in the town as the Christmas market was open. Again wished we had more time. But the guide made it a smooth and enjoyable day. Dry weather helped!
